content_cn: 荧光标记核酸碱基识别测序方法是一种利用荧光标记的核苷酸(dNTPs)来识别DNA或RNA序列中的碱基的技术。荧光标记：特定的核苷酸(dNTPs)被标记上不同的荧光分子，每种荧光分子在受到特定波长的光激发时会发出特定颜色的光。测序反应：在测序过程中，DNA聚合酶催化dNTPs在模板链上逐个添加到正在合成的DNA链上。只有与模板链碱基配对正确的dNTPs才能被添加到合成链上。碱基识别：当一个荧光标记的dNTP被添加到合成链上时，它会发出特定的荧光信号。通过检测这些信号，可以识别出合成链上新添加的碱基类型。信号采集：使用高分辨率成像系统来采集每个合成周期中发出的荧光信号。数据处理：荧光信号被转换成电信号，然后通过特定的软件进行分析，将信号转换为数字信息，从而确定DNA链上的碱基序列。循环过程：上述过程在每个待测位点重复进行，直到整个目标序列被测定。

content_cn: 倍性是指细胞或生物体基因组中同源染色体组的数量(指定为n)。例如，具有一组染色体的细胞或生物体被称为单倍体(monoploid)。具有两组同源染色体(2n)的细胞或生物体被称为二倍体。多倍体是其中一个或多个细胞(例如胚胎、后代或生物体)拥有两个以上完整的单倍体(haploid)染色体组的状态。单倍体(haploid)是指具有生物体通常完整的体细胞染色体组一半的细胞。例如，配子或生殖(性)细胞，如人类的卵子和精子细胞，是单倍体。受精过程中单倍体配子的融合产生二倍体合子，其中包含一组来自雌配子的同源染色体和一组来自雄配子的同源染色体。具有正常数量的常染色体(22个)和单个性染色体对(XX或XY)的人类胚胎被称为整倍体胚胎。因此，对于人类，整倍体状态是二倍体。在本文的各种实施例中，短语“所有染色体”可以包括所有常染色体和性染色体。在本文的各种实施例中，短语“所有染色体”不包括性染色体。

content_cn: 身份验证是证明或用于证明系统用户是被授权访问系统的人的过程。 通常,用户身份验证需要进行特殊的合法性测试。 这种测试的早期形式是随着诸如信用卡之类的身份证的出现而出现的,其带有被识别为可以访问系统的人的识别号码ID。 该卡将由系统输入处的读卡器读取,并与 ID 值表进行比较,以验证系统的潜在用户。 然而,鉴于 ID 经常被压印并且卡很容易丢失或被复制,因此该测试的价值有限。 因此,为了提供更安全的身份验证,有必要提供额外的证据,证明出示身份证的人是被授权持有该卡并访问信息系统的人。 这是通过向系统的授权用户提供用于进入系统的记忆密码PW以及用户ID来实现的。 有效密码表存储在主机数据处理系统中并且可由用户ID访问。 在该认证装置中,在系统的输入终端处读取ID卡,并且还手动输入所存储的PW,将组合发送到主机系统。 在主机系统处,根据用户ID从表中访问存储的PW,然后与从终端接收到的PW进行比较以验证系统的用户。

content_cn: 水刺无纺布是将高压微细水流喷射到一层或多层纤维网上，使纤维相互缠结在一起，从而使纤网得以加固，得到的织物即为水刺无纺布；其加工的纤维原料种类广泛，可以是涤纶、锦纶、丙纶、粘胶纤维等。水刺法加固纤网原理与针刺工艺相似，但不用刺针，而是采用能够通过高压产生的多股微细水射流的水刺机喷射纤网，水射流穿过纤网后，受托持网帘的反弹，再次穿插纤网，使得纤网中纤维在不同方向高速水射流穿插的水力作用下，产生位移、穿插、缠结和抱合，从而使纤网得到复合加固。传统的水刺工艺加工复合无纺布，多是对同类型纤维网的多层复合加固，制得的复合面料功能和触感较为单一，在针对面料的强度和舒适度都具有一定需求的领域，现有技术制得的复合水刺无纺布面料性能更是无法满足使用要求。

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种用于生产固体剂型的工艺。它包括以下步骤:将至少一种聚合粘合剂、至少一种活性组分(如果需要的话)和常规添加剂(如果需要的话)进行混合以形成一种塑性混合物,聚合粘合剂使用带有磺基的聚酰胺。
content_en: The present invention relates to a process for producing solid dosage forms by mixing at least one polymeric binder, where appropriate at least one active ingredient and, where appropriate, conventional additives to form a plastic mixture, using polyamides with sulfonate groups as polymeric binder.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种灭火颗粒改性剂，主要解决现有技术中泡沫灭火剂不能短时间内全面覆盖或泡沫不断被油罐火燃烧耗尽的问题。本发明通过采用一种灭火颗粒改性剂，将灭火颗粒进行疏水疏油表面改性处理，改性剂为含有烷基或酰胺基或磺酰胺基阳离子氟碳表面活性剂；助溶剂为醇类、醚类中的至少一种；活化剂为氢氧化钠或氢氧化钾溶液；阳离子氟碳表面活性剂的质量百分含量为5％‑25％；助溶剂质量百分含量为15％‑25％；活化剂质量百分含量为10％‑30％的技术方案较好地解决了上述问题，可用于扑救油罐类火灾中。
content_en: The invention relates to a fire-extinguishing particle modifier, and mainly solves the problem that a foam fire-extinguishing agent cannot comprehensively cover in a short time or foam is continuously combusted and exhausted by the fire of oil tanks in the prior art. The problem is solved well through adopting the technical scheme that the fire-extinguishing particle modifier is adopted, hydrophobic and oleophobic surface modification treatment is carried out on fire-extinguishing particles, and the modifier is a cationic fluorocarbon surfactant containing alkyl group or amide group or sulfamide group; a cosolvent is at least one of alcohols and ethers; an activator is sodium hydroxide solution or potassium hydroxide solution; the mass percentage content of the cationic fluorocarbon surfactant is 5%-25%; the mass percentage content of the cosolvent is 15%-25%; and the mass percentage content of the activator is 10%-30%. The fire-extinguishing particle modifier can be used for fighting the fire of the oil tanks.

content_cn: 本申请属于家用电器技术领域，具体涉及一种洗鞋机，包括：机壳、洗涤筒、多个鞋架和驱动机构，机壳上设有机门；洗涤筒设置在机壳内，洗涤筒包括底壁和侧壁，底壁上穿设有洗鞋柱，洗鞋柱的外侧套设有刷毛盘；刷毛盘朝向机门的一侧设有盘刷，机门朝向洗涤筒的一侧设有门刷，门刷和盘刷沿洗鞋柱的轴向相对设置；多个鞋架可转动的设置在洗涤筒内，且沿洗涤筒的轴向，鞋架位于门刷和盘刷之间；驱动机构与刷毛盘相连接，用于驱动刷毛盘沿洗鞋柱的轴向移动，以调节盘刷与鞋架之间的距离。通过上述设置，本申请可根据不同鞋子的长度，调节盘刷与鞋架之间的距离，以贴合鞋子的表面，从而使得洗鞋机能够适用于清洗不同长度的鞋子。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of household appliances, and particularly relates to a shoe washing machine which comprises a machine shell, a washing cylinder, a plurality of shoe racks and a driving mechanism, and a machine door is arranged on the machine shell; the washing cylinder is arranged in the machine shell and comprises a bottom wall and a side wall, a shoe washing column is arranged on the bottom wall in a penetrating mode, and the outer side of the shoe washing column is sleeved with a bristle disc; a disc brush is arranged on the side, facing the machine door, of the bristle disc, a door brush is arranged on the side, facing the washing cylinder, of the machine door, and the door brush and the disc brush are oppositely arranged in the axial direction of the shoe washing column. The plurality of shoe racks are rotatably arranged in the washing cylinder, and are positioned between the door brush and the disc brush along the axial direction of the washing cylinder; the driving mechanism is connected with the bristle disc and used for driving the bristle disc to move in the axial direction of the shoe washing column so as to adjust the distance between the disc brush and the shoe rack. Through the arrangement, the distance between the disc brush and the shoe rack can be adjusted according to the lengths of different shoes so that the disc brush can be attached to the surfaces of the shoes, and therefore the shoe washing machine can be suitable for washing the shoes of different lengths.

content_cn: 本申请实施例提供了一种计算血压的装置和电子设备，该装置包括：提取模块，用于从脉搏波中提取特征参数，所述特征参数包括时域特征参数、小波域特征参数、傅里叶变换域特征参数和希尔伯特变换域特征参数；生成模块，与所述提取模块连接，用于根据所述特征参数中的训练数据的误差，对所述训练数据及弱预测器的权重进行调整形成强预测器；输出模块，与所述生成模块连接，用于将所述特征参数输入所述强预测器以输出血压。本申请实施例提供的一种计算血压的装置和电子设备能够实时连续地计算出被试者的血压。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a blood pressure calculation device and an electronic device, and the blood pressure calculation device comprises an extraction module which is used for extracting feature parameters from a pulse wave, and the feature parameters comprise a time domain feature parameter, a wavelet domain feature parameter, a Fourier transform domain feature parameter and a Hilbert transform domain feature parameter; a generation module is connected with the extraction module and is used for adjusting the training data and the weight of the weak predictor according to theerror of the training data in the characteristic parameters to form a strong predictor; and an output module is connected with the generation module and is used for inputting the characteristic parameters into the strong predictor so as to output the blood pressure. According to the blood pressure calculating device and the electronic device, the blood pressure of the testee can be continuously calculated in real time.

content_cn: 本实用新型是一种豆浆机，包括有杯体(1)、安装在杯体(1)底部的导热板(2)、安装在导热板(2)底部的发热管(4)，其中所述发热管(4)外圈端部A与导热板(2)的几何中心O的连线AO与发热管(4)内圈端部的几何中心线BC相交。本实用新型由于采用发热管外圈端部与其中心O的连线与发热管内圈端部几何中心相交的结构，因此，发热管可以做得更长一些，这样不仅增大了发热管的有效发热面积，而且发热管发热均匀，另外，导热板不受固定夹限制，导热板可以做得更大一些，使热量传递更加均匀，本实用新型发热管通电发热后，能够使杯体底部各个区域的温度比较平均，避免了加工绿豆、米糊等食品容易糊底的问题，使得用户清洗豆浆机更加方便。
content_en: The utility model relates to a soymilk machine, which comprises a cup body (1), a heat conduction plate (2) and a heating pipe (4), wherein the heat conduction plate (2) is arranged at the bottom partof the cup body (1); the heating pipe (4) is arranged at the bottom part of the heat conduction plate (2); and the connecting line AO from the end part A of the outer ring of the heating pipe (4) tothe geometrical center O of the heat conduction plate (2) is intersected with the geometrical center line BC of the end part of the inner ring of the heating pipe (4). In the utility model, by adopting the structure that the connecting line from the end part of the outer ring of the heating pipe and the center O of the heating pipe is intersected with the geometrical center of the end part of theinner ring of the heating pipe, the heating pipe can be longer, thereby not only enlarging the effective heating area of the heating pipe, but also leading the uniform heating of the heating pipe; inaddition, the heat conduction plate is not limited by a fixing clamp and can be bigger, therefore, the heat transfer can be more uniform. After being electrified for heating, the heating pipe can leadthe temperature at each area of the bottom part of the cup body to be uniform, thereby avoiding the problem that the foods such as mung bean porridge, rice cereal and the like are not easy to be stuck with the bottom of the soymilk machine, so that the soymilk machine can be cleaned more conveniently by a user.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种电饭煲，其包括：煲体；煲盖，煲盖可枢转地设在煲体上以打开或关闭煲体，其中在煲盖打开煲体且煲盖位于最大打开位置时煲盖相对煲体可分离；第一导向件，第一导向件设在煲体上；第二导向件，第二导向件设在煲盖上且与第一导向件适配以防止煲盖相对煲体晃动。根据本实用新型的电饭煲通过设置设在煲体上的第一导向件可以限制设在煲盖上的与第一导向件适配的第二导向件的移动，从而可以限制煲盖相对于煲体在开合盖旋转平面以外的方向上的位移和旋转，这样可以有效地防止煲盖相对煲体晃动，保证开合盖的稳定性和准确性，实用性好。
content_en: The utility model discloses an electric cooker which comprises a cooker body, a cooker cover, a first guide piece and a second guide piece. The cooker cover is arranged on the cooker body in a pivoted mode to open or close the cooker body, wherein when the cooker cover is opened and the cooker cover is located at the maximum opening position, the cooker cover can be separated from the cooker body. The first guide piece is arranged on the cooker body. The second guide piece is arranged on the cooker cover and adaptive to the first guide piece to prevent the cooker cover from swinging relative to the cooker body. According to the electric cooker, the first guide piece arranged on the cooker body can limit moving of the second guide piece which is arranged on the cooker cover and adaptive to the first guide piece, the displacement and rotation of the cooker cover in other directions besides the cover opening and closing rotation plane relative to the cooker body can be limited, in this way, the situation that the cooker cover swings relative to the cooker body can be prevented effectively, the stability and accuracy of opening and closing of the cover are guaranteed, and practicability is high.

content_cn: 本发明是一种电热锅。包括本体、内锅、锅盖，锅盖和内锅之间或者锅盖上设有蒸汽通道，本体在对应于蒸汽通道的位置上固定有感温装置，感温装置包括基座、销轴、旋转组件、感温元件和升降杆，基座固定在本体上，升降杆装设在基座上，并能沿基座所设的滑道上下移动，且升降杆的上端与内锅的锅缘下方位置相对应，销轴固定在基座上，感温元件装设在旋转组件的上端，且感温元件的安装位置与蒸汽通道的位置相对应，旋转组件的下端铰装在销轴上，且旋转组件的下端设有能绕销轴转动及与升降杆联动的连杆。本发明的感温装置能准确感知排出蒸汽的温度，且方便用户操作锅盖和内锅，方便锅盖的开合及清洗，结构简单，成本低，适用于锅盖与本体分离的电热锅产品。
content_en: The invention relates to an electric heating pan. The electric heating pan comprises a body, an inner pan and a pan lid, wherein a steam channel is arranged between the pan lid and the inner pan or on the pan lid; a temperature sensing device is fixed at the position, corresponding to the steam channel, of the body; the temperature sensing device comprises a base, a pin shaft, a rotating component, a temperature sensing component and a lifting rod; the base is fixed on the body; the lifting rod is arranged on the base and can move along a sliding way which the base is provided with up and down; the upper end of the lifting rod corresponds to the lower position of the pan edge of the inner pan; the pin shaft is fixed on the base; the temperature sensing component is arranged at the upper end of the rotating component; the mounting position of the temperature sensing component corresponds to the position of the steam channel; the lower end of the rotating component is hinged on the pin shaft; and a connecting rod which can rotate around the pin shaft and is linked with the lifting rod is arranged at the lower end of the rotating component. A temperature sensing device can sense the temperature of the exhausted steam accurately, facilitates operation of the pan lid and the inner pan by a user, facilitates opening/closing and washing of the pan lid, has a simple structure and low cost, and is applicable to an electric heating pan product of which the pan lid and the body are separated from each other.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种洗碗设备，包括限定开口的洗碗机桶，洗碗机桶包括第一轮架；能够枢转地与洗碗机桶耦接以覆盖洗碗机桶的开口的门，门围绕第一铰链在用以覆盖洗碗机桶的开口的关闭位置和允许通过开口接近洗碗机桶的打开位置之间铰接，并且门包括第二轮架；中间轮架，当门处于打开位置中时，中间轮架连接第一轮架和第二轮架；以及具有多个轮子的至少一个架子，当将至少一个架子定位在洗碗机桶内的收起位置和不同于收起位置的展开位置之间时，多个轮子中的至少一个轮子接合第一轮架、第二轮架和中间轮架。根据本实用新型的洗碗设备，在展开和/或收起架子时不发生碰撞、延迟或架子的移动。
content_en: The dish washing equipment comprises a dish washing machine barrel with a limited opening, and the dish washing machine barrel comprises a first wheel carrier; a door pivotally coupled with the dishwasher tub to cover the opening of the dishwasher tub, the door hinged about a first hinge between a closed position to cover the opening of the dishwasher tub and an open position to allow access to the dishwasher tub through the opening, and the door including a second wheel carrier; an intermediate wheel carrier connecting the first wheel carrier and the second wheel carrier when the door is in the open position; and at least one shelf having a plurality of wheels, the at least one wheel of the plurality of wheels engaging the first wheel carrier, the second wheel carrier, and the intermediate wheel carrier when the at least one shelf is positioned within the dishwasher tub between a stowed position and a deployed position different from the stowed position. According to the dish washing equipment disclosed by the utility model, collision, delay or movement of the shelf can be avoided when the shelf is unfolded and/or folded.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种电水壶，包括底座、壶体和水位监测系统，其中，壶体可取放地设置在底座上；水位监测系统包括控制器和安全水位探针，控制器设置在底座内；安全水位探针设置在壶体的侧壁上，安全水位探针的检测端伸入壶体内，以形成安全水位检测点；当壶体内的水位达到安全水位检测点的位置处时，安全水位探针反馈水位下限信号给控制器，控制器接受水位下限信号以获知壶体内的水位达到最低安全水位。本发明解决了现有技术中的电水壶以电容法来检测电水壶内的水位，由于电容值随电水壶内的水位变化而实时变化，导致检测到的水位信号为连续信号，无法保证电水壶的水位检测精准性，降低了电水壶的实用性的问题。
content_en: The invention provides an electric kettle, which comprises a base, a kettle body and a water level monitoring system, and is characterized in that the kettle body is detachably arranged on the base; the water level monitoring system comprises a controller and a safe water level probe, and the controller is arranged in the base; the safe water level probe is arranged on the side wall of the kettlebody, and the detection end of the safe water level probe extends into the kettle body to form a safe water level detection point; and when the water level in the kettle body reaches the position of the safe water level detection point, the safe water level probe feeds back a water level lower limit signal to the controller, and the controller receives the water level lower limit signal to know that the water level in the kettle body reaches the lowest safe water level. The electric kettle solves the problems that in the prior art, an electric kettle detects the water level in the electric kettle through a capacitance method, due to the fact that the capacitance value changes in real time along with the change of the water level in the electric kettle, detected water level signals are continuous signals, and the water level detection accuracy of the electric kettle cannot be guaranteed, and the practicability of the electric kettle is reduced.

content_cn: 本实用新型涉及一种烹饪设备，涉及烹饪设备技术领域。本实用新型的烹饪设备，包括壳体，所述壳体内设置有能够转动的转轴，所述转轴上套设有发热体，所述发热体的外形呈叶片形。便于提高热源的自洁能力，并且减少热源和风源所占空间大小，增加风扇的功能多样。
content_en: The utility model relates to cooking equipment, and relates to the technical field of cooking equipment. The cooking equipment comprises a shell, a rotating shaft capable of rotating is arranged in the shell, a heating body is arranged on the rotating shaft in a sleeved mode, and the heating body is in a blade shape. The self-cleaning capacity of the heat source is improved, the space occupied by the heat source and the air source is reduced, and the function diversity of the fan is increased.

content_cn: 本申请提供了一种烹饪器具的控制方法及烹饪器具。该烹饪器具的控制方法包括：获取口感选择信息；根据口感选择信息在基础含水率信息的基础上调整得到目标含水率信息；根据目标含水率信息与米量信息计算理论水量；调整水量至理论水量开始加热。应用本发明的技术方案，可以得出符合用户需求口感的米饭，提高了电饭煲等烹饪器具的烹饪品质。
content_en: The invention provides a control method of a cooking utensil and the cooking utensil. The control method of the cooking utensil comprises the steps that taste selection information is obtained; targetwater content information is obtained by adjustment on the basis of basic water content information according to the taste selection information; a theoretical water amount is calculated according tothe target water content information and rice amount information; and a water amount is adjusted to the theoretical water amount and heating is started. By applying the technical scheme, rice with the taste meeting a user requirement can be obtained, so that the cooking quality of the cooking utensil such as an electric cooker or the like is improved.

content_cn: 本申请公开扫地机器人及其清扫控制方法、控制装置，其中清扫控制方法包括：响应于扫地机器人与障碍物发生碰撞，控制扫地机器人原地旋转，并利用距离传感器对障碍物进行扫描，得到扫描数据与旋转角度之间的映射曲线；利用映射曲线判断障碍物的尺寸是否在预设值以下；响应于障碍物的尺寸在预设值以下，控制扫地机器人绕过障碍物后继续沿原清扫方向前进。响应于障碍物的尺寸在预设值以下，控制扫地机器人绕过障碍物后继续沿原清扫方向前进，从而对于尺寸在预设值以下的障碍物，扫地机器人可以绕过障碍物后继续沿原清扫方向前进，扫地机器人对障碍物周围清扫的同时不改变原来的清扫方向，提高清扫覆盖率、清扫效率及对障碍物周围的清扫能力。
content_en: The invention provides a floor cleaning robot, and a cleaning control method and a control device thereof, wherein the cleaning control method comprises the following steps of responding to the collision occurrence between the floor cleaning robot and an obstacle; controlling the floor cleaning robot to rotate in situ; scanning the obstacle by a distance sensor to obtain a mapping curve between scanning data and a rotating angle; judging whether the size of the obstacle is smaller than a preset value or not by using the mapping curve; and by responding to the result that the size of the obstacle is smaller than the preset value, controlling the floor cleaning robot to bypass the obstacle and then to continuously advance in the original cleaning direction. By responding to the result that the size of the obstacle is smaller than the preset value, the floor cleaning robot is controlled to bypass the obstacle and then to continuously advance in the original cleaning direction, so that forthe obstacle with the size smaller than the preset value, the floor cleaning robot can continuously advance in the original cleaning direction after bypassing through the obstacle; the floor cleaningrobot can clean places around the obstacle under the condition of not changing the original cleaning direction; and the cleaning coverage rate, the cleaning efficiency and the cleaning capability onthe places around the obstacle can be improved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种机身及设有其的清洁设备，机身包括：机体、滚刷及梳理件，滚刷及梳理件均配接于机体，梳理件被构造为用于梳松滚刷的绒毛。本申请中提供的机身及设有其的清洁设备具有较好的清洁效果。
content_en: The invention relates to a machine body and cleaning equipment provided with the same. The machine body comprises a machine body, a rolling brush and a carding part, the rolling brush and the carding part are connected to the machine body in a matched mode, and the carding part is constructed to be used for loosening fluff of the rolling brush. The machine body and the cleaning equipment provided with the same have a good cleaning effect.

content_cn: 公开了一种真空清洁器，该真空清洁器具有防止被引入到抽吸头中的异物在抽吸头向前或向后移动时被分离到抽吸头外部的结构。
content_en: Disclosed is a vacuum cleaner having a structure that prevents foreign matter introduced into a suction head from being separated to the outside of the suction head when the suction head moves forward or backward.

content_cn: 提供了一种洗碗机以及用于控制该洗碗机的方法从而去除保留在洗涤盆的底部和过滤器处的垃圾。在排水循环期间，当洗涤水在叶片位于参考位置时从喷嘴喷射时，叶片的偏转角向后倾斜，并且洗涤水被强有力地喷射到洗涤盆的后壁，使得洗涤水形成为沿着洗涤盆的底板的快速且强的水流，并且当该快速且强的水流沿着洗涤盆的底板流动时保留在洗涤盆的底板上(特别是在过滤器上)的垃圾能够被除去。此外，即使在洗涤循环诸如初步洗涤、主洗涤等期间过量的垃圾堆积在贮水槽的顶端的过滤器而堵塞过滤器的情况下，使用少量水自动地冲洗过滤器；并且通过准确地确定过滤器堵塞还是气泡的产生是由于洗涤水的差的循环引起的洗涤性能退化的问题的原因，可以有效地提高洗涤性能。
content_en: Provided are a dish washer and a method for controlling same so as to remove filth remaining in a bottom and a filter of a washing tub. When a washing water is injected from a nozzle while a vane is positioned in a reference position during a draining cycle, the reflection angle of the vane is tilted backward, and the washing water is injected strongly to the rear wall of the washing tub so that the washing water is formed as a fast and strong water flow along the bottom plate of the washing tub, and as the fast and strong water flow flows along the bottom plate of the washing tub, filth remaining on the bottom plate, especially on the filter, of the washing tub can be removed. In addition, a small amount of water is used to wash the filter automatically, even in a case that an excessive amount of filth is stacked in a filter of an upper end of a sump blocking the filter during a washing cycle such as a pre-washing and a main washing; and a washing performance can be improved efficiently by determining accurately whether filter blocking or bubble generation is a cause of problems for lowered washing performance due to rough circulation of the washing water.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种洗碗机的控制方法、控制装置及洗碗机，该洗碗机的控制方法包括：获取人体感应信号；根据所述人体感应信号获取洗碗机当前的状态参数；根据所述状态参数生成相应的语音信号；根据所述语音信号播放相对应的语音信息。如此设置，在洗碗机工作过程中，如果用户想要获取洗碗机当前的工作状态，可以直接靠近人体感应模块的检测范围，不需要用户进行任何操作，即可直接通过语音信息获取洗碗机具体的工作状态，也不需要用户弯腰或者下蹲查看洗碗机的具体工作状态。并且无需用户通过语音进行控制，从而避免了洗碗机根据用户语音识别错误，导致播报洗碗机的工作状态。
content_en: The invention discloses a control method and control device of a dish-washing machine and a dish-washing machine. The control method of the dish-washing machine comprises the steps of: acquiring a human body induction signal; acquiring current state parameters of the dish-washing machine according to the human body induction signal; generating a corresponding voice signal according to the state parameters; and playing corresponding voice information according to the voice signal. According to the arrangement, in the working process of the dish-washing machine, if a user wants to acquire the current working state of the dish-washing machine, the user can directly get close to a detection range of the human body induction module, the specific working state of the dish-washing machine can bedirectly obtained through voice information without any operation of the user, and the user does not need to bend down or squat to check the specific working state of the dish-washing machine. And theuser does not need to adopt voice control, so that the dish-washing machine is prevented from broadcasting the working state of the dish-washing machine due to user voice recognition error.

content_cn: 本申请提供了一种烹饪设备、一种烹饪设备的控制方法、一种烹饪设备的控制装置和一种可读存储介质。上述烹饪设备包括内胆，内胆包括多个内胆壁板，多个内胆壁板围合出烹饪腔，多个内胆壁板中的至少一个内胆壁板包括多个提升内胆壁板亲水性的微纳米级的微槽结构。
content_en: The invention provides cooking equipment, a control method of the cooking equipment, a control device of the cooking equipment and a readable storage medium. The cooking equipment comprises an inner container, the inner container comprises a plurality of inner container wall plates, a cooking cavity is defined by the inner container wall plates, and at least one of the inner container wall plates comprises a plurality of micro-nano-scale microgroove structures for improving the hydrophilicity of the inner container wall plates.

content_cn: 一种机器人清洁系统和一种机器人清洁系统的灰尘去除方法，能够将安装在机器人清洁器内的第一集尘器移动到停靠站以去除收集在第一集尘器内的灰尘。所述机器人清洁系统包括机器人清洁器，所述机器人清洁器具有开口，收集被吸入的灰尘的第一集尘器通过所述开口被运送到机器人清洁器内和从机器人清洁器运送出；停靠站，机器人清洁器停靠到所述停靠站以便去除收集在第一集尘器内的灰尘；和集尘器移动单元，所述集尘器移动单元将第一集尘器移动到停靠站；所述集尘器移动单元包括致动器，所述致动器包括旋转轴；连接部分，所述连接部分连接到所述旋转轴上；和第一联接部分，所述第一联接部分在径向方向上从连接部分延伸以与第一集尘器连接。
content_en: A robot cleaning system and a method for removing the dust of the robot cleaning system are capable of moving the first dust container installed in the robot cleaner to the stop to remove the dust collected in the first dust container. The robot cleaning system contains robot cleaner with an opening through which the first dust container collecting indrawn dust is transported into and out of the robot cleaner; the stop in which the robot cleaner stops so as to remove the dust in the first dust container; and the dust container moving unit to move the first dust container to the stop.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种餐具洗涤设备。所述餐具洗涤设备，包括洗涤液容纳结构，所述洗涤液容纳结构具有洗涤液容纳腔，所述洗涤液容纳结构还具有液位检测部件、液位提示部件，所述液位检测部件用于检测洗涤液液位，所述液位检测部件与所述液位提示部件电性连接，当所述洗涤液液位低于下限液位时，所述液位检测部件输出第一信号至所述液位提示部件。根据本发明的一种餐具洗涤设备，能够在洗涤液容纳腔中的洗涤液液位低于下限液位时提醒用户，保证了餐具洗涤设备的洗涤效果。
content_en: The invention provides dishwashing equipment. The dishwashing equipment comprises a washing liquid containing structure, wherein the washing liquid containing structure is provided with a washing liquid containing chamber and further provided with a liquid level detecting part and a liquid level indicating part, the liquid level detecting part is used for detecting the liquid level of a washing liquid, the liquid level detecting part is electrically connected with the liquid level indicating part, and when the liquid level of the washing liquid is lower than a lower limit liquid level, the liquid level detecting part outputs a first signal to the liquid level indicating part. According to the dishwashing equipment, a user can be warned when the liquid level of the washing liquid in the washing liquid containing chamber is lower than the lower limit liquid level, thereby ensuring the washing effect of the dishwashing equipment.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种食物料理杯及食物料理机，食物料理杯包括一端开口且中空的杯壳，杯壳上设置有出渣口；出渣嘴，活动地安装在杯壳上，与出渣口导通。该技术方案由于出渣嘴活动地安装在杯壳上，具体地，比如可拆卸地安装在杯壳上或可滑动地安装在杯壳上，从而在包装食物料理杯时，可将出渣嘴向食物料理杯内滑动或将其从杯壳上拆卸下来，以减小食物料理杯的横向面积，从而即能够减小产品的包装盒的面积，以使产品包装的更加紧凑，进而既能够简化产品的包装工序，又能够降低产品的包装成本，同时由于包装后的产品的整体体积较小，因而能够减少运输成本，同时用户在收纳时，也可将出渣嘴向食物料理杯内滑动或将其从杯壳上拆卸下来后再进行收纳，进而能够减少收纳成本。
content_en: The invention provides a food processing cup and a food processor. The food processing cup comprises a cup shell which has an open end and is hollow, and a dreg discharge nozzle, wherein a dreg discharge outlet is arranged in the cup shell; the dreg discharge nozzle is movably mounted on the cup shell and communicates with the dreg discharge outlet. According to the technical scheme, the dreg discharge nozzle is movably mounted on the cup shell, specifically, for instance, the dreg discharge nozzle is detachably mounted on the cup shell or slidably mounted on the cup shell, so that when the food processing cup is packaged, the dreg discharge nozzle can slide towards the inside of the food processing cup or be detached from the cup shell, thus the horizontal area of the food processing cupis reduced, the area of a packing box of a product is reduced, the product is packed more compactly, further, the packaging procedure of the product can be simplified, the packaging cost of the product is also recued, meanwhile, the integral size of the packaged product is relatively small, so that the transportation cost can be reduced, moreover, during storage, a user can slide the dreg discharge nozzle towards the inside of the food processing cup or detach the dreg discharge nozzle from the cup shell for storage, and thus the storage cost is reduced.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种绿色环保农用喷雾油及其制备方法，以济南炼化重质基础油光亮油项目工艺中加氢轻润馏分为原料，通过进一步精密分馏‑‑白土精制—汽提处理，生产出满足绿色环保要求，可达到FDA认证要求的，具有饱和烃含量高、无色、光稳定性和热稳定性均佳、极低硫氮含量、不含芳烃及有害溶剂、馏程范围窄、作用效果好的环保型农用喷雾油产品。
content_en: The invention discloses a green environmental-protection agricultural spraying oil and a preparation method thereof. According to the present invention, the light and wet hydrogenation distillate in the Jinan refinery heavy base oil bright oil project process is used as a raw material, and further precision fractionation-white clay refining-steam stripping treatment is performed to produce the environmental-protection agricultural spraying oil product, wherein the environmental-protection agricultural spraying oil meets the green environmental protection requirement, can meet the FDA certification requirement, and has advantages of high saturated hydrocarbon content, colorlessness, excellent light stability, excellent thermal stability, extremely low sulfur nitrogen content, no aromatic hydrocarbon, no harmful solvent, narrow distillation range, and good effect.

content_cn: 本发明公开了治疗哺乳动物包括人2型糖尿病的药物组合物，特别是含有(R)-7-[3-氨基-4-(2，4，5-三氟-苯基)-丁酰基]-3-三氟甲基-5，6，7，8-四氢-咪唑并[1，5-a]吡嗪-1-羧酸甲酯或其药学上可接受的盐和罗格列酮或吡格列酮或它们药学上可接受的盐的固定剂量组合的药物组合物，制备所述药物组合物的方法和所述药物组合物治疗哺乳动物包括人2型糖尿病的用途。
content_en: The invention discloses a medicinal composition for treating type 2 diabetes of mammals including human beings, particularly a medicinal composition prepared by mixing (R)-7-[3-amino-4-(2,4,5-trifluoro-phenyl)-butyryl]-3-trifluoromethyl-5,6,7,8,-tetrahydro-imidazo[1,5-a]-carboxylic methyl ether or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and rosiglitazone or pioglitazone or pharmaceutically acceptable salts of the rosiglitazone or pioglitazone in fixed dose ratio, a method for preparing the medicinal composition, and application of the medicinal composition to treating type 2 diabetes in mammals including human beings.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种水龙头及具有该水龙头的饮水机。该水龙头包括：水龙头本体，水龙头本体上设置有第一进水口、第二进水口和出水口；密封结构，密封结构设置在水龙头本体内；驱动结构，驱动结构设置成可用于驱动密封结构在第一连通位置与第二连通位置之间移动，在密封结构位于第一连通位置时密封结构将第一进水口与出水口隔断且第二进水口与出水口连通，在密封结构位于第二连通位置时密封结构将第二进水口与出水口隔断且第一进水口与出水口连通。根据本发明实施例的水龙头能够实现不同水路的切换，从而能够减少饮水机上水龙头的数量。
content_en: The invention discloses a tap and a water dispenser with the same. The tap comprises a tap body, a sealing structure and a driving structure. The tap body is provided with a first water inlet, a second water inlet and a water outlet. The sealing structure is arranged in the tap body. The driving structure is capable of driving the sealing structure to move between a first communication position and a second communication position. At the first communication position, the sealing structure partitions the first water inlet from the water outlet and allows communication between the second water inlet and the water outlet; at the second communication position, the sealing structure partitions the second water inlet from the water outlet and allows communication between the first water inlet and the water outlet. According to an embodiment of the invention, switching of different water ways are achieved by means of the tap, and accordingly quantity of the taps needed for the water dispenser is decreased.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种毛巾挂烘机，包括：热风装置，配置成向下吹送温度高于环境空气的热气流；和挂杆，安装成可操作地相对于热风装置枢转，其中热风装置还配置成：当挂杆枢转至预设的第一枢转位置时启动，以向下吹送热气流；当挂杆枢转至偏离第一枢转位置的其他位置时关停，以停止向下吹送热气流。本发明利用挂杆的枢转运动控制毛巾挂烘机开停，具有结构新颖的特点，且毛巾干燥结束后可被用户直观地感知，具有较好的用户体验。
content_en: The present invention provides a towel hanging and drying machine. The towel hanging and drying machine comprises a hot air device configured to downwardly blow hot air with temperature higher than that of ambient air; and a hanging rod installed to be operated to pivot relative to the hot air device. The hot air device is also configured to be started when the hanging rod is pivoted to a first preset pivoted position and downwardly blow the hot air, and to be shut down when the hanging rod is pivoted to other positions away from the first pivoted position and stop downwardly blowing the hot air. The power on and off of the towel hanging and drying machine is controlled by utilization of pivoted motion of the hanging rod, the fact that a towel is dried can be visually perceived by users, and the towel hanging and drying machine is novel in structure and has good user experience.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种浮顶储罐电荷转移装置，包括导电金属板、及弹簧式压力支架。弹簧式压力支架由上部支架、中间支架、及底部支架一体成型为Z字型，弹簧式压力支架的上部支架上设有弹簧，上部支架的末端连接有压力件，压力件顶压在导电金属板上，弹簧式压力支架的底部支架通过螺母与导电金属板固定连接。压力件利用弹簧式压力支架提供的压力将导电金属板压在罐壁上，实现导电金属板和罐壁的大面积紧密贴合。本发明可以减少导电片雷电流泄放过程火花放电的概率，减少和消除现有导电片引起的储罐雷击火灾事故，保障储罐的抗雷击安全运行。
content_en: The invention discloses a floating roof storage tank charge transfer device, which comprises a conducting metal plate and a spring type pressure support frame, wherein the spring type pressure support frame is integrally formed into a Z shape through an upper part support frame, a middle support frame and a bottom support frame, a spring is arranged on the upper part support frame of the spring type pressure support frame, the tail end of the upper part support frame is connected with a pressure element, the pressure element is propped and pressed on the conducting metal plate, and the bottom support frame of the spring type pressure support frame is fixedly connected with the conducting metal plate through a screw nut. The pressure element presses the conducting metal plate onto a tank wall through the pressure provided by the spring type pressure support frame, and the large-area tight pasting of the conducting metal plate and the tank wall is realized. The floating roof storage tank charge transfer device has the advantages that the spark discharge probability in the conducting sheet lightning current discharge process can be reduced, the storage tank lightning stroke fire hazard accident caused by the existing conducting sheet is reduced and eliminated, and the lightning-stroke-resistant safe operation of a storage tank can be guaranteed.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种泡沫装配设备和电饭煲包装生产线。泡沫装配设备包括供料装置、机器人和定位装置，供料装置用于放置待装泡沫，机器人包括驱动臂和与驱动臂连接的泡沫夹具，泡沫夹具具有用于夹取待装泡沫的夹持状态和用于释放待装泡沫的非夹持状态；以通过机器人在供料装置处夹取待装泡沫，定位装置与机器人间隔设置，定位装置包括定位空间和围成定位空间的定位面，定位面用于与待装泡沫贴合以使待装泡沫位于预定位置；以通过机器人带动待装泡沫运动并将待装泡沫释放至定位空间内，并通过机器人在预定位置处再次夹取待装泡沫并将待装泡沫装入包装箱内。本发明的技术方案解决了现有技术中的电饭煲包装生产线的自动化程度低的问题。
content_en: The invention provides a foam assembling device and an electric cooker packaging production line. The foam assembling device comprises a feeding device, a robot and a positioning device, wherein the feeding device is used for placing to-be-packaged foam; the robot comprises a driving arm and a foam clamp connected with the driving arm; the foam clamp has a clamping state used for clamping the to-be-packaged foam and a non-clamping state used for releasing the to-be-packaged foam; the to-be-packaged foam is clamped at the feeding device by the robot, the positioning device and the robot are arranged at an interval, the positioning device comprises a positioning space and positioning surfaces for forming the positioning space; and the positioning surfaces are used for being clung to the to-be-packaged foam to enable the to-be-packaged foam to be in a packing box. The foam assembling device and the electric cooler packaging production line, which adopt the technical scheme, solve the problem that in the prior art, the degree of automation of the electric cooler packaging production line is low.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种蒙脱土/分子筛复合材料的制备方法。通过将蒙脱土与分子筛凝胶混合均匀，然后进行原位晶化，并经过滤、洗涤和干燥制得所述蒙脱土/分子筛复合材料。本发明方法制得的复合材料中，蒙脱土分散在分子筛基质中，分子筛晶粒“生长”在蒙脱土周围，从而得到一种蒙脱土与分子筛有机结合的复合催化材料。本发明使用高活性导向剂与蒙脱土作用，在蒙脱土表面诱导生长出分子筛晶粒，过程简单，分离容易，制得的分子筛复合材料水热稳定性好。本复合材料主要应用于各类催化剂及吸附剂，尤其是加氢方面的催化剂。
content_en: The present invention provides a montmorillonite/beta molecular sieve composite material and its preparing method. The montmorillonite/beta molecular sieve composite material is prepared by evenly mixing montmorillonite with beta molecular sieve gelatin, then processing home position crystallization, and via filtering, washing and drying. In the composite material, the montmorillonite disperses in the base material of the molecular sieve, the molecular sieve crystal grain ''grows'' around the montmorillonite, so the composite catalyzing material organically combined by montmorillonite and molecular sieve are obtained. The invention uses directing agent having high activity act with the montmorillonite, the molecular sieve crystal is induced generation on the surface of the montmorillonite, the preparing method is simple, the easily separating, the molecular sieve composite material has better water-heat stability. The composite material are mainly used for all kinds of catalysts and absorption agents, especially the preparing of hydrogenation catalyst.

content_cn: 一种去除裂解加氢汽油中循环氢液滴和颗粒的装置，包括一反高压闪蒸罐、换热器、一反分液罐、循环压缩机吸入罐、循环氢压缩机、二反高压闪蒸罐和硫化氢汽提塔，还包括分离器，一反分液罐和二反高压闪蒸罐的顶端气相出口分别与分离器的进口相连，分离器的顶端气相出口与所述的循环压缩机吸入罐的进口相连，二反高压闪蒸罐、分离器和循环压缩机吸入罐的底端液相出口分别经控制阀、第七换热器与硫化氢汽提塔的进口相连。本发明对进入压缩机前的带液循环氢混合物进行旋流分离，以除去循环氢混合物中夹带的液滴，消除循环氢压缩机积液现象，同时提高了循环氢的纯度，延长了催化剂的使用寿命，保证了装置的长周期稳定运转。
content_en: The invention discloses a device for removing recycling hydrogen liquid drops and particles in cracking hydrogasoline. The device comprises a reverse high pressure flash tank I, a heat exchanger, a reverse liquid separating tank, a recycling compressor suction tank, a recycling hydrogen compressor, a reverse high pressure flash tank II, a sulfuretted hydrogen stripping tower and a separator, wherein gas phase outlets in the top ends of the reverse liquid separating tank I and the reverse high pressure flash tank II are respectively connected with an inlet of the separator; a gas phase outlet in the top end of the separator is connected with an inlet of the recycling compressor suction tank, and liquid phase outlets in the bottom ends of the reverse high pressure flash tank II, the separator and the recycling compressor suction tank are respectively connected with an inlet of the sulfuretted hydrogen stripping tower through a control valve and a seventh heat exchanger. The device disclosed by the invention has the advantages that a liquid recycling hydrogen mixture before entering the compressor is subjected to hydrocyclone separation, the liquid drops entrained in the recycling hydrogen mixture are removed, a liquid accumulating phenomenon of the recycling hydrogen compressor is eliminated, meanwhile, the recycling hydrogen purity is improved, the service life of a catalyst is prolonged, and the long-period stable operation of the device is guaranteed.

content_cn: 本发明提供了碱性清洗液、酸性清洗液和超滤膜清洗方法，碱性清洗液包括：表面活性剂、非氧化型杀菌剂和水，酸性清洗液包括：活性炭、金属离子络合剂和水，超滤膜清洗方法包括碱洗、酸洗和气擦洗。本发明提供的碱性清洗液和酸性清洗液在高温条件下性能温和，不会对膜本身的物理结构和性能产生影响，所提供的清洗方法能够高效去除残留在超滤膜表面和膜孔内的各类污染物，提高超滤膜的产水通量。
content_en: The invention provides an alkaline cleaning solution, an acidic cleaning solution and an ultrafiltration membrane cleaning method; wherein the alkaline cleaning solution comprises a surfactant, a non-oxidation bactericide and water, and the acidic cleaning solution comprises activated carbon, a metal ion complexing agent and water; the ultrafiltration membrane cleaning method comprises: alkali washing, acid washing and gas scrubbing. The alkaline cleaning solution and the acidic cleaning solution provided by the invention are mild in performance under a high-temperature condition, the physicalstructure and the performance of the membrane are not influenced, various pollutants remained on the surface of the ultrafiltration membrane and in membrane pores can be efficiently removed by the cleaning method, and the water production flux of the ultrafiltration membrane is improved.

content_cn: 公开了一种行驶机器人装置。所公开的行驶机器人装置可以包括：多个悬架，用于吸收由行驶机器人装置在其上行驶的行驶表面施加的冲击；第一驱动部，包括电机并且调节多个悬架的刚度；以及至少一个处理器，用于基于关于行驶表面的状态的行驶表面信息和关于由行驶机器人装置承载的食物的状态的食物信息控制第一驱动部，以调节多个悬架的刚度。
content_en: Disclosed is a traveling robot apparatus. The disclosed traveling robot device may include: a plurality of suspensions for absorbing an impact applied by a traveling surface on which the traveling robot device travels; a first driving part including a motor and adjusting stiffness of the plurality of suspensions; and at least one processor for controlling the first driving portion to adjust stiffness of the plurality of suspensions based on traveling surface information about a state of the traveling surface and food information about a state of food carried by the traveling robotic device.

content_cn: 本申请提出一种自动加料方法、装置、系统、存储介质以及上位机，属于注塑生产领域。所述方法包括：获取供料系统中的料筒的实时水位数据；在所述实时水位数据低于第一预设水位阈值时，生成加料任务，所述加料任务包括：待加入物料信息和实时水位数据；基于所述加料任务向操作设备下发工作指令，以使各操作设备执行相应的操作，完成加料。所述装置包括：供料系统、操作设备、所述操作设备包括：自动行车装置、机械手。本申请避免了人工响应不及时导致加料延迟而影响生产；同时也避免了操作不规范加错料的问题。
content_en: The invention provides an automatic feeding method, device and system, a storage medium and an upper computer, and belongs to the field of injection molding production. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time water level data of a charging barrel in the feeding system; when the real-time water level data is lower than a first preset water level threshold value, a feeding task is generated, and the feeding task comprises to-be-added material information and the real-time water level data; and a working instruction is issued to operation equipment based on the charging task, so that the operation equipment executes corresponding operation, and charging is completed. The device comprises a feeding system and operation equipment, and the operation equipment comprises an automatic traveling device and a manipulator. According to the invention, the influence on production caused by feeding delay due to untimely manual response is avoided; and meanwhile, the problem of wrong feeding due to nonstandard operation is also avoided.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种蒸汽清洗机压力控制方法及系统。其中方法包括：在蒸汽清洗机待机执行补水过程中，检测蒸汽清洗机的加热腔室中的实时补水压力；判断实时补水压力是否大于或等于预设暂停补水压力值，并在判定实时补水压力大于或等于预设暂停补水压力值时，控制蒸汽清洗机暂停补水。其能够在蒸汽清洗机补水过程中，保证蒸汽清洗机加热腔室内的实时补水压力不会过高，降低了蒸汽清洗机出现异常的概率，提高了蒸汽清洗机的安全性。
content_en: The invention provides a steam cleaning machine pressure control method and system. The method comprises the steps of detecting real-time water replenishing pressure in a heating cavity of a steam cleaning machine in the standby water replenishing process of the steam cleaning machine; judging if the real-time water replenishing pressure is higher than or equal to a preset pause water replenishing pressure value; and controlling the steam cleaning machine to pause water replenishing when judging the real-time water replenishing pressure is higher than or equal to the preset pause water replenishing pressure value. The method can guarantee low real-time water replenishing pressure in the heating cavity of the steam cleaning machine in the water replenishing process of the steam cleaning machine, reduces the abnormal probability of the steam cleaning machine, and improves the safety of the steam cleaning machine.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种滤网控制方法，包括：在所述空调器上电时，若当前所述检测模块检测到所述滤网，则基于第一预设角度控制所述步进电机正向转动，以通过毛刷移送所述滤网；在基于第一预设角度控制所述步进电机正向转动的过程中，实时确定所述检测模块是否检测到所述滤网；在确定所述检测模块未检测到所述滤网、且所述步进电机的正向转动角度达到所述第一预设角度时，基于第二预设角度控制所述步进电机反向转动，以通过毛刷回送所述滤网。本发明还公开了一种空调器及计算机可读存储介质。本发明通过对滤网进行移送以及回送，能够确保滤网完全复位，即滤网处于安装良好时的初始位置，进而提高了后续滤网的清扫效率。
content_en: The invention discloses a filter screen control method. The method comprises the following steps: controlling a stepping motor to rotate forward based on a first preset angle if a detection module detects a filter screen at the moment when an air conditioner is powered on, and transferring the filter screen through a hairbrush; determining whether the detection module detects the filter screen ornot in real time in the process of controlling the stepping motor to rotate forward based on the first preset angle; and controlling the stepping motor to rotate backward based on a second preset angle when determining that the detection module does not detect the filter screen and the forward rotation angle of the stepping motor reaches the first preset angle, and returning the filter screen through the hairbrush. The invention also discloses an air conditioner and a computer-readable storage medium. The filter screen control method is capable of transferring and returning the filter screen and ensuring that the filter screen is completely reset, namely enabling the filter screen to be in an initial position when the filter screen is well mounted, so that the subsequent cleaning efficiency of the filter screen is improved.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种清洁冷却装置及机器人切割设备，清洁冷却装置包括：两个安装块，两个安装块之间可拆卸地连接，以共同围成用于供待清理件的一部分通过的开口槽，各个安装块上均设置有液体通道和第一气体通道，液体通道的第一液体出口和第一气体通道的第一气体出口均位于开口槽的槽壁面上；两个喷嘴组件，两个喷嘴组件与两个安装块一一对应地设置，各个喷嘴组件均包括液体喷嘴和气体喷嘴，各个液体喷嘴均安装在相应的安装块上的第一液体出口处，各个气体喷嘴均安装在相应的安装块上的第一气体出口处，以解决现有技术中的对铝压铸件上的浇口进行切割加工的圆锯片的不仅需要进行润滑冷却，还需要人工对圆锯片的锯齿上所附着的切屑进行清理的问题。
content_en: The invention provides a cleaning and cooling device and robot cutting equipment, the cleaning and cooling device comprises two mounting blocks, the two mounting blocks are detachably connected so as to jointly define an opening groove for a part of a to-be-cleaned part to pass through, each mounting block is provided with a liquid channel and a first gas channel, and the first gas channel is communicated with the opening groove; a first liquid outlet of the liquid channel and a first gas outlet of the first gas channel are both located in the groove wall face of the open groove. The two nozzle assemblies and the two mounting blocks are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner, each nozzle assembly comprises a liquid nozzle and a gas nozzle, each liquid nozzle is mounted at the first liquid outlet of the corresponding mounting block, and each gas nozzle is mounted at the first gas outlet of the corresponding mounting block; the problems that in the prior art, a circular saw blade for cutting a pouring gate in an aluminum die casting needs to be lubricated and cooled, and cuttings attached to sawteeth of the circular saw blade need to be manually cleaned are solved.

content_cn: 本申请涉及催化剂制备领域，公开了一种用于制备分子筛的气固反应器以及用于制备分子筛的设备。所述气固反应器包括输料室、混合室和排料室，所述输料室上设置有进料管(1)和进气管(2)，所述排料室上设置有排料管(7)，所述混合室为可旋转的转筒(5)。由于固体物料(分子筛初始物料)随着转筒的旋转而在转筒内部旋转，与以往的固定不动的气固反应器相比，能够与SiCl4气体更加充分地混合接触，固体物料和气体物料充分反应，从而可以明显降低SiCl4用量，提高反应效率，并且分子筛产物的质量差异较小，能够确保产品的性能和使用效果的稳定性，从而分子筛的反应均匀性提高。
content_en: The utility model relates to the field of catalyst preparation, and discloses a gas-solid reactor for preparing a molecular sieve and equipment for preparing the molecular sieve. The gas-solid reactorcomprises a material conveying chamber, a mixing chamber and a material discharging chamber, a feeding pipe (1) and a gas inlet pipe (2) are arranged on the material conveying chamber, a material discharging pipe (7) is arranged on the material discharging chamber, and the mixing chamber is a rotatable rotary drum (5). The solid material (molecular sieve initial material) rotates in the rotary drum along with the rotation of the rotary drum; compared with a conventional fixed gas-solid reactor, the gas-solid reactor has the advantages that the structure is simple; compared with the prior art,the molecular sieve provided by the utility model can be more fully mixed and contacted with SiCl4 gas, and a solid material and a gas material fully react, so that the use amount of SiCl4 can be obviously reduced, the reaction efficiency is improved, the quality difference of molecular sieve products is small, the performance of the products and the stability of the use effect can be ensured, and the reaction uniformity of the molecular sieve is improved.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种焊接装置，用于焊接制冷设备的制冷系统管路，制冷设备具有前侧敞开的储物腔，焊接装置包括：焊枪、图像采集器及图像显示器，焊枪可受操作地伸入储物腔内，以对储物腔后侧的制冷系统管路进行焊接，图像采集器用于对制冷系统管路的焊点进行拍照，以获取焊点图像，图像显示器与图像采集器信号连接，用于显示焊点图像。由此将管路的焊点图像显示在易于观察的外部环境中，使得不易于观察的焊点清晰呈现，从而可提升焊接品质。
content_en: The utility model provides a welding device. The utility model discloses a refrigeration system pipeline for welding refrigeration equipment. The refrigeration equipment is provided with a storage cavity with an open front side; the welding device comprises: a welding unit; the welding gun can extend into the storage cavity in an operable mode so as to weld the refrigerating system pipeline on therear side of the storage cavity, the image collector is used for photographing welding spots of the refrigerating system pipeline to obtain welding spot images, and the image displayer is in signal connection with the image collector and used for displaying the welding spot images. Therefore, the welding spot image of the pipeline is displayed in an external environment which is easy to observe,so that the welding spots which are not easy to observe are clearly presented, and the welding quality can be improved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种氮氧化物吸附材料及其制备方法，取镁源、钛源，分别制成溶液后混匀，强力搅拌同时加入分散剂，调节pH为2～4，得到白色凝胶停止搅拌；将凝胶干燥后在300～500℃进行晶化，产物进行洗涤、过滤；配制含步骤（1）产物、柠檬酸的混合液，将粉末钛硅分子筛加入到该混合液中浸渍，经干燥和焙烧制得吸附材料。本发明方法制备的吸附材料能够促进NO向NO2转化，对NOx具有良好的选择吸附性能。
content_en: The invention relates to a nitrogen oxide adsorption material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: taking a magnesium source and a titanium source, respectively making the magnesium source and the titanium source into solutions, uniformly conducting mixing, intensely conducting stirring, adding a dispersing agent, adjusting the pH value to 2-4, and stopping stirring after white gel is obtained; drying the gel, conducting crystallizing at 300-500 DEG C, and washing and filtering the product; and preparing a mixed solution containing the product in the step (1) and citric acid, adding a powdery titanium silicalite molecular sieve into the mixed solution for dipping, and conducting drying and roasting to obtain the adsorption material. The adsorption material prepared by the method can promote conversion of NO to NO2, and has good selective adsorption performance on NOx.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种液晶显示器切割设备及切割方法，涉及显示器处理设备技术领域，解决了现有技术中存在的采用人工的方式拆卸显示器以回收汞灯管效率相对底的技术问题。该装置包括支撑平台、推压装置、导向夹紧装置以及切割装置，其中，推压装置支撑在支撑平台上且推压装置能沿支撑台的长度方向移动，导向夹紧装置以及切割装置设置在推压装置的下方并支撑在支撑平台上，设置在支撑平台上的液晶显示器能在推压装置的推动下沿导向装置的导向方向向切割装置移动以使切割装置将液晶显示器上含汞灯管的部件切割下来。本发明用于液晶显示器的拆卸。
content_en: The invention provides liquid crystal display cutting equipment and a cutting method, and relates to the technical field of display processing equipment. The technical problem that in the prior art, the efficiency is low due to the fact that a display is disassembled in a manual mode so as to recover mercury lamp tubes is solved. The equipment comprises a supporting platform, a pushing and pressing device, a guide clamping device and cutting devices, wherein the pushing and pressing device is supported on the supporting platform, moreover, the pushing and pressing device can move in the lengthdirection of the supporting platform, the guide clamping device and the cutting devices are arranged below the pushing and pressing device and are supported on the supporting platform, and a liquid crystal display arranged on the supporting platform can move towards the cutting devices in the guiding direction of the guide device under pushing of the pushing and pressing device so as to enable the cutting devices to cut off parts provided with the mercury-containing lamp tubes on the liquid crystal display. The liquid crystal display cutting equipment and the cutting method are used for disassembling the liquid crystal display.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供一种翅片穿管故障的处理装置，包括：检测器，检测翅片导入铜管过程中翅片和/或铜管所受的力，判断是否出现故障；人机界面，显示处理故障的流程供选择；翅片穿管设备，执行所选流程，在流程中翅片穿管设备自动按照流程的预定程序运行解决故障。应用本实用新型的技术方案，将翅片穿管中的力矩故障处理方案通过程序及人机界面变成标准化作业，只需选择一个流程选项，设备就会自动完成不同情况下的故障处理和自动恢复，大大提高了生产效率并避免了人为操作误动作的可能。
content_en: The utility model provides a processing device for a fin tube-threading fault. The processing device for the fin tube-threading fault comprises a detector, which is used for detecting force applied to a fin and/or a copper tube in a process of introducing the copper tube into the fin and for judging whether a fault occurs or not; a man-machine interface, which is used for displaying process flows for processing the fault for selection; fin tube-threading equipment, which is used for executing the selected process flow and automatically runs according to a preset program of the process flow in the process flow to solve the fault. By adopting the technical scheme provided by the utility model and enabling a torque fault processing scheme during fin tube-threading to become standard operation through the program and the man-machine interface, only one process flow option needs to be selected, the equipment can automatically complete fault processing and automatic restoration under different situations, the production efficiency is greatly improved and the possible human misoperation is avoided.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种装袋机，包括：纸张传送机构，纸张传送机构具有用于传送待装袋的纸张的第一摩擦带；袋子传送机构，袋子传送机构具有用于传送待装纸的装料袋的第二摩擦带；开袋装纸机构，开袋装纸机构设置在纸张传送机构和袋子传送机构之间，以将从第一摩擦带上传送的纸张装入从第二摩擦带上传送的装料袋内。本实用新型的装袋机解决了现有技术中的装袋方式效率较低的问题。
content_en: The utility model provides a sack filling machine, include: paper transport mechanism, paper transport mechanism have and are used for the conveying to treat the first friction tape of the paper of bagging -off, sack transport mechanism, sack transport mechanism have and are used for the conveying to wait to adorn the second friction tape of the bag of feeding of paper, open paper mechanism in bags, open in bags the paper establishment of institution between paper transport mechanism and sack transport mechanism to the paper that to follow first friction tape conveying is packed into from the bag of feeding of second friction tape conveying in. The utility model discloses a sack filling machine has solved the lower problem of bagging -off mode efficiency among the prior art.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种钙钛矿/氧化铈型催化剂及其制备方法和应用。本发明的钙钛矿/氧化铈型催化剂，包括活性组分钙钛矿ABO3和载体氧化铈CeO2，所述活性组分钙钛矿ABO3占催化剂总质量的3wt%‑10wt%；所述载体氧化铈CeO2为球形，{220}晶面暴露比例为60%~90%。制备方法如下内容：（1）将硝酸铈溶解在乙醇溶液中加热，然后加入三乙烯四氨；（2）加入氨水溶液调节pH值，进行水热反应，陈化，陈化结束后将固体沉淀过滤、洗涤，干燥和焙烧得到球形氧化铈载体；（3）配制钙钛矿活性组分浸渍液浸渍载体，干燥、焙烧得到催化剂。本发明通过对载体形貌及晶面进行调控，加强活性位‑载体的强相互作用，实现高温烟气中NO高效直接分解，尤其适用于工业炉窑等所产生的高温烟气脱硝。
content_en: The invention discloses a perovskite/cerium oxide type catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The perovskite/cerium oxide type catalyst comprises an active component perovskite ABO3 and a carrier cerium oxide CeO2, and the active component perovskite ABO3 accounts for 3wt%-10wt% of the total mass of the catalyst; the carrier cerium oxide CeO2 is spherical, and the {220} crystal face exposure ratio is 60%-90%. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving cerous nitrate in an ethanol solution, heating, and then adding triethylene tetramine; (2) adding an ammonia water solution to adjust the pH value, carrying out hydrothermal reaction and aging, and after aging, filtering, washing, drying and roasting solid precipitates to obtain a spherical cerium oxide carrier; and (3) preparing a perovskite active component impregnation liquid to impregnate the carrier, drying and roasting to obtain the catalyst. The morphology and crystal face of the carrier are regulated and controlled, the strong interaction between active sites and the carrier is enhanced, efficient and direct decomposition of NO in the high-temperature flue gas is achieved, and the catalyst is especially suitable for denitration of the high-temperature flue gas generated by industrial furnaces and kilns and the like.

content_cn: 一种复合脱碳吸收剂，含有一乙醇胺、活化剂和水，含有或不含有式1化合物，所述的活化剂为式2化合物，式1化合物和式2化合物中，R1-R5均为H或者C原子数为1-5的直链烷基或者环状烷基。本发明提供的复合脱碳吸收剂具有吸收速度快、容量大、再生能耗低的特点。
content_en: The invention relates to a composite decarburization absorbent, which comprises monoethanolamine, an activator and water, and contains or does not contain a compound represented by a formula 1, wherein the activator is a compound represented by a formula 2, and R1-R5 are H or C1-C5 linear alkyl or cyclic alkyl in the compound represented by the formula 1 and the compound represented by the formula 2. The composite decarburization absorbent has characteristics of rapid absorption, large capacity and low regeneration energy consumption.

content_cn: 本发明涉及分子筛制备领域，公开了一种4A分子筛吸附剂的制备方法以及由此制备得到的4A分子筛。该方法包括：1)将4A分子筛基质小球进行焙烧处理；2)将步骤1)得到的焙烧处理后的4A分子筛基质小球进行预湿处理，3)将步骤2)得到的预湿处理后的4A分子筛基质小球与碱性水溶液进行水热晶化处理，其中，所述4A分子筛基质小球含有粘结剂，所述粘结剂为高岭土，步骤1)中，所述焙烧的条件包括：焙烧温度为550℃以上，步骤3)中，所述水热晶化的条件包括：水热晶化温度为85℃以上。本发明提供的4A分子筛吸附剂制备方法制备得到的吸附剂同时具有抗压强度好、吸附容量高等优点，且收率高，非常适用于工业生产。
content_en: The invention relates to the field of molecular sieve preparation, and discloses a preparation method of a 4A molecular sieve adsorbent and a 4A molecular sieve prepared by the preparation method. The method comprises the following steps: 1) roasting 4A molecular sieve matrix pellets; the method comprises the following steps: (1) roasting 4A molecular sieve matrix pellets, (2) carrying out pre-wetting treatment on the roasted 4A molecular sieve matrix pellets obtained in the step (1), and (3) carrying out hydrothermal crystallization treatment on the pre-wetted 4A molecular sieve matrix pellets obtained in the step (2) and an alkaline aqueous solution, the roasting condition is that the roasting temperature is 550 DEG C or above, and the hydrothermal crystallization condition in the step 3) is that the hydrothermal crystallization temperature is 85 DEG C or above. The adsorbent prepared by the preparation method of the 4A molecular sieve adsorbent provided by the invention has the advantages of good compressive strength, high adsorption capacity and the like, is high in yield and is very suitable for industrial production.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种打印机，涉及电子设备技术领域，打印机包括机体和纸盒；纸盒包括盒体、滑动板以及限位组件；滑动板滑动设置在盒体的第一侧壁上，滑动板的一端与限位组件连接，限位组件与第一侧壁形成空间大小可调的存纸空间；滑动板上设置有磁性组件，机体上设置有感应装置；滑动板随限位组件的移动而滑动至不同位置时，感应装置检测到的磁性组件的磁极不同。基于本申请提供的打印机可以检测出纸盒内放置的纸张尺寸。
content_en: The utility model provides a printer, and relates to the technical field of electronic equipment. The paper box comprises a box body, a sliding plate and a limiting assembly. The sliding plate is arranged on the first side wall of the box body in a sliding mode, one end of the sliding plate is connected with the limiting assembly, and the limiting assembly and the first side wall form a paper storage space with the adjustable space size. A magnetic assembly is arranged on the sliding plate, and a sensing device is arranged on the machine body. When the sliding plate slides to different positions along with the movement of the limiting assembly, the magnetic poles, detected by the induction device, of the magnetic assembly are different. Based on the printer provided by the invention, the size of the paper placed in the paper box can be detected.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种储液箱及冷却机，该储液箱包括：箱体，进液管及减压组件，箱体开设有储液腔、进液口、出液口及检压口，进液口、出液口及检压口均与储液腔连通，进液口的高度低于检压口的高度；进液管与进液口连通，进液管的侧壁开设有通孔；减压组件包括取压管及阻挡件，取压管的一端与检压口连通，另一端通过通孔与进液管连通，阻挡件的一端为触发部，另一端为阻挡部，阻挡部设置于取压管内，且阻挡件能够沿取压管的长度方向移动；其中，当触发部受压时，触发部带动阻挡部移动使阻挡部伸进进液管内。该储液箱的箱体不易损坏；冷却机包括上述储液箱，因此该冷却机具备使用寿命长的有点。
content_en: The invention discloses a liquid storage tank and a cooler. The liquid storage tank comprises a tank body, a liquid inlet pipe and a pressure reducing component, wherein the tank body is provided witha liquid storage cavity, a liquid inlet, a liquid outlet and a pressing detecting port; the liquid inlet, the liquid outlet and the pressure detecting port are all communicated with the liquid storage cavity; the height of the liquid inlet is lower than that of the pressure detecting port; the liquid inlet pipe is communicated with the liquid inlet; the side wall of the liquid inlet pipe is provided with a through hole; the pressure reducing component comprises a pressure tapping tube and a blocking member; one end of the pressure tapping tube is communicated with the pressure detecting port;the other end of the pressure tapping tube is communicated with the liquid inlet pipe through the through hole; one end of the blocking member is a triggering part; the other end of the blocking member is a blocking part; the blocking part is arranged in the pressure tapping tube and can move along the length direction of the pressure taking tube; and the triggering part drives the blocking partto move and forces the blocking part to extend into the liquid inlet pipe when being pressed. The tank body of the liquid storage tank is not easy to damage; and with the liquid storage tank, the cooler has the advantage of long service life.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种可调高度的罐箱卸车臂，包括组合卸车臂、支撑机构；组合卸车臂包括通过旋转接头顺次连接的下臂管、内臂管、中臂管、外臂管、金属软管、上臂管；外臂管上设置有可调俯仰角的用来支撑金属软管的支撑组件；下臂管的端部与软管相连；支撑机构包括支撑立柱，支撑立柱的侧面下部设置下支撑件，下支撑件上设置调节丝母；调节丝母与下支撑件进行转动连接；调节丝母的内螺纹孔内螺纹配合调节丝杆；调节丝杆的顶端与下臂管的外壁面固定连接。本发明中设置有支撑机构，当转动调节丝母时，会实现调节丝杆在竖直方向上的直线运动，从而带动下臂管跟随调节丝杆进行竖直方向的直线运动，进而起到调节组合卸车臂整体高度的作用。
content_en: The invention discloses a height-adjustable tank container unloading arm. The height-adjustable tank container unloading arm comprises a combined unloading arm and a supporting mechanism; the combinedunloading arm comprises a lower arm pipe, an inner arm pipe, a middle arm pipe, an outer arm pipe, a metal hose and an upper arm pipe which are sequentially connected through rotary joints; the outerarm pipe is provided with a pitch angle adjustable supporting assembly used for supporting the metal hose; the end part of the lower arm pipe is connected with the hose; the supporting mechanism comprises a supporting stand column, a lower supporting piece is arranged at the lower portion of the side face of the supporting stand column, and an adjusting nut is arranged on the lower supporting piece; the adjusting nut is rotationally connected with the lower supporting piece; an adjusting lead screw is in threaded fit in an internal threaded hole of the adjusting nut; and the top end of the adjusting lead screw is fixedly connected with the outer wall face of the lower arm pipe. According to the height-adjustable tank container unloading arm, the supporting mechanism is arranged, when theadjusting nut is rotated, linear motion of the adjusting lead screw in the vertical direction can be achieved, so that the lower arm pipe is driven to do linear motion in the vertical direction alongwith the adjusting lead screw, and then the effect of adjusting the overall height of the combined unloading arm is achieved.

content_cn: 本实用新型涉及油气管道辅助配件，特别涉及一种排污缓冲装置，包括导流筒和设置在所述导流筒内的过滤筒，所述过滤筒上设置有若干导流孔，所述过滤筒与排污阀连通，所述导流筒远离排污阀的一端设置为敞口结构，通过设置过滤筒对排污阀输出污水进行过滤阻拦，对污水起到缓冲作用，减缓污水输出速度，避免污水喷溅，同时，通过设置在过滤筒外的导流筒进一步减缓污水流出速度，减小污水输出压力，且导流孔中输出污水喷溅至导流筒内壁，在导流筒内壁上汇聚形成液滴滴落，使污水中雾化的泡排液重新液化，避免污水中泡排液的逸散。
content_en: The utility model relates to an oil and gas pipeline auxiliary accessory, in particular to a pollution discharge buffer device, which comprises a guide cylinder and a filter cylinder arranged in the guide cylinder, a plurality of guide holes are arranged on the filter cylinder, the filter cylinder is communicated with a pollution discharge valve, one end of the guide cylinder far away from the pollution discharge valve is of an open structure, and the guide cylinder is provided with a plurality of guide holes. Sewage output by the blow-down valve is filtered and blocked through the filter cartridge, the sewage is buffered, the sewage output speed is reduced, sewage splashing is avoided, meanwhile, the flow guide barrel arranged outside the filter cartridge is used for further reducing the sewage outflow speed and reducing the sewage output pressure, the sewage output in the flow guide hole is splashed to the inner wall of the flow guide barrel, and the sewage output pressure is reduced. Liquid drops are gathered on the inner wall of the guide cylinder and drop, so that atomized foam drainage liquid in the sewage is liquefied again, and the foam drainage liquid in the sewage is prevented from escaping.

content_cn: 一种成像设备，包括：墨盒，用于喷墨；室，具有入口单元和出口单元，所述入口单元吸入当墨从墨盒喷出时产生的雾，所述出口单元放出吸入的雾；空气压力产生单元，连接到室，产生用于将雾吸入到室中和从室中放出雾的空气压力；阀单元，通过在空气压力产生单元中产生的空气压力选择性地打开和关闭入口单元和出口单元。
content_en: An image forming apparatus includes a cartridge which ejects an ink, a chamber having an inlet unit which inhales a fog generated when the ink is ejected from the cartridge and an outlet unit which exhales the inhaled fog, an air pressure generating unit which is connected to the chamber to generate an air pressure to inhale and exhale the fog from the chamber, and a valve unit which selectively opens and closes the inlet unit and the outlet unit by the air pressure which is generated in the air pressure generating unit.

content_cn: 本发明涉及乙烯聚合领域，公开了一种催化剂及制法和调控乙烯聚合动力学行为的方法和应用。所述催化剂包括组分A和组分B，组分A通过以下各组分的接触反应制备得到：氯化镁醇合物载体；含钛化合物；任选的有机铝；给电子体，所述给电子体包括氟代酯类化合物；其中，氟代酯类化合物中氟的取代数量为1‑12个，氟的取代位置位于与羰基相连的α碳上或者芳基环上，和/或，位于与氧原子相连的α和/或β碳上；所述组分B为烷基铝，其中组份B中铝与组分A中钛的摩尔比为5‑500。该催化剂属于速升衰减型的动力学型催化剂，特别适用于乙烯气相聚合工艺，能够通过给电子体酯类化合物中取代基氟原子的个数和位置来调控乙烯聚合的动力学行为。
content_en: The invention relates to the field of ethylene polymerization, and discloses a catalyst, a preparation method thereof, a method for regulating and controlling the dynamic behavior of ethylene polymerization, and an application of the catalyst. The catalyst comprises a component A and a component B. The component A is prepared through a contact reaction of the following components: a magnesium chloride alcohol adduct carrier; a titanium-containing compound; optionally, an organoaluminum; an electron donor, wherein the electron donor comprises a fluorinated ester compound; wherein the substitution number of fluorine in the fluoro-ester compound is 1-12, and the substitution position of the fluorine is located on alpha carbon connected with carbonyl or an aryl ring, and/or located on alpha and/or beta carbon connected with an oxygen atom; the component B is aluminum alkyl, and the molar ratio of aluminum in the component B to titanium in the component A is 5-500. The catalyst belongs to a quick-rise attenuation type dynamic catalyst, is particularly suitable for an ethylene gas-phase polymerization process, and can regulate and control the dynamic behavior of ethylene polymerization through the number and position of substituent fluorine atoms in an electron donor ester compound.

content_cn: 本发明涉及选择性构造的基于单－、二－、三－或多羧酸或其衍生物和单－、二－、三－、四－或多元醇的高度支化或超支化聚酯，涉及制备它们的方法及其用途。
content_en: The present invention relates to selectively constructed highly-branched or hyper-branched polyester based on mono-, di-, tri- or polycarbon acids or derivatives thereof and mono-, di-, tri-, tetra- or polyols, a method for the production thereof, and the application thereof.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种检测军团菌并区分嗜肺军团菌的检测试剂盒，利用TaqMan探针多色荧光PCR技术，选择在16S rRNA基因和mip基因序列位点分别设计军团菌特异性的引物探针和嗜肺军团菌特异性引物探针，对引物探针以及扩增体系进行优化验证，确定扩增效果最优的引物探针序列、引物探针的最优组合、最优扩增体系组分浓度以及试验运行程序，检测过程仅凭不同荧光标记的探针检测就能检测出军团菌并对其中的嗜肺军团菌进行区分；同时本发明还引入了人工构建的内参对照，用于避免检测结果的假阴性。本发明的检测结果稳定可靠，试剂盒使用方便，检测灵敏度高，适合于环境、疾控以及临床中军团菌和嗜肺军团菌的快速检测。
content_en: The invention provides a detection kit for detecting legionella and distinguishing the legionella pneumophila. A TaqMan probe multicolor fluorescence PCR technology is utilized, a legionella specificprimer probe and a legionella pneumophila specific primer probe are respectively designed at sequence tagged sites of a 16S rRNA gene and an mip gene, the primer probes and an amplification system areoptimized and verified, a primer probe sequence with optimal amplification effect, an optimal combination of the primer probes, optimal amplification system component concentration and a test runningprogram are determined, the legionella can be detected only by virtue of different fluorescently-labeled probes in a detection process, and the legionella pneumophila in the legionella can be distinguished; meanwhile, artificially constructed internal control is also introduced and used for avoiding a false negative detection result. The detection kit provided by the invention is stable and reliable in detection results, easy to use, high in detection sensitivity and applicable to rapid detection on the legionella and the legionella pneumophila in environments, disease control and clinic.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种低标号道路沥青增延剂，由以下质量百分比的组分组成：催化油浆提取物86‑92％；改质剂7.2‑13.8％；交联稳定剂0.2‑0.8％。本发明提供了一种低标号道路沥青增延剂，对比传统的采用糠醛抽出油，高标号沥青等软组分调合来改善低标号道路沥青的延度性能时会影响针入度等其它各项性能指标的缺陷，本发明产品不但能在不改变低标号道路沥青产品针入度的情况下显著提升其延度性能指标，而且对低标号道路沥青的其它性能指标不会产生不良影响，甚至对低标号道路沥青的抗老化性能还有一定的改善作用。本发明还公开了上述低标号道路沥青增延剂的制备方法。
content_en: The invention discloses a low-grade road asphalt extender, which consists of the following components in percentage by mass: 86-92% of a catalytic slurry oil extract; 7.2-13.8% of a modifier; and 0.2-0.8% of a cross-linking stabilizer. The invention provides the low-grade road asphalt extender. Compared with the defects that other performance indexes such as penetration and the like are influenceddue to the fact that traditional soft components such as furfural extract oil, high-grade asphalt and the like are mixed to improve the ductility performance of the low-grade road asphalt, this product can not only obviously improve the ductility performance indexes of the low-grade road asphalt without changing the penetration of the low-grade road asphalt product, but also has no adverse effecton other performance indexes of the low-grade road asphalt, and even has certain improvement effect on the aging resistance of the low-grade road asphalt. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the low-grade road asphalt extender.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种泡沫碳基零价铁材料及其制备方法和在可渗透反应墙中的应用，将聚氨酯泡沫和聚酰胺酸等体积浸渍，然后经酰亚胺化处理和高温碳化得到泡沫碳载体，对泡沫碳载体进行亲水化表面改性并负载有机酸铁盐溶液，最后经过高温还原制得泡沫碳基零价铁材料。本发明的泡沫碳基零价铁材料具备较高的比表面积以及较强的吸附功能，用作可渗透反应墙的填料，可有效吸附水中的石油烃，使被吸附的石油烃被有效降解。
content_en: The invention discloses a foamy carbon-based zero-valent iron material and a preparation method and application thereof in a permeable reactive barrier, the foamy carbon-based zero-valent iron material is prepared by the following steps: carrying out equivalent-volume impregnation on polyurethane foam and polyamide acid, then carrying out imidization treatment and high-temperature carbonization to obtain a foamy carbon carrier, carrying out hydrophilic surface modification on the foamy carbon carrier, and loading an organic acid ferric salt solution to obtain the foamy carbon-based zero-valent iron material. And finally, the foamy carbon-based zero-valent iron material is prepared through high-temperature reduction. The foamy carbon-based zero-valent iron material disclosed by the invention has a relatively high specific surface area and a relatively strong adsorption function, and can be used as a filler of a permeable reactive barrier to effectively adsorb petroleum hydrocarbon in water, so that the adsorbed petroleum hydrocarbon is effectively degraded.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种低含蜡烃油的溶剂脱蜡方法，包括：将原油减压馏分段的原料油、石油微晶蜡和脱蜡溶剂混合，冷却至过滤温度，过滤得到滤液和蜡膏，滤液脱除溶剂后，得到脱蜡油；石油微晶蜡的滴熔点在67℃～92℃之间；石油微晶蜡与原料油的质量比为0.005∶1至0.2∶1。采用本发明的方法可以更有效地脱除低含蜡烃油中的蜡，降低脱蜡温差，提高过滤速度。
content_en: The invention relates to a solvent dewaxing method for low waxy hydrocarbon oil. The method includes mixing raw oil of a crude oil vacuum distillate fraction section, petroleum microcrystalline wax and a dewaxing solvent, cooling the mixture to a filtering temperature, filtering to obtain filtrate and cerate, and removing the solvent from the filtrate to obtain dewaxed oil, wherein the drop melting point of the petroleum microcrystalline wax is 67 DEG C to 92 DEG C, the mass ratio of the petroleum microcrystalline wax to the raw oil ranges from 0.005:1 to 0.2:1. Though use of the solvent dewaxing method, wax in the low waxy hydrocarbon oil can be more effectively removed, the dewaxing temperature difference can be reduced and the filtering speed can be increased.

content_cn: 本发明涉及油田化学品领域，公开了一种丙烯酰胺共聚物及其制备方法和应用。本发明提供的丙烯酰胺共聚物含有结构单元A、结构单元B和结构单元C，其中，所述结构单元A具有式(1)所示结构，所述结构单元B具有式(2)所示结构，所述结构单元C具有式(3)所示结构，其中，n为0‑6之间的整数；且以所述丙烯酰胺共聚物的总重量为基准，所述结构单元A的含量为85‑95重量％，所述结构单元B的含量为0.5‑5重量％，所述结构单元C的含量为1‑10重量％。该丙烯酰胺共聚物在高温、高矿化度条件下具有较高的粘度，并且能够较低油水表界面张力，具有较好的乳化性能
content_en: The invention relates to the field of oil field chemicals, and discloses an acrylamide copolymer, a preparation method and application thereof. The acrylamide copolymer provided by the invention contains a structural unit A, a structural unit B and a structural unit C, wherein the structural unit A has a structure represented by a formula (1), the structural unit B has a structure represented by aformula (2), the structural unit C has a structure represented by a formula (3), n is an integer between 0 and 6, and based on the total weight of the acrylamide copolymer, the content of the structural unit A is 85-95 wt%, the content of the structural unit B is 0.5-5 wt%, and the content of the structural unit C is 1-10 wt%. The acrylamide copolymer has high viscosity under the conditions of high temperature and high salinity, can lower the oil and water surface interface tension, and has good emulsifying property.

content_cn: 本发明公开一种用于劣质渣油悬浮床加氢裂化的油溶性催化剂。其特征在于本发明的催化剂是Mo、W金属与苯胲及其衍生物反应所得的化合物。催化剂能均匀溶解在重、渣油中，并且在氢气存在下，使含有催化剂的劣质重、渣油通过悬浮床加氢裂化为轻质产品。其目的在于降低催化剂成本的前提下，提高重、渣油悬浮床加氢裂化轻质产品的收率。
content_en: The oil-soluble catalyst is a compound obtained by using metals of Mo and W and making them react with phenylhydroxylamine and its derivative. Said catalyst can be uniformly dissolved in heavy and residual oil, and in the presence of hydrogen gas the poor heavy and residual oil containing said catalyst can be passed through the suspended bed, and hydrogenated and cracked to obtain high product. Said invention is aimed at reducing catalyst cost and raising yield rate of light product.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种连续制备带有至少两个各自独立地选自腈基、羧酸基团、羧酸酯基团和羧酰胺基团的官能团的化合物的方法。本发明方法包括如下步骤：a)在根据a3)的适合用作加成催化剂且对反应混合物呈均相的化合物存在下加成两种带有制备根据a1)的含有至少两个官能团的化合物所需的官能团的端烯烃，从而得到一种混合物，该混合物包含：a1)通过两种所述端烯烃的简单加成得到且带有至少两个各自独立地选自腈基、羧酸基团、羧酸酯基团和羧酰胺基团的官能团的化合物，a2)通过上述两种端烯烃的聚加成得到的化合物，和a3)适合作为所述加成的催化剂且对反应混合物呈均相的化合物；b)蒸馏在步骤a)中得到的混合物，得到b1)作为塔顶产物的通过两种上述端烯烃的简单加成得到且带有至少两个各自独立地选自腈基、羧酸基团、羧酸酯基团和羧酰胺基团的官能团的化合物，和b2)包含以下化合物的混合物：b2a)通过两种上述端烯烃的简单加成得到且带有至少两个各自独立地选自腈基、羧酸基团、羧酸酯基团和羧酰胺基团的官能团的化合物，b2b)通过两种上述端烯烃的聚加成得到的化合物，和b2c)适合作为所述加成的催化剂且对反应混合物呈均相的化合物；c)借助半透膜分离在步骤b2)中得到的全部混合物或其一部分，得到渗透物和保留物，以使供入步骤c)中的混合物的组分b2b)与组分b2c)的重量比小于保留物中的该重量比的方式进行；d)将在步骤c)中得到的渗透物部分或全部再循环到步骤a)中，和e)将在步骤b2)中得到且尚未在c)中分离的那部分混合物部分或全部再循环到步骤a)中。
content_en: The present invention provides a process for continuously preparing a compound which bears at least two functional groups which are each independently selected from the group consisting of nitrile group, carboxylic acid group, carboxylic ester group and carboxamide group, comprising the steps of a) adding two terminal olefins which bear the functional groups required to prepare the compound as per a1) containing at least two functional groups, in the presence of a compound as per a3) which is suitable as a catalyst for this addition and is homogeneous with respect to the reaction mixture to obtain a mixture comprising a1) a compound which is obtained by monoaddition of the two terminal olefins mentioned and bears at least two functional groups which are each independently selected from the group consisting of nitrile group, carboxylic acid group, carboxylic ester group and carboxamide group, a2) a compound which is obtained by polyaddition of the two terminal olefins mentioned and a3)the compound which is suitable as a catalyst for this addition and is homogeneous with respect to the reaction mixture, b) distilling the mixture obtained in step a) to obtain b1) the compound which is obtained by monoaddition of the two terminal olefins mentioned and bears at least two functional groups which are each independently selected from the group consisting of nitrile group, carboxylic acid group, carboxylic ester group and carboxamide group, as the top product and b2) a mixture compris.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种含磷水处理剂组合物，该组合物含有福美系杀菌剂、有机膦酸缓蚀剂和含磺酸基的共聚物。本发明还公开了该含磷水处理剂组合物在工业循环冷却水处理中的应用。其水处理性能评估表明，小剂量的该组合物用于水处理时就具有较高的阻碳酸钙垢率、阻锌率和杀菌率以及缓慢的碳钢片腐蚀速率。因此，本发明中的含磷水处理剂具有良好的水处理效果和投药量少含磷低等优点。
content_en: The invention discloses a phosphorus-containing water treatment agent composition. The composition contains a dithiocarbamate bactericide, an organic phosphonic acid anticorrosion agent and a sulfo group-containing copolymer. The invention also discloses an application of the phosphorus-containing water treatment agent composition in industrial circulating cooling water treatment. The water treatment performance evaluation of the phosphorus-containing water treatment agent composition indicates that a small dose of the composition has relatively high calcium carbonate scale inhibition rate, zinc inhibition rate and sterilizing rate and slow carbon steel sheet corrosion rate during water treatment. As a result, the phosphorus-containing water treatment agent has the advantages of excellent water treatment effect, low dosage, low phosphorus content and the like.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种己内酯低聚物的解聚方法，在温度为100-500℃以及绝对压力为0.5-80kPa下，使用解聚剂将己内酯低聚物解聚为己内酯和其它有机副产物。通过这种方法，己内酯低聚物解聚率在84.9%以上，己内酯制得率在65%以上，经济效益明显。且在解聚剂的作用下，将己内酯低聚物解聚成己内酯，变废为宝，环保效益明显。
content_en: The invention discloses a depolymerization method of a caprolactone oligomer. In the method, at a temperature of 100-500 DEG C and under an absolute pressure of 0.5-80 kPa, the caprolactone oligomer is depolymerized into caprolactone and other organic by-products by a depolymerization agent. By means of the method, a depolymerization ratio of the caprolactone oligomer is higher than 84.9% and a yield of the caprolactone is higher than 65%. The method has a significant economic benefit. In addition, by means of the depolymerization agent, the caprolactone oligomer is depolymerized into the caprolactone, thereby turning waste into resources. The method has a significant environmental-protective benefit.

content_cn: 本发明涉及以硅处理的ZSM‑5为核，利用微波合成ZSM‑5/Silicalite‑1核壳分子筛方法。主要解决现有水热法合成核壳分子筛技术中晶化时间长、壳层覆盖度低等问题。本发明通过采用微波作为加热源合成核壳分子筛，先将经过硅油预处理的ZSM‑5核相分子筛与所需硅源、模板剂、碱源与水配成料液，然后通过微波加热晶化合成较高覆盖度的ZSM‑5/Silicalite‑1核壳分子筛的技术方案，较好地解决了该问题。
content_en: The present invention relates to a method for microwave synthesis of a ZSM-5/Silicalite-1 core-shell molecular sieve by using ZSM-5 treated with silicon as a core. A purpose of the present invention is mainly to solve the problems of long crystallization time, low shell coverage and the like in the existing hydrothermal synthesis of core-shell molecular sieves. According to the present invention,the core-shell molecular sieve is synthesized by using microwaves as a heating source, wherein a material liquid is prepared from a ZSM-5 nuclear phase molecular sieve pre-treated with silicone oil, adesired silicon source, a template agent, an alkali source and water, and the ZSM-5/Silicalite-1 core-shell molecular sieve with high coverage is synthesized through microwave heating crystallization. With the technical scheme of the present invention, the problems in the prior art are well solved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及烯烃配位聚合领域，公开了环烯烃共聚物及其制备方法。本发明提供的环烯烃共聚物制备方法包括：在烯烃聚合条件下，在有机溶剂存在下，将环烯烃、非环烯烃、可选的分子量调节剂与式(I)所示的双金属催化剂和烷基铝氧烷接触；本发明还提供了由所述方法制备的环烯烃共聚物。使用本发明的制备方法，聚合活性可高达106g·mol‑1(Ti)·h‑1以上，共聚物的重均分子量在5万至63万之间的范围内进行调节，分子量分布指数在2.0左右，
content_en: The invention relates to the field of olefin coordination polymerization and discloses a cycloolefin copolymer and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the cycloolefin copolymer provided herein comprises: subjecting, in the presence of an organic solvent under olefin polymerization condition, cycloolefins, non-cycloolefins and an optional molecular weight regulator to contact with a bimetal catalyst shown as formula (I) and alkylaluminoxane. The invention also provides a cycloolefin copolymer prepared via the preparation method. The preparation method herein helps increase polymerization activity to 10<6>g mol<-1>(Ti) h<-1>; weight-average molecular weight of the cycloolefin copolymer is adjustable between 50000 and 630000; molecular weight distribution index is about 2.0.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种用于家用电器的水过滤装置及使用其处理水的方法。水过滤装置包括：过滤壳体；放置在所述过滤壳体内的过滤介质块，所述过滤介质块具有空心圆柱形构造，具有辐射通道；放置在所述过滤壳体内的电磁辐射模块，所述电磁辐射模块具有位于所述过滤介质快附近的电磁辐射源。方法包括：向所述过滤壳体的入水口提供水，通过所述过滤介质块的一个或多个壁对水进行初步处理，然后水进入所述辐射通道，由所述电磁辐射源对水进一步处理，最后水从所述过滤壳体的出水口流出。如此设置，能够增强污染物减少性能。
content_en: The invention provides a water filtering device for a household appliance and a method for treating water by using the water filtering device. The water filtering device comprises: a filtering housing; the filtering medium block is placed in the filtering shell, and the filtering medium block is of a hollow cylindrical structure and is provided with a radiation channel; and an electromagnetic radiation module disposed within the filter housing, the electromagnetic radiation module having an electromagnetic radiation source located near the filter media block. The method comprises the steps that water is provided for the water inlet of the filtering shell, primary treatment is conducted on the water through one or more walls of the filtering medium block, then the water enters the radiation channel and is further treated by the electromagnetic radiation source, and finally the water flows out of the water outlet of the filtering shell. Through the arrangement, the pollutant reduction performance can be enhanced.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种由聚亚芳基醚溶液制备聚亚芳基醚珠粒的方法，包括以下步骤：i)将聚亚芳基醚溶液分离成液滴，ii)将所述液滴转移到沉淀浴中，以在沉淀浴中形成聚亚芳基醚珠粒。所述沉淀浴(A)包含至少一种非质子溶剂(组分(1))和至少一种质子溶剂(组分(2))，(B)具有的温度为0℃至Tc，其中临界温度Tc(以[℃]计)通过数字方程式Tc＝(99-c)/0.61测定，其中c为沉淀浴中的组分(1)的浓度，以[重量％]计，以及(C)具有浓度为5重量％至cc的组分(1)，其中临界浓度cc(以[重量％]计)通过数字方程式cc＝99-0.61*T测定，其中T为沉淀浴的温度，以[℃]计，其中重量百分比各自基于沉淀浴中的组分(1)和组分(2)的重量百分比之和计。
content_en: The invention relates to a method for producing polyarylene ether beads from a polyarylene ether solution, having the steps of i) separating the polyarylene ether solution into drops and ii) transporting the drops into a precipitation bath, thereby forming polyarylene ether beads in the precipitation bath.
