The precipitation bath (A) contains at least one aprotic solvent (component (1)) and at least one protic solvent (component (2)), (B) has a temperature of 0 DEG C to Tc, the critical temperature Tc in [DEG C] being determined by the numerical equation Tc = (99 - c)/0.61, in which c is the concentration of the component (1) in the precipitation bath in [wt.%], and (C) has the component (1) in concentrations of 5 wt.% to cc, the critical concentration cc in [wt.%] being determined by the numerical equation cc = 99 - 0.61 * T, in which T is the temperature in the precipitation bath in [DEG C], wherein the wt.% in each case is based on the sum of the wt.% of the component (1) and the component (2) in the precipitation bath.

content_cn: 本发明要解决的技术问题是精馏法提纯聚甲醛二甲基醚过程中物料堵塞精馏塔塔顶难于长期连续生产运转的问题，采用包括如下步骤的技术方案：(a)反应合成单元得到的反应混合物，首先进入第一精馏塔，分离除去主要包含甲缩醛的第一馏分，得到第一塔釜液；(b)第一塔釜液进入萃取单元，与包含有机溶剂和水相的双相萃取剂进行萃取，得到包含n＝2-8聚甲醛二甲基醚与有机溶剂的萃取相，萃余相为包含甲醛的水相；(c)萃取相依次进入第二精馏塔、第三精馏塔和第四精馏塔精馏，分别得到包含有机溶剂的第二馏分、包含高纯度n＝2聚甲醛二甲基醚的第三馏分和包含n＝3-4的聚甲醛二甲基醚的第四馏分。
content_en: The invention solves the technical problem that it is difficult to make a long-term and continuous production and operation in the process of refining polyoxymethylene dimethyl ether through a distillation because the materials and supplies block the top of a distillation tower. The refinement method for polyoxymethylene dimethyl ether utilizes the technical plans which comprise the following steps: (a) a reaction mixture obtained through a reaction synthesis unit firstly enters into a first distillation tower to separate and remove a first fraction which mainly contains methylal to get first tower bottoms; (b) the first tower bottoms enters into an extraction unit to make an extraction with two-phase extraction agents which contain an organic solvent and an aqueous phase to get an extraction phase which contains n=2-8 polyoxymethylene dimethyl ether and the organic solvent, and the extraction phase is the aqueous phase which contains formaldehyde; (c) the extraction phase successively enters into a second distillation tower, a third distillation tower and a fourth distillation tower to respectively get a second fraction which contains the organic solvent, a third fraction which contains n=2 polyoxymethylene dimethyl ether of high purity and a fourth fraction which contains n=3-4 polyoxymethylene dimethyl ether.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种具有通式(II)的2-环烷基-3-仲烷基-2-氰基丁二酸酯类化合物，及其制备方法，用本发明的化合物为作烯烃聚合催化剂含钛固体催化剂组分的内给电子体合成的催化剂其催化剂性能优良，不仅对丙烯聚合的活性高，聚合物等规度好，而且分子量分布宽。催化剂综合性能优于文献报道的以2，3-二烃基的琥珀酸酯类化合物或ω-氰基的C2～C5一元酸酯类化合物为内给电子体的催化剂。
content_en: The invention relates to 2-cycloalkyl-3-secondary alkyl-2-cyansuccinate compounds with a general formula represented by formula (II) and a preparation method thereof. A catalyst which is synthesized by treating the compounds as an internal electron donor of a titanium-contained solid catalyst component of an olefin polymerization catalyst has excellent performances and has a high activity on the propylene polymerization, the isotacticity degree of obtained polymers is good, and the molecular weight distribution of the obtained polymers is wide. Comprehensive performances of the catalyst in the invention are better than comprehensive performances of catalysts which treat 2,3-dialkylsuccinate compounds or omega-cyan C2-C5 monobasic ester compounds as the internal electron donor and have been reported by literatures.

content_cn: 本发明涉及炼厂污油回炼领域，公开了一种污油处理剂及其应用和污油回炼的方法。所述污油处理剂包含氧化剂、螯合剂、润湿剂、脱金属剂、相转移剂和溶剂；其中，所述脱金属剂选自有机酸和/或酯，所述润湿剂为聚醚改性硅油。本发明的污油处理剂和破乳剂的化学作用即可实现电脱盐装置的平稳运行，达到良好的破乳脱盐脱金属效果，为后续加工装置提供合格的原料。
content_en: The invention relates to the field of refinery effluent oil recycling, and discloses an effluent oil treating agent, application thereof and a method for recycling effluent oil. The effluent oil treating agent comprises an oxidizing agent, a chelating agent, a wetting agent, a demetallizing agent, a phase transfer agent and a solvent, wherein the demetallizing agent is selected from organic acidsand/or esters; and the wetting agent is polyether modified silicone oil. The stable operation of an electric desalting device can be realized through the chemical actions of the effluent oil treatingagent and a demulsifying agent, good effects of demulsification, desalting and demetallization are achieved, and a qualified raw material is provided for a subsequent processing device.

content_cn: 本发明提出了一种铅化合物及其制备方法、用途和包含该铅化合物的润滑油组合物。本发明的铅化合物，其结构如式(I)所示：式(I)中的A基团选自式(II)所示的基团和/或式(III)所示的基团；在式(II)中，R0基团为C1～6的直链或支链亚烷基；x为0～4之间的整数，x个R1基团各自独立地选自C2～40的直链或支链烷基；环基团为(x+1)价的C3～20的环烷基团，环基团为1～5环的环烷基团；在式(III)中R2基团为C2～30的直链或支链烷基。本发明的铅化合物具有优异的油溶性、抗磨性、减摩性、抗氧化性，是一种性能优异的抗磨剂，能够用于车辆齿轮、工业齿轮、空间运动部件的润滑和其它机械部件传动的润滑。
content_en: The invention provides a lead compound, a preparation method and application thereof and a lubricating oil composition containing the lead compound. The structure of the lead compound is shown as a formula (I), wherein a group A in the formula (I) is selected from a group shown as a formula (II) and/or a group shown as a formula (III); in the formula (II), the R0 group is a straight chain or branched chain alkylene group of C1-6; x is an integer between 0 and 4, and x R1 groups are respectively and independently selected from C2-40 straight-chain or branched-chain alkyl groups; the ring group is a (x + 1)-valence C3-20 cycloalkyl group, and the ring group is a 1-5-ring cycloalkyl group; and in the formula (III), the R2 group is a C2-30 straight chain or branched chain alkyl group. The lead compound has excellent oil solubility, wear resistance, friction reduction and oxidation resistance, is an anti-wear agent with excellent performance, and can be used for lubrication of vehicle gears, industrial gears and space moving parts and lubrication of transmission of other mechanical parts.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种制备环氧苯乙烷的方法，该方法包括：S1、以纳米碳材料为催化剂，进行乙苯直接脱氢反应，将得到的直接脱氢反应后的混合物进行气液分离，得到气相产物和液相产物；S2、在钛硅催化剂及可选的溶剂存在下，使所述液相产物与过氧化氢接触进行环氧化反应。本发明的方法由乙苯制备环氧苯乙烷，且具有较高的乙苯转化率和环氧苯乙烷选择性。
content_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing styrene oxide, which comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out ethylbenzene direct dehydrogenation reaction by using a nano carbon material as a catalyst, and carrying out gas-liquid separation on the obtained mixture after the direct dehydrogenation reaction to obtain a gas-phase product and a liquid-phase product; and S2, in the presence of a titanium-silicon catalyst and an optional solvent, contacting the liquid-phase product with hydrogen peroxide to carry out epoxidation reaction. According to the method provided by the invention, styrene oxide is prepared from ethylbenzene, and the method has relatively high ethylbenzene conversion rate and styrene oxide selectivity.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种柴油深度脱硫组合方法。新鲜柴油进料进入混氢罐混氢，溶氢后的柴油进入液相加氢反应器进行精制反应；所得精制流出物进入高温低压闪蒸罐进行闪蒸，得到液相重馏分；部分重馏分循环回混氢罐，部分重馏分进行氧化脱硫，氧化脱硫后重馏分与闪蒸所得轻馏分混合并经分离得到柴油产品。本发明方法中，液相加氢在缓和条件下脱除柴油进料中的简单硫化物；经过闪蒸后，循环的重馏分继续进行加氢脱硫，并选择性的对剩余重馏分进行氧化脱硫，可以实现柴油的深度脱硫。本发明方法充分利用加氢脱硫和氧化脱硫的优点，装置投资及操作费用降低，能耗减少，可以满足柴油深度脱硫生产清洁柴油的需求。
content_en: The invention discloses a deep desulphurization combination method of diesel oil, comprising the following steps of: allowing fresh diesel oil feedstock to enter a hydrogen mixing pot for hydrogen mixing, allowing diesel oil dissolved in hydrogen to enter a liquid phase hydrogenation reactor for refining reaction; allowing the obtained refined effluent to enter a high-temperature low-pressure flash tank for flash evaporation so as to obtain a liquid phase heavy fraction; allowing part of the heavy fraction to recycle and return to the hydrogen mixing pot and part of the heavy fraction to undergo oxidative desulfurization, mixing the heavy fraction which has undergone oxidative desulfurization and the light fraction obtained by flash evaporation, and separating to obtain the diesel oil product. According to the method, liquid phase hydrogenation is performed under mild conditions to remove simple sulfide in the diesel oil feedstock; after flash evaporation, the recycled heavy fraction continues to undergo hydrodesulfurization, and residual heavy fraction is selectively subjected to oxidative desulfurization so as to realize deep desulphurization of diesel oil. According to the method, by full utilization of advantages of hydrodesulfurization and oxidative desulfurization, equipment investment and operation cost are reduced, and energy consumption is minimized. Therefore, the method can satisfy the demand of producing clean diesel oil by deep desulphurization of diesel oil.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种丙烯精制方法，包含以下步骤：(1)原料丙烯通过精馏气提塔，精馏气提塔塔顶析出含有轻组分的丙烯物料；(2)精馏塔塔顶析出的轻组分脱H2O、CO2、CO和O2，其中采用铜系催化剂单独脱除CO或者复合脱除H2、CO和O2；(3)精馏汽提塔底物料和上个步骤中得到的塔顶物料混合后，再经脱硫脱砷脱水脱二氧化碳，得到聚合级丙烯。采用本发明所述的方法，能有效脱除丙烯物料中的一氧化碳等多种微量杂质，降低能耗，降低丙烯损失。
content_en: The invention discloses a propylene refining method which comprises the steps as follows: (1) the raw material propylene passes through a rectification gas stripping column, and the top of the rectification gas stripping column precipitates a propylene material containing light components; (2) the light components precipitated from the rectification column top are subjected to H2O, CO2, CO and O2 removal, wherein a copper catalyst is adopted to independently remove CO or compositely remove H2, CO and O2; and (3) after the material on the bottom of the rectification gas stripping column and the material obtained from the column top are mixed, the mixture is desulfurized, dearsenicated, dehydrated and subjected to carbon dioxide removal to obtain the polymer propylene. The method disclosed by the invention can effectively remove carbon monoxide and many other trace impurities in the propylene material, lower the energy consumption and reduce the propylene loss.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种制备含羟基聚合物的方法,特别是一种通过对应的含酰氧基聚合物与醇在含碱金属或碱土金属催化剂存在下进行酯交换来制备带羟端基基团的聚四氢呋喃的方法,包括:适当数量的含酰氧基聚合物与该醇及催化剂被一起引入到第1预反应器(Ⅰ)中,并在其中至少部分地转化为含羟基聚合物,然后,该反应溶液被喂入到蒸馏塔(Ⅱ)的上部区(Ⅱa),另外,在该塔的下部区(Ⅱb)喂入气相的醇。该过程涉及从预反应器转移到蒸馏塔期间连续相与分散相之间的相交换。优选除第1预反应器之外,再采用另外3个作为滞留反应器的预反应器。
content_en: The invention relates to a method for producing polymers containing hydroxyl groups, especially for producing polytetrahydrofuran with terminal hydroxyl groups from the corresponding acyloxy-containing polymers by transesterification with alcohols in the presence of an alkali or earth-alkali-containing catalyst. The corresponding acyloxy-containing polymer is placed into a first primary reactor (I) together with the alcohol and the catalyst and reacted therein at least partly to form the polymer containing the hydroxyl groups. Thereafter the reaction solution is transferred to the top area (IIa) of a distillation column (II) and vaporous alcohol is supplied to the lower area (IIb) of said column. During the transition from the primary reactor to the distillation column a phase change of the cohesive and dispersed phase occurs. In addition to the first primary reactor a further three primary reactors are preferably used which serve as residence-time reactors.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种油井水泥沉降稳定剂及其制备方法和水泥浆，所述油井水泥沉降稳定剂包括纳米管和聚集在所述纳米管表面的活性硅铝氧化物，其中，所述活性硅铝氧化物具有Si‑O‑Al三维网状结构。所述的沉降稳定剂制备方法包括以下步骤：将纳米三氧化二铝和纳米二氧化硅混合均匀，高温煅烧，然后与纳米管混合加入碱溶液中超声分散、改性反应，将所得悬浊液进行抽滤、洗涤、烘干、球磨、过筛后得到沉降稳定剂。以水泥重量为100份计，加入所述的沉降稳定剂0.5～3份，可以显著提高水泥浆的沉降稳定性能。本发明操作简便、原料易得、产物收率高，所得沉降稳定剂能够适应30℃～200℃温度的不同密度的水泥浆体系，可与多种外加剂体系配伍，具有良好的相容性。
content_en: The invention provides an oil well cement settlement stabilizer, a preparation method thereof and cement paste, the oil well cement settlement stabilizer comprises a nanotube and an active silicon-aluminum oxide gathered on the surface of the nanotube, and the active silicon-aluminum oxide has a Si-O-Al three-dimensional network structure. The preparation method of the sedimentation stabilizer comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing nano aluminum oxide and nano silicon dioxide, calcining at a high temperature, then mixing with nanotubes, adding into an alkali solution, carrying out ultrasonic dispersion and modification reaction, and carrying out suction filtration, washing, drying, ball milling and sieving on the obtained turbid liquid to obtain the sedimentation stabilizer. Based on 100 parts by weight of cement, 0.5-3 parts by weight of the settlement stabilizer is added, so that the settlement stability of the cement paste can be remarkably improved. The preparation method is simple and convenient to operate, the raw materials are easy to obtain, the product yield is high, and the obtained sedimentation stabilizer can adapt to cement paste systems with different densities at the temperature of 30-200 DEG C, can be compatible with various additive systems and has good compatibility.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种衣物的洗涤方法、装置、电子设备及存储介质。该方法包括：获取用户输入的预设洗涤时间及待洗涤衣物的衣物信息；根据衣物信息确定待洗涤衣物的第一洗涤参数，第一洗涤参数至少包括第一洗涤总时间；若预设洗涤时间与第一洗涤总时间不相等，则根据洗衣机所在地信息、预设洗涤时间和第一洗涤参数，确定待洗涤衣物的第二洗涤参数，第二洗涤参数至少包括第二洗涤总时间，第二洗涤总时间等于预设洗涤时间；基于第二洗涤参数清洗待洗涤衣物。本发明的技术方案，能够智能化的设定洗涤参数，并结合用户的洗涤需求对洗涤参数进行调整，不仅可以高效、节能的洗涤待洗涤衣物，还可以满足用户的个性化需求，提升用户的使用感受。
content_en: The invention discloses a clothes washing method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining preset washing time input by a user and clothes information of clothes to be washed; determining a first washing parameter of the to-be-washed clothes according to the clothes information, wherein the first washing parameter at least comprises first washing total time; if the preset washing time is not equal to the first total washing time, second washing parameters of the to-be-washed clothes are determined according to the washing machine location information, the preset washing time and the first washing parameters, the second washing parameters at least comprise second total washing time, and the second total washing time is equal to the preset washing time; and washing the to-be-washed clothes based on the second washing parameter. According to the technical scheme, the washing parameters can be intelligently set, the washing parameters are adjusted in combination with the washing requirements of the user, the to-be-washed clothes can be efficiently washed in an energy-saving mode, the personalized requirements of the user can be met, and the use experience of the user is improved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及聚丙烯腈初生纤维制备领域，具体涉及一种凝胶纺丝制备聚丙烯腈初生纤维的方法。通过采用：所述原液中阳离子浓度为0.001～0.1mol/L，所述聚丙烯腈共聚物粘均分子量为12～30万，所述凝固浴温度为‑20～0℃的低级醇的技术方案，在发挥凝胶纺丝技术特点的同时克服了凝胶纺丝原液均一性差纺丝过程容易断头的问题。本发明可以制备得到结构高度均一、无皮芯结构、低结晶度的初生纤维。
content_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of polyacrylonitrile nascent fibers, in particular to a method for preparing polyacrylonitrile nascent fibers through gel spinning. By adopting the technical scheme that the cation concentration in the stock solution is 0.001-0.1 mol/L, the viscosity-average molecular weight of the polyacrylonitrile copolymer is 12-300 thousands, and the coagulating bath temperature is lower alcohol of-20 to 0 DEG C, the problems that the gel spinning stock solution is poor in uniformity and easy to break in the spinning process are solved while the technical characteristics of gel spinning are exerted. The nascent fiber which is uniform in structure height, free of skin-core structure and low in crystallinity can be prepared.

content_cn: 本申请属于电器技术领域，具体涉及一种洗衣机分布过程的控制方法、装置、设备及存储介质，该洗衣机分布过程的控制方法包括：在洗衣机的分布过程中，控制洗衣机的滚筒按照设定的分布运行参数升速运行；当滚筒的转速达到称重转速区间，读取滚筒的驱动电机的电流值，根据驱动电机的电流值获取滚筒的负载重量；根据负载重量，获取负载重量对应的滚筒的脱水参数；当滚筒的转速达到分布转速区间，结束洗衣机的分布过程。本申请解决了以干衣称重值作为负载重量分档的方式准确度不高的问题，在低速的情况下称重，可以保证滚筒不出现震动、移位、撞桶等异常现象，同时无需额外增加称重时间，无需增加额外的硬件，改善了用户体验。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric appliances, and particularly relates to a washing machine distribution process control method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the washing machine distribution process control method comprises the following steps: in the distribution process of a washing machine, controlling a drum of the washing machine to operate at a high speed according to set distribution operation parameters; when the rotating speed of the roller reaches the weighing rotating speed interval, reading the current value of a driving motor of the roller, and obtaining the load weight of the roller according to the current value of the driving motor; according to the load weight, obtaining a dehydration parameter of the roller corresponding to the load weight; ending the distribution process of the washing machine when the rotating speed of the drum reaches the distribution rotating speed interval. The problem that the accuracy is not high in the mode that the dry clothes weighing value serves as load weight grading is solved, weighing is carried out under the low-speed condition, it can be guaranteed that the roller does not have vibration, displacement, barrel collision and other abnormal phenomena, meanwhile, additional weighing time does not need to be increased, additional hardware does not need to be increased, and the user experience is improved.

content_cn: 本发明实施例公开了一种衣物洗涤方法、装置、洗衣设备和存储介质，具体涉及智能电器技术领域，该衣物洗涤方法包括：获取洗衣设备内的目标衣物的材质信息和图像信息；根据材质信息和图像信息预测目标衣物的串色等级；确定串色等级对应的洗涤参数和漂洗参数；根据洗涤参数对目标衣物进行洗涤，并根据漂洗参数对目标衣物进行漂洗。本发明实施例中，能够根据材质信息和图像信息准确的判断出衣物的串色等级。针对衣物不同的串色等级，设置不同的洗涤方案，有效降低了衣物在洗涤过程中发生串色的可能性，防止了衣物在洗涤过程中出现串色给用户带来损失，提高了用户体验。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a clothes washing method and device, clothes washing equipment and a storage medium, and particularly relates to the technical field of intelligent electric appliances, and the clothes washing method comprises the steps that material information and image information of target clothes in the clothes washing equipment are acquired; predicting the cross color grade of the target clothes according to the material information and the image information; determining a washing parameter and a rinsing parameter corresponding to the cross color grade; the target clothes are washed according to the washing parameters, and the target clothes are rinsed according to the rinsing parameters. In the embodiment of the invention, the cross color grade of the clothes can be accurately judged according to the material information and the image information. Different washing schemes are set according to different color crossing grades of the clothes, so that the possibility of color crossing of the clothes in the washing process is effectively reduced, the loss of a user caused by color crossing of the clothes in the washing process is prevented, and the user experience is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种衣架、叠衣机及叠衣机的控制方法。本发明的衣架包括主体和与主体连接的撑衣臂，所述撑衣臂设置有与可夹持衣架的夹持机构相配合的配合部。本发明还包括具有上述衣架的叠衣机以及叠衣机的控制方法。叠衣机在折叠衣物的过程中，需要使用特定的衣架对衣物进行支撑，并能够与衣物脱离，因而衣架上设置有配合部能够与叠衣机的其他结构实现更好的配合，能够使得衣物与衣架更容易脱离。
content_en: The invention discloses a clothes hanger, a clothes folding machine and a clothes folding machine control method. The clothes hanger comprises a body and clothes supporting arms, the clothes supporting arms are providing with matching portions matched with clamping mechanisms of the clamped clothes hanger, and the clothes folding machine comprise the clothes hanger. When clothes are folded by theclothes folding machine, the clothes are supported by the aid of a specific clothes hanger, the clothes hanger can be separated from the clothes, and the matching portion is arranged on the clothes hanger and can be effectively matched with other structures of the clothes folding machine, so that the clothes can be more easily separated from the clothes hanger.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种烘干系统的进风管、烘干系统及清洗设备，其中，进风管包括：管体；拦截装置，可拆卸地设置在管体内。本发明的技术方案有效地解决了现有技术中洗干一体机容易吸入毛绒、线屑等轻质纤维，导致烘干效果变差、机组故障的问题。
content_en: The invention provides an air inlet pipe of a drying system, the drying system and cleaning equipment. The air inlet pipe comprises a pipe body and an intercepting device detachably arranged in the pipe body. By means of the air inlet pipe of the drying system in the technical scheme, the problems that as light fibers such as plush and line scraps are easily sucked into a cleaning-drying integrated machine in the prior art, the drying effect is poor, and a unit is faulted are effectively solved.

content_cn: 一种烘干机及其堵塞检测方法，所述堵塞检测方法包括：检测吸入系统和排放系统中的空气的温度；计算检测的温度的变化率；基于检测的温度和检测的温度的变化率而确定排气管的堵塞程度。
content_en: A method for detecting a degree of blockage of an exhaust duct includes detecting the temperature of air in an intake and exhaust system, calculating a rate of change of the detected temperature, and determining a degree of blockage of the exhaust duct based on the detected temperature and the rate of change of the detected temperature.

content_cn: 本发明属于排水阀领域，具体提供一种排水阀以及包含该排水阀的衣物处理设备。本发明旨在解决现有排水阀中阀头和阀体的连接方式容易松动的问题。本发明的排水阀包括阀头和阀体，阀头上设置有连接构件，连接构件包括端面和安装位，端面上设置有弹性臂，弹性臂上设置有第二凸块，阀体包括第一连接端，第一连接端上设置有第一凸块，第一凸块旋入安装位之后，弹性臂的第二凸块将第一凸块卡在安装位内，阻止第一凸块从安装位中滑脱，即将阀头和阀体连接。通过这样的设置，提高了阀头和阀体的连接的可靠性，同时简化了阀头和阀体的连接过程，方便了维修拆卸以及不同规格阀头和阀体之间的可换性，提高了阀头和阀体的装配性。
content_en: The invention belongs to the field of drain valves, and particularly provides a drain valve and a clothes treating device comprising the same, aiming to solve the problem of poor connection between valve heads and valve bodies of existing drain valves. The drain valve comprises a valve head and a valve body. A connection member arranged on the valve head comprises an end surface and a mounting position. An elastic arm is arranged on the end surface, and a second protrusion block is arranged on the elastic arm. The valve body comprises a first connecting end. A first protrusion block is arranged at the first connecting end. After being screwed into a mounting position, the first protrusion block is clamped in the mounting position by the second protrusion block of the elastic arm to prevent slipping from the mounting position, and accordingly, the valve head is connected with the valve body. Through such arrangement, the reliability of connection between the valve head and the valve body is improved, the connection process of the valve head and the valve body is simplified, maintenance and disassembly are facilitated, the exchangeability of valve heads and valve bodies of different specifications is improved, and the assembly of the valve head and the valve body is enhanced.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供一种衣物干燥设备。该衣物干燥设备包括筒体(1)、风道(2)和热泵系统(3)，风道(2)的第一端连接至筒体(1)的进风口，风道(2)的另一端连接至筒体(1)的出风口，热泵系统(3)设置在风道(2)的通风路径上，风道(2)上设置有换风口(4)，换风口(4)用于供外界空气进入风道(2)或者供风道(2)内的流体流入外界。根据本实用新型的衣物干燥设备，功能更加多样化，不仅能够干衣，而且可以进行环境除湿，实现衣物干燥设备的功能多样化要求。
content_en: The utility model provides a garment drying apparatus. This garment drying apparatus includes barrel (1), wind channel (2) and heat pump system (3), and the first end of wind channel (2) is connectedto the air intake of barrel (1), and the other end of wind channel (2) is connected to the air outlet of barrel (1), and heat pump system (3) set up on the ventilation route of wind channel (2), are provided with on wind channel (2) and trade wind gap (4), trades wind gap (4) and is used for supplying the outside air to get into the fluid inflow external world in wind channel (2) or air feed way (2). According to the utility model discloses a garment drying apparatus, the function is more diversified, not only can do the clothing, can carry out the environment dehumidification moreover, realizes garment drying apparatus's the diversified requirement of function.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种洗涤剂投放集成结构及洗衣机，投放集成结构包括，基体；切换阀容纳腔，设置在所述基体上，用于安装进液切换阀；所述切换阀容纳腔具有第一出液口和多个第一进液口；投放泵安装腔，设置在所述基体上，与所述切换阀容纳腔的第一出液口连通；混液腔，设置在所述基体上，与所述投放泵安装腔的第二出液口连通，用于进水混合洗涤剂并导出。本发明所述的投放集成结构包括基体，所述基体上设有连通的切换阀容纳腔、投放泵安装腔和混液腔，能够方便各部件的安装，使切换阀、投放泵和混液腔形成一体安装结构，不需要在各部件之间连接管路，提高安装效率，还能够防止水路管路弯曲缠绕，减小了洗涤剂投放结构的占用空间。
content_en: The invention discloses a detergent putting integrated structure and a washing machine. The detergent putting integrated structure comprises a base body; the switching valve containing cavity is formed in the base body and used for installing a liquid inlet switching valve; the switching valve accommodating cavity is provided with a first liquid outlet and a plurality of first liquid inlets; the putting pump mounting cavity is formed in the base body and communicates with the first liquid outlet of the switching valve containing cavity; and the liquid mixing cavity is arranged on the base body, is communicated with the second liquid outlet of the putting pump mounting cavity and is used for mixing inlet water with the detergent and leading out the mixture. The feeding integrated structure comprises the base body, the switching valve containing cavity, the feeding pump mounting cavity and the liquid mixing cavity which are communicated are formed in the base body, mounting of all parts can be facilitated, the switching valve, the feeding pump and the liquid mixing cavity form an integrated mounting structure, pipelines do not need to be connected between all the parts, the mounting efficiency is improved, and the cost is reduced. The water pipeline can be prevented from being bent and wound, and the occupied space of the detergent putting structure is reduced.

content_cn: 一种滚筒式洗衣机(1)，具有：有底筒状的滚筒(2)，构成为能绕水平方向或倾斜方向延伸的轴线(S1)旋转；以及偏心检测单元(35,36)，检测所述滚筒(2)内的偏心量(M)以及偏心位置，在脱水过程中，当偏心量(M)大于大型洗涤物用阈值(β)时，判断为是起因于滚筒(2)内存在大型洗涤物，而进行使偏心量(M)降低的控制，即使进行一次或者多次使偏心量(M)降低的控制，如果偏心量(M)也不低于大型洗涤物用阈值(β)，则以低于脱水过程中设定的规定的恒定转数的大件洗涤用转数，使滚筒(2)旋转。该洗衣机(1)能通过顺利地进行脱水过程，来有效地避免洗涤时间的延迟。
content_en: A front-loading washing machine, comprising: a cylindrical drum (2) with a bottom, which is configured to be able to rotate about an axis (S1) extending along a horizontal direction or an inclined direction; and eccentricity detector units (35, 36), which detect an amount of eccentricity (M) and an eccentric position in the drum (2). During dehydration, when the amount of eccentricity (M) is greater than a threshold (beta) for large laundry, it is determined that this is caused by large laundry existing in the drum (2) and control for reducing the amount of eccentricity (M) is performed; and after the control for reducing the amount of eccentricity (M) is performed for one or more times, if the amount of eccentricity (M) is still not lower than the threshold (beta) for large laundry, the drum (2) is enabled to rotate at a rotational speed lower than the rotational speed of specified constant revolutions per minute for large laundry during dehydration. The washing machine (1) can effectively prevent delay of washing time by making the dehydration be completed smoothly.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种衣物处理装置。衣物处理装置包括壳体和设置于壳体内的滚筒，还包括射频加热模块、主烘干系统。滚筒的周壁上设置有可开闭的衣物取放口；滚筒被布置成使得具有缩进壳体内的缩进状态，以及具有至少部分位于壳体外的伸出状态，且在伸出状态下，使衣物取放口的部分或全部位于壳体的外侧。主烘干系统配置成使烘干气流从滚筒的一端进入滚筒，射频加热模块设置于滚筒的一端或两端，以对滚筒的衣物的进行加热。将射频加热应用到具有干衣功能的衣物处理装置上，以充分利用射频烘干加热的优势。增加射频加热模块，结合主烘干系统，提高筒内温度，缩短烘干时间，提高烘干效率。
content_en: A laundry treating apparatus is provided. The clothes processing device comprises a shell and a roller arranged in the shell, and further comprises a radio frequency heating module and a main drying system. A clothes taking and placing opening capable of being opened and closed is formed in the peripheral wall of the roller; the drum is arranged to have a retracting state of retracting into the shell and an extending state of being at least partially located outside the shell, and in the extending state, part or all of the clothes taking and placing opening is located on the outer side of the shell. The main drying system is configured to enable drying airflow to enter the roller from one end of the roller, and the radio frequency heating module is arranged at one end or two ends of the roller so as to heat clothes in the roller. Radio frequency heating is applied to the clothes processing device with the clothes drying function, so that the advantages of radio frequency drying and heating are fully utilized. The radio frequency heating module is added, the main drying system is combined, the temperature in the cylinder is increased, the drying time is shortened, and the drying efficiency is improved.

content_cn: 本申请提供的一种清洗方案的确定方法、装置、设备及存储介质，通过获取衣物的标签图像；基于所述标签图像确定衣物的详细信息；将所述详细信息、洗衣机的品类和功能的相关描述输入至神经网络模型中确定所述衣物的洗涤方案，其中，所述洗涤方案中包括：洗衣机和目标功能,如此，能够为用户推荐适合衣物的清洗方案。
content_en: The invention provides a cleaning scheme determination method and device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a label image of clothes; determining detailed information of the clothes based on the label image; and inputting the detailed information, the category of the washing machine and the related description of the function into a neural network model to determine a washing scheme of the clothes, the washing scheme including the washing machine and the target function, so that a washing scheme suitable for the clothes can be recommended to a user.

content_cn: 本实用新型属于衣物处理设备领域，具体提供用于洗衣机的烘干装置及洗衣机。本实用新型旨在解决过滤网的固定不够稳定可靠，无法有效的过滤线屑的问题。为此目的，本实用新型的用于洗衣机的烘干装置包括壳体和加热器，加热器固定设于壳体内，壳体还设有槽体，槽体内设有过滤器，空气通入壳体后先经过过滤器后再进入加热器，过滤器与槽体相对的外表面固定设有第一连接结构，槽体内表面固定设有与第一连接结构相对应的第二连接结构；过滤器完全安装于槽体时，第一连接结构与第二连接结构连接。本实用新型能够稳定可靠且到位的装配在壳体内，不会被风机形成的风吹起，可以有效的过滤线屑，阻止线屑进入加热器内使加热器的制热功能失效。
content_en: The utility model belongs to the field of clothes processing equipment, and particularly provides a drying device for a washing machine and the washing machine. The utility model aims to solve the problems that the fixation of the filter screen is not stable and reliable enough, and thread scraps cannot be effectively filtered. In order to achieve the purpose, the drying device for the washing machine comprises a shell and a heater, the heater is fixedly arranged in the shell, the shell is further provided with a groove body, a filter is arranged in the groove body, air enters the shell, then passes through the filter and then enters the heater, and a first connecting structure is fixedly arranged on the outer surface, opposite to the groove body, of the filter. A second connecting structure corresponding to the first connecting structure is fixedly arranged on the inner surface of the groove body; when the filter is completely mounted in the tank body, the first connecting structure is connected with the second connecting structure. The wire scrap filtering device can be stably, reliably and properly assembled in the shell, cannot be blown up by wind formed by a fan, can effectively filter wire scraps, and prevents the wire scraps from entering the heater to cause failure of the heating function of the heater.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种波轮洗衣机外桶盖及波轮洗衣机，外桶盖上设有自上而下倾斜延伸的、对应喷水口设置的压水板，所述压水板靠近喷水口一侧设有向喷水口凸出的凸起结构。本发明通过在外桶盖内周侧对应喷水口设置压水板、并在压水板靠近喷水口一侧设置凸起结构，令自外桶盖喷水口喷射喷射而出的水流受凸起结构干涉，并经压水板引流，在外桶盖内周侧形成一圈均匀的由许多水流组成的瀑布状喷淋水幕，使洗涤效果更佳，并且节约用水。
content_en: The invention discloses a pulsator washing machine outer barrel cover and a pulsator washing machine. A water pressure plate corresponding to a water injection nozzle is arranged on the inner peripheral side of the outer barrel cover and obliquely extends from top to bottom, and a projection structure projecting towards the water injection nozzle is arranged on one side, close to the water injection nozzle, of the water pressure plate. Therefore, water flow injected from the water injection nozzle of the outer barrel cover is interfered by the projection structure and guided by the water pressure plate. A uniform waterfall spray water curtain comprising a lot of water flow is formed on the inner peripheral side of the outer barrel cover, so that washing effects are better, and water is saved.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种衣物处理设备，包括：至少两个脚轮组件，设置在衣物处理设备底部的相对两侧，各脚轮组件包括脚轮轴、套设在脚轮轴上的脚轮和至少两个脚轮支架；至少两个脚轮支架间隔设置，安装在衣物处理设备的底部，各脚轮支架的侧壁上对应开设有条形孔，条形孔相对于水平方向倾斜延伸设置；脚轮轴穿过条形孔可移动地设置在各脚轮支架上；驱动组件，安装在衣物处理设备的底部，以驱动脚轮轴沿条形孔的延伸方向做升降运动，使脚轮支撑于地面或者悬空。本发明提供的衣物处理设备，可以轻松实现脚轮相对于地面的升高或者降低，结构简单且升降操作更简化，使衣物处理设备移动更省时省力，提高了用户体验。
content_en: The invention provides clothes treatment equipment, which comprises at least two trundle assemblies arranged on two opposite sides of the bottom of the clothes treatment equipment, and each trundle assembly comprises a trundle shaft, a trundle sleeved on the trundle shaft and at least two trundle supports; the at least two trundle supports are arranged at intervals and installed at the bottom of the clothes processing equipment, strip-shaped holes are correspondingly formed in the side walls of the trundle supports, and the strip-shaped holes obliquely extend relative to the horizontal direction; the trundle shafts penetrate through the strip-shaped holes and are movably arranged on the trundle supports. The driving assembly is installed at the bottom of the clothes processing equipment so as to drive the trundle shaft to do lifting motion in the extending direction of the strip-shaped hole, and the trundle can be supported on the ground or suspended in the air. According to the clothes treatment equipment provided by the invention, the trundles can be easily lifted or lowered relative to the ground, the structure is simple, the lifting operation is more simplified, the clothes treatment equipment is more time-saving and labor-saving to move, and the user experience is improved.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种洗涤设备的信息发送方法、装置及设备，该方法包括：获取所述洗涤设备对应的第一设备信息；确定所述第一设备信息的第一信息类型，所述第一信息类型为如下任意一种：所述洗涤设备的报警信息、所述洗涤设备的洗涤信息、所述洗涤设备的维护信息、所述洗涤设备对应的产品推荐信息；确定所述第一信息类型对应的信息状态，所述信息状态为发送状态或者取消发送状态，所述信息状态为根据用户在历史时段内对所述第一信息类型的设备信息的用户操作确定得到的；在所述第一信息类型对应的信息状态为发送状态时，向终端设备发送所述第一设备信息。提高服务器发送第一设备信息的准确度。
content_en: The invention provides an information sending method, device and equipment of washing equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first equipment information corresponding to the washing equipment; determining a first information type of the first equipment information, wherein the first information type is any one of the following information: alarm information of the washing equipment, washing information of the washing equipment, maintenance information of the washing equipment and product recommendation information corresponding to the washing equipment; an information state corresponding to the first information type is determined, the information state is a sending state or a sending canceling state, and the information state is determined according to user operation of a user on the equipment information of the first information type in a historical time period; and when the information state corresponding to the first information type is a sending state, sending the first equipment information to terminal equipment. The accuracy of sending the first equipment information by the server is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种衣物处理装置，其属于衣物处理技术领域，包括内筒体和提升筋，内筒体的内部形成衣物处理腔，衣物处理腔的前端敞开形成衣物投放口；提升筋与内筒体的内壁连接且自前向后延伸，沿自前向后方向，提升筋的外轮廓的面积逐渐减小。在内筒体转动的过程中，提升筋能够将衣物提升到高处，然后衣物在重力的作用下下落，且由于沿自前向后方向，提升筋的外轮廓的面积逐渐减小，因此使得衣物能够自前向后移动，达到收负载的效果；衣物不仅能够随着内筒体的转动做周向运动，还能够沿内筒体的轴向移动，避免衣物相互之间缠绕，丰富衣物的运动形式，提高衣物处理效果。
content_en: The invention discloses a clothes processing device, and belongs to the technical field of clothes processing, the clothes processing device comprises an inner cylinder and a lifting rib, a clothes processing cavity is formed in the inner cylinder, and the front end of the clothes processing cavity is open to form a clothes putting port; the lifting rib is connected with the inner wall of the inner barrel and extends from front to back, and the area of the outer contour of the lifting rib is gradually reduced in the direction from front to back. In the rotating process of the inner barrel, the lifting ribs can lift clothes to a high position, then the clothes fall under the action of gravity, and due to the fact that the area of the outer contour of the lifting ribs is gradually reduced in the direction from front to back, the clothes can move from front to back, and the load collecting effect is achieved; the clothes can do circumferential movement along with rotation of the inner barrel and can also move in the axial direction of the inner barrel, mutual winding of the clothes is avoided, the movement form of the clothes is enriched, and the clothes treatment effect is improved.

content_cn: 一种滚筒洗衣机，防止平衡配重的重量集中到外筒的螺钉焊接部。滚筒洗衣机具备：箱体(10)；外筒(20)，自由旋转地内装有收容洗涤物的滚筒(22)；外筒支承台(30)，通过多个减振器(28)而连接至箱体(10)，可摆动地支承外筒(20)；外桶箍带(31、32)，通过焊接而固定至外筒支承台(30)，沿外筒(20)的外周面延伸；以及平衡配重(D)，在外筒(20)的上部与外桶箍带(31、32)的一端部(31a、32a)和另一端部(31b、32b)连接。
content_en: Provided is a drum washing machine, which prevents the weight of the balance counterweight from being concentrated at the screw welding portion of the outer tub. The drum washing machine has: a machine body (10); an outer tub (20) provided with a drum (22) for accommodating laundry in a freely rotating manner; outer tub support platforms (30) which are connected to the machine body (10) by means of a plurality of shock absorbers (28) and swingably support the outer tub (20); outer tub bands (31, 32) fixed to the outer tub support platforms (30) by welding, and extending along the outer circumferential surface of the outer tub (20); and a balance counterweight (D) connected to one ends (31a, 32a) and the other ends (31b, 32b) of the outer tub bands (31, 32) at the upper portion of the outer tub (20).

content_cn: 本发明涉及衣物处理技术领域，具体涉及一种波轮和包括该波轮的衣物处理装置。本发明旨在解决现有洗衣机波轮存在的功能单一、洗涤效果差的问题。为此目的，本发明的波轮包括第一轮盘，第一轮盘的下表面设置有轴孔，第一轮盘通过轴孔与驱动装置连接，第一轮盘上还设置有转动轨道，转动轨道中安装有子波轮，子波轮设置成在驱动装置驱动第一轮盘正反向转动时能够自转并且沿转动轨道往复移动。通过子波轮在驱动装置驱动第一轮盘正反向转动时能够自转以及沿转动轨道往复移动的设置方式，本发明的波轮拓展了洗涤功能，提高了洗涤效果。
content_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clothing treatment, in particular to a wave wheel and a clothing treatment device including the same, with an aim to solve problems of single function and poor washing effect existing in the wave wheel of existing washing machines. The wave wheel comprises a first wheel disk, a shaft hole is arranged in the lower surface of the first wheel disk, thefirst wheel disk is connected with a drive unit through the shaft hole, a rotating track is further arranged on the first wheel disk, a wavelet wheel is installed in the rotating track, and the wavelet wheel is arranged to rotate and reciprocate along the rotating track when the drive unit drives the first wheel disk to rotate forward and backward. The wavelet is arranged to rotate and reciprocatealong the rotating track when the drive unit drives the first wheel disk to rotate forward and backward, so that the wave wheel has the advantages that the washing function is expanded, and the washing effect is improved.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种具有分区洗涤功能的衣物处理装置，包括外桶、分隔桶、第一衣物处理件和第二衣物处理件，外桶和分隔桶之间形成有第一洗涤区，分隔桶内形成有第二洗涤区；第一衣物处理件的外周部设置于第一洗涤区内，第二衣物处理件设置在第二洗涤区内；第一洗涤区和第二洗涤区可单独进排水；外桶设有外桶进风口和外桶出风口，形成第一烘干路径；分隔桶设有分隔桶出风口，形成第二烘干路径；外周部形成有衣物仿形部，提高对衣物的保护和洗涤效果；外周部两侧分别设有喷淋臂，旋转洗涤和喷淋洗涤相结合，提高整体洗涤效果；实现不同类型的衣物分区洗涤，避免洗涤水交叉感染；一套烘干组件同时对两个洗涤区烘干，简化整机结构。
content_en: The invention provides a clothes treatment device with a partitioned washing function, which comprises an outer barrel, a partition barrel, a first clothes treatment piece and a second clothes treatment piece, and is characterized in that a first washing area is formed between the outer barrel and the partition barrel, and a second washing area is formed in the partition barrel; the peripheral part of the first clothes treating part is arranged in the first washing area, and the second clothes treating part is arranged in the second washing area; the first washing area and the second washing area can independently feed and discharge water; the outer barrel is provided with an outer barrel air inlet and an outer barrel air outlet to form a first drying path; the separation barrel is provided with a separation barrel air outlet to form a second drying path; a clothes profiling part is formed on the periphery, so that the protection and washing effects on clothes are improved; spraying arms are arranged on the two sides of the peripheral portion respectively, rotary washing and spraying washing are combined, and the overall washing effect is improved. Different types of clothes can be washed in different areas, and cross infection of washing water is avoided; the two washing areas are simultaneously dried by one drying assembly, so that the structure of the whole machine is simplified.

content_cn: 本发明涉及生活用品技术领域，公开了晾衣架及其控制方法、控制装置，晾衣架，包括：主支架；伸缩杆，与主支架相连，伸缩杆可上下伸缩；衣架，通过旋转部件可在水平面内旋转地连接于伸缩杆远离主支架的端部。本发明需要晾晒衣物时，先使伸缩杆向下伸出，使衣架位于合适的高度，先在衣架的一侧挂衣物，当一侧挂满后，通过旋转衣架，使衣架的另一侧旋转到靠近人站立的位置处，对另一侧挂衣物，因此，与相关技术相比，无需用户不断走动即可将衣物挂满衣架，更便于用户使用。
content_en: The invention relates to the technical field of articles of daily use, and discloses a clothes hanger and a control method and device thereof. The telescopic rod is connected with the main support and can stretch out and draw back up and down; the clothes hanger is rotationally connected to the end, away from the main support, of the telescopic rod through a rotating component in the horizontal plane. When clothes need to be aired, the telescopic rod extends downwards firstly, the clothes hanger is located at a proper height, the clothes are hung on one side of the clothes hanger firstly, and after the clothes hanger is full of the clothes, the other side of the clothes hanger is rotated to the position close to the standing position of a person by rotating the clothes hanger, and the clothes are hung on the other side of the clothes hanger. A user can fully hang clothes on the clothes hanger without continuously walking, and the user can use the clothes hanger more conveniently.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种除湿结构及具有其的洗干机，涉及洗涤装置技术领域，该除湿结构包括换热主体，换热主体包括上盖和下盖，上盖和下盖形成一个具有进气口和出气口的腔体，腔体内形成有多个挡筋，多个挡筋配合使上盖和下盖之间形成有流道，流道沿着进气口和出气口的方向设有多个扩缩单元串联而成的节流通道，节流通道对经过其的湿热蒸汽产生降温冷凝作用。通过扩缩单元对流经除湿结构的热蒸汽进行降温减速和冷凝作用，有效地减少了具有该除湿结构结构的洗干机水盒前端凝露问题。
content_en: The invention provides a dehumidification structure and a washing and drying machine with the dehumidification structure, and relates to the technical field of washing devices.The dehumidification structure comprises a heat exchange body, wherein the heat exchange body comprises an upper cover and a lower cover, a cavity with an air inlet and an air outlet is formed by the upper cover and the lower cover, a plurality of blocking ribs are formed in the cavity, a flow channel is formed between the upper cover and the lower cover through cooperation of the multiple blocking ribs, the flow channelis provided with a throttling channel in the direction of the air inlet and the air outlet, the throttling channel is formed by connecting a plurality of expansion and contraction units in series, and the throttling channel plays a role in cooling and condensing damp and hot steam passing through the throttling channel. The hot steam flowing through the dehumidification structure is cooled, decelerated and condensed through the expansion and contraction units, so that the problem of condensation at the front end of a water box of the washing and drying machine with the dehumidification structure is effectively reduced.

content_cn: 本实用新型属于洗衣机的技术领域，具体地说，涉及一种窗垫，所述窗垫包括设于待安装结构的开口端部的外侧的第一壁面、内侧的第二壁面，第一壁面与第二壁面连接并形成夹持开口端部的安装槽，第一壁面或/和第二壁面在靠近安装槽的槽口处设有定位孔。本实用新型的窗垫可以避免洗衣机开门时被拉脱，安装稳固，有助于提升密封性能。本实用新型还涉及一种洗衣机，该洗衣机设有所述窗垫。
content_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of washing machines. The window pad comprises a first wall face arranged on the outer side of the open end of a structure to be installed, a second wall face arranged on the inner side of the open end of the structure to be installed, an installation groove connected with the first wall face and the second wall face and used for clamping the open end, and a positioning hole formed in the position, close to a groove opening of the installation groove, of the first wall face or/and the second wall face. The window pad can prevent the washing machine from being pulled off when the door of the washing machine is opened, and is stable in installation and favorable for improving sealing performance. The utility model further relates to a washing machine. The washing machine is provided with the window pad.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种具有观察口的门体洗涤机构及洗涤装置，门体洗涤机构包括碗体结构、盖板结构和气囊结构，盖板结构与碗体结构之间形成容纳腔，其中，盖板结构上设有观察口；气囊结构设置在容纳腔内并具有气囊腔，气囊结构具有展开状态和收缩状态，至少气囊结构处于展开状态时，气囊结构与观察口错开设置；其中，气囊腔作为门体洗涤腔用于容置洗涤物，或者气囊结构与碗体结构之间形成门体洗涤腔用于容置洗涤物。本实用新型的门体洗涤机构解决了现有技术中具有门体洗涤腔和整机洗涤腔的洗涤装置在两个洗涤腔同时工作时，不方便观察整机洗涤腔内衣物洗涤状态的问题。
content_en: The utility model provides a door body washing mechanism with an observation opening and a washing device, the door body washing mechanism comprises a bowl body structure, a cover plate structure and an air bag structure, a containing cavity is formed between the cover plate structure and the bowl body structure, and the observation opening is formed in the cover plate structure; the air bag structure is arranged in the containing cavity and provided with an air bag cavity, the air bag structure has an unfolded state and a contracted state, and at least when the air bag structure is in the unfolded state, the air bag structure and the observation opening are staggered; wherein the air bag cavity serves as a door body washing cavity and is used for containing washings, or the door body washing cavity is formed between the air bag structure and the bowl body structure and is used for containing the washings. The door body washing mechanism solves the problem that in the prior art, when the two washing cavities of a washing device with a door body washing cavity and a complete machine washing cavity work at the same time, the washing state of clothes in the complete machine washing cavity is inconvenient to observe.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种超稠油化学辅助热采提高采收率方法，包括：对HDCS吞吐不同周期降粘剂、CO2和蒸汽注入量进行优化，建立降粘剂、CO2和蒸汽注入量优化图版；开展多个周期HDCS吞吐，分析HDCS吞吐后期产油量低的原因；通过分析HDCS吞吐后期产油量降低的原因，得出HDCS吞吐后期油藏条件下应选择的最佳开采方式，并优化开采方式转变时机；对HDCS吞吐后期转变开采方式后各周期降粘剂、CO2、N2和蒸汽注入量进行优化，建立各周期降粘剂、CO2、N2和蒸汽注入量优化图版。该超稠油化学辅助热采提高采收率方法实现组合方式优化、注入量优化、转化时机优化，达到应用化学辅助热采技术提高采收率和经济效益的目的。
content_en: The invention provides an exploiting rate increasing method for super heavy oil chemical auxiliary heat exploiting. The exploiting rate increasing method comprises the steps of optimizing the injecting amount of viscosity reducer, CO2 and steam in different cycles of HDCS throughout and building an injecting amount optimizing plate of the viscosity reducer, CO2 and the steam; carrying out the HDCSthroughout in the multiple cycles and analyzing the reason why the oil yield is low in the later period of the HDCS throughout; obtaining an optimal exploiting mode which should be selected under oilreservoir conditions of the later period of the HDCS throughout by analyzing the reason why the oil yield is lowered in the later period of the HDCS throughout and optimizing the changing opportunityof the exploiting mode; optimizing the injecting amount of the viscosity reducer, CO2, N2 and the steam in all the cycles after the exploiting mode is changed in the later period of the HDCS throughout and building the injecting amount optimizing plate of the viscosity reducer, CO2, N2 and the steam in all the cycles. The exploiting rate increasing method for super heavy oil chemical auxiliary heat exploiting optimizes the combining mode, optimizes the injecting amount and optimizes the changing opportunity and achieves the purposes of increasing the exploiting rate and economic benefit by applying a chemical auxiliary heat exploiting technology.

content_cn: 本发明公开了防反窜分层流量控制采油管柱，包括油井中的套管及套管内的油管，所述油管的管柱上在每个油层开采段至少设置有一套压差流量控制阀，所述压差流量控制阀通过每个油层与油管内存在的压差来控制阀的开度。本发明具体压差大小可根据调节套和弹簧进行预设，该阀可控制油层流量，同时防止因其他某油层压力突然增加导致该层反窜的问题，可以实现分层流量控制开采；适用于大斜度井、水平井等分层开采；防止油层反窜倒灌，避免油层污染，保护油层。
content_en: The invention discloses a reverse-play preventing layering flow control flow string which comprises a sleeve arranged in an oil well and an oil pipe arranged in the sleeve. A tubular column of the oil pipe is provided with at least one set of pressure difference flow control valve at each oil layer exploitation section, and the pressure difference flow control valves control the open degree through the pressure difference between each oil layer and the inside of the oil pipe. The specific pressure difference can be preset according to an adjustment sleeve and a spring, the valves can control flows of the oil layers, meanwhile, the problem of reverse-play of the layer due to unexpected pressure increase of other oil layers is avoided, layering flow control exploitation can be achieved, the reverse-play preventing layering flow control flow string is suitable for layering exploitation of highly-deviated wells, horizontal wells and the like, oil layer reverse-play backward flowing is prevented, oil layer pollution is avoided, and the oil layers are protected.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种注水井启动压力测试方法，属于石油勘探开发测试工艺技术领域。该注水井启动压力测试方法，利用配水管柱，将注水井分隔为N个注水层，建立不同流量等级对应注水层段的开启流量与关闭流量之间的对应关系，确定各注水层的启动流量对应的压力。本发明有益效果是：解决了真实油藏条件下不同流量级别注水井录取注水层启动压力数据误差大的问题，精细划分了注水井注水层段的压力、流量级差，录取的启动压力数据快速准确、详实可靠，为油田的油水井精细注采调整提供技术支撑。
content_en: The invention relates to a method for testing starting pressure of a water injection well and belongs to the technical field of petroleum exploration and development testing processes. According to the method for testing starting pressure of the water injection well, a water distribution string is used for dividing the water injection well into N water injection layers, the corresponding relation between starting flows and stopping flows of water injection layer segments corresponding to different flow levels is established, and pressure corresponding to the starting flow of each water injection layer is determined. The method has the beneficial effects as follows: the problem of large errors of recorded starting pressure data of the water injection layers of the water injection well in different flow levels under the condition of real oil reservoir is solved, pressure and flow level differences of the water injection layer segments of the water injection well are finely divided, the starting pressure data is recorded rapidly, the data is accurate, detailed and reliable, and technical support is provided for fine injection and recovery adjustment of oil-water wells in the oil field.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种智能门锁，包括外壳和扬声器，扬声器设置在外壳内，外壳的面板上设置有安装口；智能门锁还包括：安装部，设置在外壳内且与外壳连接，安装部与面板间隔设置，扬声器与安装部拆卸连接，扬声器与安装口相对设置；盖板，可活动地设置以打开和关闭安装口，以在打开安装口时安装或拆卸扬声器，本发明的智能门锁解决了现有技术中的智能门锁的扬声器不便于更换的问题。
content_en: The invention provides an intelligent door lock which comprises a shell and a loudspeaker, the loudspeaker is arranged in the shell, and a mounting opening is formed in a panel of the shell; the intelligent door lock further comprises a mounting part which is arranged in the shell and connected with the shell, the mounting part and the panel are arranged in a spaced mode, the loudspeaker is detachably connected with the mounting part, and the loudspeaker and the mounting opening are oppositely arranged; the cover plate is movably arranged to open and close the mounting opening so that the loudspeaker can be mounted or dismounted when the mounting opening is opened, and the intelligent door lock solves the problem that in the prior art, a loudspeaker of an intelligent door lock is inconvenient to replace.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种深层水平井压裂提高桥塞泵送效率的方法。包括：(1)裂缝参数及压裂施工参数优化；(2)簇射孔参数优化；(3)酸预处理；(4)混合前置液压裂造缝；(5)可溶性暂堵剂加砂压裂；(6)70‑140目支撑剂加砂压裂；(7)40‑70目支撑剂长段塞加砂压裂；(8)30‑50目高密度支撑剂压裂充填；(9)混合顶替。本发明实现了促进缝高纵向延伸、提升支撑剂纵向沉降空间以及为后续泵送桥塞施工提供有效的流动通道，从而有效缓解压后泵送桥塞过程中高泵压施工风险和提升桥塞的泵送效率。
content_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the pumping efficiency of a bridge plug through deep horizontal well fracturing. The method comprises the following steps of (1) optimization of fractureparameters and fracturing construction parameters; (2) optimization of cluster perforation parameters; (3) acid pretreatment; (4) preflushing fluid mixing for fracturing fracture making; (5) sand addition into a soluble temporary plugging agent for fracturing; (6) sand addition into a 70-140-mesh propping agent for fracturing; (7) long slug sand addition into a 40-70-mesh propping agent for fracturing; (8) fracturing and filling by using a 30-50-mesh high-density propping agent; and (9) mixing and displacement. The method provided by the invention achieves the effects that the longitudinal extension of the fracture height is promoted; the longitudinal sedimentation space of the propping agent is improved; and an effective flow channel is provided for the subsequent bridge plug pumping construction, so that the high pumping pressure construction risk in the process of pumping the bridge plug after pressing is effectively relieved, and the pumping efficiency of bridge plugs is improved.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了钢质连续抽油杆完井的底端组合工艺管柱，包括自下而上依次连接的柱塞、加重抽油杆、钢质抽油杆。所述柱塞上端通过拉杆连接加重抽油杆。所述钢质抽油杆包括上下依次连接的上钢质连续抽油杆和下钢质抽油杆。并且两两之间通过快速接头连接。所述钢质连续抽油杆上端连接光杆。本实用新型使油井事故减少，延长了油管和抽油杆的使用寿命，增加了下泵深度，降低了能耗。
content_en: The utility model discloses a bottom group technology tubular column of steel continuous sucker rod well completion, including the plunger that connects gradually from bottom to top, aggravate sucker rod, steel sucker rod. The plunger upper end is through pull rod connection aggravating sucker rod. The steel sucker rod is including the last steel continuous sucker rod and lower steel sucker rod that connect gradually from top to bottom. And connect through quick -operation joint between two liang. Steel continuous sucker rod connects the polished rod in the upper end. The utility model discloses make the oil well accident reduce, prolonged the life of oil pipe and sucker rod, increased time pump degree of depth, reduced the energy consumption.

content_cn: 本发明属于油田开发技术领域，具体涉及一种含蜡油井微生物清防蜡的方法。该方法具体包括以下步骤：试验油井的筛选；低、中和高温菌种温度范围的确定；低、中和高温菌种的筛选；低、中和高温菌种复配性能的确定；复配菌种现场投加比例、投加总量和投加周期的确定；现场试验以及效果的评价。本发明具有工艺简单、可操作性强和现场试验效果好的优点，有效延长热洗周期200d以上，单井年平均节省热洗井次5次以上，投入产出比大于1：5。因此，本发明可广泛地应用于高含蜡油井清防蜡作业中。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oilfield development, and particularly relates to a microbial paraffin removal and inhibition method for a paraffin-containing oil well. The method specifically comprises the following steps of screening a test oil well; determining temperature ranges of low-temperature, medium-temperature and high-temperature strains; screening the low-temperature,medium-temperature and high-temperature strains; determining the compounding performance of the low-temperature, medium-temperature and high-temperature strains; determining the on-site adding proportion, the on-site total adding amount and the on-site adding period of compounding strains; and performing field testing and effect evaluation. The microbial paraffin removal and inhibition method hasthe advantages of being simple in process, high in operability and good in field test effect, the thermal washing period is effectively prolonged by 200 d or above, the thermal washing times of one single well are averagely saved by 5 times or above every year, and the input-output ratio is larger than 1:5. Therefore, the method can be widely applied to paraffin removal and inhibition operation ofthe high-paraffin-content oil well.

content_cn: 本发明属于井下工具技术领域，具体地，涉及一种可关闭回流通道浮箍。可关闭回流通道浮箍包括外壳和设置在所述外壳内的凡尔，在所述外壳内还设置有封堵机构，所述封堵机构设置在所述凡尔的上方，在泵注水泥浆阶段，所述封堵机构上下两侧的所述外壳的内腔相互连通，在水泥浆泵注完成之后，所述封堵机构构造成将所述外壳的内腔封堵。本发明能够解决现有技术中回压凡尔浮箍浮鞋失效导致固井质量差的问题。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of downhole tools, and particularly relates to a float collar capable of closing a backflow channel. The float collar capable of closing the backflow channel comprises a shell and a valve arranged in the shell, a plugging mechanism is further arranged in the shell, the plugging mechanism is arranged above the valve, in the cement slurry pumping stage, inner cavities, on the upper side and the lower side of the plugging mechanism, of the shell are communicated with each other, and after cement slurry pumping is completed, the plugging mechanism is arranged in the inner cavity of the shell. And the blocking mechanism is configured to block the inner cavity of the shell. The problem of poor well cementation quality caused by failure of a float collar and a float shoe of a back pressure valve in the prior art can be solved.

content_cn: 本实用新型涉及一种冲击式多级整形装置，属于油气田井下变形套管整形修复用工具技术领域。由本体、胀管段和导向头组成，本体管外中部设有三级胀管段，本体和胀管段采用一体式结构设计，本体下部为导向头。冲击式多级整形装置，以三级胀管段为例，从下到上胀管段外径依次逐级增加，一次下钻可使变形套管内径扩大达到三次整形施工效果，提高了整形效率；每级胀管段上设有上整形段、保径段和下整形段三个部分，钻具下放过程中，下整形段与变形套管接触，挤胀变形套管内径，而上提过程中，上整形段起作用，实现双向整形，再加上定径段的保径作用，可明显提高整形效果；采用一体式结构设计，装置总体强度高。
content_en: The utility model relates to a multistage shaping device of impacted style belongs to the oil gas field and is out of shape tube shaping in the pit and repairs and to use instrument technical field. Comprise body, expand tube section and direction head, body outside of tubes middle part is equipped with tertiary expand tube section, and body and expand tube section adopt integral type structural design, and the body lower part is the direction head. Multistage shaping device of impacted style to tertiary expand tube section is the example, and from the bottom up expand tube section external diameter increases in proper order step by step, once runs the drilling tool into the well to make the expansion of deformation cover internal diameter of pipe reach cubic plastic construction effect, has improved plastic efficiency, be equipped with plastic section, guarantor footpath section and lower plastic section three in every grade of expand tube section, the in -process is transferred to the drilling tool, and the internal diameter of pipe is overlapped with deformation sleeve pipe contact, crowded bloated the deformation to lower plastic section, and lifts the in -process, goes up the plastic section to work, realizes two -way plastic, and in addition the guarantor of sizing section directly acts on, can obviously improve the plastic effect, adopt integral type structural design, install overall intensity height.

content_cn: 本发明提出了一种测压装置和管柱，该测压装置包括上接头、可选择性设置在上接头下端的中心筒、套设在中心筒的外侧的第一卡挂件和固定设置在中心筒的下端的压力计，该测压装置结构简单，功能可靠，操作简便。
content_en: The pressure measuring device comprises an upper connector, a center cylinder selectively arranged at the lower end of the upper connector, a first clamping and hanging piece arranged on the outer side of the center cylinder in a sleeving mode and a pressure gauge fixedly arranged at the lower end of the center cylinder, and the pressure measuring device is simple in structure, reliable in function and easy and convenient to operate.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种锚定式注水工艺管柱及其使用方法，其中锚定式注水工艺管柱，包括套管，所述套管内设置有油管，所述油管上连接有以下部件，若干封隔器，所述封隔器间隔设置于所述油管上，将所述油管分为多个注水层段；若干配水器，分别设置于每个注水层段相对应的油管上；锚定装置，设置于一对相邻的所述封隔器与所述配水器之间；增力装置，设置于所述锚定装置的下端的油管上。本发明设置有增力装置，在起管时可以克服封隔器均与套管的摩擦阻力，以及锚定工具增加的起管负荷，增加起管动力，实现利用小修设备即可完成起管的效果，能有效减少作业成本和占井周期。
content_en: The invention discloses an anchoring type water injection process pipe column and a use method thereof. The anchoring type water injection process pipe column comprises a casing pipe, wherein an oil pipe is arranged in the casing pipe, the oil pipe is connected with following components which are respectively a plurality of packers, a plurality of water distributors, an anchoring device and a force enhancement device, the packers are arranged on the oil pipe at intervals, and divide the oil pipe into multiple water injection layer segments, each packer is arranged on a portion, correspondingto each water injection layer segment, of the oil pipe, the anchoring device is arranged between one of the packers and one of the water distributors, which are adjacent, and the force enhancement device is arranged on another portion, at the lower end of the anchoring device, of the oil pipe. The power enhancement device is arranged on the anchoring type water injection process pipe column, and therefore when the casing pipe is lifted, the anchoring type water injection process pipe column can overcome frictional resistance between each packer and the casing pipe, overcome pipe lifting load increased by the anchoring device, increase pipe lifting power, achieve the effect of completing pipe lifting by using current repair equipment, and effectively reduce operation cost and shorten a welloccupation period.

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种地层渗透率测井计算方法、装置、电子设备及介质，包括：针对大斜度井的中子和密度测井曲线进行环境校正，获得校正后曲线；通过校正后曲线，计算岩心地面孔隙度；建立岩心地面孔隙度和覆压孔隙度的第一转换公式，计算岩心地面孔隙度对应的覆压孔隙度；建立覆压孔隙度和覆压渗透率的第二转换公式；将岩心地面孔隙度对应的覆压孔隙度带入第二转换公式，获得岩心地面孔隙度对应的覆压渗透率，即为地层渗透率。本发明基于有限的岩心实验，利用环境校正后的测井曲线开展大斜度井条件下弱成岩地层渗透率的计算，为储层特征和产能评价提供精确的地层渗透率参数，具有资料覆盖广、成本低和精度高等优势，从而指导油气田的勘探开发工作。
content_en: The invention discloses a formation permeability logging calculation method and device, electronic equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the environment correction of a neutron and density logging curve of a highly-deviated well, and obtaining a corrected curve; calculating the core ground porosity through the corrected curve; establishing a first conversion formula of the core ground porosity and the overburden porosity, and calculating the overburden porosity corresponding to the core ground porosity; establishing a second conversion formula of the overburden pressure porosity and the overburden pressure permeability; and substituting the overburden pressure porosity corresponding to the core ground porosity into a second conversion formula to obtain the overburden pressure permeability corresponding to the core ground porosity, namely the stratum permeability. According to the method, the weak diagenetic stratum permeability under the highly-deviated well condition is calculated by utilizing the well logging curve after environment correction based on limited core experiments, accurate stratum permeability parameters are provided for reservoir characteristics and productivity evaluation, and the method has the advantages of wide data coverage, low cost, high precision and the like, so that exploration and development work of oil and gas fields is guided.

content_cn: 本发明提出了一种基于有源无线电磁信号的尾管悬挂器及动作触发器，包括尾管悬挂器，所述尾管悬挂器上设置有动作器；以及动作触发器，所述动作触发器能够发射驱动所述动作器动作的指令的无线电磁信号；其中，所述动作触发器投入井下后，随自重和钻井液的驱动下向下移动，在移动的过程中发出无线电磁信号；当移动到所述尾管悬挂器位置时，所述动作器接收所述无线电磁信号并动作，使所述尾管悬挂器坐挂。
content_en: The invention provides a drilling liner hanger and action trigger based on an active wireless electromagnetic signal, comprising a drilling liner hanger which is provided with an action device; the action trigger can emit a wireless electromagnetic signal of an instruction for driving the action of the action device; wherein after the action trigger is put into a well, the action trigger moves downwards under the driving of self weight and drilling fluid, and a wireless electromagnetic signal is sent out in the moving process; and when moving to the position of the drilling liner hanger, the actuator receives the wireless electromagnetic signal and acts, so that the drilling liner hanger is hung in a sitting manner.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种零散砂体发育的多层砂岩油藏开发调整方法，包括：步骤1，进行精细油藏地质研究及地质建模；步骤2，建立数值模型；步骤3，运用数模、结合油藏工程方法进行剩余油分布研究；步骤4，进行多轮次层系轮替可行性研究；步骤5，评价层系轮替资源；步骤6，设计多轮层系轮替方案；步骤7，进行指标预测和经济评价，并实施方案。该零散砂体发育的多层砂岩油藏开发调整方法对于多层油藏特高含水后期提高储量控制程度、提高采油速度，具备较好的实用性，低油价条件下，能够经济有效提高特高含水后期多层油藏的采收率，为老油田稳产增产提供支撑。
content_en: The invention provides a development and adjustment method for a multi-layer sandstone oil reservoir with developed scattered sand bodies. The development and adjustment method comprises the followingsteps that 1, fine reservoir geological research and geological modeling are carried out; 2, a numerical model is established; 3, the numerical model is combined with an oil reservoir engineering method to study the distribution of remaining oil; 4, a multi-round series of strata alternating feasibility study is carried out; 5, the series of strata alternating resource is evaluated; 6, a multi-round series of strata alternating scheme is designed; and 7, index prediction and economic evaluation are carried out, and the scheme is implemented. The development and adjustment method for the multi-layer sandstone oil reservoir with the developed scattered sand bodies has good practicability for improving the reserve control degree and oil recovery speed in the late stage of ultra-high water cut of the multi-layer oil reservoir, under the condition of low oil price, the recovery ratio of the multi-layer reservoir in the late stage of the ultra-high water cut can be economically and effectively improved, and the development and adjustment method provides support for stable production and production increase in old oil fields.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种陆相页岩油水平井轨迹控制方法及设备，属于石油与天然气勘探开发技术领域，包括：岩‑电结合开展小层划分及存储精细评价，并筛选出水平井穿行小层位；对水平井穿行小层位开展进一步精细评价，筛选出水平井靶窗；采用水平井靶窗及其上下区域，建立水平井造斜段及水平段纵向岩性组合区，并明确各区域的岩、电、元素特征；根据各区域的所述岩、电、元素特征，开展随钻跟踪调整。优选了水平井靶窗，并将主要目标层划分为3个区域，其中水平井靶窗为中部核心区，也就是水平段穿行目标区，在水平井实施时，利用各区域岩性组合、伽马值及元素变化等差异判断钻头位置，开展轨迹调控，提升了水平井目的层钻遇率。
content_en: The invention discloses a continental facies shale oil horizontal well track control method and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of petroleum and natural gas exploration and development. The method comprises the steps that small layer division and storage fine evaluation are carried out through rock-electricity combination, and horizontal well passing small layers are screened out; further fine evaluation is carried out on the horizontal well passing small horizon, and a horizontal well target window is screened out; a horizontal well target window and upper and lower areas thereof are adopted, a horizontal well deflecting section and horizontal section longitudinal lithology combination area is established, and rock, electricity and element characteristics of all the areas are determined; and carrying out tracking adjustment while drilling according to the rock, electricity and element characteristics of each area. According to the method, a horizontal well target window is optimized, a main target layer is divided into three areas, the horizontal well target window is a middle core area, namely a horizontal section penetrating target area, when a horizontal well is implemented, the position of a drill bit is judged and track regulation is carried out by utilizing differences such as lithology combination, gamma values and element changes of all the areas, and the drilling rate of the target layer of the horizontal well is increased.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种连续油管安全机构，包括支撑座、左手臂、右手臂、左卡瓦、右卡瓦，所述左手臂中部通过左销轴铰接在支撑座上，所述右手臂中部通过右销轴铰接在支撑座上，所述左手臂前端安装左卡瓦，所述右手臂前端安装右卡瓦，所述左手臂、右手臂对称设置，所述左卡瓦、右卡瓦对称设置，所述左手臂后端和右手臂后端同时铰接驱动装置。本发明在注入器发生故障时候可以迅速抱紧管柱，防止连续油管落井。为连续油管（或复合管）的安全作业提供技术保障。
content_en: The invention discloses a coiled tubing safety mechanism. The coiled tubing safety mechanism comprises a supporting base, a left arm, a right arm, a left drilling slip and a right drilling slip, the middle of the left arm is hinged to the supporting base through a left pin roll, the middle of the right arm is hinged to the supporting base through a right pin roll, the left drilling slip is installed at the front end of the left arm, the right drilling slip is installed at the front end of the right arm, the left arm and the right arm are symmetrically arranged, the left drilling slip and the right drilling slip are symmetrically arranged, and the rear end of the left arm and the rear end of the right arm are hinged to a driving device simultaneously. By means of the coiled tubing safety mechanism, a tubular column can be quickly and tightly held when an injector breaks down, and a coiled tubing is prevented from falling to a well. Technical guarantee is provided for safe operation of the continuous oil tubing (or a compound tubing).

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种深层油气藏分级助抽高效举升方法及管柱，方法包括以下步骤：搜集油井前期生产资料，对应水井资料，分析油水连通性，分析储油层的稠稀程度、含砂量、腐蚀性、结蜡性、气体含量、含水率；根据储油层分析结果，选择适配的振动器；根据流体分析特性，选择适用的油管；根据泵深、流体特性，设计两个及两个以上助抽器相互之间的间距；根据设计结果进行施工，先下入管柱，然后管柱试压，试压合格后，下入抽油杆连接举液泵，试抽憋压合格，进行正常生产。根据储层特性，优化应用匹配的振动器，可提高储层的渗流能力，起到快速采油的作用；依据流体特性，进行助抽装置的分布优化。
content_en: The invention discloses a deep oil and gas reservoir grading pumping-assisting efficient lifting method and string. The method comprises the following steps that oil well early-stage production data and corresponding water well data are collected, oil-water connectivity is analyzed, and the thickening degree, the sand content, the corrosivity, the wax precipitation property, the gas content and the water content of an oil storage layer are analyzed; an adaptive vibrator is selected according to the analysis result of the oil storage layer; an applicable oil pipe is selected according to fluid analysis characteristics; according to the pump depth and fluid characteristics, the distance between the two or more pumping assistors is designed; and construction is conducted according to the design result, firstly, the string is tripped in, then pressure testing is conducted on the string, after pressure testing is qualified, a sucker rod is tripped in to be connected with a liquid lifting pump, and normal production is conducted after trial pumping pressure building is qualified. According to the characteristics of the reservoir, the matched vibrator is optimally applied, the seepage capacity of the reservoir can be improved, and the effect of rapid oil extraction is achieved; and the distribution of the pumping assisting devices is optimized according to the fluid characteristics.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开的是压裂完井用可开关控制阀，用于石油工业水平井或直井中的套管分段压裂完井管柱中，使用专用工具打开或关闭，满足套管分段压裂完井的需要。可开关控制阀包括外套筒和内滑套，外套筒上设有液流通道，内滑套装于外套筒内，外套筒两端连接上接头和下接头，在水平井的水平段或直井的多个压裂完井层段，可根据需要放置多个设计规格统一、大通径的压裂完井用的可开关控制阀，可使用同一套专用工具完成多个可开关控制阀的启闭，压裂分级数量不受限制，满足大排量、大规模压裂改造的需要。多个压裂地层的压裂施工可连续完成，无需变动压裂完井管柱，提高了压裂效率，节约压裂费用且完井工艺简单。
content_en: The utility model discloses a control valve used for fracturing well completion and capable of being opened and closed. The control valve is used in a casing staged fracturing well completion pipe string in a horizontal well or a straight well in the petroleum industry, is opened or closed through a special tool, and meets the requirements on casing staged fracturing well completion. The control valve comprises an outer sleeve and an inner sliding sleeve, wherein a liquid flow channel is formed on the outer sleeve; the inner sliding sleeve is mounted in the outer sleeve; and an upper joint and a lower joint are connected with two ends of the outer sleeve. A plurality of large-diameter control valves for fracturing well completion, which have uniform design specifications, are placed as required at the horizontal section of the horizontal well or a plurality of fracturing well completion intervals of the straight well; the control valves can be opened and closed through the same set of special tool; the number of fracturing stages is unlimited; and the requirements of large-discharge large-scale fracturing reformation are met. The fracturing construction of a plurality of fracturing stratums can be completed continuously, without needing to change the fracturing well completion pipe string, so that the fracturing efficiency is improved, and the fracturing cost is saved; and the well completion technology is simple.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种全通径无限级压裂完井组件及其工艺方法，包括压裂完井滑套和用于开启压裂完井滑套的打开工具，二者通过特定的滑块与凹槽的配合结构，具有多种序列组合，保证分段压裂级数不受限制；开启方式既可实现任意定点压裂完井滑套的一匙一开，也可实现一级多簇压裂完井滑套的一匙多开；压后，打开工具可全部溶解，实现完井管柱全通径；满足连续快速、大规模、多级多簇的压裂完井施工需求，提高压裂效率。
content_en: The full-bore infinite-order fracturing well completion assembly comprises a fracturing well completion sliding sleeve and an opening tool used for opening the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve, the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve and the opening tool have multiple sequence combinations through a matching structure of a specific sliding block and a groove, and it is guaranteed that staged fracturing stages are not limited; according to the opening mode, one-key one-opening of the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve at any fixed point can be achieved, and one-key multi-opening of the first-stage multi-cluster fracturing well completion sliding sleeve can also be achieved. After pressing, the tool is opened and can be completely dissolved, so that the full bore of a well completion pipe string is realized; the continuous, rapid, large-scale, multi-stage and multi-cluster fracturing well completion construction requirements are met, and the fracturing efficiency is improved.

content_cn: 本发明属于油气钻井技术领域，具体地，涉及一种脉冲发生器。脉冲发生器包括第一外壳；同轴式固定地设置在所述第一外壳内部的编码盘，在所述编码盘上沿周向均匀贯穿设置有多个大小不等的编码孔；设置成与所述编码盘同轴转动式连接的阀块，所述阀块构造成在转动期间能够至少部分地堵塞至少一个编码孔但使至少另一个编码孔畅通。本发明能够提供压力脉冲信号，还可用作定向钻井过程中降摩减阻的工具及装备。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil and gas drilling, and particularly relates to a pulse generator. The pulse generator comprises a first shell; the coding disc is coaxially and fixedly arranged in the first shell, and a plurality of coding holes with different sizes are uniformly formed in the coding disc in the circumferential direction in a penetrating manner; the valve block is coaxially and rotationally connected with the coding disc, and the valve block is constructed to be capable of at least partially blocking at least one coding hole but enabling at least another coding hole to be unblocked during rotation. The device can provide a pressure pulse signal, and can also be used as a tool and equipment for reducing friction and drag in the directional drilling process.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种浮箍，包括：配合座、内套、凡尔座以及阀板，内套的内部形成过流通道，配合座设置于凡尔座的内部且与其连接，部分内套设置于凡尔座的内部，且与配合座通过固定部固定连接，固定部能够被剪断以使得内套与配合座脱离，凡尔座的下端具有阀口，阀板能够通过转动封闭阀口，部分内套伸出于阀口，且外壁能够与阀板的表面抵接，以阻止阀板转动。本发明能够在浮箍内部形成过流通道，保障浮箍在随套管下入过程中能够一直过流，避免套管产生压力激荡。
content_en: The invention provides a float collar which comprises a matching seat, an inner sleeve, a valve seat and a valve plate, an overflowing channel is formed in the inner sleeve, the matching seat is arranged in the valve seat and connected with the valve seat, part of the inner sleeve is arranged in the valve seat and fixedly connected with the matching seat through a fixing part, and the fixing part can be cut off so that the inner sleeve can be separated from the matching seat. A valve port is formed in the lower end of the valve seat, the valve plate can seal the valve port through rotation, part of the inner sleeve extends out of the valve port, and the outer wall can abut against the surface of the valve plate so as to prevent the valve plate from rotating. The overflow channel can be formed in the float collar, it is guaranteed that the float collar can always overflow in the process of tripping in along with a casing pipe, and the casing pipe is prevented from generating pressure agitation.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开的是一种钻井液除泥沙装置，本装置设有箱体、水力旋流器和过滤板，过滤板中设置若干个滤孔，水力旋流器安装在过滤板下方的箱体中，覆盖在过滤板上方的疏通板中设有与滤孔相对应的疏通柱；往复疏通机构设有电机、主动齿条和安装于主动齿条两侧的从动齿轮，固定在支撑板上端的电机的输出轴通过偏心设置的齿条连接轴与主动齿条的一端连接、使主动齿条带动从动齿轮在支撑板上面做往复运动；疏通板通过拨杆与设置在从动齿轮外侧的卡槽滑动连接、往复疏通滤孔。本实用新型解决了现有钻井液泥沙过滤和清理装置存在的缺陷，解决了过滤板上的滤孔容易堵塞的问题。清理其中的过滤板时，不影响钻、修井工作的进行，本装置可长期使用。
content_en: The utility model discloses a drilling fluid silt removing device which is provided with a box body, a hydrocyclone and a filter plate, a plurality of filter holes are formed in the filter plate, the hydrocyclone is installed in the box body below the filter plate, and dredging columns corresponding to the filter holes are arranged in a dredging plate covering the filter plate; the reciprocating dredging mechanism is provided with a motor, a driving rack and driven gears installed on the two sides of the driving rack, an output shaft of the motor fixed to the upper end of the supporting plate is connected with one end of the driving rack through an eccentrically-arranged rack connecting shaft, and the driving rack drives the driven gears to reciprocate on the supporting plate. The dredging plate is in sliding connection with a clamping groove formed in the outer side of the driven gear through a driving lever to dredge the filter holes in a reciprocating manner. The drilling fluid sediment filtering and cleaning device overcomes the defects of an existing drilling fluid sediment filtering and cleaning device and solves the problem that filtering holes in the filtering plate are prone to being blocked. When the filter plate is cleaned, drilling and well repairing work is not affected, and the device can be used for a long time.

content_cn: 本发明属于三次采油技术领域，具体涉及一种利用油藏边底水进行微生物采油的方法。本发明首先进行边底水油藏筛选和类型的划分，确定适应于微生物驱油的边底水油藏；然后进行边底水油藏油井油层和水井水层中微生物进行解析，并筛选出相应的激活剂体系；其次确定油井控制参数以及现场注入工艺，进行现场驱油试验；最后评价现场实施效果。本发明具有实施工艺简单，针对性和可靠性强，有效地扩大了边底水油藏微生物驱油的应用效果。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tertiary oil recovery, and particularly relates to a method for carrying out microbial oil recovery by utilizing edge and bottom water of an oil reservoir. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out edge-bottom water reservoir screening and type division, and determining an edge-bottom water reservoir suitable for microbial oil displacement; then analyzing microorganisms in an edge-bottom water reservoir oil well oil layer and a water well water layer, and screening out a corresponding activator system; secondly, oil well control parameters and an on-site injection process are determined, and an on-site oil displacement test is carried out; and finally evaluating the field implementation effect. The method has the advantages that the implementation process is simple, the pertinence and the reliability are high, and the application effect of microorganism oil displacement of the edge-bottom water reservoir is effectively expanded.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种阀体组件及阀控装置。该阀体组件包括：阀体组件，包括：阀体，阀体包括阀杆和阀芯，阀杆远离阀芯的端部具有沿阀杆的径向设置的至少一个凸柱；按键，按键包括按压件及与至少一个凸柱卡接固定的卡接件，卡接件设置于按压件的按压面的背面。该阀控装置，包括壳体，壳体上设置有上述的阀体组件。根据本发明的阀体组件及阀控装置，通过在阀杆上设置凸柱，并将凸柱与按键的卡接件卡接固定，按压按键即可推动阀杆，实现对阀体的控制；相较于现有技术的阀体组件，减少了弹簧的使用，结构简单且降低了成本，提高装配效率。
content_en: The invention provides a valve assembly and a valve control device. The valve assembly comprises a valve and a button. The valve comprises a valve rod and a valve element. At least one protruding pillar arranged in the radial direction of the valve rod is arranged at the end, far away from the valve element, of the valve rod. The button comprises a pressing piece and clamping pieces fixed to the protruding pillars in a clamped manner. The clamping pieces are arranged on the back face of the pressing face of the pressing piece. The valve control device comprises a shell. The valve assembly is arranged on the shell. According to the valve assembly and the valve control device, the valve rod is provided with the protruding pillars, the protruding pillars and the clamping pieces of the button are fixed in the clamped manner, the valve rod can be pushed by pressing the button, and the valve is controlled. Compared with a valve assembly in the prior art, usage of springs is reduced, the structure is simple, cost is reduced, and the assembling efficiency is improved.

content_cn: 本实用新型空调室外机和空调器，空调室外机包括压缩机、消音管、壳体和填充层。压缩机具有排气口，消音管与排气口连通，消音管的至少部分穿设于壳体上，填充层填充在消音管的外周壁和壳体的内壁之间。根据本实用新型的空调室外机，通过在消音管的外周壁和壳体的内壁之间填充填充层，消音管在振动时会受到填充层的摩擦阻尼，从而可以有效地降低消音管产生的振动能量，进而可以有效地降低由振动产生的噪音。
content_en: The utility model discloses air -conditioning outdoor unit and air -conditioning unit, air condensing units include compressor, hush pipe, casing and filling layer. The compressor has a gas vent, hushpipe and gas vent intercommunication, and on the at least part of hush pipe wore to locate the casing, the filling layer was filled between the inner wall of the periphery wall of hush pipe and casing. According to the utility model discloses an air condensing units fills the filling layer between the inner wall through periphery wall at the hush pipe and casing, the hush pipe can receive the frictional damping of filling layer when the vibration to the vibration energy that the hush pipe produced can be reduced effectively, and then the noise by the oscillation generation can be reduced effectively.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种吊扇，包括：壳体，所述壳体的外壁设有进风孔，所述进风孔与所述壳体的空腔连通；风机，所述风机设置于所述壳体的空腔内，所述风机的进风端朝向所述进风孔设置；及出风叶，所述出风叶设置于所述壳体，所述出风叶设有进风风道和多个与所述进风风道连通的出风孔，所有所述出风孔沿所述出风叶的长度方向间隔设置于所述出风叶的外壁，所述进风风道的进风口与所述壳体的空腔连通、且所述进风风道的进风口朝向所述风机的出风端。该吊扇的通过在壳体设置出风叶，并通过设置于出风叶上的出风口排风，扩大了出风范围和出风角度，进而提升了使用体验感。
content_en: The utility model discloses a ceiling fan which comprises a shell, an air inlet hole is formed in the outer wall of the shell, and the air inlet hole is communicated with a cavity of the shell.
