The draught fan is arranged in the cavity of the shell, and the air inlet end of the draught fan faces the air inlet hole; air outlet blade, the air outlet blades are arranged on the shell; the air outlet blade is provided with an air inlet channel and a plurality of air outlet holes communicated with the air inlet channel, all the air outlet holes are formed in the outer wall of the air outlet blade atintervals in the length direction of the air outlet blade, an air inlet of the air inlet channel is communicated with the cavity of the shell, and an air inlet of the air inlet channel faces the airoutlet end of the draught fan. According to the ceiling fan, the air outlet blades are arranged on the shell, air is exhausted through the air outlets formed in the air outlet blades, the air outlet range and the air outlet angle are enlarged, and then the use experience feeling is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开一种燃烧器及燃气热水器，燃烧器包括壳体、预混合器、预热燃烧器及喷射管，壳体形成有燃烧室；预混合器接入燃气和空气并进行预混合，并向燃烧室提供混合气体；预热燃烧器用于将混合气体点燃；喷射管的进气口与预混合器连通，并将燃烧室内的温度加热至预设温度；喷射管的喷射口与燃烧室连通，以用于向燃烧室喷射混合气体，使得燃烧室内进行高温空气燃烧反应。本发明提供一种具有高温空气燃烧功能的燃烧器及燃气热水器。
content_en: The invention discloses a combustor and a gas water heater. The combustor comprises a shell, a premixer, a preheating combustor and an injection pipe, and a combustion chamber is formed in the shell; gas and air are introduced into the premixer and premixed, and mixed gas is provided for the combustion chamber; the preheating combustor is used for igniting the mixed gas; an air inlet of the injection pipe communicates with the premixer, and the temperature in the combustion chamber is increased to a preset temperature; and an injection opening of the injection pipe communicates with the combustion chamber and is used for injecting mixed gas into the combustion chamber, so that high-temperature air combustion reaction is performed in the combustion chamber. The combustor with a high-temperature air combustion function and the gas water heater are provided.

content_cn: 本发明揭示了一种冰箱，包括箱体、主门，所述主门上设有开口和次门，所述次门具有打开所述开口的打开状态和关闭所述开口的关闭状态，其特征在于，所述主门具有主门前面板，所述次门具有次门前面板，所述冰箱还包括驱动机构，所述驱动机构驱动所述次门相对于所述主门移动以实现所述打开状态和关闭状态之间的变换，当所述次门处于关闭状态时，所述次门前面板与所述主门前面板大致平齐，所述驱动机构包括相对于所述主门固定不动的驱动电机、设于所述驱动电机和次门之间的传动结构，所述冰箱还包括对所述次门的移动进行导向的导向结构。该冰箱的次门关闭时具有很好的整体可视性，且冰箱的次门打开时所占用空间较小、取放物品方便。
content_en: The invention discloses a refrigerator. The refrigerator comprises a refrigerator body and a main door. The main door is provided with an opening and an auxiliary door. The auxiliary door has an opening state in which the opening is opened and a closing state in which the opening is closed. The refrigerator is characterized in that the main door is provided with a main door front panel, the auxiliary door is provided with an auxiliary door front panel, the refrigerator further comprises a drive mechanism, and the drive mechanism drives the auxiliary door to move relative to the main door so that conversion between the opening state and the closing state can be achieved; when the auxiliary door is in the closing state, the auxiliary door front panel and the main door front panel are roughlyflush; the drive mechanism comprises a drive motor fixed relative to the main door and a transmission structure arranged between the drive motor and the auxiliary door; and the refrigerator further comprises a guiding structure for guiding the movement of the auxiliary door. When the auxiliary door of the refrigerator is closed, good integral visuality is achieved, and when the auxiliary door ofthe refrigerator is opened, the occupied space is small, and object taking and placing are convenient.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种室内机及具有其的空调器，其中，室内机包括连接部和安装组件，其中，连接部具有第一连接结构；安装组件具有与第一连接结构相配合的第二连接结构，安装组件通过第二连接结构和第一连接结构的配合作用以与连接部可拆卸地连接，安装组件用于安装装饰物。本实用新型解决了现有技术中的智慧屏空调的成本较高，导致智慧屏空调的售价昂贵，普通用户购买受限的问题。
content_en: The utility model provides an indoor unit and an air conditioner with the same, the indoor unit comprises a connecting part and a mounting assembly, and the connecting part is provided with a first connecting structure; and the mounting assembly is provided with a second connecting structure matched with the first connecting structure, is detachably connected with the connecting part through the matching effect of the second connecting structure and the first connecting structure, and is used for mounting an ornament. The intelligent screen air conditioner solves the problems that an intelligent screen air conditioner in the prior art is high in cost, the price of the intelligent screen air conditioner is high, and common users are limited in purchase.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供一种阀门固定装置。该阀门固定装置包括阀门支架(1)和阀门组件(2)，阀门组件(2)包括阀门座(3)，阀门座(3)的一端通过连接件(4)与阀门支架(1)固定连接，阀门座(3)的另一端与阀门支架(1)卡接固定。根据本实用新型的阀门固定装置，操作简单，阀门装拆效率高。
content_en: The utility model provides a valve fixing device. This valve fixing device includes valve bracket (1) and valve member (2), and connecting piece (4) and valve bracket (1) fixed connection are passed through including valve seat (3), the one end of valve seat (3) in valve member (2), and the other end of valve seat (3) is fixed with valve bracket (1) joint. According to the utility model disclosesa valve fixing device, easy operation, the valve is installed and removed efficiently.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开一种微通道换热器及换热设备，该换热器包括两集流管以及设置在两集流管之间的扁管，扁管上设有翅片，集流管由外部实心管壁和内部多孔微通道结构组成；和/或，扁管由外部实心管壁和内部多孔微通道结构组成。本实用新型可提高制冷剂分配到每根扁管中的均匀性，扁管强制换热作用增强，提高换热效率，此外，还可以提升换热器的耐电化学腐蚀性。
content_en: The utility model discloses a microchannel heat exchanger and a heat exchanging device. The microchannel heat exchanger comprises two collecting pipes and flat pipes arranged between the two collecting pipes. Each flat pipe is provided with a fin. Each collecting pipe is composed of an outer solid pipe wall and an inner multi-hole microchannel structure, and/or each flat pipe is composed of an outer solid pipe wall and an inner multi-hole microchannel structure. According to the microchannel heat exchanger, the evenness of refrigerating fluid distributed to each flat pipe can be improved, the forceful heat exchanging effect of the flat pipes is improved, the heat exchanging efficiency is improved, and in addition, the electrochemistry corrosivity resistance of the heat exchanger can be improved.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种半导体空调用风叶组件、风机组件以及半导体空调，涉及半导体空调技术领域，解决了现有的针对厨房环境使用的空调机组结构复杂、清洁拆装的难度及工作量较大的技术问题。该半导体空调用风叶组件包括风叶本体以及半导体制冷组件；其中，所述风叶本体包括冷风风道，所述半导体制冷组件安装在所述风叶本体内且所述半导体制冷组件的制冷面朝向所述冷风风道。该风机组件包括电机组件以及半导体空调用风叶组件。该半导体空调包括空调本体以及风机组件。本实用新型用于提供一种结构简单，清洁拆装难度较低，工作量较小的半导体空调用风叶组件、风机组件以及半导体空调。
content_en: The utility model provides a fan blade assembly for a semiconductor air conditioner, a fan assembly and the semiconductor air conditioner, relates to the technical field of semiconductor air conditioners, and solves the technical problems that an existing air conditioning unit used for a kitchen environment is complex in structure, difficult to clean, disassemble and assemble and large in workload. The fan blade assembly for the semiconductor air conditioner comprises a fan blade body and a semiconductor refrigeration assembly. Wherein the fan blade body comprises a cold air channel, the semiconductor refrigeration assembly is installed in the fan blade body, and the refrigeration face of the semiconductor refrigeration assembly faces the cold air channel. The fan assembly comprises a motor assembly and a fan blade assembly for the semiconductor air conditioner. The semiconductor air conditioner comprises an air conditioner body and a fan assembly. The fan blade assembly for the semiconductor air conditioner, the fan assembly and the semiconductor air conditioner are simple in structure, low in cleaning, disassembling and assembling difficulty and small in workload.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种空调器，空调器包括：风道件和导风组件，风道件限定出出风风道，出风风道的一端形成为出风口；导风组件具有导风板，导风板可转动地设在空调器的出风口处，导风板在宽度方向上具有相互连接的第一弯折部和第二弯折部，在气流流动方向上，第一弯折部沿着顺时针的方向弯曲，第二弯折部沿着逆时针的方向弯曲。根据本实用新型的空调器，气流在流经沿顺时针的方向弯曲的第一弯折部时可以沿着顺时针方向偏转，在流经沿逆时针的方向弯曲的第二弯折部时，可以沿着逆时针的方向偏转，使得流出导风板的气流流向与进入导风板的气流流向之间的偏转角度较小，可以在导风板调整出风方向的同时保证出风距离，有利于保证空调器的换热效率。
content_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner which comprises an air duct piece and an air guide assembly, an air outlet duct is defined by the air duct piece, and an air outlet is formed in one end of the air outlet duct; the air guide assembly is provided with an air guide plate, the air guide plate is rotatably arranged at an air outlet of the air conditioner, the air guide plate is provided with a first bent part and a second bent part which are connected with each other in the width direction, and in the airflow flowing direction, the first bent part is bent in the clockwise direction, and the second bent part is bent in the anticlockwise direction. According to the air conditioner, airflow can deflect in the clockwise direction when flowing through the first bending part which is bent in the clockwise direction, and can deflect in the anticlockwise direction when flowing through the second bending part which is bent in the anticlockwise direction; the deflection angle between the flow direction of airflow flowing out of the air guide plate and the flow direction of airflow entering the air guide plate is small, the air outlet distance can be guaranteed while the air outlet direction of the air guide plate is adjusted, and the heat exchange efficiency of the air conditioner is guaranteed.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种冰箱照明装置，包括：遮光罩，遮光罩配置成不透光；透光部，可透光，与遮光罩共同限定出照明腔室，透光部包括安装部，安装部配置成可夹持冰箱的搁物架的横向边缘；和发光元件，设置于照明腔室，用于发射光线；其中，发光元件发射的光线通过穿透透光部而对外部进行照明。照明装置安装完成后，发光元件发出的光线透过透光部后横向射入透明的搁物架中。射入搁物架中的光线能够完全布满搁物架上下的整个储物空间，并且搁物架上下的储物空间内的光线分部也十分均匀，极大的提升照明效果。
content_en: The utility model provides a refrigerator lighting device which comprises a light shield, a light guide plate and a light guide plate. The light-transmitting part can transmit light, the light-transmitting part and the light shield jointly define a lighting cavity, the light-transmitting part comprises a mounting part, and the mounting part is configured to be capable of clamping the transverse edge of a rack of the refrigerator; the light-emitting element is arranged in the lighting chamber and used for emitting light; light emitted by the light-emitting element illuminates the outside by penetrating through the light-transmitting part. After the lighting device is installed, light emitted by the light-emitting element penetrates through the light-transmitting part and then is transversely emitted into the transparent rack. The light emitted into the rack can completely cover the whole storage space above and below the rack, and the light in the storage space above and below the rackis also distributed very uniformly, so that the lighting effect is greatly improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种空调器的控制方法，包括：获取当前室内环境的室内温度及相对湿度；基于所述室内温度及相对湿度确认当前室内环境所处的温湿区域；根据所述温湿区域，控制空调器开启制热模式，并对应控制所述空调器的加湿风门开启或关闭。本发明还公开了一种空调器的控制装置、空调器及存储介质。本发明通过室内温度及相对湿度确认当前室内所处的预设温室区域，并根据预设温度区域的控制方式，开启/关闭加湿风门以调整室内温湿度的数值。以实现空调器在调整室内温度的基础上同时调整室内空气的相对湿度的有益效果。
content_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner control method. The air conditioner control method comprises the steps of acquiring indoor temperature and relative humidity of current indoor environment; confirming a temperature and humidity area of the current indoor environment based on the indoor temperature and the relative humidity; controlling an air conditioner to enter a heating mode based on the temperature and humidity area; and correspondingly controlling a humidifying ventilation door of the air conditioner to open or close. The invention also discloses an air conditioner control device, an air conditioner and a storage medium. According to the air conditioner control method, a preset heated housing area of the current indoor environment is confirmed based on the indoor temperatureand the relative humidity, and the humidifying ventilation door is opened/ closed based on the control mode of the preset temperature area so as to adjust the value of the indoor temperature and humidity, and as a result, the beneficial effect of the air conditioner in adjusting relative humidity of indoor air while conditioning indoor temperature is achieved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种新型壁挂式空调器，包括壳体，位于壳体内的风机、换热器和控制器，壳体为四面体，包括前壳和后壳，后壳包括与墙角的三个墙面相适应的第一后壳、第二后壳和第三后壳，前壳与第一后壳、第二后壳、第三后壳中任意两个的相接处均设置有气流口，壳体内在气流口之间形成气流流通路径，风机和换热器位于所述气流流通路径上，前壳上设置有显示装置。本发明空调器可安装于不易引起注意的墙角位置，前壳上的显示装置可图案、图画或影像，与周围环境融为一体不会显得突兀，不会破坏房间的整体协调性和布局。气流口位于前壳与任意两个后壳的相接处，流出的气流随着墙角线流动，不会直接吹向室内空间，不会直吹人体，大大提高了舒适性。
content_en: The invention relates to a novel wall-mounted air conditioner. The novel wall-mounted air conditioner comprises a shell, as well as a fan, a heat exchanger and a controller which are located in the shell, wherein the shell is a tetrahedron, and comprises a front shell and a rear shell; the rear shell comprises a first rear shell, a second rear shell and a third rear shell which are adaptive to three wall surfaces of a wall corner; airflow ports are arranged in the junctions of the front shell and any two of the first rear shell, the second rear shell and the third rear shell; an airflow flowing path is formed between the airflow ports in the shell; the fan and the heat exchanger are located on the airflow flowing path; and a display device is arranged on the front shell. The air conditioner disclosed by the invention can be installed at the wall corner which is not easy to attract attention; and the display device on the front shell is capable of displaying patterns, pictures or images, and is integrated with an ambient environment, without incongruity and destroy to the overall harmony and layout of a room. The airflow ports are located in the junctions of the front shell and any two rear shells, and airflows flowing out flow along the line of the wall corner, and cannot be directly blown to an indoor space and a human body, thus comfort is greatly improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种微通道换热器和具有其的制冷设备，所述微通道换热器包括：铝板，所述铝板上形成有贯通的多个通风孔；扁管，所述扁管设在所述铝板的一侧表面上，所述扁管包括相互平行设置的多个延伸管段，其中所述通风孔位于相邻的两个所述延伸管段之间。根据本发明的微通道换热器，将扁管与铝板贴合而构成微通道换热器，结构简单，制造方便，而且通过在微通道换热器的铝板上设置多个通风孔，空气可以穿过多个通风孔与微通道换热器进行换热。由此，增大了微通道换热器的换热面积，提高微通道换热器的换热效率。
content_en: The invention discloses a microchannel heat exchanger and a refrigeration device provided with the same. The microchannel heat exchanger comprises an aluminum plate and a flat pipe, wherein multiple through ventilating holes are formed in the aluminum plate, the flat pipe is arranged on one side surface of the aluminum plate and comprises multiple mutually and parallelly arranged extending pipe sections, and the ventilating holes are located between every two adjacent two extending pipe sections. According to the microchannel heat exchanger, the flat pipe attaches to the aluminum plate to form the microchannel heat exchanger. The microchannel heat exchanger is simple in structure and convenient to manufacture. Air can penetrate through the multiple ventilating holes to perform exchange with the microchannel heat exchanger by forming the multiple ventilating holes in the aluminum plate of the microchannel heat exchanger. Therefore, the heat exchange area of the microchannel heat exchanger is increased, and the heat exchange efficiency of the microchannel heat exchanger is improved.

content_cn: 本申请涉及空调技术领域，公开一种分流器，包括：分液头，构造有分液腔及与分液腔相连通的多个分流流道；进液管，自分液头的底部插入分液腔，进液管的周壁开设有多个射流孔；射流孔与分液腔相连通，且射流孔与相邻的分流流道错位设置。射流孔起到节流的作用，进液管内的制冷剂经射流孔喷入分液腔时，压力降低，在分液腔内完成充分的缓冲后再进入分流流道，不仅可以提高气液两相的制冷剂的混合均匀性，而且还可以达到更好的均匀分流效果；另外，射流孔与相邻的分流流道错位设置，射流孔不直接对应某一分流流道的进口，能够避免自射流孔喷出的制冷剂直接进入相对应的分流流道内，进一步提高分流的均匀性。本申请还公开一种空调。
content_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and discloses a flow divider which comprises a liquid dividing head provided with a liquid dividing cavity and a plurality of flow dividing runners communicating with the liquid dividing cavity. The liquid inlet pipe is inserted into the liquid separation cavity from the bottom of the liquid separation head, and a plurality of jet flow holes are formed in the peripheral wall of the liquid inlet pipe; the jet flow holes communicate with the liquid separation cavity, and the jet flow holes and the adjacent flow division flow channels are arranged in a staggered mode. The jet flow hole plays a role in throttling, when a refrigerant in the liquid inlet pipe is sprayed into the liquid separation cavity through the jet flow hole, the pressure is reduced, the refrigerant is fully buffered in the liquid separation cavity and then enters the flow dividing runner, the mixing uniformity of the gas-liquid two-phase refrigerant can be improved, and a better uniform flow dividing effect can be achieved. In addition, the jet flow holes and the adjacent flow dividing flow channels are arranged in a staggered mode, the jet flow holes do not directly correspond to an inlet of a certain flow dividing flow channel, refrigerants sprayed out of the jet flow holes can be prevented from directly entering the corresponding flow dividing flow channels, and the flow dividing uniformity is further improved. The utility model further discloses the air conditioner.

content_cn: 一种压缩机定位螺栓结构及压缩机，涉及压缩机技术领域，该压缩机定位螺栓结构包括定位螺栓,所述定位螺栓的底端设置有摇摆结构，所述摇摆结构竖直开设有通孔，所述定位螺栓的底端竖直开设有配合所述通孔的配合孔，所述通孔与所述配合孔由下往上竖直插入有拉销组件。在产品生产运输的过程中，定位螺栓可用于固定压缩机脚垫和基脚，且由于拉销组件插入摇摆结构和定位螺栓内部，定位螺栓不可以绕摇摆结构转动，产品到用户家中后，将定位螺栓内的拉销组件取下，定位螺栓可绕摇摆结构转动，这样既能解决压缩机运行的过程中脚垫在受到横向力的作用下脚垫顶到定位螺栓上，引起脚垫减振失效的问题，又能解决运输、跌落过程中脚垫从基脚中脱出的隐患。
content_en: The invention discloses a compressor positioning bolt structure and a compressor, and relates to the technical field of compressors. The compressor positioning bolt structure comprises a positioning bolt, wherein the bottom end of the positioning bolt is equipped with a swing mechanism; a through hole is vertically formed in the swing structure; the bottom end of the positioning bolt is verticallyequipped with a matched hole which is matched with the through hole; and a pull pin assembly is vertically inserted into the through hole and the matched hole from bottom to top. In a product production and transportation process, the positioning bolt can be used for fixing a compressor foot cushion and a base pin; the pull pin assembly is inserted into the swing structure and the positioning bolt, and the positioning bolt cannot rotate around the swing structure, so that the pull pin assembly in the positioning bolt is taken down after a product reaches a user's home, and the positioning bolt can rotate around the swing structure, and therefore, the problem that foot cushion damping failure due to the fact that the foot cushion jacks the positioning bolt under action of transverse forcein a compressor operation process can be solved, and the hidden danger that the foot cushion drops from the base pin in transportation and drop processes also can be solved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种门中门结构及冰箱，涉及冰箱技术领域。本发明的门中门结构，包括箱体，所述箱体上铰接有第一门体，所述第一门体上开设有连通所述箱体内部空间的通槽，所述通槽远离所述箱体的一端设置有至少一个第三门体，所述第三门体设置有用于控制其启闭的驱动组件，所有的所述第三门体处于关闭状态时能够封堵所述通槽。相比完全打开冰箱门能够减少冷气泄漏，使其能够在不影响冰箱的功能性的同时大大减少日常使用的能耗。
content_en: The invention relates to a door-in-door structure and a refrigerator, and relates to the technical field of refrigerators. The door-in-door structure comprises a box body, a first door body is hinged to the box body, a through groove communicating with the inner space of the box body is formed in the first door body, at least one third door body is arranged at the end, away from the box body, of the through groove, and the third door body is provided with a driving assembly used for controlling opening and closing of the third door body. And when all the third door bodies are in a closed state, the through groove can be blocked. Compared with the mode that the refrigerator door is completely opened, cold air leakage can be reduced, and energy consumption in daily use can be greatly reduced while the functionality of the refrigerator is not affected.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种遥控器组件、遥控器和空调器。该遥控器组件包括显示模组和按键模组，所述显示模组设在第一安装面上，所述按键模组设在第二安装面上；所述第一安装面与所述第二安装面相交或平行设置。将遥控器的主要部件设在不同安装面上，相比传统细长型遥控器而言，形体较小，类似魔方结构易带来童趣。
content_en: The utility model provides a remote controller assembly, a remote controller and an air conditioner. The remote controller assembly comprises a display module and a key module, the display module is arranged on a first mounting surface, and the key module is arranged on a second mounting surface; and the first mounting surface and the second mounting surface are intersected or arranged in parallel. The main parts of the remote controller are arranged on different mounting surfaces, so that compared with a traditional slender remote controller, the remote controller is smaller in size and similar to a magic cube structure, and children interest is easily brought.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种定位销体、阀体组件及球阀，涉及阀门技术领域，解决了球阀全开或全闭不到位和球阀在全开或全闭状态时转动的技术问题。定位销体包括定位块、定位杆和弹性部件，定位块上设置有与球阀实现固定连接的装配结构，定位杆可滑动套设于定位块的通孔内，具有与球阀销接而锁定球阀全开状态或全闭状态的第一位置以及与球阀脱离销接的第二位置；定位杆能通过限位结构与定位块卡接而处于所述第二位置；弹性部件弹性设置于定位杆与定位块之间，并向定位杆提供运动至第一位置的弹性力。定位销体确保球阀全开或全闭到位，阀杆转到对应的全开或全闭位置时，能自动定位并锁紧，避免出现球阀全开或全闭不到位和球阀工作时阀球发生转动的现象。
content_en: The utility model provides a positioning pin body, a valve body assembly and a ball valve, relates to the technical field of valves, and solves the technical problems that the ball valve is not fully opened or fully closed in place and rotates in a fully opened or fully closed state. The positioning pin body comprises a positioning block, a positioning rod and an elastic component, the positioning block is provided with an assembly structure fixedly connected with the ball valve, and the positioning rod is slidably arranged in a through hole of the positioning block in a sleeved mode and is provided with a first position in pin joint with the ball valve to lock the full-open state or the full-closed state of the ball valve and a second position out of pin joint with the ball valve; the positioning rod can be clamped with the positioning block through the limiting structure so as to be located at the second position; the elastic component is elastically arranged between the positioning rod and the positioning block and provides elastic force for the positioning rod to move to the first position. The positioning pin body ensures that the ball valve is fully opened or fully closed in place, when the valve rod rotates to the corresponding fully opened or fully closed position, automatic positioning and locking can be achieved, and the phenomena that the ball valve is not fully opened or fully closed in place and the valve ball rotates when the ball valve works are avoided.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种风扇切雾组件以及风扇，风扇切雾组件包括：流通管，流通管的两端分别为总进雾口和顶部出雾口，流通管设有贯通流通管的外壁的第一导向孔和第二导向孔，第一导向孔与第二导向孔相对设置；活塞，活塞内限定出进雾腔，进雾腔的两端分别为侧部进雾口和侧部出雾口，活塞在第一位置和第二位置之间可滑动地设在第一导向孔和第二导向孔上，在第一位置时活塞阻隔总进雾口与顶部出雾口的导通，总进雾口与侧部进雾口导通且侧部出雾口伸到叶片所在区，在第二位置时总进雾口与侧部进雾口隔断；以及驱动件，驱动件与活塞连接以驱动活塞滑动。风扇切雾组件具有防凝雾与快速切雾优点。
content_en: The invention discloses a fan water spray cutting component and a fan. The fan water spray cutting component comprises a circulation pipe, a piston and a drive part, wherein two ends of the circulation pipe are respectively a master water spray inlet and a top water spray outlet, the circulation pipe is provided with a first guide hole and a second guide hole penetrating the outer wall of the circulation pipe, and the first guide hole and the second guide hole are opposite; a water spray inlet cavity is defined in the piston, two ends of the water spray inlet cavity are respectively a lateral water spray inlet and a lateral water spray outlet, the piston is slidably disposed on the first guide hole and the second guide hole when located between a first position and a second position, the piston prevents the master water spray inlet from being communicated with the top water spray outlet when located at the first position, the master water spray inlet is communicated with the lateral water spray inlet and the lateral water spray inlet extends to a blade area, and the master water spray inlet is disconnected with the lateral water spray inlet when the piston is located at the second position; the drive part is connected with the piston to drive the same to slide. The fan water spray cutting component can prevent water spray condensation and cut the water spray fast.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种燃气灶，包括：壳体、炉头、电控组件和隔热板。所述壳体的顶壁上设有火盖；所述炉头设在所述壳体内且与所述火盖相对；所述电控组件设在所述壳体内，且所述电控组件与所述炉头之间连接有气管；所述隔热板设在所述壳体内,且所述隔热板将所述炉头和所述电控组件间隔开。根据本发明的燃气灶，炉头辐射出的热量的一部分被隔热板阻挡，只有少部分的热量可以辐射至电控组件，从而降低燃气灶工作时电控组件的温度，降低炉头辐射的热量对电控组件的影响。使电控组件可以稳定运行。
content_en: The invention discloses a gas stove, comprising a shell, a burner, an electric control assembly and a heat insulating plate. A burner cap is arranged on the top wall of the shell; the burner is arranged in the shell and is opposite to the burner cap; the electric control assembly is arranged in the shell, and a gas pipe is connected between the electric control assembly and the burner; and the heat insulating plate is arranged in the shell and separates the burner from the electric control assembly. According to the gas stove, part of heat radiated by the burner is blocked by the heat insulating plate, and only small part of the heat can be radiated to the electric control assembly, so that the temperature of the electric control assembly when the gas stove works is reduced, the influence of the heat radiated by the burner on the electric control assembly is reduced, and the electric control assembly can run stably.

content_cn: 本发明提出一种蒸汽储放系统及储供蒸汽装置，蒸汽储放系统包括：第一定压储热罐，其入口连接供蒸汽系统的供蒸汽管道，其第二出口的连接管道上设有第三切换阀和循环泵，并连接供蒸汽系统的补液管道；闪蒸器，其入口连接所述第一定压储热罐的第一出口，出气口通过出气管道连接所述供蒸汽系统的供蒸汽管道；第二定压储热罐，其入口连接闪蒸器的出液口；定压装置，同时连接第一定压储液罐和第二定压储热罐，并对应设有定压阀。本发明采用双定压储热罐的方式存储热水，不仅能够有效降低蓄热水的温度，提高蒸汽发生系统例如热泵机组的制热能效，而且降低了压力容器的设计压力，从而大大提高了整个系统的安全性，降低系统制热能耗。
content_en: The invention provides a steam storage system and a steam storage and supply device, the steam storage system comprises a first constant pressure heat storage tank, an inlet of the first constant pressure heat storage tank is connected with a steam supply pipeline of a steam supply system, a connecting pipeline of a second outlet of the first constant pressure heat storage tank is provided with a third switching valve and a circulating pump, and the first constant pressure heat storage tank is connected with a liquid supplementing pipeline of the steam supply system; an inlet of the flash evaporator is connected with a first outlet of the first constant-pressure heat storage tank, and an air outlet of the flash evaporator is connected with a steam supply pipeline of the steam supply system through an air outlet pipeline; an inlet of the second constant-pressure heat storage tank is connected with a liquid outlet of the flash evaporator; and the constant pressure device is simultaneously connected with the first constant pressure liquid storage tank and the second constant pressure heat storage tank and is correspondingly provided with a constant pressure valve. Hot water is stored in a double-constant-pressure heat storage tank mode, the temperature of the heat storage water can be effectively reduced, the heating energy efficiency of a steam generation system such as a heat pump unit is improved, the design pressure of the pressure container is reduced, and therefore the safety of the whole system is greatly improved, and the heating energy consumption of the system is reduced.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供一种壁挂炉，主燃烧器包括第一加热单元和第二加热单元，当需要同时进行采暖和制备生活热水时，通过第一加热单元流出的高温水流入到换热器内部，对换热器生活热水进水口流入的冷水进行加热，热水然后通过生活热水出水口流出。换热器内部经过换热后产生的低温水返回至第二加热单元，在第二加热单元中进行进一步加热，经过第二加热单元加热后产生的高温水通过采暖出水口进入到暖器设备中，对室内进行加热操作。通过控制出气端上的电磁阀，使得每个出气端可以导通或者关闭，可以实现采暖单元或者换热器的快速升温。
content_en: The utility model provides a wall-hanging stove. The main combustor comprises a first heating unit and a second heating unit, when heating and domestic hot water preparation need to be conducted at the same time, high-temperature water flowing out of the first heating unit flows into the heat exchanger to heat cold water flowing into a domestic hot water inlet of the heat exchanger, and then hot water flows out of a domestic hot water outlet. And low-temperature water generated after heat exchange in the heat exchanger returns to the second heating unit and is further heated in the second heating unit, and high-temperature water generated after heating of the second heating unit enters the heater equipment through the heating water outlet to heat the indoor space. By controlling the electromagnetic valves at the air outlet ends, each air outlet end can be connected or disconnected, and rapid temperature rise of the heating unit or the heat exchanger can be achieved.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供一种换热器及空调器，包括第一换热器段、第二换热器段、第三换热器段，换热器段的冷媒流路相连通；冷媒流路设有冷媒进口、第一出口、第二出口，均设置在第二换热器段上，冷媒从冷媒进口流入后，分两路在冷媒流路中内流动，并分别从第一出口、第二出口流出。冷媒流路采用一进二出的方式，冷媒流动均匀，能够实现均匀换热，有助于提高换热器的换热效率。多个盘管组件采用叠置组成换热器段，将大平面的换热器分段、分层，可调整盘管组件的层数、及分段后错置安装等方式，综合提升换热器的换热面积，提高换热器的换热能力。盘管组件采用端部安装的边板固定，装配方便，固定牢固可靠，扩展性较好。
content_en: The utility model provides a heat exchanger and an air conditioner. The heat exchanger comprises a first heat exchanger section, a second heat exchanger section and a third heat exchanger section, therefrigerant flow path is provided with a refrigerant inlet, a first outlet and a second outlet which are all formed in the second heat exchanger section, and after flowing in from the refrigerant inlet, a refrigerant flows in the refrigerant flow path in two paths and flows out from the first outlet and the second outlet respectively. The refrigerant flow path adopts a one-inlet and two-outlet mode, the refrigerant flows uniformly, uniform heat exchange can be realized, and the heat exchange efficiency of the heat exchanger is improved. The multiple coil pipe assemblies are stacked to form the heat exchanger sections, the large-plane heat exchanger is segmented and layered, the number of layers of the coil pipe assemblies can be adjusted, staggered installation is conducted after segmentation, the heat exchange area of the heat exchanger is comprehensively increased, and the heat exchange capacity of the heat exchanger is improved. The coil pipe assembly is fixed through the side plates installed at the ends, assembling is convenient, fixing is firm and reliable, and expansibility is good.

content_cn: 本发明实施例公开了一种数据库的存储、查询方法及装置，涉及计算机技术领域，可以解决由于查询数据时可能需要读取较多的冗余数据，导致查询数据的开销较大，查询数据的效率较低的问题。具体方案为：接收查询请求，该查询请求用于从数据库中查询符合查询条件的数据；确定与查询条件对应的查询数据区间，并从多个索引项中确定出匹配索引项，该匹配索引项中的索引键所指示的取值区间包含查询数据区间；从匹配索引项中的索引值指向的存储单元中，读取待查询数据。本发明实施例应用于数据库中的数据存储或查询过程中。
content_en: Embodiments of the invention disclose storage and query methods and apparatuses for a database, which relate to the technical field of computers and can solve the problems of relatively high data query cost and relatively low data query efficiency due to the fact that relatively numerous redundant data possibly needs to be read during data query. According to the specific scheme, the query methodcomprises the steps of receiving a query request, wherein the query request is used for querying data meeting a query condition from the database; determining a data query interval corresponding to the query condition, and determining a matching index item from multiple index items, wherein a value interval indicated by an index key in the matching index item comprises the data query interval; andfrom a storage unit pointed by an index value in the matching index item, reading to-be-queried data. The storage and query methods and apparatuses are applied to the data storage or query process ofthe database.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种热辐射测量装置及其测量方法。热辐射测量装置包括水平滑动机构、竖直滑动机构，水平滑动机构用于调整热辐射计的水平位置，竖直滑动机构用于调整热辐射计的竖直高度。热辐射测量方法基于上述的热辐射测量装置，能快速准确的定位热辐射计的安装位置，包括热辐射计距离热源的水平距离、热辐射计距离地面的垂直高度；可以快速方便地调整热辐射计的安装角度，准确测得某一点处的最大热辐射值。本发明在测得某一点的热辐射值后，可以快速调整热辐射计的安装位置、角度，测量下一测量点的热辐射值，实现热源热辐射数据的快速测量，降低测量的成本。
content_en: The invention discloses a heat radiation measurement apparatus and measurement method. The heat radiation measurement apparatus comprises a horizontal sliding mechanism and a vertical sliding mechanism. The horizontal sliding mechanism is used for adjusting the horizontal position of a thermal radiator; the vertical sliding mechanism is used for adjusting the vertical height of the thermal radiator. The heat radiation measurement method is based on the heat radiation measurement apparatus, and can rapidly and accurately position the installation position of the thermal radiator, the horizontal distance of the thermal radiator to a heat source, and the vertical height of the thermal radiator to the ground, rapidly and conveniently adjust the installation angle of the thermal radiator, and accurately measure a largest heat radiation value at some point. The heat radiation measurement apparatus can adjust the installation position and angle of the thermal radiator after measuring the heat radiation value at some point, rapidly measure the heat radiation value of a next measuring point, realize rapid measurement of thermal radiator radiation data, and reduce measurement cost.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种合格标签的检测方法、存储介质及电子设备，所述方法包括以下步骤：获取包含待检测标签的产品图像；将产品图像输入至预设的神经网络模型进行检测，获得第一标签信息；获取预设对比图像；采用纹理检测算法对第一标签信息进行纹理检测处理，建立第一标签信息的直方图；采用颜色识别模型检测第一标签信息的颜色特征；基于第一标签信息的直方图和颜色特征，分别与对比图像的直方图和颜色特征进行对比；当直方图和颜色特征匹配时，输出第一判定信息；当不匹配时，输出第二判定信息。本发明的神经网络模型检测产品标签提高了检测速度和检测准确率，还能降低人员成本，能有效避免因人工检查漏检或误检带来的损失。
content_en: The invention discloses a qualified label detection method, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a product image containing a to-be-detected label; inputting the product image into a preset neural network model for detection to obtain first label information; obtaining a preset comparison image; performing texture detection processing on the first label information by adopting a texture detection algorithm, and establishing a histogram of the first label information; detecting color features of the first label information by adopting acolor recognition model; based on the histogram and the color feature of the first label information, respectively comparing with the histogram and the color feature of the comparison image; when thehistogram is matched with the color feature, outputting first judgment information; and if not, outputting second judgment information. According to the neural network model for detecting the productlabel, the detection speed and the detection accuracy are improved, the personnel cost can be reduced, and the loss caused by missing detection or false detection of manual detection can be effectively avoided.

content_cn: 本公开提供了确定分类器、确定生成器、识别命令的方法及设备。所述确定分类器的方法包括：通过与正常命令对应的第一训练数据和与异常命令对应的第二训练数据来优化第一损失函数的参数和第二损失函数的参数，以确定基于优化的参数的分类器。根据本公开，可提高命令识别能力。
content_en: The invention provides a method and device for determining a classifier, a generator, and an identification command. The method of determining a classifier includes optimizing a parameter of a first loss function and a parameter of a second loss function by first training data corresponding to a normal command and second training data corresponding to an abnormal command to determine a classifierbased on the optimized parameters. According to the invention, the command recognition capability can be improved.

content_cn: 本发明实施例涉及一种提醒方法、装置、智能床具及存储介质，所述方法包括：获取第一用户的睡眠状态；根据所述睡眠状态和预设的睡眠时间阈值，确定所述第一用户的提醒级别；生成与所述提醒级别相对应的提醒信息，通过用户的睡眠状态划分对应的提醒等级，按照提醒等级对用户进行提醒，避免用户出现过渡睡眠、吃饭时间安排不合理等情况，实现对用户的精准看护。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a reminding method and device, an intelligent bed and a storage medium. The method comprises: acquiring the sleep state of a first user; determining a reminding level of the first user according to the sleep state and a preset sleep time threshold; and generating reminding information corresponding to the reminding level, dividing the corresponding reminding level according to the sleep state of the user, and reminding the user according to the reminding level, so that the situations of excessive sleep, unreasonable dining time arrangement and the like of the user are avoided, and accurate nursing of the user is realized.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种管道检测设备，该管道检测设备包括：加压装置，加压装置具有用于与待检测的管道的第一端连接的输出端；密封件，密封件密封安装在待检测的管道的第二端。本发明克服了现有技术中由于没有设置用于检测管道发生爆破时的压力的检测设备，而使出厂的管道因未进行检测而无法达到使用时的爆破压力标准的问题。将此管道检测设备应用在管道出厂检验项目中，可以提高出厂管道的质量，从而有效地避免了管道在使用过程中由于所能承受的压力较低而容易发生安全事故的问题。
content_en: The invention provides pipeline inspection equipment. The pipeline inspection equipment comprises a pressurizing device and a sealing element, wherein the pressurizing device is provided with an output end connected with the first end of a pipeline to be inspected; the sealing element is arranged at the second end of the pipeline to be inspected in a sealing way. By using the pipeline inspection equipment, the problem that pipelines leaving a factory cannot be up to the burst pressure standard when being used because of not being inspected by using equipment for detecting pressure in pipeline burst in the prior art is solved. When the pipeline inspection equipment is applied to a pipeline delivery inspection item, the quality of the pipelines leaving the factory can be improved, so that the problem that safety accidents easily occur as the pipelines only can bear low pressure in the use process is effectively avoided.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种支撑装置及电子设备，支撑装置包括第一装置本体、第二装置本体、第一芯轴和伸缩结构；第一芯轴与第一装置本体转动连接，与第二装置本体固定连接；伸缩结构与第一芯轴耦合，在第二装置本体相对第一装置本体打开时驱动第一芯轴转动，第一芯轴用于驱动伸缩结构伸展，在第二装置本体相对第一装置本体闭合时，第一芯轴用于驱动伸缩结构收缩；在打开状态下，伸展的至少部分伸缩结构位于第一芯轴远离第一装置本体的一侧，且用于支撑第二装置本体。本申请的支撑装置在通过第一芯轴实现打开和闭合过程中，第一芯轴可联动驱动伸缩结构伸展和收缩，使得在打开状态下提升支撑装置的稳定性，可提升电子设备的支撑稳定性。
content_en: The invention provides a supporting device and electronic equipment. The supporting device comprises a first device body, a second device body, a first core shaft and a telescopic structure. The first mandrel is rotationally connected with the first device body and fixedly connected with the second device body; the telescopic structure is coupled with the first mandrel, the first mandrel is driven to rotate when the second device body is opened relative to the first device body, the first mandrel is used for driving the telescopic structure to stretch, and the first mandrel is used for driving the telescopic structure to retract when the second device body is closed relative to the first device body; in the open state, at least part of the stretching telescopic structure is located on the side, away from the first device body, of the first mandrel and used for supporting the second device body. According to the supporting device, in the opening and closing process through the first core shaft, the first core shaft can drive the telescopic structure to stretch and contract in a linkage mode, so that the stability of the supporting device is improved in the opening state, and the supporting stability of the electronic equipment can be improved.

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种光伏运维数据的处理方法、装置、设备及存储介质，涉及光伏发电技术领域，可以提高管理海量光伏运维数据的效率和准确率。该方法包括：接收光伏运维设备的数据写入请求；数据写入请求携带有光伏运维设备的设备类型标识及至少一个光伏运维数据组；设备类型标识用于唯一表征一种光伏运维设备；一个光伏运维数据组对应一种光伏运维参数，一个光伏运维数据组至少包括参数标识、参数值及时间戳；从候选数据模型中确定出与设备类型标识对应的目标数据模型，并基于目标数据模型对至少一个光伏运维数据组进行处理，得到至少一个展示数据组；基于目标数据模型中包含的至少一个存储标识，对至少一个展示数据组分别进行存储。
content_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic operation and maintenance data processing method and device, equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, and can improve the efficiency and accuracy of managing mass photovoltaic operation and maintenance data. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a data writing request of photovoltaic operation and maintenance equipment; the data write-in request carries an equipment type identifier of the photovoltaic operation and maintenance equipment and at least one photovoltaic operation and maintenance data set; the equipment type identifier is used for uniquely representing one kind of photovoltaic operation and maintenance equipment; one photovoltaic operation and maintenance data set corresponds to one photovoltaic operation and maintenance parameter, and at least comprises a parameter identifier, a parameter value and a timestamp; determining a target data model corresponding to the equipment type identifier from the candidate data models, and processing the at least one photovoltaic operation and maintenance data set based on the target data model to obtain at least one display data set; and based on the at least one storage identifier contained in the target data model, respectively storing the at least one display data group.

content_cn: 本申请提供了一种去嵌入方法和装置，涉及仿真领域，该方法包括：将待测设计的第一端口延伸，以获得第二端口；对待仿真对象进行仿真，以确定第一寄生参数，其中，该待仿真对象包括该第一端口、该第二端口以及该第一端口与该第二端口之间的连接，该第一寄生参数用于指示该第一端口的第二寄生参数与该第二端口的第三寄生参数的乘积；根据该第一寄生参数，确定该第二寄生参数；根据该第二寄生参数，对该第一端口进行去嵌入。相比于经验公式的技术方案，本申请实施例提供的去嵌入方法可以适用更宽的频率范围，并且考虑了寄生电容和寄生电阻，提升了去嵌入的通用性和准确性。
content_en: The invention provides a de-embedding method and device, and relates to the field of simulation, and the method comprises the steps: extending a first port of a to-be-tested design to obtain a second port; a to-be-simulated object is simulated to determine a first parasitic parameter, the to-be-simulated object comprises the first port, the second port and a connection between the first port and the second port, and the first parasitic parameter is used for indicating a product of a second parasitic parameter of the first port and a third parasitic parameter of the second port; determining the second parasitic parameter according to the first parasitic parameter; and de-embedding the first port according to the second parasitic parameter. Compared with the technical scheme of an empirical formula, the de-embedding method provided by the embodiment of the invention can be applied to a wider frequency range, and the universality and accuracy of de-embedding are improved by considering parasitic capacitance and parasitic resistance.

content_cn: 一种功能覆盖率测试度量系统和方法。该系统包括总线功能单元(3)、激励单元(2)、主控台(1)、结果分析单元(4)、以及验证用例功能覆盖率统计单元(5)，用于通过所述分析结果，计算出验证用例中的各个度量要素参数的功能覆盖得分，并根据所述各个度量要素参数的功能覆盖得分得到验证用例的功能覆盖率；被测对象功能覆盖率统计单元(6)，用于通过所述分析结果，计算出被测对象的各个测试层的功能覆盖得分，得到被测对象的功能覆盖率。本发明还提供一种功能覆盖率度量的测试方法，能够在EDA工具中实现，并可以对验证用例和被测对象功能覆盖率进行自动统计。
content_en: A testing and measuring system of function coverage rate comprises bus function unit, excitation unit, master control desk, result analyzing unit, counting up unit of function coverage rate on verification sample for obtaining function coverage rate of verification sample and counting up unit of function coverage rate on object to be tested and measured for obtaining function coverage rate of object to be tested and measured. The method for testing function coverage rate by utilizing said system is also disclosed.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种使用具有减少数量的用于驱动电压稳定的电容器的电路的STN LCD驱动器及其方法。该STN－LCD驱动器包括驱动电压产生电路、公共/段驱动电路、第一到第三电容器和控制电路。该驱动电压产生电路产生第一到第五驱动电压，以经由第一到第五输出终端输出所产生的驱动电压。由驱动极性信号控制的公共/段驱动电路接收第一到第五驱动电压，并且产生公共驱动信号和段驱动信号。第一电容器连接在第一输出终端和接地电压之间。控制电路响应于驱动极性信号而控制输出终端和电容器的连接，以便降低用于驱动电压稳定的电容器的数量。
content_en: An STN LCD driver using a circuit with a reduced number of capacitors for driving voltage stabilization, and a method therefor, are provided. The STN LCD driver includes a driving voltage generating circuit, a common/segment driving circuit, first through third capacitors, and a control circuit. The driving voltage generating circuit generates first through fifth driving voltages to output the generated driving voltages via first through fifth output terminals. The common/segment driving circuit, which is controlled by a driving polarity signal, receives the first through fifth driving voltages and generates a common driving signal and a segment driving signal. The first capacitor is connected between the first output terminal and a ground voltage. The control circuit controls connection of the output terminals and the capacitors in response to the driving polarity signal, in order to reduce the number of the capacitors for driving voltage stabilization.

content_cn: 公开了一种存储系统、一种存储系统的操作方法和一种计算系统。该存储系统包括：存储装置；诊断电路，其生成测试图案，将测试图案发送到存储装置，从存储装置接收与测试图案对应的结果数据，并且通过将测试图案与结果数据进行比较来测试存储装置是否正常操作；以及调试端口，其连接到诊断电路，从外部装置接收辅助电力，将辅助电力供应到诊断电路，并且将存储装置中的数据发送到外部装置。
content_en: The invention discloses a storage system, an operation method of the storage system, and a computing system. The storage system includes: a storage device; a diagnostic circuit that generates a test pattern, transmits the test pattern to the storage device, receives result data corresponding to the test pattern from the storage device, and tests whether the storage device is operating normally by comparing the test pattern with the result data; and a debug port connected to the diagnostic circuit, receiving the auxiliary power from the external device, supplying the auxiliary power to the diagnostic circuit, and transmitting the data in the storage device to the external device.

content_cn: 本发明涉及控制在串行快闪存储器中的适当执行及相应的快闪存储器芯片，使得具有预定存储量的串行快闪存储器控制器能够访问串行快闪存储器，以读取所需数据所属的整个页面，并发送想要的数据到主控制单元或执行该数据。该装置包括：高速缓存模块，用于响应于从主控制单元接收的命令，访问所指定的串行快闪存储器的存储器地址，并读取或写入主控制单元所需的数据；串行快闪存储器控制器，具有启动装载器，用于允许通过下列方式来执行系统启动：读取写在串行快闪存储器上的启动代码，将该启动代码存储到缓冲器中，并且，当主控制单元需要启动代码时立即将该启动代码发送到主控制单元。
content_en: The invention is for controlling execute-in-place in a serial flash memory and a flash memory chip using the same, enabling a serial flash controller with predetermined amount of storage to access the serial flash, to read an entire page to which required data belong, and to transmit the desired data to a main control unit or to execute the data. The apparatus includes a cache module for accessing a designated memory address of the serial flash in response to a command received from a main control unit, and reading or writing data required by the main control unit; a serial flash controller with a boot loader for allowing system booting to be performed by reading boot codes written on the serial flash, and storing the boot codes in a buffer and immediately transmitting the boot codes to the main control unit when the main control unit requires the boot codes.

content_cn: 本申请涉及字符显示技术领域，公开了一种用于字符显示的装置。所述装置包括：第一接收模块，接收并存储字体转换设备发出的汉字点阵数据库；第二接收模块，接收显示请求，所述显示请求包括目标字符及所述目标字符对应的类型；第一确定模块，利用所述汉字点阵数据库对所述目标字符及所述目标字符对应的类型进行查表操作确定目标点阵数据；所述目标点阵数据为一个或多个备选点阵数据；显示模块，对所述目标点阵数据进行显示。这样，直接选择与类型对应的备选点阵数据进行显示，不需要对点阵数据进行放大以适应显示屏的大小，能够在满足显示尺寸的情况下，保证点阵字体的显示效果。本申请还公开一种用于字符显示的方法、电子设备、存储介质。
content_en: The invention relates to the technical field of character display, and discloses a device for character display. The device comprises a first receiving module for receiving and storing a Chinese character dot matrix database sent by font conversion equipment; the second receiving module receives a display request, and the display request comprises a target character and a type corresponding to the target character; the first determining module is used for performing table look-up operation on the target character and the type corresponding to the target character by utilizing the Chinese character dot matrix database to determine target dot matrix data; the target dot matrix data is one or more pieces of alternative dot matrix data; and the display module is used for displaying the target dot matrix data. Therefore, the alternative dot matrix data corresponding to the type is directly selected to be displayed, the dot matrix data does not need to be amplified to adapt to the size of a display screen, and the display effect of dot matrix fonts can be guaranteed under the condition that the display size is met. The invention further discloses a character display method, electronic equipment and a storage medium.

content_cn: 本申请公开了存储介质、存储元件、存储介质配置方法及数据传输方法，属于数据处理技术领域。对于存储介质而言，该存储介质包括至少两个介质颗粒，至少两个介质颗粒通过信号线有序相连形成闭环，至少两个介质颗粒用于通过总线传输数据。其中，信号线的电平由通过信号线相连的两个介质颗粒控制，信号线的电平用于至少两个介质颗粒确定通过总线传输数据的顺序。本申请提供的存储介质能够根据信号线的电平确定通过总线传输数据的顺序，因而介质颗粒可以在完成准备之后自行占用总线完成数据传输，提高了数据传输效率。并且，由于至少两个介质颗粒有序相连形成闭环，因而可以在完成介质颗粒的封装之后再对介质颗粒的优先级进行调整。
content_en: The invention discloses a storage medium, a storage element, a storage medium configuration method and a data transmission method, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. For the storage medium, the storage medium comprises at least two medium particles, the at least two medium particles are orderly connected through a signal line to form a closed loop, and the at least two medium particles are used for transmitting data through a bus. Wherein the level of the signal line is controlled by the two medium particles connected through the signal line, and the level of the signal line is used for the at least two medium particles to determine the sequence of data transmission through the bus. According to the storage medium provided by the invention, the sequence of data transmission through the bus can be determined according to the level of the signal line, so that the medium particles can occupy the bus to complete data transmission after preparation is completed, and the data transmission efficiency is improved. Moreover, the at least two medium particles are orderly connected to form a closed loop, so that the priority of the medium particles can be adjusted after the packaging of the medium particles is completed.

content_cn: 本申请涉及家电技术领域，公开一种用于控制家电的方法，包括：确定用户操作的位置；按所述位置所对应的第一功能/参数的选项和第二功能/参数的选项执行相关操作；其中，所述位置的横坐标对应所述第一功能/参数的选项，所述位置的纵坐标对应所述第二功能/参数的选项。在本申请中，将原本需要进行的两次选择整合为一个操作，且横坐标和纵坐标具有多个不同的交叉点，对应不同的调节选项，方便操作，且调节方式更多样化。本申请还公开一种用于控制家电的控制面板及家电。
content_en: The invention relates to the technical field of household appliances, and discloses a method for controlling a household appliance, which comprises the following steps: determining a position of user operation; executing related operation according to the option of the first function/parameter and the option of the second function/parameter corresponding to the position, wherein the abscissa of the position corresponds to the option of the first function/parameter, and the ordinate of the position corresponds to the option of the second function/parameter. According to the method, two times of selection originally required to be performed are integrated into one operation, and the abscissa and the ordinate have a plurality of different cross points and correspond to different adjustment options, so that the operation is convenient, and the adjustment modes are more diversified. The invention further discloses a control panel for controlling the household appliance and the household appliance.

content_cn: 本发明提出一种按键功能的自定义方法和装置，该按键功能的自定义方法包括在移动设备的应用程序中对产品的按键进行场景功能定义，以得到按键对应的场景功能字段；建立移动设备与产品之间的通信连接，以进入传输模式；将场景功能字段发送至产品，以使用户根据场景功能字段控制产品进行场景工作；断开移动设备与产品之间的通信连接，以退出传输模式。通过本发明能够满足用户的个性化需求，有效提升用户的使用体验。
content_en: The invention brings forward a method and apparatus for customizing a button function. The method for customizing the button function comprises carrying out scene function defining on a button of a product in an application program of a mobile device so as to obtain a scene function field corresponding to the button; establishing communication connection between the mobile device and the product so as to enter a transmission mode; sending the scene function field to the product so as to enable a user to control the product to carry out scene work according to the scene function field; and breaking the communication connection between the mobile device and the product so as to exit from the transmission mode. Through the method and apparatus provided by the invention, the customized demand of the user can be met, and the application experience of the user is effectively improved.

content_cn: 本发明实施例提供一种事故情景构建方法和用于事故情景构建的系统，涉及安全科学与工程应急管理方法技术领域。所述方法包括：根据企业的风险评估报告确定的重大危险源，利用一系列方法分析确定典型重大情景；以及根据三维建模技术，对所述典型重大情景进行三维建模，并用CFD软件仿真所述典型重大情景的事故发生过程和事故的影响区域。通过本发明的技术方案，将企业提供的大量基础数据，进行统计、分析，确定出典型重大情景，并对所述典型重大情景进行建模及仿真计算，可以将典型重大情景以画面的形式展示出来，更加生动形象，便于员工理解，还可以以确定的典型重大情景为基础进行演练培训等，有效提高企业和员工对未来可能发生的严重事故的应急能力。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an accident scene construction method and a system for accident scene construction, and relates to the technical field of safety science and engineering emergency management methods. The method comprises the steps that according to a major hazard source determined by a risk evaluation report of an enterprise, a series of methods are utilized to analyze anddetermine a typical major situation; According to a three-dimensional modeling technology, carrying out three-dimensional modeling on the typical major scenario, and simulating an accident occurrenceprocess and an accident influence area of the typical major scenario by using CFD software. According to the technical scheme of the invention; a large amount of basic data provided by an enterprise is used; statistics, analysis, determining typical significant scenarios, the method is advantaged in that the typical major situation is acquired, modeling and simulation calculation are carried out on the typical major situation, the typical major situation can be displayed in a picture mode, the method is more vivid and convenient for employees to understand, drilling training can be carried outon the basis of the determined typical major situation, and emergency capability of enterprises and employees for severe accidents possibly happening in the future is effectively improved.

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种视觉任务处理方法及其相关设备，可通过目标模型对待处理图像进行处理，目标模型最终输出的特征可保持多样性，有利于提高针对待处理图像的视觉任务的处理精度。本申请的方法包括：获取待处理图像；通过目标模型对待处理图像进行处理，得到待处理图像的特征，目标模型包含第一模块以及第二模块，第一模块与第二模块连接，第一模块至少包含图神经网络，第二模块至少用于实现特征变换；基于待处理图像的特征，完成针对待处理图像的视觉任务。
content_en: The invention discloses a visual task processing method and related equipment thereof, an image to be processed can be processed through a target model, features finally output by the target model can be kept diverse, and the processing precision of a visual task for the image to be processed can be improved. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a to-be-processed image; the to-be-processed image is processed through a target model to obtain features of the to-be-processed image, the target model comprises a first module and a second module, the first module is connected with the second module, the first module at least comprises an image neural network, and the second module is at least used for realizing feature transformation; and completing a visual task for the to-be-processed image based on the features of the to-be-processed image.

content_cn: 本发明涉及一种用于对卷积神经网络的卷积层实现张量链式分解运算的设备。该设备接收包括第一数量的通道的输入数据，并对输入数据执行1x1卷积，以获得多个数据组，其中，所述多个数据组包括第二数量的通道。该设备还对所述多个数据组执行分组卷积，以获得包括第三数量的通道的中间数据。此外，该设备对中间数据执行1x1卷积，以获得包括第四数量的通道的输出数据。
content_en: The invention relates to equipment for realizing tensor chain decomposition operation on a convolutional layer of a convolutional neural network. The apparatus receives input data including a first number of channels and performs a 1 * 1 convolution on the input data to obtain a plurality of data sets, where the plurality of data sets includes a second number of channels. The device also performs packet convolution on the plurality of data sets to obtain intermediate data comprising a third number of lanes. Further, the device performs a 1 * 1 convolution on the intermediate data to obtain output data including a fourth number of channels.

content_cn: 本发明公开一种冷水机房群控系统的控制柜检验方法及装置。其中，该装置包括：机组回路测试模块，电机回路测试模块，电动蝶阀回路测试模块，模拟量测试模块，通讯测试模块。通过本发明，使用具有现实水系统设备功能的检验装置，可模拟各种工况下的控制器控制水系统设备的运行情况，便于测试结果的观测，降低控制柜检验成本。
content_en: The invention discloses a control cabinet inspection method and device for a cold water machine room group control system. The device comprises a unit loop test module, a motor loop test module, an electric butterfly gate loop test module, an analog quantity test module, and a communication test module. According to the invention, with the inspection device having the existing water system equipment function, running conditions of the water system equipment under control of the controller under various working conditions are simulated; the test result is convenient to observe; and the test cost of the control cabinet is lowered.

content_cn: 本申请提供了一种音频子系统的实现方法、电子设备、计算机可读介质，音频子系统的实现方法应用于运行有第一和第二操作系统的移动设备；第一和第二操作系统运行在主系统上；第一操作系统中的音频子系统包括第一音频系统框架层；第二操作系统中的音频子系统包括第二音频系统框架层；还包括设置在第一或第二操作系统或主系统中的音频硬件抽象层；该方法包括：在第一或第二音频系统框架层向音频硬件抽象层请求音频服务的情况下，在预设缓存中查看是否存在对应的音频通道的参数；在预设缓存中存在对应的音频通道的参数的情况下，根据音频通道的参数为第一或第二音频系统框架层提供音频服务。
content_en: The invention provides an implementation method of an audio subsystem, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. The implementation method of the audio subsystem is applied to mobile equipment running a first operating system and a second operating system. The first operating system and the second operating system run on the main system; the audio subsystem in the first operating system comprises a first audio system framework layer; the audio subsystem in the second operating system comprises a second audio system framework layer; the audio hardware abstraction layer is arranged in the first or second operating system or the main system; the method comprises the following steps: when a first audio system framework layer or a second audio system framework layer requests an audio service from an audio hardware abstraction layer, checking whether a parameter of a corresponding audio channel exists in a preset cache; and under the condition that the corresponding parameters of the audio channel exist in the preset cache, providing audio service for the first or second audio system framework layer according to the parameters of the audio channel.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种基于地应力分析的完井方式决策方法及系统，该方法通过围绕目标储层建立包含分布特征以及属性特征的三维裂缝分布模型和三维溶洞分布模型；进而结合三维分布模型的信息根据测量的离散性地应力反演确定真实的地应力分布情况；基于计算的地应力提取三向地应力分量后结合临界井底压力确定井眼的稳定性程度，并针对稳定性程度不同的裸眼井确定匹配的完井方式。采用上述方案，能够克服现有完井方式选择技术中决策操作复杂以及应用存在局限的问题，对于缝洞型储集体发育储层区域的裸眼井能够基于简单的操作匹配合适的完井方案，有助于促进油气井开发工程的效率提升和生产质量优化。
content_en: The invention provides a well completion mode decision-making method and system based on ground stress analysis. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional crack distribution model and a three-dimensional karst cave distribution model containing distribution characteristics and attribute characteristics around a target reservoir; the real crustal stress distribution condition is determined by combining the information of the three-dimensional distribution model according to the measured discrete crustal stress inversion; and three-dimensional crustal stress components are extracted based on the calculated crustal stress, then the stability degree of the borehole is determined in combination with the critical bottom hole pressure, and matched well completion modes are determined for open hole wells with different stability degrees. By the adoption of the scheme, the problems that in an existing well completion mode selection technology, decision operation is complex, and application is limited can be solved, a proper well completion scheme can be matched for an open hole well in a fracture-cavity type reservoir body development reservoir area based on simple operation, and efficiency improvement and production quality optimization of oil and gas well development engineering are facilitated.

content_cn: 提供了一种电子设备，包括：通信电路，被配置为与无人机(UAV)进行无线数据的发送和接收；显示器，被配置为显示用于操作UAV的用户界面(UI)；存储器；以及处理器，与通信电路、显示器和存储器电耦接。处理器被配置为从UAV接收与UAV的第一点的方向相关的信息，响应于接收到与UAV的移动或旋转相关联的用户输入，在显示器上显示与第一点的方向相对应的方向指示对象，响应于方向指示对象的位置和用户输入，产生用于相对于第一点移动或旋转UAV的控制信号，并且使用通信电路向UAV发送所产生的控制信号。
content_en: An electronic device is provided that includes a communication circuit configured to transmit and receive wireless data with the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), a display configured to display a user interface (UI) for operating the UAV, a memory, and a processor electrically coupled with the communication circuit, the display, and the memory. The processor is configured to receive information about a direction of a first point of the UAV from the UAV, display a direction indication object corresponding to a direction of the first point on the display in response to receiving a user input associated with movement or rotation of the UAV, generate a control signal for moving or rotating the UAV with respect to the first point in response to a location of the direction indication object and the user input, and transmit the generated control signal to the UAV using the communication circuit.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种生成多媒体文件的方法，方法步骤如下：在多媒体录制过程中，根据接收的至少一个输入指令，选取多媒体片段；解析所述选取的多媒体片段得到对应的文本信息，根据所述接收的至少一次输入指令生成多媒体文件，并根据所述文本信息生成所述多媒体文件的文件名。通过上述技术方案，通过解析多媒体片段得到的文本信息生成多媒体文件，使得多媒体文件的文件名能够准确的反应多媒体文件的关键信息，提高查找目标多媒体文件的效率。
content_en: The invention discloses a multimedia file generation method. The method comprises steps that in the multimedia recording process, according to at least one received input instruction, a multimedia segment is selected; the selected multimedia segment is analyzed to acquire the corresponding text information, a multimedia file is generated according to received at least one input instruction, and afile name of the multimedia file is generated according to the text information. The method is advantaged in that the multimedia file is generated through the text information acquired through analyzing the multimedia segment, the key information of the multimedia file can be accurately reflected through the file name of the multimedia file, and search efficiency of the target multimedia file is improved.

content_cn: 提供了用于有助于在多载波无线通信系统中的不连续接收的系统、方法和装置。第一方法的实例可以包括：提供分别对应于一个或多个不活动时段的一个或多个不连续接收周期。在该一个或多个不连续接收周期各自的唤醒时段期间，可以在一个或多个频率载波中的相应频率载波上接收数据。可以基于该一个或多个不活动时段来确定要在其上接收数据的一个或多个频率载波的数量和类型。此外，在一些实施例中，除了在所选择的频率载波上提供不连续接收之外，可以在诸如锚载波的其它频率载波上根据连续接收来接收数据。
content_en: Systems, methods and apparatus for facilitating discontinuous reception in a multi-carrier wireless communication system are provided. An example of a first method can include providing one or more discontinuous reception cycles respectively corresponding to one or more inactivity periods. During respective awake periods of the one or more discontinuous reception cycles, data can be received on respective ones of one or more frequency carriers. The number and type of the one or more frequency carriers on which data is received can be determined based on the one or more inactivity periods. Further, in some embodiments, in addition to providing discontinuous reception on selected frequency carriers, data can be received according to continuous reception on other frequency carriers, such as the anchor carrier.

content_cn: 提供了一种保证用户匿名的方法和一种使用该方法的无线LAN系统。在无线LAN系统中，保证用户匿名的方法包括步骤：(a)创建多个临时地址集，每个临时地址集对应于无线终端的唯一媒体访问控制(MAC)地址并将该临时地址集传送至对应的无线终端，和(b)使用选自对应于无线终端的临时地址集的临时地址作为源地址或目的地址，执行在无线终端和无线访问节点之间的数据包传输。因此，在无线终端和无线访问节点之间的数据包传输期间，通过不暴露MAC地址，能够保证用户的匿名并改善系统的安全性。
content_en: A method of guaranteeing users' anonymity and a wireless LAN system therefor are provided. In a wireless LAN system, the method of guaranteeing user' anonymity includes (a) creating a plurality of temporary address sets, each of which corresponds to a unique Media Access Control (MAC) address of a wireless terminal and transmitting the temporary address set to the corresponding wireless terminal, and (b) performing data packet transmission between the wireless terminal and the wireless access node using a temporary address selected from the temporary address set as a source address or a destination address. Therefore, it is possible to guarantee users' anonymity and improve security of a system by not exposing a MAC address during data packet transmission between a wireless terminal and a wireless access node.

content_cn: 本发明的实施例提供一种确定数据传输的方法及装置，涉及移动通信技术领域，能够保证基站与UE之间的正常通信，从而提高了基站与UE之间的通信效率。该方法包括：通信设备确定当前子帧属于第一时间段，该第一时间段为辅载波调度的时间段；通信设备确定当前子帧的数据传输。
content_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and device for determining data transmission, relate to the technical field of mobile communications field and are capable of ensuring the normal communication between a base station and a UE (User Equipment), thereby improving the communication efficiency between the base station and the UE. The method comprises: a communication device determines that the current sub-frame belongs to a first time period, and the first time period is the time period modulated by a secondary carrier; the communication device determines the data transmission of the current sub-frame.

content_cn: 描述了用于无线通信的方法、系统和设备，以使得基站或用户设备(UE)中的一个或两个能够使用一个或多个物理小区标识符(PCI)与控制资源集(CORESET)之间的关联来识别用于被调度的通信的一个或多个PCI，CORESET例如用于发送调度通信的授权。基站可以识别与通信相关联的一个或多个PCI之间的映射，并且可以向UE发送在与一个或多个PCI相关联的CORESET上调度通信的授权。UE可以基于在CORESET中接收到授权来识别CORESET和与该通信相关联的一个或多个PCI之间的映射。UE和基站可以使用与一个或多个所识别的PCI相关联的参数来传送由授权调度的消息。
content_en: Methods, systems, and devices are described for wireless communication to enable one or both of a base station or a user equipment (UE) to identify one or more Physical Cell Identifiers (PCIs) for scheduled communications using an association between the one or more PCIs and a Control Resource Set (CORESET), such as an authorization for sending scheduled communications. The base station may identify a mapping between one or more PCIs associated with the communication, and may send an authorization to the UE to schedule the communication on a CORESET associated with the one or more PCIs. The UE may identify a mapping between the CORESET and one or more PCIs associated with the communication based on receiving the grant in the CORESET. The UE and the base station may transmit a message scheduled by the grant using parameters associated with the one or more identified PCIs.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种电子设备，通过将系统单芯片和射频集成电路分别内置于不同电路板中，同时将任一个短距天线与系统单芯片之间的距离设置为大于任一个移动蜂窝天线与射频集成电路之间的距离，进而可以实现在电路板上合理分布电路器件，减少电路器件占用电路板的面积比例，从而提高电池在电路板上的面积比例。同时，系统单芯片和射频集成电路通过连接器进行通信，还可以减少电路板间过轴通信的功率损耗问题，满足系统单芯片可承受的链路损耗。
content_en: According to the electronic equipment provided by the invention, the system single chip and the radio frequency integrated circuit are respectively arranged in different circuit boards, and meanwhile, the distance between any short-distance antenna and the system single chip is set to be greater than the distance between any mobile cellular antenna and the radio frequency integrated circuit; therefore, the circuit devices can be reasonably distributed on the circuit board, the area proportion of the circuit devices occupying the circuit board is reduced, and the area proportion of the battery on the circuit board is improved. Meanwhile, the system single chip communicates with the radio frequency integrated circuit through the connector, the problem of power loss of through-axis communication between circuit boards can be reduced, and the bearable link loss of the system single chip is met.

content_cn: 本发明实施例提供一种远程资源访问方法和交换设备，能够实现本地计算机系统与远端的物理资源设备之间的数据传输且实现远端的物理资源设备以中断的方式访问计算机系统。其方法为：计算机系统访问远端的物理资源设备时，首先将虚拟资源设备的第一访问消息中的虚拟地址转换为对应的远端的物理资源设备的物理地址，生成第二访问消息，并将该访问消息通过网络发送至物理地址对应的远端的物理资源设备，从而实现本地计算机系统与远端的物理资源设备之间的数据传输。
content_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a remote resource access method and a switching device, so as to implement data transmission between a local computer system and a remote physical resource device, and enable the remote physical resource device to access a computer system using an interrupt manner. The remote resource access method is as follows: When the computer system accessing the remote physical resource device, the switching device converts a virtual address that is of a virtual resource device and that is in a first access message into a corresponding physical address of the remote physical resource device, so as to generate a second access message. Then, the switching device sends the second access message to the remote physical resource device corresponding to the physical address by using a network, thereby implementing the data transmission between the local computer system and the remote physical resource device.

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种基于多波束轮询的传输方法及装置，以及基于该方法的一种通讯设备及电子设备可读存储介质，通过接入点AP广播信标消息，该信标消息用于指明信标周期的时长；并向站点STA发送包含有信道使用时长的数据包；其中，信道使用时长用于指明在信标周期的时长范围内AP与STA进行通讯的目标时隙；从而使得AP与STA可以在目标时隙进行通讯。实现了AP基于多波束轮询STA，通过向STA分配目标时隙，实现以定向通讯代替全向通讯，有助于在保证长距离传输的前提下还能够提升系统增益；同时，实现各个STA与AP之间通讯的有序性，提升交互效率，且大大缓解STA间通讯冲突的问题。
content_en: Disclosed are a multi-beam polling based transmission method and apparatus, and a communication device based on the method and an electronic device readable storage medium. The method comprises: broadcasting a beacon message via an access point (AP), wherein the beacon message is used for indicating the duration of a beacon period; and sending a data packet containing a channel usage duration to astation (STA), wherein the channel usage duration is used for indicating a target time slot, where the AP communicates with the STA, within the range of the duration of the beacon period, so that theAP and the STA can communicate within the target time slot. Thus, an AP polling STAs based on multiple beams is realized, and by allocating a target time slot to the STAs, omnidirectional communication is replaced with directional communication, so that system gains can also be improved while ensuring long-distance transmission. In addition, the orderliness of communication between the STAs and the AP is realized, thereby improving the interaction efficiency and greatly relieving the problem of communication conflicts between the STAs.

content_cn: 本申请提供了用于获取证书或凭证的方法、装置、设备、存储介质和程序产品，涉及数据安全领域。该方法包括在物理主机处向验证服务器发送用于获取加密证书的请求，该请求包括针对虚拟机的虚拟可信根的目标公钥；从验证服务器接收由目标公钥加密的随机数；基于加密的随机数来从物理主机的硬件可信根获取经签名的远程证明信息；向验证服务器发送经签名的远程证明信息和目标公钥；以及从验证服务器接收针对目标公钥的加密证书。本申请的实施例实现了虚拟可信根和硬件可信根的关联关系，改进了对应于硬件可信根的虚拟可信根的验证效率，提高了用户体验。
content_en: The invention provides a method and device for acquiring a certificate or a certificate, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the field of data security. The method comprises the following steps: sending a request for obtaining an encryption certificate to a verification server at a physical host, wherein the request comprises a target public key aiming at a virtual trusted root of a virtual machine; receiving a random number encrypted by the target public key from the authentication server; obtaining signed remote attestation information from a hardware root of trust of the physical host based on the encrypted random number; sending the signed remote attestation information and the target public key to a verification server; and receiving an encrypted certificate for the target public key from the authentication server. According to the embodiment of the invention, the association relationship between the virtual trusted root and the hardware trusted root is realized, the verification efficiency of the virtual trusted root corresponding to the hardware trusted root is improved, and the user experience is improved.

content_cn: 一种发起用户面路径重建的方法、装置及通信系统，用以为终端设备的会话提供更好的服务，以提高用户体验。其中该方法包括：会话管理功能实体根据终端设备的第一位置信息，确定所述终端设备的当前会话所属的会话服务区，并在接收到移动性管理功能实体发送的所述终端设备的第二位置信息后，若确定所述第二位置信息不在所述会话服务区内，则指示所述终端设备发起针对所述当前会话的重建流程，或者发起切换流程。由于引入了会话服务区，因此当终端设备为在两个相邻的用户面功能实体的服务区域的边缘来回移动时，避免了在两个用户面功能实体之间来回切换导致的乒乓效应，从而提高了用户体验。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for initiating user plane path reconstruction and a communication system, which are used for providing better service for a session of terminal equipment so as to improve the user experience. The method comprises the following steps of: enabling the session management functional entity to determine a session service area to which a current session of the terminal device belongs according to the first position information of the terminal equipment;, and after receiving the second position information of the terminal device sent by the mobility management function entity, if the second position information is determined not to be in the session service area, instructing the terminal device to initiate a reconstruction process for the current session or initiate a switching process. Due to the introduction of the session service area, when the terminal equipment moves back and forth at the edges of the service areas of the two adjacent user plane functional entities, the ping-pong effect caused by back and forth switching between the two user plane functional entities is avoided, so that the user experience is improved.

content_cn: 本发明提出了用于加密和认证数据的方法和装置，使得一些数据可以以明文的形式发送但仍然由发送机认证。一组明码位置或一组密文位置被用于指定哪些数据块会被用于生成输入校验和值(470)和输出校验和值(475)。这些校验和值接着被用于生成认证标记(490)。
content_en: Methods and apparatus are presented herein for encrypting and authentication data, such that some of data can be transmitted in the clear but still be authenticated by the sender. A set of cleartext positions and/or a set of ciphertext positions are used to specify which data blocks will be used to generate an input checksum value (470) and an output checksum value (475). These checksums are then used to generate an authentication tag (490).

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种通信方法、装置及设备，用于终端设备与为终端设备提供专属服务的核心网功能进行通信。该方法为：终端设备在获取到所述终端设备的第一标识之后，可以根据所述第一标识，与所述第一标识中的第一指示所指示的第一核心网功能进行通信。其中，所述第一标识包括：第一指示，以及第二指示和/或第三指示；所述第一指示用于指示为所述终端设备提供专属服务的第一核心网功能，所述第二指示用于指示与所述第一核心网功能连接的第一接入功能，所述第三指示用于指示管理所述第一核心网功能的第一控制功能。这样，所述终端设备可以根据所述第一标识，与为所述终端设备提供专属服务的第一核心网功能进行通信。
content_en: The invention discloses a communication method, device and equipment, which are used for communication between terminal equipment and a core network function for providing exclusive service for the terminal equipment. The method comprises the following steps: after acquiring a first identifier of the terminal equipment, the terminal equipment can communicate with a first core network function indicated by a first indication in the first identifier according to the first identifier. Wherein the first identifier comprises a first indication, and a second indication and/or a third indication; the first indication is used for indicating a first core network function for providing exclusive service for the terminal equipment, the second indication is used for indicating a first access function connected with the first core network function, and the third indication is used for indicating a first control function for managing the first core network function. Thus, the terminal device can communicate with the first core network function providing the exclusive service for the terminal device according to the first identifier.

content_cn: 本申请实施例公开了一种天线校准方法及系统，用于通信技术领域。该系统包括：基带处理单元、射频拉远单元、天线阵列和耦合天线；所述天线阵列，用于向无线网络发送基带处理单元发送的射频校准信号；或者接收射频校准信号；所述射频拉远单元，用于提供多条传输通道；所述多条传输通道和所述多个传输端口对应；所述耦合天线，用于在所述无线网络中接收所述基带处理单元发送的所述射频校准信号，并将所述射频校准信号对应的耦合信号传输至所述基带处理单元；或者向所述无线网络发送所述射频校准信号；所述基带处理单元，用于根据所述射频校准信号和所述耦合信号的差异，对所述多条传输通道对应的多个待发送基带信号进行校准。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an antenna calibration method and system, and is applied to the technical field of communication. The system comprises a baseband processing unit, a remote radio unit, an antenna array and a coupled antenna, the antenna array is used for sending the radio frequency calibration signal sent by the baseband processing unit to a wireless network; or receiving a radio frequency calibration signal; the radio remote unit is used for providing a plurality of transmission channels; the plurality of transmission channels correspond to the plurality of transmission ports; the coupled antenna is used for receiving the radio frequency calibration signal sent by the baseband processing unit in the wireless network and transmitting a coupled signal corresponding to the radio frequency calibration signal to the baseband processing unit; or sending the radio frequency calibration signal to the wireless network; and the baseband processing unit is used for calibrating a plurality of to-be-sent baseband signals corresponding to the plurality of transmission channels according to the difference between the radio frequency calibration signal and the coupling signal.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种电流补偿方法、功率解耦电路及功率变换器系统，该方法包括：通过控制功率解耦电路注入的补偿电流的相位角与主功率变换器电路的直流母线侧上的母线电流的交流分量的相位角之间的差值大于或等于180°且小于或等于270°，提高功率解耦电路的损耗补偿能力，使得功率解耦电路采用成本较低且损耗较大的元器件，有益于减小功率解耦电路的体积，还可以基于主功率变换器电路的直流母线侧上的母线电压的交流分量，调节功率解耦电路注入的补偿电流的幅值，综合考虑主功率变换器电路的损耗和功率解耦电路的损耗，优化了功率变换器系统的综合损耗和效率，减小了主功率变换器电路的直流母线侧上的电压纹波，保证了良好的电流补偿抵消效果。
content_en: The invention provides a current compensation method, a power decoupling circuit and a power converter system. The method comprises the steps: the difference between the phase angle of the compensation current injected by the power decoupling circuit and the phase angle of the AC component of the bus current on the DC bus side of the main power converter circuit is controlled to be greater than orequal to 180 degrees and less than or equal to 270 degrees to improve the loss compensation ability of the power decoupling circuit so that the power decoupling circuit adopts components with lower cost and higher loss,the volume of the power decoupling circuit is reduced, the amplitude of the compensation current injected by the power decoupling circuit can be adjusted based on the AC componentof the bus voltage on the DC bus side of the main power converter circuit and the loss of the main power converter circuit and the loss of the power decoupling circuit is comprehensively considered, the comprehensive loss and the efficiency of the power converter system are optimized, the voltage ripple on the DC bus side of the main power converter circuit is reduced and the good current compensation and cancellation effect is ensured.

content_cn: 本实用新型是一种实现空调光伏系统供电待机的低压供电系统，包括空调控制芯片和信号接收装置，空调控制芯片和信号接收装置相连接，其特征是，还包括有光伏系统，所述光伏系统分别与空调控制芯片和信号接收装置连接；所述光伏系统包括光伏电池板、控制器、蓄电池、DC/DC转换器以及控制上述部件的检测和控制系统，所述光伏电池板与控制器连接，控制器分别与蓄电池和DC/DC转换器连接，检测控制系统与上述部件连接。本实用新型能利用光伏系统对空调的控制芯片和信号接收装置供电，使这两部件在空调工作和待机时无需市用交流电供应，实现空调零瓦交流电待机。其具有通用性、高效率利用光能、装配方便、安全可靠的特点。
content_en: The utility model discloses a low voltage power supply system capable of realizing air-conditioning photovoltaic system power supply standby. The system comprises an air conditioning control chip and a signal receiving apparatus. The air conditioning control chip is connected with the signal receiving apparatus. The system is characterized in that: the system also comprises a photovoltaic system; the photovoltaic system is connected with the air conditioning control chip and the signal receiving apparatus respectively; the photovoltaic system comprises a photovoltaic cell panel, a controller, a storage battery, a DC/DC converter and a detection and control system which is used to control the above parts; the photovoltaic cell panel is connected with the controller; the controller is connected with the storage battery and the DC/DC converter respectively; the detection control system is connected with the above parts. The system of the utility model can provide power for the control chip of an air conditioning and the signal receiving apparatus by using the photovoltaic system so that an alternating current in a city does not need to provide the power for the two parts when the air conditioning is working and is in a standby state. Therefore, the air-conditioning zero tile alternating current standby is realized. The system possesses the following characteristics that: versatility is possessed; luminous energy can be used efficiently; assembling is convenient; and the system is safe and reliable.

content_cn: 本发明实施例提供一种网络切片确定方法、通信设备、系统及存储介质，终端通过从服务器处获取的可用网络切片信息了解到自己当前的可用网络切片，然后从这些可用网络切片中确定出目标网络切片，随后再向核心网侧申请该目标网络切片，与核心网侧建立该目标网络切片对应的会话，进而基于该目标网络切片进行通信，享受该目标网络切片提供的服务。所以在本发明实施例中，终端最终接入哪个网络切片是由终端侧决定的，终端侧拥有对目标网络切片的决定权，同时，因为终端侧能够更清楚其自身或者用户的通信需求，所以，终端侧自己选择出的目标网络切片更有利于满足用户通信需求，提升用户体验。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a network slice determination method, a communication device, a system and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: a terminal knows a current available network slice through available network slice information obtained from a server, and then determines a target network slice from the available network slices; and then applying for the target network slice from the core network side, establishing a session corresponding to the target network slice with the core network side, and further performing communication based on the target network slice to enjoy services provided by the target network slice.
