When initial water is lower than a low-temperature limit value and advanced water reaches a first set water level, the method is stopped, and a heating device is started to heat water to improve the activity of a detergent; the heating device is closed after the water is heated to the first set water temperature, the washing procedure is executed according to the specified rotation-stop ratio after the water is fed to the specified water level, and the specified rotation-stop ratio is determined according to the difference value between the low-temperature limit value and the initial water temperature and is in direct proportion to the difference value, so that the effect of increasing the washing duration at the low temperature is achieved; the measure of increasing the washing time is used for making up the influence of low water temperature on the washing effect; the activity of the detergent is improved by feeding a small amount of water for heating, the rotation-stop ratio is properly increased based on the difference value between the low-temperature limit value and the initial water temperature after the water is supplemented to the designated water level, so that the influence of the low water temperature on the washing effect is made up through control over the washing duration, and the washing duration is not excessively prolonged while the washing effect is guaranteed.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种衣物护理机，所述衣物护理机设置有微处理器，所述衣物护理机包括：主机，设置有蒸汽通道、蒸汽手柄、蒸汽发生器和工频输入端，所述蒸汽通道连接于所述蒸汽手柄和所述蒸汽发生器之间，所述蒸汽发生器与所述微处理器连接；支架结构，设置有蒸汽手柄容纳部、支架杆和底座，所述蒸汽手柄容纳部用于放置所述蒸汽手柄，所述支架杆和所述底座可通过旋转结构组装在一起；衣物感应装置，连接至所述微处理器，所述微处理器根据所述衣物感应装置的感测结果对所述蒸汽发生器的工作状态进行控制。通过本实用新型技术方案，实现了衣物护理机的智能控制，节约功耗，提高了产品安全性，并让衣物护理机的支架可以旋转，提升了用户的使用体验。
content_en: The utility model provides a clothes caring machine. The clothes caring machine is provided with a microprocessor and comprises a main machine, a support structure and a clothes sensing device, wherein the main machine is provided with a steam passage, a steam handle, a steam generator and a power frequency input end, the steam passage is connected between the steam handle and the steam generator, and the steam generator is connected with the microprocessor; the support structure is provided with a steam handle accommodating part, a support rod and a base, the steam handle accommodating part is used for placing the steam handle, and the support rod and the base are assembled together through a rotary structure; the clothes sensing device is connected to the microprocessor, and the microprocessor controls the working states of the steam generator according to the sensing result of the clothes sensing device. By the arrangement, the clothes caring machine has the advantages that intelligent control of the clothes caring machine is achieved, power consumption is reduced, product safety is increased, the support of the clothes caring machine is rotatable, and user experience is increased.

content_cn: 本发明公开的示警控制方法、装置及干衣机，基于不同材质的衣物对过滤网趋污的影响程度不同，预先制定了衣物材质与校正系数间的对应关系，例如，具体可采用对单位重量的棉织物干衣单位时长所产生的毛屑量为参考基准，获取各种衣物材质所对应的校正系数。在此基础上，每次干衣后，在对干衣时长进行累计前，首先利用相应的校正系数对获取的实际干衣时长进行折合、校正，即累计所得的总时长实质为总校正时长，并在总校正时长达到预设阈值时，控制报警。可见，本发明通过依据不同材质的衣物对过滤网趋污的不同影响对干衣时长进行相应校正，提高了过滤网清洗提醒的参考价值及准确率。
content_en: The invention discloses a warning control method, a warning control device and a clothes drying machine. On the basis that clothes made of different materials have different influence degrees on filter net contamination, a corresponding relationship between the clothes materials and a correcting coefficient is made in advance, for example, the flock quantity generated in the unit duration of cotton fabric clothes drying in unit weight can be concretely adopted as the reference standard, and correcting coefficients corresponding to various clothes materials can be obtained. On the basis, after the clothes drying in each time and before the accumulation on the clothes drying duration, firstly, the corresponding correcting coefficient is used for calculating and correcting the obtained actual clothes drying duration, the accumulated and obtained total duration is actually the total correction duration, and when the total correction duration reaches a preset threshold, the warning is controlled. Therefore the method, the device and the clothes drying machine have the advantages that the clothes drying duration can be correspondingly corrected according to different influence of the clothes made of different materials on the filter net contamination, and the accuracy and the reference value of the filter net cleaning prompt are improved.

content_cn: 本发明属于洗衣机技术领域，公开了一种洗衣机及其控制方法，所述洗衣机包括内桶，所述内桶的桶底上开设排水孔，所述洗衣机还包括设置在内桶下方的密封机构，所述密封机构封堵所述排水孔形成封闭内桶，用于独立盛放洗涤水；所述洗衣机还包括可螺旋上升/下降的推动件，所述推动件在驱动机构的带动下螺旋上升，推动密封机构封堵排水孔。本发明的洗衣机通过推动件螺旋上升推动密封机构封堵排水孔，使内桶可以独立盛水进行洗涤，内桶的转动不影响推动件与密封机构的位置，打开与封堵排水孔之前均不需要对内桶进行定位，控制逻辑简单，易于实现。
content_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of washing machines, and discloses a washing machine and a control method thereof.The washing machine comprises an inner barrel, a drainage hole is formed in the barrel bottom of the inner barrel, the washing machine further comprises a sealing mechanism arranged below the inner barrel, and the sealing mechanism blocks the drainage hole to form the closed inner barrel and is used for independently containing washing water; the washing machine further comprises a pushing part capable of spirally ascending/descending, and the pushing part is driven by the driving mechanism to spirally ascend to push the sealing mechanism to block the drainage hole. According to the washing machine, the pushing piece spirally ascends to push the sealing mechanism to block the drainage hole, the inner barrel can independently contain water for washing, rotation of the inner barrel does not affect the positions of the pushing piece and the sealing mechanism, the inner barrel does not need to be positioned before the drainage hole is opened and blocked, control logic is simple, and implementation is easy.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了主动轮式高原抽油机移机装置，包括传动轴、滚轮、轴套、从动轮，所述传动轴为阶梯轴，传动轴两端设置有扳手，所述扳手为棘轮扳手，扳手上设置有换向开关，所述滚轮为防滑处理的圆轮，当给传动轴施加扭力时传动轴转动，带动滚轮与抽油机一起移动，从动轮起辅助减少摩擦的作用，防滑处理的滚轮增加附着力，解决轮子空转。高强度快速板手可保证施力时角度，减少多次调整板手费时费力问题。本实用新型比传统移机装置成本低。安装应用方便。
content_en: The utility model discloses a driving wheel type highland oil pumping unit moving device. The driving wheel type highland oil pumping unit moving device comprises a transmission shaft, rollers, a shaft sleeve and a driven wheel, wherein the transmission shaft is a stepped shaft; levers are arranged at two ends of the transmission shaft and are ratchet levers; each lever is provided with a reversing switch; and the rollers are anti-sliding round wheels. When a twisting force is applied to the transmission shaft, the transmission shaft rotates, the rollers and an oil pumping unit are driven to move together, the driven wheel has an effect of reducing friction, an adhesive force is improved by the anti-sliding roller, and idling of the rollers is avoided. The angle can be guaranteed during force application by the high-strength quick levers, and the problem that the time and the labor are wasted due to the fact that the levers are adjusted repeatedly is solved. Compared with the traditional oil pumping unit moving device, the driving wheel type highland oil pumping unit moving device is low in cost and convenient to mount and use.

content_cn: 本发明涉及烹饪设备及其面板开合控制装置及打开控制方法，打开控制方法包括：接收面板开启信号；控制驱动机构以逐级增大的占空比渐进式推动面板打开；控制驱动机构以逐级增大的占空比渐进式推动面板打开包括：驱动机构以设定占空比推动面板，并且判断驱动机构当前的实际堵转电流是否小于堵转电流阈值：若是，则控制驱动机构继续以当前占空比推动面板，直至判断到面板已打开到位，停止驱动；若否，则控制驱动机构重新启动并以大于当前占空比的下一级别的占空比推动面板。本发明在面板开启过程中控制驱动机构以逐渐增大的占空比逐级推动面板，可以有效地避免驱动机构以最大占空比推动面板容易产生机械卡滞，误判率高，打开成功率低的问题。
content_en: The invention relates to cooking equipment and a panel opening and closing control device and an opening control method thereof. The opening control method comprises the following steps: receiving a panel opening signal; the driving mechanism is controlled to gradually push the panel to be opened at the duty ratio which is increased step by step; the step of controlling the driving mechanism to gradually push the panel to be opened with the duty ratio increasing step by step comprises the steps that the driving mechanism pushes the panel with the set duty ratio, and whether the current actual locked-rotor current of the driving mechanism is smaller than a locked-rotor current threshold value or not is judged, if yes, the driving mechanism is controlled to continue to push the panel with the current duty ratio, and if not, the panel is opened. Driving is stopped until it is judged that the panel is opened in place; if not, the driving mechanism is controlled to be restarted, and the panel is pushed with the next-level duty ratio larger than the current duty ratio. In the panel opening process, the driving mechanism is controlled to push the panel step by step at the gradually-increased duty ratio, and the problems that mechanical clamping stagnation is easily generated, the misjudgment rate is high and the opening success rate is low due to the fact that the driving mechanism pushes the panel at the maximum duty ratio can be effectively solved.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供了一种油气井用套管组件。所述套管组件包括第一、二套管，第一套管包括第一套管管体和第一接头，第一接头具有超出第一套管管体的外圆周面的第一加厚部以及形成在该第一加厚部上的外螺纹；第二套管包括第二套管管体和第二接头，第二接头具有超出第二套管管体的外圆周面的第二加厚部及形成在该第二加厚部上的内螺纹；内、外螺纹的锥度均为1∶(13～19)，内、外螺纹彼此过盈配合且均为具有承载面为负角的偏梯形螺纹，内、外螺纹连接部分的两端分别设置一处锥面对锥面的金属弹性密封。本实用新型与现有技术中带接箍的接箍相比，外径减小了约8～12mm。
content_en: The utility model provides a casing pipe assembly for an oil-gas well. The casing pipe assembly comprises a first casing pipe and a second casing pipe, wherein the first casing pipe comprises a first casing pipe body and a first connector, the first connector is provided with a first thickened portion exceeding out of the outer peripheral face of the first casing pipe body and outer threads formed on the first thickened portion. The second casing pipe comprises a second casing pipe body and a second connector, the second connector is provided with a second thickened portion exceeding out of the outer peripheral face of the second casing pipe body and inner threads formed on the second thickened portion. Tapers of the inner threads and the outer threads are 1: (13-19), the inner threads are mutually interference fit with the outer threads, the inner threads and the outer threads are buttress threads with bearing faces at negative angles, and metal elastic seals with opposite conical surfaces are arranged at two ends of the connecting portion for the outer threads and the inner threads respectively. Compared with couplings in the prior art, outer diameter is decreased by about 8-12 mm.

content_cn: 本实用新型提出了一种射孔工具，其包括射孔管柱；设置在射孔管柱的下端的射孔枪；位于射孔枪上端的标定装置；设置在射孔管柱上并位于射孔枪上端的定位装置，定位装置能与标定装置配合以获得相应的射孔枪的位置，其中，标定装置构造为在第一状态下固定在射孔管柱上而在第二状态下固定在射孔工具下入的套管上，该射孔工具可以调整射孔管柱的位置和方位以调整射孔的位置，以最大范围沟通储层。
content_en: The utility model provides a perforation instrument, it includes perforated string, the setting is at the perforation rifle of perforated string's lower extreme, be located the calibration device of perforation rifle upper end, the setting is on perforated string and lie in the positioner of perforation rifle upper end, positioner can with the position of calibration device cooperation in order toobtain corresponding perforation rifle, wherein, the calibration device structure is fixed on the sleeve pipe that perforation instrument goes into down under the second state for fixing under firststate on perforated string, this perforation instrument can adjust perforated string's position and the position position in order to adjust the perforation to link up the reservoir the most on a large scale.

content_cn: 一种陆相细粒沉积岩岩石相分析方法，包括：根据岩性或岩性组合方式、有机碳含量、硅质含量和钙质含量对岩石相进行分类，建立岩石相分类规则；提取待分析细粒沉积岩的岩心，识别岩心中的岩性或岩性组合界面，并基于岩性或岩性组合和岩石相分类命名规则，确定待分析细粒沉积岩的岩石相类型；分别确定每种类型的岩石相的特征参数，从而确定其中的有利岩石相，建立有利岩石相测井评价标准。该岩石相分析方法通过岩性组合方式、有机碳丰度、硅质丰度和钙质丰度对岩石相进行分类，建立岩石相分类规则，使其能够适用于陆相细粒沉积岩。
content_en: A lithofacies analysis method for continental facies fine-grained sedimentary rocks includes classifying lithofacies according to the lithology or lithological association mode, the content of organiccarbon, the content of silicon and the content of calcium, and establishing lithofacies classification rules; extracting a core of a to-be-analyzed fine-grained sedimentary rock, identifying a lithology or lithological association interface in the core, and determining the lithofacies type of the to-be-analyzed fine-grained sedimentary rock according to the lithology or lithological association and the lithofacies classification and naming rules; determining the characteristic parameters of each type of lithofacies, determining the favorable lithofacies, and establishing logging evaluation criteria of the favorable lithofacies. The lithofacies analysis method has the advantages that the lithofacies is classified according to the lithological association mode, the abundance of the organiccarbon, the abundance of the silicon and the abundance of the calcium, the lithofacies classification rules are established, and accordingly, the lithofacies analysis method can be applied to the continental facies fine-grained sedimentary rocks.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种全通径无限级压裂完井组件及其工艺方法，包括压裂完井滑套和用于开启压裂完井滑套的打开工具，二者通过特定的滑块与凹槽的配合结构，具有多种序列组合，保证分段压裂级数不受限制；开启方式既可实现任意定点压裂完井滑套的一匙一开，也可实现一级多簇压裂完井滑套的一匙多开；压后，打开工具可全部溶解，实现完井管柱全通径；满足连续快速、大规模、多级多簇的压裂完井施工需求，提高压裂效率。
content_en: The full-bore infinite-order fracturing well completion assembly comprises a fracturing well completion sliding sleeve and an opening tool used for opening the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve, the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve and the opening tool have multiple sequence combinations through a matching structure of a specific sliding block and a groove, and it is guaranteed that staged fracturing stages are not limited; according to the opening mode, one-key one-opening of the fracturing well completion sliding sleeve at any fixed point can be achieved, and one-key multi-opening of the first-stage multi-cluster fracturing well completion sliding sleeve can also be achieved. After pressing, the tool is opened and can be completely dissolved, so that the full bore of a well completion pipe string is realized; the continuous, rapid, large-scale, multi-stage and multi-cluster fracturing well completion construction requirements are met, and the fracturing efficiency is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种异常井井温预警方法，属于油田开发技术领域。其包括以下步骤：(1)根据Remay理论井筒散热模型，以水当量为决定出液温度的关键参数，对井温影响较小的次要参数视为常量，建立出液温度预测模型：其中，T为井口出液温度；Q为单井产液量；fw为含水率；a、b、c、为常数；(2)对实测油井数据进行拟合，确定a、b、c的值；(3)针对不同环境温度下的井口出液温度形成合理井温范围，建立井温图版，通过远传系统导出每一口井的井温实时数据，对异常井温进行排查。该方法适用性强，能够及时发现油井出液异常，提高处理时效，极大节省成本。
content_en: The invention discloses an abnormal well temperature early warning method, and belongs to the technical field of oilfield development. The method comprises the following steps: (1) according to a Remay theory wellbore heat dissipation model, establishing an outlet liquid temperature prediction model by taking water equivalent as a key parameter for determining the outlet liquid temperature and taking a secondary parameter with small influence on the well temperature as a constant, q is the liquid production capacity of a single well; fw is the water content; a, b and c are constants; (2) fitting actually measured oil well data, and determining values of a, b and c; and (3) forming a reasonable well temperature range according to the well mouth liquid outlet temperatures under different environment temperatures, establishing a well temperature chart, exporting well temperature real-time data of each well through a remote transmission system, and checking abnormal well temperatures. The method is high in applicability, oil well liquid outlet abnormity can be found in time, the treatment time efficiency is improved, and the cost is greatly saved.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种表征油水两相流体的流动型态的方法，其包括以下步骤：步骤1、对油水两相流体的特定温度和压力条件进行划分，以得到不同的子温度和压力条件；步骤2、在同一子温度和压力条件下，同时以油水两相流体的流速和持水率作为自变量对油水两相流体的流动型态进行测量，以得到油水两相流体在不同流速和不同持水率条件下对应的流动型态；步骤3、在同一子温度和压力条件下，绘制用于表征油水两相流体的流动型态的流速‑持水率的图版，以确定油水两相流体的流动型态边界。通过上述方法能够直观而准确地表征出不同条件下油水两相流动型态，为研究油水两相流体的两相流动规律奠定基础，以改善油液在垂直井筒中发生举升困难或停产的情况。
content_en: The invention provides a method for representing the flow pattern of an oil-water two-phase fluid. The method comprises the following steps that 1, the specific temperature and pressure conditions ofthe oil-water two-phase fluid are divided to obtain different sub-temperature and pressure conditions; 2, under the same sub-temperature and pressure condition, the flow velocity and specific retention of the oil-water two-phase fluid simultaneously serve as independent variables to measure the flow pattern of the oil-water two-phase fluid so as to obtain the corresponding flow patterns of the oil-water two-phase fluid under different flow velocities and different specific retention conditions; and 3, under the same sub-temperature and pressure condition, a flow velocity-specific retention chart used for representing the flow pattern of the oil-water two-phase fluid is drawn to determine a flow pattern boundary of the oil-water two-phase fluid. Through the method, the oil-water two-phase flow patterns under the different conditions can be intuitively and accurately represented, and the foundation is laid for the study of the two-phase flow rule of the oil-water two-phase fluid so as torelieve the situations of difficult lifting and halt production of oil liquid in a vertical wellbore.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种双型抽油机固定基础，可用于安装横向孔距相同的第一抽油机和第二抽油机，双型固定基础(1)上设置有用于安装第一抽油机的第一预埋组件(2)和用于安装第二抽油机的第二预埋组件(3)，第一预埋组件(2)和第二预埋组件(3)相互间隔设置，第一预埋组件与抽油机底部的安装件相匹配，第二预埋组件与第二抽油机底部的安装件相匹配，第一抽油机或第二抽油机可通过第一预埋组件、第二预埋组件固定连接在双型固定基础(1)上。本实用新型的一种双型抽油机固定基础，可在同一固定基础上安装不同型号的抽油机，调整机型时，无需重新补打抽油机固定基础，提高了生产时效。
content_en: The utility model discloses a fixed basis of dimorphism beam -pumping unit, can be used to install the same first beam -pumping unit of horizontal pitch -row and second beam -pumping unit, be provided with the pre -buried subassembly of second (3) that is used for installing first pre -buried subassembly (2) of first beam -pumping unit and is used for installing the second beam -pumping unit on the fixed basis of dimorphism (1), first pre -buried subassembly (2) and the pre -buried subassembly of second (3) separate the setting each other, the installed part phase -match of first pre -buried subassembly bottom the beam -pumping unit, the installed part phase -match of the pre -buried subassembly of second bottom the second beam -pumping unit, first beam -pumping unit or the first pre -buried subassembly of second beam -pumping unit accessible, the pre -buried subassembly fixed connection of second is on the fixed basis of dimorphism (1). The utility model discloses a fixed basis of dimorphism beam -pumping unit can install the beam -pumping unit of different models on same fixed basis, during the adjustment model, need not to mend again and beat the fixed basis of beam -pumping unit, has improved the production prescription.

content_cn: 本实用新型涉及一种投球打开式滑套和压裂管柱。该投球打开式滑套包括：滑套本体，贯穿其侧壁设置有压裂孔，能贴合滑套本体的内壁而滑动的球座，在球座上轴向地设置有通孔，球座在第一位置处通过剪钉与滑套本体固定相连并封堵住压裂孔。这种投球打开式滑套能实现了现有技术中的滑套的功能，而且结构简单。
content_en: The utility model relates to a ball-throwing opening type sliding sleeve and a pressing tubular column. The ball-throwing opening type sliding sleeve comprises a sliding sleeve body, a pressing-cracking hole which is formed by penetrating through the side wall of the sliding sleeve body and a ball base which can slide by being attached to the inner wall of the sliding sleeve body. A through hole is formed in the ball base in the axial direction. A first position of the ball base is fixedly connected with the sliding sleeve body through a shearing screw and seals the pressing-cracking hole. The ball-throwing opening type sliding sleeve can achieve the function of the sliding sleeve in the prior art, and the structure is simple.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种射孔压裂连续作业中的单球自动投球器，解决了现有射孔压裂连续作业中需要人工投球操作的问题。技术方案包括中空的投球管，所述投球管的上段开有放球口，底面为投球口，所述投球管中段开有活塞口，所述活塞口与液压油缸液动组件的活塞腔对应，所述活塞腔内设有活塞，所述活塞的后端和活塞腔后端之间设有复位弹簧，所述液压开关组件固定在所述投球管中段外壁。本实用新型结构极为简单、可有效地提高工作时效，通过完全替代人工操作，大大提高安全性，并允许现场带压作业。
content_en: The utility model discloses a single-ball automatic ball injector in perforation and fracturing continuous operation, which solves the problem that manual ball injection operation is needed in the existing perforation and fracturing continuous operation. According to the technical scheme, the ball throwing device comprises a hollow ball throwing pipe, a ball placing opening is formed in the upper section of the ball throwing pipe, a ball throwing opening is formed in the bottom face of the ball throwing pipe, a piston opening is formed in the middle section of the ball throwing pipe and corresponds to a piston cavity of a hydraulic oil cylinder hydraulic assembly, a piston is arranged in the piston cavity, and a reset spring is arranged between the rear end of the piston and the rear end of the piston cavity. The hydraulic switch assembly is fixed to the outer wall of the middle section of the ball throwing pipe. According to the utility model, the structure is extremely simple, the working efficiency can be effectively improved, the safety is greatly improved by completely replacing the manual operation, and the field operation under pressure is allowed.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种连续钢杆输送水力径向钻孔工艺管柱，包括第一硬质油管、第二硬质油管、定位装置、喷射喷头，所述第一硬质油管包括竖直段管、水平段管，其中竖直段管设置在第二硬质油管内，水平段管处于第二硬质油管下方的井底位置，所述定位装置连接在第二硬质油管的下端，所述水平段管固定在定位装置上，水平段管的末端安装喷射喷头。所述定位装置为一油管短节，所述定位装置开设有用于水平段管穿过并定位的定位孔。所述第一硬质油管的竖直段管与第二硬质油管之间构成环空，竖直段管外壁安装活动密封器。本实用新型彻底解决了径向钻孔的方向及孔径问题，保证油井正常连续生产，延长了油井生产的寿命。通过现场使用，效果非常明显。
content_en: The utility model discloses a continuous steel rod conveying hydraulic radial drilling process pipe column. The device comprises a first hard oil pipe, a second hard oil pipe, a positioning device andan injection nozzle, the first hard oil pipe comprises a vertical section pipe and a horizontal section pipe, the vertical section pipe is arranged in the second hard oil pipe, the horizontal sectionpipe is located at the bottom of the well below the second hard oil pipe, the positioning device is connected to the lower end of the second hard oil pipe, the horizontal section pipe is fixed to thepositioning device, and the tail end of the horizontal section pipe is provided with the spraying nozzle. The positioning device is an oil pipe nipple and is provided with a positioning hole for thehorizontal section pipe to penetrate through and be positioned. An annular space is formed between the vertical section pipe of the first hard oil pipe and the second hard oil pipe, and a movable sealer is installed on the outer wall of the vertical section pipe. According to the utility model, the problems of radial drilling direction and aperture are thoroughly solved, normal continuous production of an oil well is ensured, and the service life of oil well production is prolonged. Through on-site use, the effect is very obvious.

content_cn: 一种出风方式可调的空调室外机，包括由压缩机，换热器，铜管组成的系统部分，和由风机风口、风机风道、风机电机、电机支架、连接板与外机的钣金外壳组成的风机电机部分；风机风口可设置于所述室外机的前面、或者左侧面、或者右侧面。外壳上端面固定有上钣金，上部固定有电机支架，风机电机通过连接板与电机支架固定连接；外壳对应风机电机的风机风道设置有风机风口，并通过连接件将两者紧固在一起。本实用新型的出风口可根据用户的需求，可设置于室外机的前面、或者左侧面、或者右侧面，在确保换热效率的前提下，不增加机器的体积，又可以实现侧出风的目的，避免了增加换热器所带来的成本。其具有结构简单合理，安全可靠，制造成本低，且换热效率高等特点。
content_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner outdoor machine capable of adjusting an air outlet mode. The air conditioner outdoor machine comprises a system part consisting of a compressor, a heat exchanger and a copper tube and a fan motor part consisting of a fan tuyere, a fan air duct, a fan motor, a motor bracket, a connection plate and an outdoor machine sheet metal shell, wherein the fan tuyere can be formed on the front or left side face or right side face of the outdoor machine; an upper sheet metal is fixed on the upper end face of the shell; the motor bracket is fixed on the upper part of the shell; the fan motor is fixedly connected with the motor bracket through the connection plate; and the fan tuyere is formed on the fan air duct on the shell, which corresponds to the fan motor, and fastened with the fan air duct. The air outlet of the air conditioner outdoor machine can be formed on the front or the left side face or the right side face of the outdoor machine according to a demand of a user; on the premise of guaranteeing the heat exchange efficiency, the size of the machine is not increased, and an aim of realizing a side air outlet mode is fulfilled; and therefore, a phenomenon of increase of the cost, which is caused by a heat exchanger, is avoided. The air conditioner outdoor machine has the characteristics of simple and rational structure, safety, reliability, low manufacturing cost, high heat exchange efficiency and the like.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种风叶组件及具有其的暖风机，其中，风叶组件包括壳体、风叶和弹性顶压机构，风叶可转动地设置于壳体内；弹性顶压机构包括连接部和锁止部，连接部与壳体相连接，锁止部可活动地设置于连接部的安装腔内，风叶通过锁止部与壳体可拆卸地连接；锁止部具有伸出安装腔，以使风叶与壳体连接的锁止位置，以及锁止部具有退回安装腔，以使风叶与壳体分离的拆卸位置。本发明解决了现有技术中的风叶组件的风叶的设置方式不合理，无法保证风叶的安装或拆卸便捷性，导致风叶的清洗作业繁琐复杂，降低了用户对暖风机的使用体验好感的问题。
content_en: The invention provides a fan blade assembly and a fan heater with the same. The fan blade assembly comprises a casing, fan blades and an elastic jacking and pressing mechanism; the fan blades are rotatably arranged in the casing; the elastic jacking and pressing mechanism comprises a connecting part and a locking part; the connecting part is connected with the casing; the locking part is movably arranged in an assembly cavity of the connecting part; the fan blades are detachably connected with the casing through the locking part; and the locking part is provided with a locking position extending out of the assembly cavity to connect the fan blades with the casing and a disassembly position withdrawn to the assembly cavity to separate the fan blades from the casing. The problems that the arranging mode of the fan blades of the fan blade assembly in the prior art is unreasonable, so that the assembly and disassembly convenience of the fan blades cannot be ensured, resulting in causing the problems that the cleaning operation of the fan blades is complicated and cumbersome, and good user's experience feeling of the fan heater is reduced are solved.

content_cn: 本实用新型涉及换热设备领域，提供了一种折流板换热器及石油加工系统，包括壳体和设置于壳体内的含有多个折流板的折流板组以及换热管束；换热管束穿过折流板组，多个折流板呈离散型错缝分布。石油加工系统，包括如本申请提供的折流板换热器。该换热器成本低，不易结垢，维护清洗保养成本低。
content_en: The utility model relates to the field of heat exchange equipment, and provides a baffle plate heat exchanger and a petroleum processing system, which comprise a shell, a baffle plate group and a heat exchange tube bundle, the heat exchange tube bundle penetrates through the baffle plate set, and the multiple baffle plates are distributed in a discrete staggered joint mode. The petroleum processing system comprises the baffle plate heat exchanger provided by the utility model. The heat exchanger is low in cost, not prone to scaling and low in maintenance cost.

content_cn: 本实用新型公开了一种空调加湿器和空调器，空调加湿器包括：加热水箱，所述加热水箱包括水箱本体和加热元件，所述加热元件用于对所述水箱本体内的水进行加热，所述水箱本体具有入水口和蒸汽出口；单向阀，所述单向阀的第一接口与所述入水口相连，所述单向阀在从所述单向阀到所述入水口的方向上单向导通。根据本实用新型的空调加湿器，通过在入水口处设置单向阀并使单向阀在从单向阀到入水口的方向上单向导通，从而加热水箱内的水或蒸汽不会流过单向阀，加热水箱内不断地产生蒸汽，压力不断地增大，从而将风管中的冷凝水压出，继而有利于提高加湿效果。
content_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner humidifier and an air conditioner, the air conditioner humidifier comprises a heating water tank, the heating water tank comprises a water tank body anda heating element, the heating element is used for heating water in the water tank body, and the water tank body is provided with a water inlet and a steam outlet; and a first interface of the one-wayvalve is connected with the water inlet, and the one-way valve is unidirectionally conducted in the direction from the one-way valve to the water inlet. The utility model discloses an air conditionerhumidifier. The one-way valve is arranged at the water inlet, and the one-way valve is unidirectionally conducted in the direction from the one-way valve to the water inlet, so that water or steam inthe heating water tank cannot flow through the one-way valve, the steam is continuously generated in the heating water tank, the pressure is continuously increased, condensed water in the air pipe ispressed out, and the humidification effect is improved.

content_cn: 本发明公开一种空调室内机和空调器，其中，该空调室内机包括：包括底盘和侧固定部；底盘包括朝前下侧延伸的倾斜板，倾斜板的下部两侧分设有一朝上敞口的接水槽；两侧固定部分别设有滑槽结构；换热器；蜗壳，蜗壳的左右两端分别设有与滑槽结构可滑动配合的滑凸结构；上接水盘、下接水盘，下接水盘设于蜗壳上部的前侧，上接水盘设于蜗壳上部的后侧；引流槽，引流槽连通上接水盘和下接水盘，引流槽的底部邻近蜗壳的后部且于每一接水槽的槽口正上方开设有引流口；排水管，连接于排水口，用以将接水槽内的水排出空调室内机外。本发明技术方案使蜗壳和空调室内机排水结构无需装拆，仍能实现排水功能，从而提高蜗壳拆出清洗或维修的便捷性。
content_en: An indoor unit of an air conditioner, and the air conditioner. The indoor unit of the air conditioner comprises a base plate (11), side fixed portions (12), a heat exchanger (2), a volute (3), an upper water receiving plate (4), a lower water receiving plate (5), a flow guide groove (6), and a water discharge pipe. The base plate (11) comprises an oblique plate (112) extending to a forward lower side, and a water receiving tank (112a) provided with an upward opening is disposed on each of the two sides of the lower portion of the oblique plate (112). A sliding groove (121) is formed in each of the two side fixed portions (12). A slidable raised structure capable of slidably fitted to the sliding groove (121) is disposed at each of the left end and the right end of the volute (3). The lower water receiving plate (5) is disposed on the front side of the volute (3), and the upper water receiving plate (5) is disposed on the rear side of the volute (3). The flow guide groove (6) communicates with the upper water receiving plate (4) and the lower water receiving plate (5). The bottom of the flow guide groove (6) is adjacent to the rear part of the volute (3), and a flow guide opening (621) is formed on the right-above position of the tank opening of each water receiving tank (112a). The water discharge pipe is connected to the water outlet (112b) and is used for discharging the water in the water receiving tank (112a) outside the indoor unit of the air conditioner. The water discharge function can be implemented without the assembly and disassembly of the volute (3) and a water discharge structure, thereby improving the convenience of cleaning or repair of the volute (3) after disassembly.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种变频空调及其控制方法、计算机可读存储介质，该方法包括获取设定的目标温度以及环境温度，根据目标温度以及环境温度确定压缩机的目标运行频率，压缩机的运行频率逐渐调节至目标运行频率，其中，压缩机的运行频率调节至目标运行频率时，每达到预设的频率停留点，在预设停留时间内保持压缩机的运行频率；压缩机的运行频率调节过程中，获取压缩机的排气温度，根据排气温度调节电子膨胀阀的开度：根据排气温度所在的温度范围段，以预设的速率增加或者减小电子膨胀阀的开度。该变频空调应用上述控制方法。该计算机可读存储介质的程序被处理器执行时能够实现上述的方法。本发明可以减少变频空调产生的气流噪声。
content_en: The invention provides a variable frequency air conditioner, a control method thereof and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps that the set target temperature and the environment temperature are obtained, the target running frequency of a compressor is determined according to the target temperature and the environment temperature, and the running frequency of the compressor is gradually adjusted to the target running frequency, wherein when the running frequency of the compressor is adjusted to the target running frequency, the running frequency of the compressoris kept within the preset staying time every time the preset frequency staying point is reached; in the running frequency adjusting process of the compressor, the exhaust temperature of the compressoris obtained, and the opening degree of an electronic expansion valve is adjusted according to the exhaust temperature; and according to the temperature range segment where the exhaust temperature islocated, the opening degree of the electronic expansion valve is increased or decreased at the preset speed. The variable frequency air conditioner applies the above control method. When a program ofthe computer readable storage medium is executed by a processor, the above method can be achieved. By means of the variable frequency air conditioner, the control method thereof and the computer readable storage medium, airflow noise generated by the variable frequency air conditioner can be reduced.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种泵体及压缩机。泵体包括曲轴和滚子，曲轴上设置有偏心圆，滚子套设在偏心圆的外周，滚子沿曲轴上的径向的厚度和偏心圆沿曲轴的径向上的最大宽度的比值为0.41至0.51。本发明提供了滚子沿曲轴上的径向的厚度和偏心圆沿曲轴的径向上的最大宽度的比值对压缩机摩擦功耗、损耗影响的评价指标及参考范围，解决了滚子与曲轴偏心圆大小、高度及排量设计关系的难点问题。
content_en: The invention provides a pump body and a compressor. The pump body comprises a crankshaft and a roller, an eccentric circle is arranged on the crankshaft, and the periphery of the eccentric circle issleeved with the roller. The specific value of the thickness of the roller in the radial direction of the crankshaft to the largest width of the eccentric circle in the radial direction of the crankshaft is 0.41-0.51. According to the pump body and the compressor, the evaluation index and reference range of the specific value of the thickness of the roller in the radial direction of the crankshaftto the largest width of the eccentric circle in the radial direction of the crankshaft on the friction power consumption and loss influence of the compressor are provided, and the difficult problem of the design relations of the sizes, the heights and displacements of the roller and the eccentric circle of the crankshaft is solved.

content_cn: 本发明是关于一种室内机及应用其的空调器，涉及空调领域，主要目的在于解决现有室内机的导风板与出风口处的配合间隙大的技术问题。主要采用的技术方案为：室内机，包括出风口和可在所述出风口处转动的导风板；所述导风板与所述出风口的侧壁之间具有运转间隙；所述室内机还包括活动挡板，活动挡板用于运动至第一位置时封闭所述运转间隙；和运动至第二位置时让开所述运转间隙。根据本发明提供的技术方案，因为活动挡板运动至第一位置时可以封闭导风板与出风口之间的运转间隙，从而可以实现导风板与出风口之间的无缝配合状态，使出风口在闭合状态时的外观更加简洁、美观和大方。
content_en: The invention relates to an indoor unit and an air conditioner using the same, and relates to the field of air conditioners. The indoor unit and the air conditioner mainly aim to solve the technical problem that fit clearance between an air guide plate and an air outlet of an existing indoor unit is large. According to the main technical scheme, the indoor unit comprises an air outlet and an air guide plate capable of rotating at the air outlet; a transfer gap is formed between the air guide plate and the side wall of the air outlet. The indoor unit further comprises a movable baffle used forsealing the transfer gap when moving to a first position and opening the transfer gap when moving to a second position. According to the technical scheme, the movable baffle can seal the transfer gapbetween the air guide plate and the air outlet when moving to the first position so that the seamless fit state between the air guide plate and the air outlet can be achieved, and accordingly the appearance is more concise, attractive and elegant when the air outlet is in a closed state.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种出风风道结构、出风面板及天井式空调内机，出风风道结构包括相对设置的第一风道壁和第二风道壁，在所述第一风道壁和所述第二风道壁之间形成出风通道，所述第一风道壁沿气流方向包括相连的多个凹曲面，所述多个凹曲面的曲率半径沿气流方向依次减小。本发明提供的出风风道结构，通过在第一风道壁沿气流方向设计出相连的多个凹曲面，且多个凹曲面的曲率半径沿气流方向依次减小，这样增强了引风能力，进而实现增大风量的目的，同时也使得出风风道结构可以得到灵活处理。
content_en: The invention discloses an air outlet duct structure, an air outlet panel and a ceiling type air conditioner indoor unit. The air outlet duct structure comprises a first air duct wall and a second airduct wall which are oppositely arranged, an air outlet channel is formed between the first air duct wall and the second air duct wall, the first air duct wall comprises a plurality of connected concave curved surfaces in the airflow direction, and the curvature radiuses of the concave curved surfaces are sequentially reduced in the airflow direction. According to the air outlet duct structure provided by the invention, the multiple connected concave curved surfaces are designed on the first air duct wall in the airflow direction, the curvature radiuses of the multiple concave curved surfacesare sequentially reduced in the airflow direction such that the air inducing capacity is enhanced, the purpose of increasing the air volume is achieved, and meanwhile, the air outlet duct structure can be flexibly processed.

content_cn: 一种布线机构，包括:连杆组件，包括分体设置的第一杆和第二杆，所述第一杆可相对第二杆运动从而使得连杆组件展开或压缩；电源信号线，所述电源信号线具有固定于所述第一杆上远离所述第二杆的一端的第一固定点、固定于所述第二杆上远离所述第一杆的一端的第二固定点，所述电源信号线呈柔性且总长度不小于连杆组件展开时的长度；所述连杆组件处于压缩状态时，所述第一杆和第二杆至少部分相互重叠，所述电源信号线折叠压缩；所述连杆组件处于展开状态时，所述第一杆和第二杆相互远离且不相重叠，所述电源信号线拉伸延长。
content_en: The invention discloses a wiring mechanism. The wiring mechanism comprises a connecting rod component and a power supply signal wire, wherein the connecting rod component comprises a first rod and a second rod which are separately arranged; the first rod can move relative to the second rod, so that the connecting rod component is unfolded or compressed; the power supply signal wire is provided with a first fixing point which is fixed at one end, away from the second rod, on the first rod, and a second fixing point which is fixed at one end, away from the first rod, on the second rod; the power supply signal wire is flexible and total length of the power supply signal wire is not smaller than that of the connecting rod component when being unfolded; when the connecting rod component is located in a compressing state, at least part of the first rod and the second rod are mutually superposed, and the power supply signal wire is folded and compressed; and when the connecting rod component is located in an unfolding state, the first rod and the second rod are mutually kept away from each other and are not mutually superposed, and the power supply signal wire is extended and elongated.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种泵体组件、流体机械及换热设备。其中，泵体组件包括：上法兰；下法兰；气缸，夹持在上法兰和下法兰之间，气缸与下法兰同心，与上法兰的偏心距离为e，气缸的侧壁具有排气孔；气缸套，套设在气缸外并夹持在上法兰与下法兰之间，气缸的外周面与气缸套的内壁间形成排气间隙；活塞，可滑动地设置在气缸的第一滑移孔内，活塞与气缸的内壁之间形成变容积腔，活塞具有第二滑移孔，变容积腔通过排气孔与排气间隙连通；转轴，其底端滑动设置在第二滑移孔内，活塞相对于第一滑移孔滑动的第一滑移方向与转轴相对于第二滑移孔滑动的第二滑移方向之间具有滑移夹角。本发明的泵体组件具有运转良好、能耗小的特点。
content_en: The invention provides a pump body assembly, a fluid machine and heat exchange equipment. The pump body assembly comprises an upper flange, a lower flange, an air cylinder, an air cylinder sleeve, a piston and a rotating shaft, wherein the air cylinder is clamped between the upper flange and the lower flange and is concentric with the lower flange; the eccentric distance between the air cylinder and the upper flange is e; the side wall of the air cylinder is provided with exhaust holes; the air cylinder sleeve is arranged outside the air cylinder in a sleeving mode and clamped between the upper flange and the lower flange; an exhaust clearance is formed between the peripheral surface of the air cylinder and the inner wall of the air cylinder sleeve; the piston is slidably arranged in a first sliding hole of the air cylinder; a variable volume cavity is formed between the piston and the inner wall of the air cylinder; the piston is provided with a second sliding hole; the variable volume cavity communicates with the exhaust clearance through the exhaust holes; the bottom end of the rotating shaft is slidably arranged in the second sliding hole; and a sliding included angle is formed between the first sliding direction where the piston slides relative to the first sliding hole and the second sliding direction where the rotating shaft slides relative to the second sliding hole. The pump body assembly has the characteristics of being good in operation and low in energy consumption.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种具有感温包插片功能的线扎及使用该线扎的空调器，包括将感温包固定在感温包套管内的连接件，设于连接件一端与所述感温套管一端固定的倒扣，设于连接件另一端与感温套管另一端固定用于固定感温包线的线扎结构。本发明可与感温套管固定，其中线扎结构可以捆住感温包线，使感温包线被拉动时不会导致感温包松动，解决了感温套管线扎难扎的问题，同时避免了管路感温包脱落的风险。
content_en: The invention discloses a wire binding piece with a temperature sensing package inserting piece function and an air conditioner using the wire binding piece. The wire binding piece comprises a connecting piece, an inverted buckle and a wire binding structure, wherein the connecting piece is used for fixing a temperature sensing package into a temperature sensing package sleeving, the inverted buckle is arranged at one end of the connecting piece and fixed to one end of a temperature sensing sleeving, and the wire binding structure is arranged at the other end of the connecting piece, fixed tothe other end of the temperature sensing sleeving and used for fixing the temperature sensing package. The wire binding piece can be fixed together with the temperature sensing sleeving. A temperaturesensing package wire can be bound by the wire binding structure, so that the temperature sensing package is not loosened when the temperature sensing package wire is pulled, the binding difficulty ofthe temperature sensing sleeving and the wire binding piece is solved, and the risk that the pipeline temperature sensing package falls off is avoided.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种滑片式压缩机及制冷装置，其中滑片式压缩机包括上气缸和下气缸，上气缸设有上工作腔，上工作腔内设有多个上滑片；下气缸设有下工作腔，下工作腔内设有多个下滑片；下工作腔和上工作腔之间有过气通道，过气通道一端和下工作腔的高压端连通，另一端和上工作腔的低压端连通。本发明所述的滑片式压缩机，提高了滑片式压缩机的可靠性，通过采用双级压缩机结构，降低滑片背压，同时为适应不同空间需求，采用变容技术，达到节能的目的。
content_en: The invention discloses a sliding vane compressor and a refrigerating device. The sliding vane compressor comprises an upper air cylinder and a lower air cylinder, wherein the upper air cylinder is provided with an upper working cavity; a plurality of upper slip sheets are arranged in the upper working cavity; the lower air cylinder is provided with a lower working cavity; a plurality of lower slip sheets are arranged in the lower working cavity; an air passing channel is arranged between the lower working cavity and the upper working cavity; one end of the air passing channel communicates with the high pressure end of the lower working cavity; and the other end of the air passing channel communicates with the low pressure end of the upper working cavity. The sliding vane compressor, disclosed by the invention, improves the reliability of the sliding vane compressor, reduces the backpressure of a sliding sheet through adopting a twin-stage compressor structure, and adopts the volume changing technology for being suitable for different space demands to realize the purpose of saving energy.

content_cn: 本公开涉及一种波长选择开关及其相关的光学设备。该波长选择开关包括：2D光纤阵列，包括第一列光纤和第二列光纤，其中第二列光纤中的光纤与第一列光纤中的光纤被布置为沿切换方向交替排布，并且第二列光纤沿色散方向相对于第一列光纤偏移预定间距；色散单元，被配置为对来自第一光路调整部件的第一光束进行色散，以产生对应于不同波长的多个第一子光束；以及光交换引擎，被配置为接收多个第一子光束，并且可操作地对所述多个第一子光束的方向进行调整，以入射回色散单元；其中色散单元还被配置为将入射回的至少部分所述多个第一子光束进行合波，以产生经合波的第二光束，并将第二光束经由第一光路调整部件引导至输出端口。
content_en: The invention relates to a wavelength selective switch and related optical equipment. The wavelength selective switch comprises a 2D optical fiber array comprising a first column of optical fibers and a second column of optical fibers, the optical fibers in the second column of optical fibers and the optical fibers in the first column of optical fibers are alternately arranged along a switching direction, and the second column of optical fibers are offset by a predetermined distance relative to the first column of optical fibers along a dispersion direction; the dispersion unit is configured to perform dispersion on the first light beam from the first light path adjusting component so as to generate a plurality of first sub-light beams corresponding to different wavelengths; and an optical switching engine configured to receive the plurality of first sub-beams and operably adjust the directions of the plurality of first sub-beams so as to be incident back to the dispersion unit, wherein the dispersion unit is further configured to combine at least part of the incident first sub-beams to generate a combined second beam, and guide the second beam to the output port through the first optical path adjusting component.

content_cn: 提供一种具有双触摸屏的移动终端和显示其用户界面的方法。第一触摸传感器和第二触摸传感器形成在显示单元的前侧和背侧。所述方法包括：在显示单元中显示包括至少一个背景屏幕和至少一个或多个内容的用户界面。所述方法还包括基于触摸事件根据检测的便携式终端的状态来改变用户界面的亮度。
content_en: Provided is a method of displaying a user interface of a portable terminal having a two-sided touch screen where a first touch sensor and a second touch sensor are formed to the front side and the backside of a display unit. The method includes displaying a user interface including at least one of a background screen and at least one or more contents in the display unit. The method also includes changing brightness of the user interface according to a detected state of the portable terminal based on a touch event.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种轴向位移检测方法、装置和轴向位移传感器。其中，该方法包括：通过一个轴向位移传感器中的多个探头采集检测面的多个轴向位移信号，其中，检测面为用于对磁悬浮系统的轴的轴向位移进行检测的检测平面；根据采集的多个轴向位移信号确定轴的轴向位移。本发明解决了由于检测面倾斜和传感器不一致，导致的轴向位移检测不真实不准确的技术问题。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting axial displacement and an axial displacement sensor. The method comprises the following steps: collecting multiple axial displacement signals of a detection surface through multiple probes in an axial displacement sensor, wherein the detection surface is a detection plane used for detecting the axial displacement of the shaft of a magnetic levitation system; and determining the axial displacement of the shaft according to collected multiple axial displacement signals. By the method, the technical problem that the axial displacement detection is untrue and inaccurate as the detection surface inclines inconsistently with the sensor is solved.

content_cn: 本发明涉及强度测试装置领域，公开了一种薄膜纵向撕裂强度的测试装置和一种薄膜纵向撕裂强度的测试方法。所述测试装置包括：(i)基座(1)；(ii)与所述基座垂直并固定在所述基座(1)上的试验架(2)；(iii)固定于试验架(2)上部的用于固定薄膜试样的固定夹(3)；(iv)固定于试验架(2)上的水平的平台(4)；以及(v)放置于平台(4)上的砝码(5)。采用本发明提供的技术方案，不必预计算对薄膜所施载荷的大小，只需准确测量薄膜受到瞬时撕裂力时的撕裂长度，能够表征薄膜在瞬时性外力作用下薄膜纵向撕裂的现象，并且对于软质和硬质薄膜均适用，装置结构简单，测试方法简单易行。
content_en: The invention relates to the field of strength testing devices and discloses a testing device and method for longitudinal tearing strength of a film. The testing device comprises (i) a substrate (1);(ii) a test rack (2) which is perpendicular to the substrate and fixed to the substrate (1); (iii) a fixed clamp (3) fixed to the upper part of the test rack (2) for fixing a film test sample; (iv) ahorizontal platform (4) fixed to the test rack (2); (v) a weight (5) placed on the platform (4). By adopting the technical scheme provided by the invention, the loaded applied to the film needs not tobe pre-calculated and the tearing length of the film subjected to an instantaneous tearing force is only measured accurately, so that a longitudinal tearing phenomenon of the film under the instantaneous external force action of the film can be represented. The device is suitable for soft and hard films and is simple in structure, and the testing method is simple and feasible.

content_cn: 描述了用于确定移动设备的方位的方法、系统和设备。一种方法包括：在移动设备处，捕获规定照明参考轴的至少一个照明物体的图像(1205)；确定该照明参考轴与该移动设备的设备参考轴之间的第一角度(1210)；确定该照明参考轴与公共参考轴之间的第二角度(1215)；估计设备参考轴与公共参考轴之间的第三角度(1220)；以及至少部分地基于第一角度、第二角度和第三角度，确定该移动设备的方位(1225)。
content_en: Methods, systems, and devices are described for determining an orientation of a mobile device. One method includes capturing, at the mobile device, an image of at least one illuminated object defining an illuminated reference axis (1205); determining a first angle between the illuminated reference axis and a device reference axis of the mobile device(1210); determining a second angle between the illuminated reference axis and a common reference axis (1215); estimating a third angle between the device reference axis and the common reference axis (1220); and determining an orientation of the mobile device based at least in part on the first angle, the second angle, and the third angle (1225).

content_cn: 本申请公开了一种插入同步指令的方法及装置，涉及计算机领域。该方法通过自动分析程序中指令之间的数据依赖关系来识别待同步功能指令，进而进行同步指令的插入。在获取包含一条或多条语句的第一程序块后，确定第一程序块中存在数据依赖的第一功能指令和第二功能指令，然后在第一功能指令所属的语句与第二功能指令所属的语句之间插入同步指令对，能够有效地提升功能指令间的并行性，提升了DAE或类DAE的处理器处理功能指令的处理性能。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and device for inserting a synchronization instruction, and relates to the field of computers. According to the invention, the method includes identifying the functioninstruction to be synchronized by automatically analyzing the data dependence relationship between instructions in a program, and then inserting the synchronization instruction; after the first program block containing one or more statements is obtained, determining the first function instruction and the second function instruction which have data dependence to exist in the first program block, and then inserting the synchronization instruction pair between the statement to which the first function instruction belongs and the statement to which the second function instruction belongs, so thatthe parallelism between the function instructions can be effectively improved, and the processing performance of the DAE or DAE-like processor for processing the function instruction is improved.

content_cn: 本发明提供一种移动终端，包括壳体、显示模组和若干器件，所述显示模组包括第一显示区和第二显示区，所述第一显示区和所述第二显示区均能够显示信息，所述若干器件中至少一个器件设置于所述第二显示区的所述显示模组和所述壳体之间，所述若干器件中至少一个器件能够透过所述显示模组发射和/或接收光信号。通过设置至少一个透明的显示区域，允许该区域下设置的器件透过所述显示模组发射和接收光信号。所述移动终端集非透明显示与透明显示功能，合理设置所述移动终端需透光器件的表面区域，提高移动终端显示的屏占比，实现全面屏显示效果，同时丰富了显示效果，提升了用户的体验性。本发明还提供一种所述移动终端的显示方法。
content_en: The present invention provides a mobile terminal, comprising a housing, a display module, and multiple devices. The display module comprises a first display region and a second display region; the first display region and the second display region are both able to display information; at least one device in the multiple devices is provided between the display module and the housing in the second display region; at least one device in the multiple devices can transmits and/or receives an optical signal by means of the display module. At least one transparent display region is provided, and a device provided in the region is permitted to transmit and receive an optional signal through the display module. The mobile terminal is integrated with a non-transparent display function and a transparent display function, a surface region of a device requiring light transmission of the mobile terminal is reasonably configured, the screen-to-body ratio of displaying of the mobile terminal is improved, a full-screen displaying effect is implemented, the displaying effect is enriched, and user experience is improved. The present further provides a display method of the mobile terminal.

content_cn: 遥控类似类型装置的方法，该一个或多个装置是具有与设置在多个模式之一的控制装置的模式相同的模式的受控装置，该方法包括：接收模式信息的输入以便将控制装置的模式转换为多个模式之一；根据模式信息转换控制装置的模式；接收信息的输入，控制装置通过该信息遥控受控装置的功能；根据转换后的模式产生对应于该信息的控制信号；将控制信号发送到受控装置；接收模式信息的输入以便将受控装置的模式转换为多个模式之一；根据模式信息转换受控装置的模式；接收控制信号；和如果所接收到的控制信号被确认在受控装置的转换后的模式下有效，则根据控制信号控制受控装置的功能。
content_en: A method of remotely controlling similar types of devices, one or more of which is a controlled device having the same mode as that of a control device set in one of a plurality of modes, the method including receiving an input of mode information in order to convert a mode of the control device into one of the plurality of modes, converting the mode of the control device according to the mode information, receiving an input of information by which a function of the controlled device is remotely controlled by the control device, generating control signals that correspond to the information according to the converted mode, transmitting the control signals to the controlled device, receiving an input of the mode information in order to convert a mode of the controlled device into the one of the plurality of modes, converting the mode of the controlled device according to the mode information, receiving the control signals, and controlling the function of the controlled device according to the control signals if the received control signals are recognized as being effective in the converted mode of the controlled device.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种跳转指令编码的方法和系统，均可在执行循环时，相对于操作周期，提前到内存中获取循环开始指令；当循环体最后一条指令执行完时，完成循环开始指令的获取。本发明方法和系统，通过汇编编码的预处理，从软件的层面简化了硬件逻辑，保证不需要去添加额外的逻辑来解决循环折回时流水线需要停顿的问题，省去了很多的硬件逻辑和硬件资源，节省了面积和成本，使得实现简单，也提高了实现方案的可靠性。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for coding a jump instruction; and the method and system can both obtain a LOOP_BEGIN command from a memory in advance when executing a loop relative to an operation cycle, and finish acquiring the LOOP_BEGIN command when the execution of a last command of a loop body is completed. The method and system of the invention simplify hardware logic from a software level via preprocessing assembly coding, and guarantee to solve a problem that a pipeline needs to be suspended during a loop retracement without adding additional logic, thus saving much hardware logic and hardware resources, economizing the area and cost, simplifying the implementation, and enhancing the reliability of the implementation scheme.

content_cn: 为了解决现有技术中文件I/O过于频繁的问题，本发明公开了一种控制文件输入输出缓存的方法及装置，该方法包括，接收读取文件的请求消息并获取待读取文件；若当前文件缓存中不存在待读取文件，且除指定内存空间外文件缓存中没有足够的空间放入待读取文件，则将待读取文件替换当前文件缓存中的文件；若文件缓存中的文件的输入输出率大于第一阈值，则在再次接收读取文件的请求消息，需要执行文件替换步骤时，将读取频度最高的文件放入文件缓存中的指定内存空间，避免被待读取文件替换。正是将读取频度最高的文件放入文件缓存中的指定内存空间，避免被替换，使得文件输入输出缓存次数减少。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling a file to be input into/output from a cache, which aim to solve the problem that file I/O is too frequently in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps of: receiving a request message for reading a file and acquiring a file to be read; if the file to be read does not exist in a current file cache, and cannot be stored inan enough space except a specified memory space of a file cache, replacing the file to be read by the file in the current file cache; if the input/output power of the file in the file cache is greater than a first threshold, receiving the request message for reading the file again; and when a file replacing step needs to be executed, placing the file with highest reading frequency into the specified memory space in the file cache so as to prevent the file with the highest frequency from being replaced by the file to be read. The file with the highest reading frequency is placed in the specified memory space in the file cache so as to be prevented from being replaced; and therefore, the frequency of the file input into/output from the cache is reduced.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种致密砂岩储层建模方法，包括：基于叠后三维地震解释资料，以钻井、测井资料为约束进行岩性反演，获得多个反演数据体；将多个反演数据体与测井解释结论对比，优选出最能体现不同岩性的反演数据体；根据测井解释出的岩性数据与优选出的反演数据体中的数值的相关性，确定岩性划分标准；基于所述岩性划分标准对三维空间中每个三维网格中的反演数据体的数值进行岩性识别，得到三维岩性数据体；在沉积相的主体中心和各边界内部的位置设置虚拟井，将虚拟井所对应的三维岩性数据体中的数值确定为虚拟井的岩性数据；将实钻井和虚拟井的岩性数据作为建模基础数据，进行随机模拟建模，得到三维储层岩相模型，达到精细描述储层的目的。
content_en: The present invention discloses a tight sandstone reservoir modeling method. The tight sandstone reservoir modeling method comprises the steps of: taking drilling and logging information as constraints to perform lithology inversion based on post-stack three-dimensional seismic interpretation data to obtain a plurality of inversion data volumes; comparing the inversion data volumes with a logginginterpretation conclusion to optimize an inversion data volume which can most reflect different lithologies; determining a lithology partition criterion according to the dependency of lithology data interpreted from the logging and the values in the optimized inversion data volumes; obtaining a three-dimensional logging lithology data volumes through lithology identification of the values of the inversion data volumes in each three-dimensional grid in the three-dimensional space based on the lithology partition criterion; setting virtual wells at the main body centers of sedimentary facies andthe internal portion of each boundary, and determining the values in the three-dimensional lithology data volumes corresponding to the virtual wells as the lithology data of the virtual wells; and taking the lithology data of the actual drilling wells and the virtual wells as modeling basic data to perform random simulation modeling to obtain a three-dimensional reservoir lithology model so as toachieve the purpose of fine description of the reservoir.

content_cn: 公开了一种链路层到物理层(PHY)串行接口。在一方面，片上系统(SoC)集成电路(IC)包括链路层电路，并且远程IC包括通用串行总线(USB)PHY电路。具有四条或更少导线的总线连接这两个IC。链路桥与链路层电路通信并且将接收自该链路层电路的USB收发机宏蜂窝小区接口(UMTI)信令串行化为用于传输到远程IC的高速(HS)USB消息。该链路桥还从远程IC上的USBPHY电路接收HS消息。该链路桥将HS消息解串行化以提取UTMI信令并且将所提取的UTMI信令传递给该链路层电路。
content_en: A link layer to physical layer (PHY) serial interface is disclosed. In one aspect, a system on a chip (SoC) integrated circuit (IC) includes a link layer circuit, and a remote IC includes a Universal Serial Bus (USB) PHY circuit. A bus having four or fewer wires connects the two ICs. A link bridge communicates with the link layer circuit and serializes USB Transceiver Macrocell Interface (UTMI) signaling received from the link layer circuit as high speed (HS) USB messages for transmission to the remote IC. The link bridge also receives HS messages from the USB PHY circuit on the remote IC. The link bridge deserializes the HS messages to extract UTMI signaling and passes the extracted UTMI signaling to the link layer circuit.

content_cn: 一种信息记录介质和一种记录/再现设备以及一种用于记录介质的记录/再现方法。通过用一个或多个替换记录块替换原始记录块来顺序地更新原始数据。替换记录块包括原始地址字段或先前地址字段中的至少一个，原始地址字段指示原始记录块的位置，先前地址字段指示紧先前的记录块的位置。通过参照各替换记录块中的地址字段，在备用区或用户数据区发生逻辑重写(LOW)的替换的系统中可以有效地恢复替换系统。
content_en: An information recording medium, and a recording/reproducing apparatus and a recording/reproducing method for the recording medium. Original data is sequentially updated by replacing an original recording block with one or more replacement recording blocks. A replacement recording block includes at least one of an original address field indicating a location of the original recording block or a previous address field indicating a location of an immediately previous recording block. Replacement information is effectively recovered in a system where a replacement for logical overwriting (LOW) occurs in either a spare area and a user data area by reference to the address fields in each replacement recording block.

content_cn: 本发明实施例公开一种下行数据的ACK/NACK信息反馈方法，包括：获取用户设备的处理能力信息，并将所述处理能力信息上报给基站；获取下行数据包的数据信息；根据所述处理能力信息及数据信息，计算所述用户设备针对所述下行数据包进行数据解码及ACK/NACK信息编码所需要的基础延迟时间；接收基站针对所述下行数据包下发的额外延迟时间，所述额外延迟时间用于指示反馈所述下行数据包对应的ACK/NACK信息的子帧的位置；根据所述基础延迟时间和所述额外延迟时间之和，选择对应的子帧反馈所述下行数据包对应的ACK/NACK信息。另，本发明实施例还公开一种应用所述方法的基站及用户设备。所述方法可以有效降低数据传输延迟。
content_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an ACK/NACK information feedback method for downlink data, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring processing capacity information of user equipment, and reporting the processing capacity information to a base station; acquiring data information of the downlink data packet; according to the processing capability information and the data information, calculating basic delay time required by the user equipment for performing data decoding and ACK/NACK information coding on the downlink data packet; receiving extra delay time issued by thebase station for the downlink data packet, wherein the extra delay time is used for indicating the position of a subframe for feeding back ACK/NACK information corresponding to the downlink data packet; and selecting a corresponding subframe to feed back ACK/NACK information corresponding to the downlink data packet according to the sum of the basic delay time and the additional delay time. In addition, the embodiment of the invention also discloses a base station and user equipment using the method. The method can effectively reduce data transmission delay.

content_cn: 本申请实施例提供一种V2X通信方法，包括：第一网络设备向第二网络设备发送请求消息并从第二网络设备接收响应消息，请求消息用于请求第二网络设备为终端配置V2X资源；响应消息包括V2X资源配置信息，其中V2X资源配置信息用于指示为终端配置的V2X资源。第一网络设备将V2X资源配置信息发送给终端。如此，终端可以接收该V2X资源配置信息，从而获得除第一网络设备的小区之外更多小区的V2X的资源，利用该V2X资源，发起V2X业务，从而提高V2X的数据吞吐率。
content_en: Provided is a V2X communication method, comprising the steps: a first network device sends a request message to a second network device and receives a response message from the second network device,the request message being used for requesting the second network device to configure V2X resources for a terminal; wherein the response message comprises V2X resource configuration information, and the V2X resource configuration information is used for indicating V2X resources configured for the terminal; and the first network device sends the V2X resource configuration information to the terminal. Thus, the terminal can receive the V2X resource configuration information so as to obtain V2X resources of more cells except the cell of the first network device, and initiate the V2X service by using the V2X resources so as to improve the data throughput rate of the V2X.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种确定终端移动性管理类型的方法和系统，其中，移动终端向网络侧上报信息，所上报的信息包括：移动终端所支持的移动性能力信息；网络侧根据所述移动终端的上报信息，以及自己所支持的移动性能力信息，确定出所述移动终端的移动性管理类型。通过本发明的实施例，当移动终端通过不同的接入过程接入网络后，网络侧能够针对不同接入过程中接入的终端，确定相应的移动性管理类型。
content_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining the types of terminal mobility management, wherein, the mobile terminal reports information to a network and the reported information comprises mobility ability information supported by the mobile terminal. The network determines the types of mobile terminal mobility management according to the reported information and the mobility ability information supported by the mobile terminal. With the embodiment of the invention, when the mobile terminal accesses the network through different access processes, the network can determine the corresponding types of mobility management according to the mobile terminals connected to the network through different access processes.

content_cn: 一种轨道交通中无线局域网的信道管理方法及相关设备。该方法包括：若第一轨旁接入点与车载接入点已建立无线通信链路且第一信道与第二信道不相同，所述第一轨旁接入点将所述第一轨旁接入点的工作信道改变为所述第二信道，所述第一信道为所述第一轨旁接入点的工作信道改变前所述第一轨旁接入点的工作信道，所述第二信道为第二轨旁接入点的工作信道；所述第一轨旁接入点指示所述车载接入点将所述车载接入点的工作信道改变为所述第二信道。本发明实施例可确保轨旁接入点之间的信道相同。
content_en: The invention relates to a channel management method of a wireless local area network in rail transit and related equipment. The method includes the following steps that: if a wireless communication link has been established between a first trackside access point and an on-board access point, and a first channel and a second channel are different, the first trackside access point changes the working channel of the first trackside access point to the second channel, wherein the first channel is the working channel of the first trackside access point before the working channel of the first trackside access point is changed, and the second channel is the working channel of a second trackside access point; and the first trackside access point instructs the on-board access point to change the working channel of the on-board access point to the second channel. With the method and related equipment provided by the embodiments of the present invention adopted, channels between the trackside access points can be identical.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种通信方法及相应的装置和系统，该方法包括：根据路由信息在第一空口资源上发送第一控制信息，其中，所述路由信息包括所述第一空口资源的特征，所述第一控制信息用于指示第一信息的第一资源；在所述第一信息的第一资源上发送所述第一信息。本申请可以适用于Relay(中继)场景、Mesh(网状)场景、IAB(Integrated Access Backhaul，接入回传一体化)场景、V2X(Vehicle to Everything，车对万物)场景、UC(UE Cooperation，UE协作)场景、高频传输场景、工业场景、机器人协作场景、物联网场景等中的一项或多项。通过本申请提供的方法，装置和系统，可以减少传输时延，提高传输效率。
content_en: Provided are a communication method and a corresponding device and system, the method comprising: sending first control information on a first air interface resource according to routing information, wherein the routing information comprises a feature of the first air interface resource, and the first control information is used for indicating a first resource of first information; and sending the first information on the first resource of the first information. The application can be applied to one or more of a Relay (Relay) scene, a Mesh (mesh) scene, an IAB (International Access Backhaul) scene, a V2X (Vehicle to Everything) scene, a UC (UE coordination) scene, a high-frequency transmission scene, an industrial scene, a robot coordination scene, an Internet of Things scene and the like. Through the method, the device and the system provided by the invention, the transmission delay can be reduced, and the transmission efficiency can be improved.

content_cn: 本发明实施例公开了一种无线网络接入控制方法及设备、系统，其中，所述方法包括：控制设备接收用户设备发送的无线接入请求消息，所述无线接入请求消息中至少包括一个无线网络的标识；确定与所述无线网络的标识对应的控制策略参数，所述控制策略参数包括所述无线网络的标识、接入密码和预设接入条件参数；根据所述控制策略参数中的预设接入条件参数，在确定所述无线网络的当前接入条件参数满足所述预设接入条件参数时，将所述控制策略参数发送给所述用户设备，以使所述用户设备根据所述控制策略参数中的无线网络的标识、接入密码接入所述无线网络，能够灵活控制无线网络的接入，既不会造成无线网络资源的浪费，也不会影响无线网络的接入质量。
content_en: Disclosed are a wireless network access control method, device and system. The method comprises: a control device receives a wireless access request message sent by a user equipment, the wireless access request message comprising an identifier of at least one wireless network; determines control policy parameters corresponding to the identifier of the wireless network, the control policy parameters comprising the identifier of the wireless network, an access password and a preset access condition parameter; and sends the control policy parameters to the user equipment when it is determined, according to the preset access condition parameter in the control policy parameters, that a current access condition parameter of the wireless network satisfies the preset access condition parameter, so that the user equipment accesses the wireless network according to the identifier of the wireless network and the access password in the control policy parameters. The access to the wireless network can be flexibly controlled, wireless network resources are not wasted, and the quality of the access to the wireless network is not affected.

content_cn: 本发明公开了一种通讯加密的方法与系统，所述方法包括步骤：A、主机A上的应用客户端模块向本地的SSH安全代理模块发送代理请求，要求连接目标主机B；B、SSH安全代理模块解析代理请求，根据解析出的目标主机的IP地址，获知主机A的应用客户端模块要连接的目标主机为主机B后，向主机B发起连接请求，并请求建立端口转发隧道；C、目标主机B接收到连接请求后，建立安全隧道，主机A和目标主机B通过安全隧道传输数据。所述的系统包括：一台主机，至少一台目标主机，所述主机上包括应用客户端模块和SSH安全代理模块，目标主机上包括SSH Server模块和应用服务端模块。采用上述方法与系统，可实现点到点或点到多点访问时的通讯加密。
content_en: The invention relates to a communication encrypt method and relative system, wherein said method comprises that: a, the application client module of host A sends proxy request to the local SSH safety proxy module, to request to connect target host B; b, SSH safety proxy module analyzes the proxy request, via the IP address of target host, to send connection request to host B, when obtaining the target host is host B, and request to build port transfer tunnel; c, target host B receives connection request, builds safety tunnel, host A and target host B transmit data via safety tunnel. And the system comprises a host, at least one target host, while the host comprises application client module and SSH safety proxy module; the target host comprise SSH Server module and application server module. The invention can realize point-to-point or point-to-multipoint communication encrypt.

content_cn: 一种由第一设备实现的方法，包括：估计所述第一设备与第二设备之间的侧行链路波束对应的、所述第一设备与服务接入节点之间的第一路径损耗，所述侧行链路波束被所述第一设备用于与所述第二设备进行设备到设备(device‑to‑device，D2D)传输；根据所述第一路径损耗确定所述第一设备与所述第二设备之间的用于侧行链路传输的侧行链路发射功率；根据所述侧行链路发射功率与所述第二设备进行所述侧行链路传输。
content_en: A method implemented by a first device, comprising: estimating a first path loss between the first device and a serving access node corresponding to a sidelink beam between the first device and a second device, the sidelink beam being used by the first device for device-to-device (D2D) transmission with the second device; determining sidelink transmitting power for sidelink transmission between the first equipment and the second equipment according to the first path loss; and performing the sidelink transmission with the second device according to the sidelink transmitting power.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种像素采集电路、动态视觉传感器以及图像采集设备。该像素采集电路包括：光电转换电路、模数转换电路、差分电路以及比较电路；光电转换电路，被配置为将采集到的光信号转换成模拟信号；模数转换电路，被配置为接收来自光电转换电路的模拟信号；以及，通过对模拟信号进行模数转换获得数字信号；差分电路，被配置为接收来自模数转换电路的数字信号；以及，获得上一触发时刻的数字信号与当前触发时刻的数字信号的差值信号，其中，上一触发时刻和当前触发时刻至少由数字时钟信号确定；比较电路，被配置为接收来自差分电路的差值信号，输出脉冲信号。在本申请中，利用数字元器件来实现动态视觉传感器中的像素采集电路，以减弱噪声，减少干扰，方便调试。
content_en: The invention provides a pixel acquisition circuit, a dynamic vision sensor and image acquisition equipment. The pixel acquisition circuit comprises a photoelectric conversion circuit, an analog-to-digital conversion circuit, a differential circuit and a comparison circuit, the photoelectric conversion circuit is configured to convert the acquired optical signal into an analog signal; an analog-to-digital conversion circuit configured to receive an analog signal from the photoelectric conversion circuit and performing analog-to-digital conversion on the analog signal to obtain a digital signal; a differential circuit configured to receive the digital signal from the analog-to-digital conversion circuit, and obtaining a difference signal between the digital signal at the previous triggeringmoment and the digital signal at the current triggering moment, the previous triggering moment and the current triggering moment being at least determined by a digital clock signal; and the comparison circuit configured to receive the difference signal from the differential circuit and output a pulse signal. According to the application, the pixel acquisition circuit in the dynamic vision sensoris realized by utilizing the digital components, so that the noise is weakened, the interference is reduced, and the debugging is convenient.

content_cn: 随着物联网的兴起和智能家居的不断普及，厨房在智能家居中的位置举足轻重。目前厨房中的智能家电种类最多，包括冰箱、电水壶、燃气灶、电饭锅、高压锅、电烤箱、洗碗机、电磁炉等等，虽然种类繁多，但是大多数智能家电的功能都还不够完善和智能。在烧水方面，目前虽然开发了多种电水壶，但是都有一个缺陷就是当人们在忙碌的时候，比如家里来了客人需要烧水泡茶、早晨赶时间需要烧水泡面等，在这类手忙脚乱的场合，容易发生注好水而忘记按下煮水按钮的情况，当再次想起要用热水时才发现并没有煮水，难免心里生出郁闷之感，同时影响用水，而这种情况在生活中常有发生。
content_en: With the rise of the Internet of Things and the continuous popularity of smart homes, the kitchen plays an important role in smart homes. At present, there are the most types of smart home appliances in the kitchen, including refrigerators, electric kettles, gas stoves, rice cookers, pressure cookers, electric ovens, dishwashers, induction cookers, etc. Although there are many types, the functions of most smart home appliances are not perfect. And smart.In terms of boiling water, although a variety of electric kettles have been developed, they all have a shortcoming when people are busy. For example, when guests come home, they need to boil water to make tea, and they need to boil water for instant noodles in a hurry. In rushed situations, it is easy to fill the water and forget to press the boil button. When I remember to use hot water again, I find that the water is not boiled. It is inevitable that I will feel depressed and affect the water use. It often happens in life.

content_cn: 对本发明而言，气凝胶是一种已经通过溶胶-凝胶法生产的多孔材料，其中液相已经在超临界条件下从该凝胶除去。气凝胶和藻酸盐在化妆品组合物中的使用原则上由现有技术已知。气凝胶是超轻的多孔材料。最早的气凝胶由Kristler在1932年制备。它们通常经由溶胶-凝胶法在液体介质中合成并且随后干燥，通常通过用超临界流体—最常用的是超临界CO2萃取而干燥。这类干燥使得可以避免孔和材料的收缩。其他类型的干燥也使得可以由凝胶获得多孔材料，即冻干，这包括在低温下固化凝胶，然后使溶剂升华并通过蒸发干燥。如此得到的材料分别称为冻凝胶和干凝胶。
content_en: For the purposes of the present invention, an aerogel is a porous material that has been produced by the sol-gel method, in which the liquid phase has been removed from the gel under supercritical conditions. The use of aerogels and alginates in cosmetic compositions is known in principle from the prior art. Aerogel is an ultra-light porous material. The earliest aerogel was produced by Kristler in 1932. They are usually synthesized via a sol-gel method in a liquid medium and subsequently dried, usually by extraction with a supercritical fluid-most commonly supercritical CO2. This type of drying makes it possible to avoid shrinkage of pores and materials. Other types of drying also make it possible to obtain porous materials from gels, namely lyophilization, which involves curing the gel at low temperatures, then sublimating the solvent and drying by evaporation. The materials thus obtained are called cryogel and xerogel, respectively.

content_cn: 目前大部分的压力锅的锅内压力采用装设在锅盖上的阀芯以及扣在阀芯的重锤来控制，但是阀芯上所采用的管状排气通道的内孔很小，路径较长，容易发生堵塞，引起爆锅，甚至引发安全事故。另外中国专利ZL03225541.1公开了一种在压力锅及压力锅容器上使用的硅胶泄压阀，包括阀体、阀芯，它的特点在于采用了一个硅胶做成的阀体，以及一个不锈钢球作为阀芯，阀体上设有上下两个腔体，两个腔体之间形成腰部，不锈钢球阀芯靠硅橡胶的弹性装配进入阀体下腔内。自然状态阀芯位于阀体的下腔而不脱离阀体，在气压强制作用下，阀体由下腔经过腰部进入阀体上腔，使锅内压力连续快速下降，确保使用安全。这种压力控制装置，虽然排气孔较大，但它设有直径较小的腰部，仍然不能完全避免引起的堵塞问题。同时由于它采用一种弹性装配的结构设计，其阀体必须采用柔软的硅胶材料，因此难以精确地控制锅内压力，而且阀芯一旦在气压作用下进入了阀体上腔，当锅内压力快速下降后，无法自动回到下腔，实现下一工作周期。
content_en: At present, most of the pressure inside the pressure cooker is controlled by a valve core mounted on the lid and a weight attached to the valve core, but the tubular exhaust passage used in the spool has a small inner hole and a long path. It is prone to blockages, causing explosions and even causing safety accidents. In addition, Chinese patent ZL03225541.1 discloses a silicone pressure relief valve for use on a pressure cooker and a pressure cooker vessel, including a valve body and a valve core, which is characterized by the use of a valve body made of silica gel and a stainless steel ball as a valve. The core has two upper and lower cavities on the valve body, and a waist is formed between the two cavities. The stainless steel ball valve core is assembled into the lower cavity of the valve body by elastic assembly of the silicone rubber. The natural state spool is located in the lower chamber of the valve body without leaving the valve body. Under the forced action of the air pressure, the valve body enters the upper chamber of the valve body from the lower chamber through the waist, so that the pressure in the pot continuously drops rapidly, ensuring safe use. Such a pressure control device, although having a large vent hole, is provided with a waist portion having a small diameter, and the clogging problem still cannot be completely avoided. At the same time, because it adopts a flexible assembly structure design, the valve body must be made of soft silicone material, so it is difficult to accurately control the pressure inside the pot, and once the valve core enters the upper cavity of the valve body under the action of air pressure, when the pressure in the pot After a rapid drop, it is not possible to automatically return to the lower chamber for the next duty cycle.

content_cn: 现有自动洗碗机的控制方法一般为：在对餐具进行预设时间的清洗后，获得自动洗碗机内餐具洗涤水的第一污染程度，确定第一污染程度对应的污染等级，餐具的污染等级包括轻度污染、中度污染和重度污染；当餐具的污染等级为重度污染时，控制洗碗机重新进水对餐具再次进行清洗，检测再次清洗后的餐具洗涤水的第二污染程度，确定第二污染程度对应的污染等级，并针对第二污染程度对应的污染等级确定是否需要再次对餐具进行清洗。
content_en: The control method of the existing automatic dishwasher is generally: after the tableware is cleaned for a preset time, the first pollution degree of the tableware washing water in the automatic dishwasher is obtained, and the pollution level corresponding to the first pollution degree is determined. The pollution level includes light pollution, moderate pollution and heavy pollution; when the pollution level of the tableware is heavy pollution, control the dishwasher to refill the water to clean the tableware again, and detect the second pollution degree of the tableware washing water after the re-washing , Determine the pollution level corresponding to the second pollution degree, and determine whether the tableware needs to be cleaned again according to the pollution level corresponding to the second pollution degree.

content_cn: 本发明的一个目标目的是提供用于卫生用品(特别是用即弃尿布)的改良吸水性储存层。用于改良吸水性储存层，可使用常规的吸水性聚合物颗粒。并且，所述改良吸水性储存层中应基本上不含纤维素纤维，并且吸水性储存层中的吸水性聚合物颗粒无论是在干燥或湿润状态都既不会滑动也不会或掉出。在本申请的上下本中，“不含纤维素纤维”意指在本发明吸水性储存层中的纤维素的含量优选少于30重量％，优先少于20重量％，更优选少于10重量％，最优选少于5重量％。理想地，根本不存在纤维素。
content_en: An object of the present invention is to provide an improved water-absorbing storage layer for sanitary products, especially disposable diapers. For improving the water-absorbing storage layer, conventional water-absorbing polymer particles can be used. Moreover, the improved water-absorbing storage layer should be substantially free of cellulose fibers, and the water-absorbing polymer particles in the water-absorbing storage layer will neither slip nor fall out, whether in a dry or wet state. In the context of this application, 'cellulose-free fiber' means that the content of cellulose in the water-absorbing storage layer of the present invention is preferably less than 30% by weight, preferably less than 20% by weight, more preferably less than 10% by weight %, Most preferably less than 5% by weight. Ideally, there is no cellulose at all.

content_cn: 上述涡旋分离器中，分离段的直径在进风口指向出风口的方向上逐渐增大，使气尘在分离段内受的离心力逐渐增大。如此，气尘从涡旋段进入分离段进行螺旋运动时，气尘中的灰尘相对空气重量较大，受到的离心力较大，更靠近分离段的内壁，而空气更靠近分离段的中心，灰尘便沿分离段的内壁旋转流动，且通过直径不断增大的分离段为灰尘的旋转运动不断加速。同时，分离段的侧壁上开设有排尘口，离心力不断增大的灰尘沿分离段的内壁不断加速，直至遇到排尘口，灰尘便可由排尘口被甩出，实现灰尘分离。并且，进风口和出风口分别位于主分离管轴向的相对两端，空气从主分离管轴向的一端流入，从主分离管轴向的另一端流出，形成轴流风道，空气在进风口与出风口之间的流动轨迹不需要弯折，空气在流动过程中不会产生二次涡流，有效避免流道产生的吸力损耗，不会出现二次涡流扬起灰尘及影响正常螺旋分离气流的情况，灰尘分离效果较佳。
content_en: In the above vortex separator, the diameter of the separation section gradually increases in the direction in which the air inlet is directed to the air outlet, so that the centrifugal force of the air dust in the separation section is gradually increased. In this way, when the air dust enters the separation section and spirally moves from the scroll section, the dust in the air dust is relatively heavy with respect to the air, and the centrifugal force is larger, closer to the inner wall of the separation section, and the air is closer to the center of the separation section, and the dust The flow is rotated along the inner wall of the separation section, and the rotational movement of the dust is continuously accelerated by the separation section having an increasing diameter. At the same time, the side wall of the separation section is provided with a dust discharge port, and the dust with increasing centrifugal force is continuously accelerated along the inner wall of the separation section until the dust discharge port is encountered, and the dust can be taken out by the dust discharge port to realize dust separation. Moreover, the air inlet and the air outlet are respectively located at opposite ends of the main separation tube in the axial direction, and air flows in from the axial end of the main separation tube, and flows out from the other end of the main separation tube in the axial direction to form an axial flow duct, and the air is in progress. The flow path between the tuyere and the air outlet does not need to be bent. The air does not generate secondary eddy current during the flow process, effectively avoiding the suction loss generated by the flow channel, and the secondary vortex does not raise dust and affect the normal spiral separation airflow. In the case, the dust separation effect is better.

content_cn: 本发明技术方案，具有如下优点：1.本发明提供的囊状降噪减震结构，囊体内装有至少两种在混合后可迅速膨胀为固态弹性体以至充满整个腔体的固态填充物和液态填充物。这样不仅可以依靠囊体的固态弹性体吸收、过滤掉噪音，减少因震动体工作使整个装置产生的振动，还可以有效避免在长期使用后由于囊体的老化，液体从囊体中向外泄露的现象。2.本发明提供的具有囊状降噪减震结构的装置，在震动体周向外表面与机壳内表面形成的整个空间中填充有上述囊体，这样在装置长期使用后，由于避免了液体从囊体中向外泄露，因此最大程度上降低了液体对电机和控制电路造成的损坏，延长了使用寿命。3.本发明提供的具有囊状降噪减震结构的装置，固体与液体的重量份数比为1:(50-400)。这样既可以保证填充的固体可以完全膨胀填满囊体内部的空间，又可以最大程度上减少囊体内部液体的残留，避免泄露。
content_en: The technical solution of the present invention has the following advantages:1.The present invention provides a capsule-like noise reduction shock absorbing structure in which at least two kinds of solid fillers and liquid fillers which can rapidly expand into a solid elastomer after mixing to fill the entire cavity are provided.
