content_cn: 有一种比较常见的情形是：家庭中拥有多只宠物，如养猫的同时也养狗，或者养多只猫，其中猫的品种和年龄有所不同。在宠物食的品种趋于多样化以及宠物的主人豢养趋于精细化两种前提下，不同的宠物之间的宠物食往往不同。此时，如果宠物喂食器在固定的时间段投喂宠物食，则会存在投喂错乱的现象。鉴于此，目前的一种处理方式是：为宠物配置如蓝牙模块、RFID标签，宠物喂食器上相应地配置有蓝牙模块、RFIS读写器等，从而通过识别蓝牙信号、RFID信号的方式来识别宠物的身份，在此基础上进行针对性的投喂。不过，该针对性的投喂方案需要针对宠物和宠物喂食器双向配置与识别相关的部件，且由于宠物的外出行为具有一定的不确定性，配置于宠物的部件容易发生损坏、丢失的问题。还有一种处理方式是：通过图像数据来识别宠物的身份，在此基础上进行针对性的投喂。该针对性的投喂方案存在这样的问题：识别存在需要引起关注的出错率。如出错率产生的原因是：如外形明显不同的宠物(如猫和狗、大型犬和小型犬、条纹猫和灰猫)可以通过图像识别的方式来区分，不过对于品种、颜色、提醒等较为相似的宠物而言，其区别较为细微(如只有宠物的主人比较熟知)，这种情形下，采用图像识别的方式便可能存在相当的出错率。这样一来，假设识别不准确，则本次投喂相当于无效投喂甚至可能会影响宠物的健康。
content_en: There is a relatively common situation: there are multiple pets in a family, such as cats and dogs at the same time, or multiple cats, and the breeds and ages of the cats are different. Under the two premise that the variety of pet food tends to be diversified and pet owners tend to be refined, the pet food of different pets is often different. At this time, if the pet feeder feeds pet food in a fixed time period, there will be a phenomenon of disordered feeding. In view of this, one of the current processing methods is: configure Bluetooth modules, RFID tags for pets, and correspondingly configure Bluetooth modules, RFID readers, etc. on the pet feeder, so as to identify Bluetooth signals and RFID signals. Based on the identity of the pet, targeted feeding is carried out. However, this targeted feeding solution requires two-way configuration and identification-related components for pets and pet feeders, and due to the uncertainty of pets’ going out behavior, the components configured for pets are prone to damage and loss. Another processing method is to identify the identity of the pet through image data, and then carry out targeted feeding on this basis. The problem with this targeted feeding regimen is that there is an error rate in identification that needs attention. For example, the reason for the error rate is that pets with obviously different appearances (such as cats and dogs, large dogs and small dogs, striped cats and gray cats) can be distinguished through image recognition, but for breeds, colors, reminders, etc. For similar pets, the difference is relatively subtle (for example, only the owner of the pet is familiar with it). In this case, there may be a considerable error rate in the way of image recognition. In this way, assuming that the identification is inaccurate, this feeding is equivalent to invalid feeding and may even affect the health of the pet.

content_cn: 长时间的血压测量可能会由于用户不适导致血压测量准确度下降。例如：1、手部长时间血压循环受阻，会使用户产生酸、麻的不适感；2、加压的时间过长而没有出现血压值，容易使使用者产生焦虑、急躁的情绪，造成血压短时波动，所测量出来的血压值容易出现偏差；3、测量血压过程中需要使用者保持正确的测量姿势(即，人体静止不动，手腕部与心脏高度保持平齐)，如果持续时间过长，支撑保持测量姿势的肌肉力量不足(尤其是中老年人)，用户的手臂、手腕会不自觉的出现微小抖动，这种微小抖动所产生的信号会作为噪声加载进脉搏波信号中，降低脉搏波信号的信噪比，降低血压测量的精度。
content_en: Long-term blood pressure measurement may reduce the accuracy of blood pressure measurement due to user discomfort. For example: 1. The blood pressure cycle is blocked for a long time, which will cause the user to feel sour and numb; 2. If the pressure is too long without the blood pressure value, it is easy to cause anxiety and irritability in the user, resulting in short blood pressure Time fluctuations, the measured blood pressure value is prone to deviation; 3. During blood pressure measurement, the user needs to maintain the correct measurement posture (that is, the human body is still, the wrist and the heart are level), if the duration is too long , The muscle strength to support the measurement posture is insufficient (especially the middle-aged and elderly people), and the user's arms and wrists will unconsciously appear small jitters. The signal generated by this small jitter will be loaded into the pulse wave signal as noise to reduce the pulse The signal-to-noise ratio of the wave signal reduces the accuracy of blood pressure measurement.

content_cn: 控制面板位于箱体外侧时，相比于现有技术距离蒸烤箱内部发热的区域更远了，同时控制面板和发热的区域之间还至少间隔着箱体的外壳。因此无论是辐射热，还是热传导均得到了一定程度的削弱，从而减小控制面板受蒸烤箱内部温度的影响。当蒸烤箱烹饪工作完成时，用户可以先将控制面板拆下，防止打开蒸烤箱时，热气或蒸汽上浮与控制面板接触。现有技术中，大部分蒸烤箱设置在高度较低的地柜中，用户操作需要弯腰或蹲下进行。本方案中的控制面板可拆卸连接在箱体上，用户可将控制面板拆下，对控制面板上的程序进行设定后，再将控制面板装在箱体上。使用户在设定程序的操作过程中，不必弯腰或蹲下。
content_en: When the control panel is located outside the cabinet, compared with the prior art, it is farther away from the heating area inside the steam oven, and at least the casing of the cabinet is spaced between the control panel and the heating area. Therefore, whether it is radiant heat or heat conduction is weakened to a certain extent, thereby reducing the influence of the control panel by the internal temperature of the steam oven. When the cooking operation of the steam oven is completed, the user can remove the control panel to prevent hot air or steam from coming into contact with the control panel when the steam oven is opened. In the prior art, most steaming ovens are set in a floor cabinet with a low height, and users need to bend or squat to perform operations. The control panel in this solution is detachably connected to the box. The user can remove the control panel, set the program on the control panel, and then install the control panel on the box. Allows the user to avoid bending or squatting during the operation of the setting program.

content_cn: 综上所述，以往文献中虽然报导了一些用于烯烃物流的吸附剂和相应净化方法，但具体应用中存在吸附剂的吸附净化深度低、吸附容量低、净化精度低、吸附容量低、再生稳定性差等问题。虽然八面沸石分子筛NaX和NaY具有较强的极性，尤其对极性杂质的脱除具有较高的脱除效率等特点，常用于各种气体、液体原料的吸附净化。现有的NaX和NaY分子筛吸附剂一方面吸附净化深度低，产品纯度不能满足下游生产要求。同时吸附容量有限，使吸附剂的用量以及净化装置体积庞大，增加了装置投入费用，频繁再生也使操作变得复杂。另一方面，吸附选择性较差，吸附含氧化合物的同时也吸附大量烯烃，而烯烃吸附时放出较多热量对吸附效率带来不利影响。此外，再生过程中残留在吸附剂孔道内的烯烃在高温下容易发生炭化使吸附剂性能下降。
content_en: In summary, although some adsorbents and corresponding purification methods for olefins are reported in the literature, there are low adsorption and purification depths of adsorbents, low adsorption capacity, low purification precision, low adsorption capacity, and regeneration. Problems such as poor stability. Although the faujasite molecular sieves NaX and NaY have strong polarity, especially for the removal of polar impurities, they have high removal efficiency and are commonly used for adsorption and purification of various gases and liquid materials. The existing NaX and NaY molecular sieve adsorbents have low adsorption purification depth on the one hand, and the product purity cannot meet the downstream production requirements. At the same time, the adsorption capacity is limited, so that the amount of the adsorbent and the purification device are bulky, which increases the input cost of the device, and the frequent regeneration also complicates the operation. On the other hand, the adsorption selectivity is poor, and a large amount of olefin is adsorbed while adsorbing the oxygen-containing compound, and the release of more heat during the adsorption of the olefin adversely affects the adsorption efficiency. In addition, olefins remaining in the pores of the adsorbent during regeneration tend to carbonize at high temperatures to degrade the performance of the adsorbent.

content_cn: 在一些实施方式中，对由所述机器人的机器臂末端的加速度传感器获取的加速度数据进行滤波处理，根据所述滤波处理后的加速度数据确定所述机器人的机器臂末端的第二空间位置，包括：按设定的滤波周期，对所述加速度传感器的设定方向上的加速度数据进行滤波后，计算所述机器人的机器臂末端在当前的一个所述滤波周期内结束时的位移；根据所述坐标原点、以及所述机器人的机器臂末端在当前的一个所述滤波周期内结束时的位移，计算所述机器人的机器臂末端在当前的一个所述滤波周期结束时的当前空间位置；根据所述加速度传感器按所述滤波周期进行滤波的滤波次数、以及所述机器人的机器臂末端在当前的一个所述滤波周期结束时的当前空间位置，计算所述机器人的机器臂末端在累计所述滤波次数个所述滤波周期结束时的累计空间位置，作为所述滤波处理后的加速度数据确定所述机器人的机器臂末端的第二空间位置。
content_en: In some embodiments, filtering the acceleration data acquired by the acceleration sensor at the end of the robot arm of the robot, and determining the second spatial position of the end of the robot arm of the robot according to the acceleration data after the filtering process includes : After filtering the acceleration data in the set direction of the acceleration sensor according to the set filter period, calculate the displacement of the end of the robot arm of the robot at the end of the current filter period; according to the The coordinate origin and the displacement of the end of the robot arm of the robot at the end of the current filter period are calculated, and the current spatial position of the end of the robot arm of the robot at the end of the current filter period is calculated; The number of filtering times that the acceleration sensor performs filtering according to the filtering period and the current spatial position of the end of the robot arm of the robot at the end of the current filtering period are calculated, and the end of the robot arm of the robot is calculated to accumulate the filtering The cumulative spatial position at the end of the filtering period of the number of times is used as the acceleration data after the filtering process to determine the second spatial position of the end of the robot arm of the robot.

content_cn: 当空调器外机输送到自动上料装置时，挡料板12将其固定在预定的位置。丝杠32为两个，通过其中一个丝杠可以调节挡料板12的位置。电机18带动另一个丝杠转动从而带动滑板221沿着直线导轨50滑动。承载板222随着滑板221的运动而逐渐翻起，直到与承载板222呈90°角。上胶装置300将连接管粘在空调器外机上后，电机31带动滑板221退出，滑板221逐渐降下。第一传感器71用于监测滑板221的位置，微动开关用于确认滑板221上有连接管的情况下才开始动作。当连接管放置到承载板上时，复位弹簧带动卡板夹紧连接管。止挡块用于调整卡板之间所能放置的物料的最大宽度。紧固件3带动滑板221随转轴6转动90°，将连接管紧贴在空调器外机侧面上。承载板222呈U型的开口是上胶装置300粘贴胶带的位置。当连接管粘贴好后，气缸44带动卡板张开，承载板222随滑板221退回。开口销2通过拉伸弹簧与滑板221上的开口销相连接，使承载板222能够复位。滚轮2211和承载板222固定在转轴6上，滚轮2211在导轨部21上运动的过程中会带动转轴6转动，同时带动承载板222翻转。
content_en: When the external unit of the air conditioner is transported to the automatic loading device, the baffle 12 secures it at a predetermined position. There are two lead screws 32, and the position of the baffle 12 can be adjusted by one of the lead screws. The motor 18 drives the other screw to rotate to drive the slide 221 to slide along the linear guide 50. The carrier plate 222 is gradually turned up as the slider 221 moves until it is at an angle of 90 to the carrier plate 222. After the gluing device 300 adheres the connecting tube to the external unit of the air conditioner, the motor 31 drives the sliding plate 221 to exit, and the sliding plate 221 is gradually lowered. The first sensor 71 is used to monitor the position of the slider 221, and the micro switch is used to confirm that the slider 221 has a connecting tube to start the action.When the connecting tube is placed on the carrying plate, the return spring drives the card to clamp the connecting tube. The stop block is used to adjust the maximum width of the material that can be placed between the cards. The fastener 3 drives the slide plate 221 to rotate 90° with the rotating shaft 6, and the connecting pipe is closely attached to the outer side of the air conditioner. The U-shaped opening of the carrier plate 222 is the position at which the gluing device 300 affixes the tape. When the connecting pipe is pasted, the cylinder 44 drives the card to open, and the carrying plate 222 is retracted with the sliding plate 221 . The split pin 2 is coupled to the split pin on the slider 221 by a tension spring to enable the carrier plate 222 to be reset. The roller 2211 and the carrier plate 222 are fixed on the rotating shaft 6. During the movement of the roller 2211 on the rail portion 21, the rotating shaft 6 is rotated, and the carrying plate 222 is turned over.

content_cn: 与现有己内酰胺尾气治理技术相比，本实用新型具有如下优点：（1）己内酰胺尾气中的硫酸雾、NOx和SOx基本被全部回收，用于己内酰胺生产装置制备亚硝基硫酸，环境效益和经济效益显著提高。（2）将吸附设备解吸产生的高浓度NOx和SOx解吸气与臭氧发生器产生的臭氧混合后再进行吸收处理，臭氧利用率更高，操作费用更低，处理效果好。（3）使用多相流泵或射流泵，不仅吸收效果好，节省能耗；而且浓硫酸吸收尾气中的NO2和SO3后会产生亚硝基硫酸固体粉末，不会对泵体产生磨损，而且以泵运转过程中产生的负压使饱和吸附剂解吸，减少了由于使用真空泵而产生的能耗。
content_en: Compared with the existing caprolactam tail gas treatment technology, the utility model has the following advantages:（1）The sulfuric acid mist, NOx and SOx in the caprolactam tail gas were substantially recovered for the preparation of nitroso sulfuric acid in the caprolactam production plant, and the environmental benefits and economic benefits were significantly improved.（2）The high concentration of NOx and SOx desorption gas generated by the desorption of the adsorption equipment are mixed with the ozone produced by the ozone generator, and the ozone utilization rate is higher, the operation cost is lower, and the treatment effect is good.（3）The use of multi-phase flow pump or jet pump, not only absorb the effect is good, save energy; and concentrated sulfuric acid absorption of tail gas NO 2 and SO 3 will produce nitrosyl sulfate solid powder, will not wear on the pump, The negative pressure generated during the operation of the pump causes the saturated adsorbent to desorb and reduce the energy consumption due to the use of the vacuum pump.

content_cn: 机器人是一种能够自主完成一定动作的智能设备，机器人所包含的系统控 制单元能够控制机械臂按照一定轨迹运行，完成相应动作。动作的实施主体为 机器人所包含的机械臂，机械臂作为实施特定动作的末端结构，需要适应不同 的工作场合。机械臂的长度在一定程度上体现了机器人的工作半径，机械臂的 长度越长则机器人的工作半径越大，所能够覆盖的范围越广。不同工作场合所 需要的工作半径不同，即所需要机械臂的长度不同。因此一般机械臂包括加长 臂和固定臂，当需要较大工作半径时在固定臂中连接上所述加长臂，使得整体 机械臂的长度增加，当所需工作半径较小时则只选用固定臂即可。而加长臂与 固定臂之间的连接一般需要在加长臂和固定臂外设置法兰，利用螺栓等连接件 将加长臂与固定臂连接。在使用的过程中，裸露在加长臂和固定臂外的螺栓容 易卷入异物，一方面会导致机械臂无法正常运转，另一方面存在较大的安全风险。
content_en: A robot is an intelligent device that can complete certain actions autonomously. The system control unit contained in the robot can control the robotic arm to run on a certain trajectory and complete the corresponding actions. The main body of the action is the manipulator contained in the robot. The manipulator, as the end structure for specific actions, needs to be adapted to different work situations. The length of the robotic arm reflects the working radius of the robot to a certain extent. The longer the length of the robotic arm, the larger the working radius of the robot and the wider the coverage area. The working radius required for different working occasions is different, that is, the length of the robot arm required is different. Therefore, a general mechanical arm includes an extension arm and a fixed arm. When a larger working radius is required, the extension arm is connected to the fixed arm to increase the length of the overall mechanical arm. When the required working radius is small, only the fixed arm is used. can. The connection between the extension arm and the fixed arm generally requires flanges outside the extension arm and the fixed arm, and bolts and other connectors are used to connect the extension arm to the fixed arm. During use, the bolts exposed outside the extension arm and the fixed arm can easily get involved in foreign objects. On the one hand, the robot arm cannot operate normally, on the other hand, there is a greater safety risk.

content_cn: 在固井过程中，泡沫水泥浆在油气井工程领域中作为一种低密度水泥浆在防止环空压力过大引起漏失、气井保证压稳、防止油气水窜、平衡固井压力、防止环空窜流等方面发挥重要作用。泡沫水泥浆硬化后形成水泥块，水泥块内部的气泡具有很好的保温性能，非常适合用于热采井，可以防止热量流失。目前，泡沫水泥浆的制备方式主要包括物理发泡法。物理发泡法包括以下步骤：首先向水中加入起泡剂形成起泡液，起泡剂一般为表面活性物质，起泡剂用于降低气-水界面上的张力。然后向该起泡液中充气并搅拌该起泡液形成泡沫液。这些泡沫液通过泡沫泵送装置注入到混合组件中与水泥浆混合后形成泡沫水泥浆。由于泡沫液的密度比水泥浆的密度小很多，并且水泥浆和泡沫液的粘度均较大，水泥浆和泡沫液难以混合均匀。这种泡沫水泥浆中的泡沫容易聚集在一起，甚至与水泥浆分开，这样有可能导致泡沫水泥浆中的一些泡沫无法随水泥浆一起泵送至井下，造成井下的泡沫水泥浆密度过高。另外，泡沫泵送装置需要泵送气-液两相共存的泡沫液，其成本较高。
content_en: In the process of cementing, foam cement slurry is used as a kind of low-density grout in the field of oil and gas wells to prevent leakage caused by over-pressure in the annulus. The gas well ensures pressure stability, prevents oil and gas water channeling, balances well cementing pressure and prevents annulus Channeling and other aspects play an important role. The foam grout hardens to form a cement block. The bubbles inside the cement block have good thermal insulation properties and are very suitable for thermal production wells to prevent heat loss. At present, the preparation method of foam grout mainly includes the physical foaming method. The physical foaming method includes the following steps:First, a foaming agent is added to the water to form a foaming liquid, and the foaming agent is generally a surface-active substance, and the foaming agent is used to lower the tension at the gas-water interface. The bubbling liquid is then aerated and stirred to form a foam liquid. These foam liquids are injected into the mixing assembly through a foam pumping device and mixed with the cement slurry to form a foam cement slurry. As the density of the foam liquid is much lower than the density of the slurry, and the viscosity of the slurry and the foam liquid are large, it is difficult to mix the slurry and the foam liquid uniformly. The foams in this foam grout tend to congregate and even separate from the grout, which may cause some of the foam in the grout to fail to be pumped downhole along with the grout, resulting in an excessively high density of downhole grout. In addition, the foam pumping device needs to pump the foam liquid coexisting in the gas-liquid phase, which is more costly.

content_cn: 本实用新型的目的在于：针对油气管线拆卸后，重新安装时，错位法兰对正困难，需要多种工具配合，费时费力的问题，提供一种法兰错位矫正装置。为实现上述目的，本实用新型采用的技术方案为：一种法兰错位矫正装置，包括支架体，在所述支架体的前部设有卡块，所述卡块用于钩接错位法兰的螺栓孔；所述支架体的后部设有顶紧机构，所述顶紧机构与定位法兰的侧壁抵接能够带动所述支架体移动产生使错位法兰相对于定位法兰移动的拉力。在错位法兰矫正时，首先通过支架体的前部的卡块钩接错位法兰，再通过支架体后部设置的顶紧机构与定位法兰的侧壁抵接，定位法兰为顶紧机构提供支撑作用，产生使支架体移动的反作用拉力，通过卡块作用于错位法兰上，能够使错位法兰相对于定位法兰移动，进而使错位法兰的螺栓孔与定位法兰的螺栓孔对位，本装置结构简单，操作方便，解决了油气管线拆卸后，重新安装时，错位法兰对正困难，需要多种工具配合，费时费力的问题。优选的，所述支架体包括横板，在所述横板上分别设有第一竖板和第二竖板，所述卡块与所述第一竖板的侧壁连接，所述顶紧机构与所述第二竖板连接。
content_en: The purpose of the utility model is to provide a flange dislocation correcting device in order to solve the problem that the dislocation flange is difficult to align after the oil and gas pipeline is disassembled and re-installed, and the coordination of various tools is required, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive.To achieve the above object, the technical scheme adopted by the present utility model is:A flange dislocation correcting device includes a bracket body, and a clamping block is arranged at the front of the bracket body, and the clamping block is used for hooking the bolt holes of the dislocation flange; the rear part of the bracket body is provided with a top A tightening mechanism is provided, and the abutting of the pressing mechanism with the side wall of the positioning flange can drive the bracket body to move to generate a pulling force that makes the dislocation flange move relative to the positioning flange.When the dislocation flange is corrected, the dislocation flange is first hooked through the block at the front of the bracket body, and then abutted with the side wall of the positioning flange through the clamping mechanism provided at the rear of the bracket body. The mechanism provides support and generates a reaction pulling force that moves the bracket body. The clamping block acts on the dislocation flange, which can make the dislocation flange move relative to the positioning flange, so that the bolt holes of the dislocation flange and the bolts of the positioning flange can be moved. Hole alignment, the device has a simple structure and is easy to operate, which solves the problem of difficulty in aligning the misaligned flanges when the oil and gas pipelines are disassembled and reinstalled, requiring the cooperation of various tools, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive.Preferably, the bracket body includes a horizontal plate, a first vertical plate and a second vertical plate are respectively provided on the horizontal plate, the clamping block is connected to the side wall of the first vertical plate, and the top-tight plate is The mechanism is connected with the second riser.

content_cn: 应用本发明的技术方案，冲铆夹紧装置的上夹模和下夹模均可以沿纵向移动，使用时，下夹模先沿纵向向上运动，下夹模到位后，管件在外力的作用下(可以通过直线传送机构或者手动)开始进料并停留在下夹模的第二容纳槽内，上夹模开始沿纵向向下运动，直至运行到上夹模与下夹模相接触，这时管件在上夹模的压力下夹紧。之后进行管件的冲铆过程(管件冲喇叭口)，管件冲铆后，管件在外力的作用下出料，出料时上夹模和下夹模均可以返回至使用前的位置，这样，在管件返回过程中，不会对冲铆后的管件产生阻挡，从而方便管件的出料。
content_en: By applying the technical solution of the present invention, both the upper and lower clamping dies of the punching and riveting clamping device can be moved in the longitudinal direction. When in use, the lower clamping die moves upward in the longitudinal direction first. (It can be fed through a linear conveyor or manually) Start feeding and stay in the second holding slot of the lower clamp, the upper clamp starts to move downward in the longitudinal direction until it runs until the upper clamp contacts the lower clamp, at this time the pipe Clamp under the pressure of the upper clamp. After that, the pipe is punched and riveted (the pipe is punched into the bell mouth). After the pipe is riveted, the pipe is discharged under the action of external force. During the discharge, the upper and lower clamps can be returned to the position before use. During the return process of the pipe fitting, the pipe fitting after punching and riveting will not be blocked, thereby facilitating the discharge of the pipe fitting.

content_cn: 随着中国制造业的逐步强大，自动化转型发展成为各大制造业发展的主要趋势。各大企业通过优化产线布局、调整人员分配、引进自动化设备等逐步减少对人工作业的依赖，以达到降低劳动力成本实现自动化生产的目的。目前国内各大空调公司，在空调外机生产完成后，需要对空调外机进行包装，将外机放置在底托上，然后套上包装箱打包，以便于后期存放、运输。目前需专门的物流人员将底托组件的泡沫和纸托进行组装形成底托组件，然后将底托组件放置在皮带线上，通过皮带线运送底托组件。但人工将底托组件放置在皮带线上，操作繁琐，费时费力，而且人工摆放定位不准确，造成底托摆放不整齐，影响实际使用，制约了生产效率的提升。
content_en: With the gradual strength of China's manufacturing industry, the development of automation transformation has become the main trend in the development of major manufacturing industries. Major enterprises gradually reduce their dependence on manual operations by optimizing the layout of production lines, adjusting the distribution of personnel, and introducing automated equipment to achieve the goal of reducing labor costs and achieving automated production. At present, major domestic air-conditioning companies need to package the air-conditioning outer unit after the production of the air-conditioning outer unit, place the outer unit on the bottom support, and then wrap it in a packing box for later storage and transportation. At present, specialized logistics personnel are required to assemble the foam and paper support of the bottom support component to form a bottom support component, and then place the bottom support component on a belt line and transport the bottom support component through the belt line. However, manually placing the bottom support assembly on the belt line is cumbersome, time-consuming and laborious, and the manual placement and positioning is not accurate, which causes the bottom support to be untidy, affects actual use, and restricts the improvement of production efficiency.

content_cn: 本发明的实施例提供的技术方案可以包括以下有益效果：通过控制机械臂末端自动检测标定板的原点定位点和标定板的X轴最远定位点，实现了工件坐标系下X轴的自动标定，然后根据相邻定位点的横向间距和纵向间距，确定标定板上剩余定位点在机械臂末端坐标系下的坐标，实现了九点坐标的自动定位，相比现有技术中人工操作机器人标定对齐时人眼及手动操作容易造成误差的技术方案，本发明提供的技术方案，由于在坐标系标定即点位标定过程中减少了人为参与，从而减少了人为造成的标定误差，进而避免了因误差导致的重复标定工作，在提高标定准确度的同时，提高视觉调试效率，对操作人员要求降低，从而使人员更快上手。
content_en: The technical solutions provided by the embodiments of the present invention may include the following beneficial effects:By controlling the end of the robot arm to automatically detect the origin positioning point of the calibration plate and the farthest X-axis positioning point of the calibration plate, automatic calibration of the The coordinates of the remaining positioning points on the calibration board in the coordinate system of the end of the robot arm realize the automatic positioning of the nine-point coordinates. Compared with the existing technical solutions in which errors are easily caused by human eyes and manual operations when calibrating and aligning manually operated robots, this method The technical solution provided by the invention reduces human participation in the process of coordinate system calibration, that is, point calibration, thereby reducing human-caused calibration errors and thus avoiding repeated calibration work caused by errors. While improving calibration accuracy, Improve the efficiency of visual debugging and reduce the requirements on operators, allowing operators to get started faster.

content_cn: 具体地，生产线还包括：配重机组50、检测机组60和控制机组。配重机组50设置在输送组件20的侧部，配重机组50具有装配状态和卸取状态；当配重机组50处于装配状态时，配重机组50用于将配重块安装在导流盘上，以对完成堆叠工序的多个导流盘进行压紧；当配重机组50处于卸取状态时，配重机组50用于将多个导流盘上的配重块取下，并通过第二装配机组32将上法兰安装在多个导流盘上。通过设置配重机组50可以实现对配重块的自动化装配与运送，以提高生产线的自动化程度。其中，检测机组60设置在输送组件20的侧部，检测机组60用于检测装配有配重块的导流盘的刻度是否对齐，检测机组60的设置能够取代传统人工视觉识别，一方面能够提高生产线的效率，另一方面也可以使得识别准确度获得进一步提升。检测机组60和配重机组50均与控制机组连接，当检测机组60检测到导流盘的刻度对齐时，控制机组控制配重机组50处于卸取状态，通过设置控制机组能够使系统自动控制系统动作，减少了人工参与，能够提升生产线的自动化程度。
content_en: Specifically, the production line also includes: a counterweight unit 50 , a detection unit 60 and a control unit. The counterweight unit 50 is arranged on the side of the conveying assembly 20, and the counterweight unit 50 has an assembled state and an unloading state; when the counterweight unit 50 is in the assembled state, the counterweight unit 50 is used to install the counterweight on the deflector to compress the multiple guide plates that have completed the stacking process; when the counterweight unit 50 is in the unloading state, the counterweight unit 50 is used to remove the counterweights on the multiple guide plates, and pass The second assembly unit 32 installs the upper flange on a plurality of deflectors. The automatic assembly and delivery of the counterweights can be realized by setting the counterweight unit 50, so as to improve the degree of automation of the production line. Among them, the detection unit 60 is arranged on the side of the conveying assembly 20, and the detection unit 60 is used to detect whether the scales of the deflectors equipped with counterweights are aligned. The setting of the detection unit 60 can replace the traditional manual visual recognition, and can improve The efficiency of the production line, on the other hand, can also further improve the recognition accuracy. Both the detection unit 60 and the counterweight unit 50 are connected to the control unit. When the detection unit 60 detects that the scales of the deflector are aligned, the control unit controls the counterweight unit 50 to be in the unloading state. By setting the control unit, the system can automatically control the system. Action, reducing manual participation, can improve the degree of automation of the production line.

content_cn: 输送线主要包括传送带等设备，用于输送物料，将物料转移至所需位置，常常被使用在生产车间、包装车间和库房等场地，降低了生产、存放等过程中的搬运成本。相关技术中，为提高传输效率，可能会出现多个传送带向一个总传送带上送料的情况，不同的传送带之间可能会相互干扰，甚至在交汇处出现拥堵的现象，影响物料的正常输送。基于此，有必要针对上述的问题，提供一种能够便于有序输送物料的输送线及生产系统。
content_en: Conveyor lines mainly include equipment such as conveyor belts, which are used to transport materials and transfer them to the required location. They are often used in production workshops, packaging workshops, warehouses and other places, reducing the transportation costs during production and storage.In related technologies, in order to improve transmission efficiency, multiple conveyor belts may feed materials to a general conveyor belt. Different conveyor belts may interfere with each other, or even cause congestion at the intersection, affecting the normal transportation of materials.Based on this, it is necessary to provide a conveying line and production system that can facilitate the orderly conveying of materials in order to solve the above problems.

content_cn: 本发明实施方式中，所述第一滚轮的直径在2mm-5mm的范围内。本发明实施方式中，所述第一滚轮的轴向延伸方向与所述曲面盖板具有弧边区域的一对边的延伸方向一致，所述第一滚轮的轴向长度大于所述曲面盖板具有弧边区域的一对边的长度。本发明实施方式中，所述第一滚轮的材质包括合金钢。所述第一滚轮组件还包括设置在所述第一滚轮两端的第一轴套，所述第一轴套设置于所述固定架上。本发明实施方式中，每个所述滚轮压合件还包括设置在所述固定架上的第二滚轮组件，所述第二滚轮组件与所述第一滚轮组件轴向平行设置，所述第二滚轮组件设置于所述第一滚轮组件远离所述盖板固定件的一侧，且所述第二滚轮组件可沿竖直方向相对所述第一滚轮组件移动，远离或靠近所述第一滚轮组件。本发明实施方式中，当所述滚轮压合件在所述曲面盖板中部平直区域移动的过程中，所述第二滚轮组件与所述第一滚轮组件贴合且沿竖直方向正对设置，用以支撑所述第一滚轮组件；当所述滚轮压合件运动到所述曲面盖板两边的弧边区域时，所述第二滚轮组件与所述第一滚轮组件分离，所述第二滚轮组件退出贴合区域。本发明实施方式中，所述第二滚轮组件包括第二滚轮、设置于所述第二滚轮两端的连接轴、以及套设于所述连接轴上的第二轴套。
content_en: In the embodiment of the present invention, the diameter of the first roller is in the range of 2mm-5mm.In the embodiment of the present invention, the axial extension direction of the first roller is consistent with the extension direction of a pair of sides of the curved cover plate having an arc edge region, and the axial length of the first roller is greater than that of the curved cover plate The length of a pair of sides with arc side areas.In the embodiment of the present invention, the material of the first roller includes alloy steel. The first roller assembly further includes a first shaft sleeve arranged at both ends of the first roller, and the first shaft sleeve is arranged on the fixing frame.In the embodiment of the present invention, each of the roller pressing parts further includes a second roller assembly arranged on the fixing frame, the second roller assembly is arranged in parallel with the first roller assembly, and the first roller assembly The second roller assembly is arranged on the side of the first roller assembly away from the cover fixing member, and the second roller assembly can move in the vertical direction relative to the first roller assembly, away from or close to the first roller assembly. Roller assembly.In the embodiment of the present invention, when the roller pressing member moves in the flat area in the middle of the curved cover plate, the second roller assembly is attached to the first roller assembly and is aligned in the vertical direction. Is configured to support the first roller assembly; when the roller pressing member moves to the arc edge areas on both sides of the curved cover plate, the second roller assembly is separated from the first roller assembly, and the The second roller assembly exits the bonding area.In the embodiment of the present invention, the second roller assembly includes a second roller, a connecting shaft provided at both ends of the second roller, and a second sleeve sleeved on the connecting shaft.

content_cn: 一种制备本发明共聚体的方法包括，在催化剂[(4，5-亚甲基-菲基)(叔丁基氨基)二甲基硅烷]二甲基钛和合适的活化化合物的存在下，将可聚合单体的混合物进行聚合。通过使用该催化剂，本发明共聚体可通过描述于EP-A-0416815(JamesC.Stevens等人)和美国专利5703187(FrancisJ.Timmers)的方法来制备，在此将两者都作为参考并入本发明。这些聚合反应优选的操作条件为大气压至3000个大气压的压力以及-50℃至200℃的温度。在高于各单体自动聚合温度之上的温度下进行聚合反应并去除未反应单体可能导致形成一定量的得自自由基聚合反应的均聚物聚合产物。在制备本发明的共聚体时，由于乙烯基芳族单体在高温下的均聚反应而可能形成一定量的无规立构乙烯基或亚乙烯基芳族均聚物。乙烯基芳族均聚物的存在一般对本发明没有害处且可以容许。乙烯基芳族均聚物可根据需要通过萃取技术如液相色谱从该共聚体中分离，或使用该共聚体或乙烯基或亚乙烯基芳族均聚物的非溶剂从溶液中进行选择性沉淀。
content_en: A process for preparing the interpolymer of the present invention comprises, in the presence of the catalyst [(4,5-methylene-phenanthryl)(tert-butylamino)dimethylsilane]dimethyltitanium and a suitable activating compound, The mixture of polymerizable monomers is polymerized. By using the catalyst, the inventive interpolymers can be prepared by the methods described in EP-A-0416815 (James C. Stevens et al.) and U.S. Patent 5,703,187 (Francis J. Timmers), both of which are incorporated herein by reference. Into the invention. Preferred operating conditions for these polymerizations are pressures from atmospheric to 3000 atmospheres and temperatures from -50 °C to 200 °C. Performing the polymerization at a temperature above the autopolymerization temperature of each monomer and removing unreacted monomers may result in the formation of a certain amount of homopolymer polymerization product derived from the radical polymerization. In preparing the interpolymers of the present invention, a certain amount of atactic vinyl or vinylidene aromatic homopolymer may be formed due to the homopolymerization of the vinyl aromatic monomer at elevated temperatures. The presence of a vinyl aromatic homopolymer is generally not deleterious and can be tolerated by the present invention. The vinyl aromatic homopolymer can be isolated from the interpolymer by extraction techniques such as liquid chromatography, or selected from a solution using a non-solvent of the interpolymer or vinyl or vinylidene aromatic homopolymer. precipitation.

content_cn: 称取一定量的富马酸（FMA）加入去离子水中溶解，然后滴入FeCl3继续搅拌溶解；将混合液转入聚四氟乙烯的反应釜中，在100℃恒温箱中反应24h；将反应物取出，用无水乙醇反复洗涤，经离心、干燥得到Fe-MOFs催化剂。取5gFe-MOFs材料超声分散在去离子水中制得前驱体；按Fe/Ti摩尔比4，将一定量的Fe(NO3)3和TiCl4分别溶解于水溶液当中，混合搅拌均匀；将混合液和一定浓度的氨水进行并流共沉淀滴入前驱体中，沉淀在45℃水浴条件下以230r/min速度搅拌，控制pH为8，将沉淀洗涤过滤、120℃干燥、850℃焙烧4h后得到载氧体。
content_en: Weigh a certain amount of fumaric acid (FMA) into deionized water to dissolve, and then dropwise into FeCl3 to continue stirring and dissolving; transfer the mixture into a polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle, and react in a 100°C incubator for 24 hours; The material was taken out, washed repeatedly with anhydrous ethanol, centrifuged and dried to obtain Fe-MOFs catalyst. Take 5g Fe-MOFs material and ultrasonically disperse it in deionized water to obtain the precursor; according to the Fe/Ti molar ratio of 4, a certain amount of Fe(NO3)3 and TiCl4 were dissolved in the aqueous solution respectively, mixed and stirred evenly; The concentration of ammonia water was co-precipitated and dropped into the precursor. The precipitate was stirred at a speed of 230 r/min under the condition of a 45 °C water bath, and the pH was controlled to 8. The precipitate was washed and filtered, dried at 120 °C, and calcined at 850 °C for 4 hours to obtain oxygen carrier. body.

content_cn: 本实施例中，所述净饮机的控制装置集成的模块/单元如果以软件功能单元的形式实现并作为独立的产品销售或使用时，可以存储在一个计算机可读取存储介质中。基于这样的理解，本发明实现上述实施例方法中的全部或部分流程，也可以通过计算机程序来指令相关的硬件来完成，所述的计算机程序可存储于一计算机可读存储介质中，该计算机程序在被处理器执行时，可实现上述各个方法实施例的步骤。其中，所述计算机程序包括计算机程序代码，所述计算机程序代码可以为源代码形式、对象代码形式、可执行文件或某些中间形式等。所述计算机可读介质可以包括：能够携带所述计算机程序代码的任何实体或装置、记录介质、U盘、移动硬盘、磁碟、光盘、计算机存储器、只读存储器(ROM，Read-OnlyMemory)、随机存取存储器(RAM，Random Access Memory)、电载波信号、电信信号以及软件分发介质等。需要说明的是，所述计算机可读介质包含的内容可以根据司法管辖区内立法和专利实践的要求进行适当的增减，例如在某些司法管辖区，根据立法和专利实践，计算机可读介质不包括电载波信号和电信信号。
content_en: In this embodiment, if the modules / units integrated in the control device of the decoction machine are implemented in the form of software functional units and sold or used as independent products, they can be stored in a computer-readable storage medium. Based on such an understanding, the present invention implements all or part of the processes in the methods of the above embodiments, and may also be completed by a computer program instructing related hardware. The computer program may be stored in a computer-readable storage medium. The computer When the program is executed by a processor, the steps of the foregoing method embodiments can be implemented. The computer program includes computer program code, and the computer program code may be in a source code form, an object code form, an executable file, or some intermediate form. The computer-readable medium may include: any entity or device capable of carrying the computer program code, a recording medium, a U disk, a mobile hard disk, a magnetic disk, an optical disk, a computer memory, a read-only memory (ROM, Read-OnlyMemory), Random access memory (RAM, Random Access Memory), electric carrier signals, telecommunication signals, and software distribution media. It should be noted that the content contained in the computer-readable medium can be appropriately increased or decreased according to the requirements of legislation and patent practice in the jurisdictions. For example, in some jurisdictions, the computer-readable medium Excludes electric carrier signals and telecommunication signals.

content_cn: 本发明提供了一种甲基硅油组合物，包括：甲基硅油95wt％～99wt％；耐热添加剂A0.005wt％～1wt％；耐热添加剂B 0.05wt％～2wt％；耐热添加剂C 0.1wt％～5wt％；所有组份用量之和为100wt％；所述耐热添加剂A选自有机钛的一种或几种；所述耐热添加剂B选自锆盐的一种或几种；所述耐热添加剂C选自有机酚类和胺类化合物中的一种或几种。在研究中，发明人创造性地发现，单独使用耐热添加剂A、耐热添加剂B和耐热添加剂C并不能有效改善甲基硅油的热稳定性，而将耐热添加剂A、耐热添加剂B和耐热添加剂C组合使用，并添加到甲基硅油中，组合添加剂可以与甲基硅油很好地相容，并且能够有效改善甲基硅油的热稳定性，显著提高甲基硅油的使用温度。因此，本发明提供的甲基硅油组合物的热稳定性和耐热性较高。另外，本发明公开的甲基硅油组合物的制备方法简单易行，成本较低。实验结果表明，本发明提供的甲基硅油组合物将甲基硅油的起始氧化温度提高到350℃以上。
content_en: The present invention provides a methyl silicone oil composition comprising: methyl silicone oil 95 wt% to 99 wt%; heat resistant additive A 0.005 wt% to 1 wt%; heat resistant additive B 0.05 wt% to 2 wt%; heat resistant additive C 0.1 Wt% ~ 5wt%; the sum of all the components used is 100wt%; the heat-resistant additive A is selected from one or more of organic titanium; the heat-resistant additive B is selected from one or more of zirconium salts; The heat-resistant additive C is selected from one or more of organic phenols and amines. In the study, the inventors inventively found that the use of the heat-resistant additive A, the heat-resistant additive B, and the heat-resistant additive C alone cannot effectively improve the thermal stability of the methyl silicone oil, while the heat-resistant additive A, the heat-resistant additive B, and The heat-resistant additive C is used in combination and added to the methyl silicone oil. The combined additive can be well compatible with the methyl silicone oil, and can effectively improve the thermal stability of the methyl silicone oil and significantly increase the use temperature of the methyl silicone oil. Therefore, the methyl silicone oil composition provided by the present invention has higher thermal stability and heat resistance. In addition, the method for preparing the methyl silicone oil composition disclosed by the present invention is simple and easy to implement and has a low cost. The experimental results show that the methyl silicone oil composition provided by the present invention increases the initial oxidation temperature of methyl silicone oil to 350° C. or higher.

content_cn: 环戊醇为无色粘稠液体，具有芳香性气味，是一种重要的医药、农药精细化工产品中间体，主要用于制备溴代环戊烷、氯代环戊烷、抗菌药、抗过敏药等产品；此外由于它对各种树脂具有很好的溶解性能，在电子行业作为溶剂得到广泛应用。传统的环戊醇生产主要以以己二酸为原料，经高温脱羧制得环戊酮再加氢后得到，但由于产生大量的污染物和受到原料来源的制约，限制了该工艺进一步的发展。近年来，由于C5烯烃馏分来源广泛，价格低廉，以C5馏分为原料生产环戊醇的研究引起人们极大的兴趣。其中环戊烯可通过间接水合或直接水来合制备环戊醇，间接水合法虽然具有转化率高、选择性好的优势，但硫酸对设备腐蚀严重，硫酸回收套用时浓缩过程能耗大；而直接水合法虽然转化率较低，但解决了设备腐蚀、能耗大的问题，越来越受到人们的关注。
content_en: Cyclopentanol is a colorless viscous liquid with aromatic odor. It is an important intermediate for pharmaceutical and pesticide fine chemical products. It is mainly used to prepare brominated cyclopentane, chlorocyclopentane, antibacterial, anti-allergic. Products such as medicines; in addition, because of its excellent solubility to various resins, it is widely used as a solvent in the electronics industry. The traditional production of cyclopentanol is mainly obtained by re-hydrogenation of cyclopentanone by high temperature decarboxylation with adipic acid as raw material, but it restricts the further development of the process due to the generation of a large amount of pollutants and the restriction of the source of raw materials. . In recent years, due to the wide range of C5 olefin fractions and low prices, research on the production of cyclopentanol from C5 fractions has attracted great interest. Among them, cyclopentene can be prepared by indirect hydration or direct water. Although indirect hydration has the advantages of high conversion rate and good selectivity, sulfuric acid has serious corrosion to equipment, and the concentration process of sulfuric acid recovery is high. Although the direct water law has a low conversion rate, it solves the problem of equipment corrosion and energy consumption, and has attracted more and more attention.

content_cn: 本发明目的是提供一种生产超低硫柴油的加氢处理方法，所要解决的技术问题是生产超低硫柴油时，高温下操作不能有效地控制催化剂床层温升，存在床层局部温度过高。装置操作周期短的问题。本发明提供的方法为：氢气I全部溶解到柴油馏分原料油中进入第一加氢处理反应区，在纯液相的条件下与加氢处理催化剂接触，在反应温度340～400℃的条件下进行反应，第一加氢处理反应器的流出物再与氢气II混合进入第二加氢处理反应区，在纯液相或低氢油比的状态下与加氢处理催化剂接触，在反应温度为240～320℃的条件下进行反应；第二加氢处理反应区的流出物经冷却、分离后得到柴油产品。
content_en: The object of the invention provides a kind of hydroprocessing process of producing ultra-low-sulphur diesel, and technical problem to be solved is that operation control catalyst bed temperature rise effectively exists the bed local temperature too high under the high temperature when producing ultra-low-sulphur diesel.The problem that the device operational cycle is short. Method provided by the invention is: hydrogen I all is dissolved into and gets into the first hydrotreatment reaction zone in the diesel oil distillate raw oil; Under the condition of pure liquid phase, contact with hydrotreating catalyst; Under the condition of 340～400 ℃ of temperature of reaction, react; The elute of first hydrotreating reactor is mixed into the second hydrotreatment reaction zone with hydrogen II again, under the state of pure liquid phase or low hydrogen/gasoline ratio, contacts with hydrotreating catalyst, in temperature of reaction is to react under 240～320 ℃ the condition; The elute of the second hydrotreatment reaction zone obtains diesel product after cooling, separation.

content_cn: 为了进一步减小对臭氧层的破坏，国际汽车空调行业正在大力推广符合上述规定的几种新型制冷剂，包括：二氧化碳、1，1-二氟乙烷(R152a)、CF3CF＝CH2(HFO-1234yf)等。由于HFO-1234yf具有很好的保护臭氧层的作用，因此，为了与HFO-1234yf制冷剂相匹配，相关人员对冷冻机油进行了大量研究。例如，申请号为200180023562.2的中国专利文献报道了一种冷冻机油组合物，包括基础油、含磷极压润滑剂和油性剂。申请号为200580009716.7的中国专利文献报道了一种冷冻机油组合物。但是，上述报道的冷冻机油与HFO-1234yf制冷剂的相溶性较差，从而冷冻机油易在制冷系统中的蒸发器和冷凝器表面蓄积，影响制冷性能。
content_en: In order to further reduce the damage to the ozone layer, the international automotive air-conditioning industry is vigorously promoting several new refrigerants that meet the above regulations, including: carbon dioxide, 1,1-difluoroethane (R152a), CF3CF = CH2 (HFO-1234yf) Wait. Because HFO-1234yf has a good protection of the ozone layer, in order to match with HFO-1234yf refrigerant, relevant personnel have conducted a lot of research on refrigeration oil. For example, the Chinese patent document with the application number 200180023562.2 reports a refrigerator oil composition including a base oil, a phosphorus-containing extreme-pressure lubricant, and an oily agent. The Chinese patent document with the application number 200580009716.7 reports a refrigerating machine oil composition. However, the refrigerant oil reported above has poor compatibility with HFO-1234yf refrigerant, so the refrigerator oil tends to accumulate on the surface of the evaporator and condenser in the refrigeration system, which affects the refrigeration performance.

content_cn: 石油化工与有机合成工业广泛使用浓硫酸做催化剂，该过程将产生大量的废硫酸。通常对于浓度在40％以上的废硫酸进行再生处理才有更有经济意义。同时，一些有机合成工艺如合成甲基丙烯酸甲酯(MMA)和丙烯腈(AN)，除产生废硫酸外，还产生约30-45wt％的废硫酸铵。这些含硫废弃物对环境有严重的污染，因此有必要对工业废酸和含硫废液进行净化处理，并尽可能的回收利用。我国废硫酸和含硫废液每年的产生量有千万吨，这些废液大多含有有机物，难以直接再利用。废硫酸和含硫废液的处理主要有高温浓缩、溶剂萃取、碱中和、化学氧化、高温燃烧等。其中，高温燃烧的方法比较彻底和清洁。但是，目前现有的高温燃烧方法获得的二氧化硫工艺气体由于原料的不同往往会造成二氧化硫含量低，导致后续的接触法制酸装置生产效率低，浓酸产品不合格。同时，废硫酸和含硫废液裂解过程中会产生大量的NOx，NOx溶解在硫酸中不仅会影响硫酸品质，使得硫酸发红，而且会破坏钝化膜，加速硫酸对管道和设备的腐蚀，同时，最终产品尾气中NOx含量超标，无法满足环保排放要求。
content_en: The petrochemical and organic synthesis industries widely use concentrated sulfuric acid as a catalyst, and this process will produce a large amount of waste sulfuric acid. Usually, it is more economical to regenerate waste sulfuric acid with a concentration of more than 40%. Meanwhile, some organic synthesis processes, such as the synthesis of methyl methacrylate (MMA) and acrylonitrile (AN), generate about 30-45 wt% waste ammonium sulfate in addition to waste sulfuric acid. These sulfur-containing wastes have serious pollution to the environment, so it is necessary to purify the industrial waste acid and sulfur-containing waste liquid, and recycle them as much as possible.The annual production volume of waste sulfuric acid and sulfur-containing waste liquid in my country is tens of millions of tons. Most of these waste liquids contain organic matter and are difficult to be reused directly. The treatment of waste sulfuric acid and sulfur-containing waste liquid mainly includes high temperature concentration, solvent extraction, alkali neutralization, chemical oxidation, high temperature combustion, etc.Among them, the method of high temperature combustion is more thorough and clean. However, the sulfur dioxide process gas obtained by the existing high-temperature combustion method often results in low sulfur dioxide content due to different raw materials, resulting in low production efficiency of the subsequent contact method acid-making device and unqualified concentrated acid products. At the same time, a large amount of NOx will be generated during the cracking of waste sulfuric acid and sulfur-containing waste liquid. The dissolution of NOx in sulfuric acid will not only affect the quality of sulfuric acid, making the sulfuric acid red, but also destroy the passivation film and accelerate the corrosion of sulfuric acid to pipelines and equipment. At the same time, the NOx content in the exhaust gas of the final product exceeds the standard and cannot meet the environmental emission requirements.

content_cn: 为解决以上技术问题，本发明所采用的技术方案如下，一种小晶粒ZSM-5沸石的制备方法：将所需量的原料配制成固体重量含量为20～50％的浆液经喷雾干燥成型得到的粒径为10～200μm的硅铝小球，经300～600℃焙烧后，与所需量的碱、模板剂以及水混合混匀得到重量组成为10.0SiO2∶0～0.85Al2O3∶0～2.5Na2O∶0～45.0模板剂∶50～300H2O的混合物I，向混合物I中加入重量0.5～20％的晶化导向剂后在100～200℃晶化10～360小时得到晶粒尺寸为200～1000nm的小晶粒ZSM-5沸石，其中所用模板剂为二乙胺、三乙胺、正丙胺、正丁胺、己二胺、四丙基氢氧化铵或四丙基溴化铵中的一种；晶化导向剂是按照100SiO2∶0.17～6.80Al2O3∶0～20.0Na2O∶60～450模板剂∶450～3000H2O的重量组成将所需量的硅源、铝源，碱源、模板剂以及水混合均匀后在温度60～120℃下晶化10～360小时后制得，其中所用模板剂为四丙基氢氧化铵或四丙基溴化铵。
content_en: In order to solve the above technical problems, the technical scheme adopted by the present invention is as follows, a preparation method of small-grain ZSM-5 zeolite: the required amount of raw materials is formulated into a slurry with a solid content of 20-50% by spray drying The obtained silicon aluminum pellets with a particle size of 10 to 200 μm are calcined at 300 to 600 ° C., mixed with the required amount of alkali, template and water to obtain a weight composition of 10.0SiO2: 0 to 0.85Al2O3: 0 to 2.5Na2O: 0 ～ 45.0 template agent: mixture I of 50 ～ 300H2O, add 0.5 ～ 20% by weight of crystallization guide agent to the mixture I, then crystallize at 100 ～ 200 ℃ for 10 ～ 360 hours to obtain crystal grain size of 200 ～ 1000nm small-grain ZSM-5 zeolite, in which the template agent used is one of diethylamine, triethylamine, n-propylamine, n-butylamine, hexamethylenediamine, tetrapropylammonium hydroxide or tetrapropylammonium bromide The crystallization guide agent is based on the weight composition of 100SiO2: 0.17 ~ 6.80Al2O3: 0 ~ 20.0Na2O: 60 ~ 450 template agent: 450 ~ 3000H2O. The required amount of silicon source, aluminum source, alkali source, template agent and water It is prepared after crystallization after mixing for 10 to 360 hours at a temperature of 60 to 120 ° C. The agent is tetrapropylammonium hydroxide or tetrapropylammonium bromide.

content_cn: 本发明方法利用超重力反应器作为反应后物料的分离设备，利用水蒸气将反应流出物中的甲醇分离出来，同时丁二酸酐和水蒸气在超重力反应器中发生水解反应，反应过程放热，可以加速甲醇蒸发，使得甲醇通过超重力反应器的气相出口排出，丁二酸酐水解后生成丁二酸，丁二酸易溶于水，而丁二酸单甲酯不易溶于水，经过冷却结晶后丁二酸单甲酯即可结晶析出，不需要重结晶即可得到纯度较高的丁二酸单甲酯。而且采用水蒸汽作为分离溶剂，成本低、无污染、无毒无害、操作简单。通过超重力反应器分离甲醇的同时得到产品，解决了丁二酸单甲酯分离步骤繁琐、需重结晶引入其他溶剂、收率低等问题。本发明方法，采用静态混合器作为甲醇和丁二酸酐酯化反应器，充分利用了静态混合器可以极大强化微观混合的效果，使丁二酸酐快速溶解于甲醇中，同时发生酯化反应，缩短了酯化反应时间。本发明经过大量研究发现，在特定的反应温度及压力下，丁二酸酐和甲醇可以发生单酯化反应，且酯化反应过程不需要催化剂，节约了生产成本，省去了催化剂过滤步骤，节约了操作费用。本发明丁二酸单甲酯的制备工艺合理，操作简单，甲醇的分离与制得目标产物同时进行，能耗低，采用该分离方法得到的产品收率高，纯度高，质量好，便于实现大规模工业化生产。
content_en: The method of the invention utilizes a supergravity reactor as a separation device for the post-reaction material, and uses the steam to separate the methanol in the reaction effluent, while the succinic anhydride and water vapor are hydrolyzed in the supergravity reactor, and the reaction process is exothermic. It can accelerate the evaporation of methanol, so that methanol is discharged through the gas phase outlet of the supergravity reactor, succinic anhydride is hydrolyzed to form succinic acid, succinic acid is easily soluble in water, and dimethyl succinate is not easily soluble in water, after cooling After crystallization, the monomethyl succinate can be crystallized, and the monomethyl succinate having higher purity can be obtained without recrystallization. Moreover, water vapor is used as a separation solvent, which is low in cost, non-polluting, non-toxic and harmless, and simple in operation. The product is obtained by separating the methanol by the supergravity reactor, and solves the problems that the separation step of the monomethyl succinate is complicated, the recrystallization is required to introduce other solvents, and the yield is low.The method of the invention adopts a static mixer as the esterification reactor of methanol and succinic anhydride, fully utilizes the static mixer to greatly enhance the effect of micro-mixing, so that the succinic anhydride is rapidly dissolved in methanol, and the esterification reaction occurs at the same time. The esterification reaction time is shortened.The invention has found through a large number of studies that succinic anhydride and methanol can undergo a monoesterification reaction at a specific reaction temperature and pressure, and a catalyst is not required in the esterification reaction process, thereby saving production cost and eliminating the catalyst filtration step and saving. Operating costs.The preparation process of the monomethyl succinate of the invention is reasonable, the operation is simple, the separation of the methanol and the preparation of the target product are carried out at the same time, and the energy consumption is low, and the product obtained by the separation method has high yield, high purity, good quality and convenient realization. Large-scale industrial production.

content_cn: 外源基因在宿主细胞中的高效表达是蛋白质的结构和功能分析、蛋白质或多肽类药物研究开发的先决条件。用于表达重组蛋白的表达体系有微生物、植物、酵母、昆虫细胞和动物细胞等。哺乳动物细胞是表达具有天然活性蛋白的最佳宿主，其优势在于能正确有效地识别真核蛋白的合成、加工和分泌信号，识别和去除基因中的内含子，再经剪切加工成为成熟的mRNA，能准确地完成糖基化、磷酸化，形成链内和链间二硫键及蛋白水解等翻译后加工过程，因而产生的完整抗体和天然抗体一样，具有生物学活性，既可识别抗原又可激活补体系统。哺乳动物细胞易被重组的DNA转染，经过筛选可得到转化的细胞，具有遗传稳定性和可重复性，表达的产物分泌到培养基中易于纯化。利用哺乳动物细胞表达蛋白产物已广泛应用于生物制品工业，如病毒疫苗、抗体、干扰素、免疫调节剂、激素、和生长因子等的大量制备。但动物细胞外源蛋白表达效率低，且成本高，因此提高动物细胞外源蛋白表达效率，降低生产成本是当前工作中的重中之重。
content_en: The efficient expression of a foreign gene in a host cell is a prerequisite for the structural and functional analysis of the protein, and the development of a protein or polypeptide drug. Expression systems for expressing recombinant proteins include microorganisms, plants, yeast, insect cells, and animal cells. Mammalian cells are the best hosts for expressing naturally active proteins. They have the advantage of correctly and efficiently identifying the synthesis, processing and secretion signals of eukaryotic proteins, recognizing and removing introns from genes, and then undergoing shear processing to become mature. The mRNA can accurately perform glycosylation, phosphorylation, and form post-translational processes such as intrachain and interchain disulfide bonds and proteolysis. The resulting intact antibody is biologically active and can be recognized as well as natural antibodies. The antigen in turn activates the complement system. Mammalian cells are easily transfected with recombinant DNA and screened to obtain transformed cells with genetic stability and reproducibility, and the expressed products are secreted into the medium for easy purification. The use of mammalian cells to express protein products has been widely used in the biological products industry, such as the preparation of viral vaccines, antibodies, interferons, immunomodulators, hormones, and growth factors. However, the expression efficiency of exogenous proteins in animal cells is low and the cost is high. Therefore, it is the most important task in the current work to increase the expression efficiency of exogenous proteins in animal cells and reduce production costs.

content_cn: 所述脱硫处理包括：采用以下方式1或方式2进行脱硫处理，方式1：将所述轻馏分引入碱洗单元以与其中的碱液接触而进行碱洗精制，得到脱硫醇后轻馏分；然后将所述中馏分和所述脱硫醇后轻馏分引入溶剂抽提单元的溶剂抽提塔中与贫溶剂接触以进行抽提蒸馏，得到抽余油和抽出油；方式2：将所述中馏分引入溶剂抽提单元的溶剂抽提塔中与贫溶剂接触以进行抽提蒸馏，得到抽余油和抽出油；然后将所述抽余油与所述轻馏分引入碱洗单元以与其中的碱液接触而进行碱洗精制，得到脱硫醇后馏分；所述加氢处理包括：将所述脱硫处理的方式1或方式2中的抽出油与所述重馏分一起依次引入至包括含有加氢脱硫催化剂I的第一反应区和含有加氢脱硫催化剂II的第二反应区的加氢脱硫单元中进行加氢脱硫反应，并将所述加氢脱硫单元的产物依次进行气液分离和汽提，得到加氢后重馏分；所述混合处理包括：将所述脱硫处理的方式1中得到的抽余油或方式2中得到的脱硫醇后馏分与所述加氢处理中的加氢后重馏分混合以得到所述汽油产品。
content_en: The desulfurization treatment includes: performing desulfurization treatment in the following manner 1 or manner 2,Method 1: The light fraction is introduced into the alkaline washing unit to be contacted with the alkaline liquid to perform alkaline washing and refining to obtain a light distillate after desulfurization; then the middle distillate and the light distillate after desulfurization are introduced into a solvent for extraction The solvent extraction tower of the unit is contacted with the lean solvent to perform extraction distillation to obtain the residual oil and the extracted oil;Method 2: The middle distillate is introduced into a solvent extraction tower of a solvent extraction unit and is contacted with a lean solvent to perform extractive distillation to obtain a raffinate oil and a distillate oil; then the raffinate oil and the light distillate are introduced The alkaline washing unit is subjected to alkaline washing and refining by contacting with the alkaline solution therein to obtain a dethiolized fraction;The hydroprocessing includes: introducing the extracted oil in the method 1 or method 2 of the desulfurization treatment together with the heavy fraction into the first reaction zone including the hydrodesulfurization catalyst I and the hydrodesulfurization catalyst II Performing hydrodesulfurization in the hydrodesulfurization unit of the second reaction zone, and sequentially subjecting the products of the hydrodesulfurization unit to gas-liquid separation and stripping to obtain a heavy fraction after hydrogenation;The mixing treatment includes: mixing the after-purified oil fraction obtained in the method 1 of the desulfurization treatment or the dethiolized post-distillate obtained in the mode 2 with the post-hydrogenated heavy fraction in the hydroprocessing to obtain the gasoline product .

content_cn: 将1500g纯度为99.95％的铂粉均匀加在电解池槽体的底部，然后通过加料口向电解池的第一槽体内通入8mol/l的优级纯盐酸，当盐酸通过位于第二隔板上的溢流孔注满电解池的所有槽体后，停止加盐酸。电解池槽体的尺寸为190mm×60mm×300mm，第二隔板与顶盖之间具有20mm的空隙，溢流孔开在距离顶盖50mm的位置，直径为10mm。在同一槽体内的A、B电极两端加载80伏的民用交流电，交流电流大小在1-20安培之间，对电解池中的铂粉进行电解。其间，控制冷却水的流量，保持电解池中盐酸温度在80℃左右。电极选用光谱级Φ16mm、长度300mm的圆柱体石墨电极，共8根，固定在顶盖上，同一槽体内的A、B电极间距120mm。注意接电时只在同一槽体内的电极A、B间形成回路，不可在电极A、A间或电极B、B间形成回路。随着铂粉的电解，盐酸中的铂含量逐渐升高，持续电解5小时，盐酸中的铂含量达到75g/L，然后从电解池的进料口以57ml/min的速度继续通入盐酸，盐酸的通入速度使电解池中的盐酸中的铂含量维持在75g/L，此时会有溶有75g/L铂的盐酸溶液从出料口排出，经Φ100mm的溢流过滤装置过滤后收集入储罐，形成连续进盐酸原料，连续出含75g/L铂的盐酸溶液。然后视电解池槽体底部铂粉的剩余量从加料器补加入铂粉即可。从储罐中取1000ml溶液，蒸馏出过量盐酸和水，得到浓缩液，浓缩液中铂的含量为200g/l。将浓缩液放入结晶炉中，150℃，结晶8h，冷却后得到160g固体氯铂酸。
content_en: 1500g of platinum powder with a purity of 99.95% is uniformly added to the bottom of the electrolytic cell tank, and then 8mol/l of pure grade hydrochloric acid is introduced into the first tank of the electrolytic cell through the feeding port, and when the hydrochloric acid passes through the second partition After the upper overflow hole is filled in all the tanks of the electrolytic cell, the hydrochloric acid is stopped. The size of the electrolytic cell tank body is 190 mm × 60 mm × 300 mm, and there is a gap of 20 mm between the second partition plate and the top cover, and the overflow hole is opened at a position of 50 mm from the top cover, and the diameter is 10 mm.At the ends of the A and B electrodes in the same tank, 80 volts of civilian alternating current is applied, and the alternating current is between 1 and 20 amps to electrolyze the platinum powder in the electrolytic cell. In the meantime, the flow rate of the cooling water is controlled, and the temperature of the hydrochloric acid in the electrolytic cell is maintained at about 80 °C. The electrode is a cylindrical graphite electrode with a spectral level of Φ16mm and a length of 300mm. A total of 8 cylindrical graphite electrodes are fixed on the top cover. The distance between the A and B electrodes in the same tank is 120 mm. Note that only the circuits A and B in the same tank form a loop when the battery is connected, and no loop can be formed between the electrodes A and A or between the electrodes B and B.With the electrolysis of platinum powder, the platinum content in hydrochloric acid gradually increased, and the electrolysis was continued for 5 hours. The platinum content in hydrochloric acid reached 75 g/L, and then the hydrochloric acid was continuously introduced from the inlet of the electrolytic cell at a rate of 57 ml/min. The penetration rate of hydrochloric acid is such that the platinum content in the hydrochloric acid in the electrolytic cell is maintained at 75 g/L. At this time, a hydrochloric acid solution in which 75 g/L of platinum is dissolved is discharged from the discharge port, and is collected by filtration through a Φ100 mm overflow filtration device. Into the storage tank, a continuous hydrochloric acid raw material is formed, and a hydrochloric acid solution containing 75 g/L of platinum is continuously discharged. Then, depending on the remaining amount of platinum powder at the bottom of the electrolytic cell tank, the platinum powder may be added from the feeder.1000 ml of the solution was taken from the storage tank, and excess hydrochloric acid and water were distilled off to obtain a concentrate having a platinum content of 200 g/l. The concentrate was placed in a crystallization furnace, crystallized at 150 ° C for 8 h, and cooled to obtain 160 g of solid chloroplatinic acid.

content_cn: 一种洗衣机内筒，包括桶状的筒本体，在所述筒本体的内筒底部设置有至少一个贮水装置，洗涤液能从进水孔流入所述贮水装置、并从出水孔流出，所述出水孔与所述筒本体的内部相连通；其中，在所述筒本体的所述内筒底部形成向内凹陷的凹槽，所述凹槽与三脚架相适配；所述贮水装置由所述三脚架与所述凹槽之间的空间形成，或由所述凹槽中去除所述三脚架所占空间后剩余的空间与围挡形成；或，所述贮水装置为固定在所述内筒底部内侧面上的贮水盒；所述贮水盒上设置有至少一个进水孔和至少一个出水孔。特别是，所述三脚架的内部形成有能供水流动的空腔结构，在所述三脚架上设置有所述进水孔，在内筒的所述内筒底部上设置所述出水孔。特别是，在所述凹槽的外侧面上设置有至少一片所述围挡，所述围挡靠近所述内筒底部外侧的外边缘处、并遮挡住所述凹槽中去除所述三脚架所占空间后剩余的空间，所述围挡的四条边均为闭合边；在所述内筒底部上对应所述围挡的位置处设置有至少一个进水孔和至少一个出水孔。
content_en: An inner barrel of a washing machine includes a barrel-shaped barrel body, at least one water storage device is provided at the bottom of the inner barrel of the barrel body, and washing liquid can flow into the water storage device from the water inlet and out of the water outlet. The water outlet communicates with the interior of the barrel body; wherein, an inwardly concave groove is formed at the bottom of the inner barrel of the barrel body, the groove is adapted to a tripod; the water storage device It is formed by the space between the tripod and the groove, or the remaining space and the enclosure after the space occupied by the tripod is removed from the groove; or, the water storage device is fixed at the A water storage box on the inner side of the bottom of the inner cylinder; the water storage box is provided with at least one water inlet hole and at least one water outlet hole.In particular, a cavity structure capable of water supply flow is formed inside the tripod, the water inlet hole is provided on the tripod, and the water outlet hole is provided on the bottom of the inner cylinder of the inner cylinder.In particular, at least one piece of the enclosure is provided on the outer surface of the groove, the enclosure is located near the outer edge of the outer bottom of the inner cylinder, and covers the groove to remove the tripod In the remaining space after the space, all four sides of the enclosure are closed sides; at least one water inlet hole and at least one water outlet hole are provided on the bottom of the inner cylinder corresponding to the enclosure.

content_cn: 随着现有的经济水平日渐提高，用户对高效、高品质的健康生活需求越来越高，干衣机因其能够缩短晾衣时间，降低天气对干衣，尤其是潮湿天气对干衣的影响，而收到逐步增长的关注。在干衣机中提高进风量是增大干衣效率的重要途径，然而，目前市场上普遍仅在干衣机底部设置进风口。侧面由于必须满足国标中IPX1的防水要求等原因，通常不会开设相应的进风孔，导致干衣机可进风区域未得到充分利用，干衣机干衣效率仍有提升空间。
content_en: As the current economic level improves, users have higher and higher demands for efficient, high-quality and healthy life. Clothes dryers can shorten the drying time and reduce the impact of weather on dry clothes, especially wet weather on dry clothes. influence and received gradually growing attention.Increasing the air inlet volume in a clothes dryer is an important way to increase drying efficiency. However, currently on the market, it is common to only provide an air inlet at the bottom of the clothes dryer. Because the side must meet the waterproof requirements of IPX1 in the national standard, there are usually no corresponding air inlets. As a result, the air inlet area of the dryer is not fully utilized, and there is still room for improvement in the drying efficiency of the dryer.

content_cn: 为了提高该青提使用的便捷性，优选的，腔体1包括壳体，多个腔室设置在壳体内，多个腔室至少两个腔室之间和/或多个腔室中的至少一个与壳体内壁之间形成可拆卸的凸凹配合嵌设关系。进一步优选的，嵌设关系为过盈配合关系。便于腔室的拆卸，便于维修和清洁等操作。实现过个腔室的设计有多种，优选的，衣物处理装置包括壳体，多个腔室形成在壳体内，且壳体在多个腔室之间设有隔板2将多个腔室分隔成多个独立工作的腔室；且每相邻两个腔室之间的隔板2还在相邻两个腔室的嵌设区形成一可用于相邻两个腔室的功能区。通过隔板的作用，相邻两个腔体之间相互不通风，不过水，可以有效避免洗涤时相邻两个腔体之间相互污染。考虑到应用该腔体的装置的实际需求，优选的，功能区用作衣物处理剂投放室5。优选的，多个腔室的底面8向下凹陷形成一储水腔，储水腔的侧壁上进水口，储水腔的底面8设有排水口。进一步优选的，多个腔室的底面8均形成有向下突的弧面，底面8的中心位置为弧面的最低点，储水腔设置在底面8的中心位置。
content_en: In order to improve the ease of use of the green tea, preferably, the cavity 1 includes a shell, a plurality of chambers are arranged in the shell, and at least two of the plurality of chambers and/or at least one of the plurality of chambers A detachable convex-concave fitting embedded relationship is formed with the inner wall of the housing. Further preferably, the embedded relationship is an interference fit relationship. It is convenient for the disassembly of the chamber, and is convenient for maintenance and cleaning operations.There are many designs for realizing one chamber. Preferably, the clothes treatment device includes a housing, a plurality of chambers are formed in the housing, and the housing is provided with partitions 2 between the plurality of chambers. It is divided into a plurality of independently working chambers; and the partition plate 2 between every two adjacent chambers also forms a functional area for the two adjacent chambers in the embedded area of the two adjacent chambers. Through the effect of the partition, the two adjacent cavities are not ventilated to each other, but water is not used, which can effectively avoid mutual contamination between the two adjacent cavities during washing. Considering the actual requirements of the device using the cavity, preferably, the functional area is used as the laundry treatment agent injection chamber 5.Preferably, the bottom surface 8 of the multiple chambers is recessed downward to form a water storage cavity, the side wall of the water storage cavity has a water inlet, and the bottom surface 8 of the water storage cavity is provided with a drain port. More preferably, the bottom surfaces 8 of the plurality of chambers are all formed with downwardly protruding arc surfaces, the center position of the bottom surface 8 is the lowest point of the arc surface, and the water storage cavity is arranged at the center position of the bottom surface 8.

content_cn: 目前我们所使用的滚筒洗衣机一般都有加热管，洗衣机长时间使用后，在加热管上面会产生一定量水垢，水垢的产生会对加热管使用效率产生影响，水垢越多越影响电加热管对水的热传导，从而影响水工作温度的升高速度，造成电能浪费。而且加热管的热量如果传导不出来，加热管的表面负荷也会越来越高，由于热障冷缩的原理，加热管会产生爆管现象，从而缩短加热管的使用寿命。目前市场上对于家用电器，缺乏一种有效监测水垢生成的系统方案以及方法。
content_en: At present, the drum washing machines we use generally have heating tubes. After the washing machine is used for a long time, a certain amount of scale will be produced on the heating tube. The generation of scale will have an impact on the efficiency of the heating tube. The more scale, the more impact the electric heating tube will have on the heating tube. The heat conduction of water affects the rate of increase of water working temperature, resulting in a waste of electrical energy. Moreover, if the heat of the heating tube cannot be conducted out, the surface load of the heating tube will become higher and higher. Due to the principle of thermal barrier shrinkage, the heating tube will burst, thereby shortening the service life of the heating tube. Currently, there is a lack of a system solution and method for effectively monitoring scale generation for household appliances on the market.

content_cn: 为了实现上述目的，根据本发明的一个方面，提供了一种基于电机功率的脱水漂洗方法，基于电机功率的脱水漂洗方法在主洗完成后进行，基于电机功率的脱水漂洗方法包括：获取脱水漂洗指令，并进入脱水漂洗程序，脱水漂洗程序包括：控制排水组件启动；控制喷淋组件向洗涤装置的外筒洗涤腔喷水，并控制电机带动筒体转动，以对筒体内的衣物进行脱水；获取电机的功率；根据电机的功率选定与预设功率区间相匹配的子脱水漂洗程序；在不同的子脱水漂洗程序中，喷淋组件的运行时长、排水组件的运行时长、电机的转速中的至少一者不同。进一步地，在不同的子脱水漂洗程序中，预设功率区间的端点值越大，对应的电机的转速越小；和/或预设功率区间的端点值越大，对应的子脱水漂洗程序的运行时长越长。
content_en: In order to achieve the above object, according to one aspect of the present invention, there is provided a dehydration rinsing method based on motor power, the dehydration rinsing method based on motor power is performed after the main washing is completed, and the dehydration rinsing method based on motor power includes: obtaining dehydration rinsing command, and enter the dehydration rinsing procedure, the dehydration rinsing procedure includes: controlling the start of the drain assembly; controlling the spray assembly to spray water to the outer tub washing chamber of the washing device, and controlling the motor to drive the tub to rotate to dehydrate the clothes in the tub; Obtain the power of the motor; select the sub-dehydration and rinsing program that matches the preset power interval according to the power of the motor; in different sub-dehydration and rinsing programs, the running time of the spray component, the running time of the drainage component, and the speed of the motor are among the at least one of them is different.Further, in different sub-dehydration and rinsing programs, the larger the endpoint value of the preset power interval, the smaller the corresponding motor speed; and/or the larger the endpoint value of the preset power interval, the higher the corresponding sub-dehydration rinsing program. longer runtime.

content_cn: 现有的干衣机尤其是热泵干衣机，一方面在烘干运行中，其蒸发器上会粘附一些线屑，时间长了会影响干衣机的运行效率；另一方面热泵的干衣机能耗和冷凝效率也遇到了瓶颈，依靠整机密封性和制冷系统已经很难提高，需要另辟蹊径。关于线屑的清洗，申请号为200880114983.4的专利公开了一种用于清洁构件、特别是冷凝装置的蒸发器的方法和装置，将通过烘干潮湿衣物获得的且被收集在冷凝水盘中的冷凝水供给到设置在蒸发器上方的冲洗容器中，冷凝水在冲洗容器的出口侧突然打开而作为喷涌水分配到构件上，该专利中也提到利用加压的自来水分配到构件上，利用自来水的高压冲击力，加上特定的水流分配器，利用短时大流量的冲洗水流喷洒到构件表面，从而实现构件表面的清洗。这种清洗方式结构较为复杂，对于能耗和冷凝效率没有帮助，而且突然大流量冷却不利于热泵系统稳定运行。
content_en: The existing clothes dryer, especially the heat pump dryer, on the one hand, in the drying operation, some scraps will adhere to the evaporator, and the long time will affect the operating efficiency of the dryer; on the other hand, the heat pump is dry The energy consumption and condensation efficiency of the clothes machine have also encountered bottlenecks. It is difficult to improve the sealing performance and refrigeration system of the whole machine, and it is necessary to find another way.Regarding the cleaning of the swarf, the patent application No. 200880114983.4 discloses a method and apparatus for cleaning a component, in particular an evaporator of a condensing device, which is obtained by drying wet laundry and collected in a condensate pan. The condensed water is supplied to a rinsing container disposed above the evaporator, and the condensed water is suddenly opened at the outlet side of the rinsing container to be distributed as a gushing water to the member. The patent also mentions the use of pressurized tap water for dispensing onto the member, utilizing The high-pressure impact of tap water, combined with a specific water flow distributor, is sprayed onto the surface of the component with a short-time, large-flow flushing water flow to achieve cleaning of the component surface. This cleaning method is relatively complicated in structure, and does not contribute to energy consumption and condensation efficiency, and sudden large-flow cooling is not conducive to stable operation of the heat pump system.

content_cn: 现有的与衣物处理腔连通的风道包括向衣物处理腔内通入烘干风的第一风道和排出衣物处理腔内的烘干风的第二风道，第一风道作为上述的烘干风道，风道内可转动地设有能够改变第一风道出风方向和第二风道进风方向的换向板，换向板在第一位置时，第一风道具有一个出风方向，第二风道具有一个进风方向，换向板在第二位置时，第一风道具有另一个出风方向，第二风道具有另外一个进风方向，换向板无论是在第一位置还是在第二位置，换向板的两端分别与风道内壁抵接，例如，当换向板在第一位置时，第一风道的出风和第二风道的进风对换向板具有阻力、冲击换向板，若换向板的两端与风道内壁直接抵接，则会使得换向板出现晃动，不能保持在第一位置上，从而使得第一风道和第二风道之间相互漏风，导致第一风道内的烘干风的烘干温度降低，从而降低衣物处理腔对衣物的烘干效果。
content_en: The existing air duct connected to the clothing processing chamber includes a first air duct for introducing drying air into the clothing processing chamber and a second air duct for discharging the drying air in the clothing processing chamber. The first air duct serves as the above-mentioned drying air duct, and a reversing plate capable of changing the air outlet direction of the first air duct and the air inlet direction of the second air duct is rotatably provided in the air duct. When the reversing plate is in a first position, the first air duct has an air outlet direction, and the second air duct has an air inlet direction. When the reversing plate is in a second position, the first air duct has another air outlet direction, and the second air duct has another air inlet direction. Whether the reversing plate is in the first position or the second position, the two ends of the reversing plate are respectively in contact with the inner wall of the air duct. For example, when the reversing plate is in the first position, the air outlet of the first air duct and the air inlet of the second air duct have resistance to the reversing plate and impact the reversing plate. If the two ends of the reversing plate directly abut against the inner wall of the air duct, the reversing plate will shake and cannot be maintained in the first position, thereby causing air leakage between the first air duct and the second air duct, resulting in a decrease in the drying temperature of the drying air in the first air duct, thereby reducing the drying effect of the clothing processing chamber on the clothes.

content_cn: 上述控制方法中，由于单独脱水是对含有水分的湿衣物进行处理，因此会选择根据衣物的重量来确定脱水参数，而脱水过程中洗涤桶发生撞桶和偏心等不平衡现象时，常采用在洗涤桶内进一定量的水的方式实现桶的再平衡，而进水会拖慢衣物的脱水过程，因此需要合适的进水量来进行平衡修正，本发明提供的控制方法通过比较桶内的原始水位和衣物堆积高度对应的水位，选择适合于平衡修正的进水量，从而加快脱水过程。所述控制方法中使用高度传感装置以检测放置在洗涤桶中的衣物堆积高度，与高度传感装置可操作连接的电子控制单元处理来自高度传感装置并表征衣物堆积高度的信号，由此确定流入桶内的第二水位并控制进水，直到水位传感装置检测到已达到控制单元确定的第二水位。高度传感装置包括用于发射和接收作用于旋转转筒中衣物载荷的声波脉冲的装置。
content_en: In the above control method, since the separate dehydration is to process the wet clothes that contain moisture, the dehydration parameters will be determined according to the weight of the clothes. During the dehydration process, when the washing tub collides and eccentricity occurs, it is often used A certain amount of water is injected into the washing tub to realize the rebalance of the tub, and the water inflow will slow down the dehydration process of the clothes. Therefore, an appropriate amount of water is required to perform balance correction. The control method provided by the present invention compares the original The water level corresponds to the water level of the clothing accumulation height, and the water intake suitable for the balance correction is selected to speed up the dehydration process. In the control method, a height sensing device is used to detect the stacking height of the laundry placed in the washing tub, and an electronic control unit operatively connected to the height sensing device processes the signal from the height sensing device and characterizing the stacking height of the laundry, thereby Determine the second water level flowing into the barrel and control the water inflow until the water level sensing device detects that the second water level determined by the control unit has been reached. The height sensing device includes a device for transmitting and receiving sound wave pulses acting on the load of clothes in the rotating drum.

content_cn: 本发明进水阀的进水端设置在开口处，安装或拆卸进水管时无需拆卸箱体，非常方便。进水阀设置在安装部上，振动小，安装更稳固。所述进水管设置在箱体外部，进水管的粗细不受壁挂式洗衣机箱体内部空间的限制，可以选择大滚筒洗衣机或大波轮洗衣机通用的进水管，管径加大，进水时间缩短，由于是通用件，成本也降低了。通用进水管强度高，耐水压高，使用寿命长，产品质量升高。此外，进水端的端部与开口处于同一平面，不会凸出于箱体外部影响箱体的安装，也不影响美观和运输。
content_en: The water inlet end of the water inlet valve of the present invention is arranged at the opening, and the box body does not need to be disassembled when the water inlet pipe is installed or disassembled, which is very convenient. The water inlet valve is set on the installation part, with less vibration and more stable installation. The water inlet pipe is arranged outside the cabinet, and the thickness of the water inlet pipe is not limited by the internal space of the wall-mounted washing machine cabinet. The water inlet pipe commonly used for large drum washing machines or large pulsator washing machines can be selected. The pipe diameter is enlarged and the water intake time is shortened. Because it is a common part, the cost is also reduced. The universal inlet pipe has high strength, high water pressure resistance, long service life, and improved product quality. In addition, the end of the water inlet and the opening are in the same plane, and will not protrude from the outside of the box and affect the installation of the box, nor will it affect the appearance and transportation.

content_cn: 随着人们生活水平的不断提高，人们对生活品质及美好生活的不断追逐，滚筒洗衣机的洗涤功能越来越受到人们的关注。那么相应而生的各类洗涤程序逐渐被应用进来、针对性的智能洗涤程序越来越被消费者所青睐，如快洗、超快洗是指用较短洗涤时间(大约30分钟以内)洗涤完少量当日穿着衣物(1-2kg)，以满足人们日益加快的生活节奏及生活品质；羊毛洗涤是指针对人们平时身上所穿的羊毛程序进行相应的洗涤；被毯洗指的是针对日常生活中的大件衣物进行洗涤；童装是对家里儿童衣物进行分类洗涤，从而加快洗涤时间和提高洗涤效果等等。那么如何能够发扬滚筒洗衣机的传统洗涤优势，又避免程序分类导致洗涤效果欠佳的窘境问题呢？当前各类滚筒洗衣机的程序分类中只关注了怎样细致的分类，如何将衣物洗的更快，洗的更干净，当今社会各种高档衣物层出不穷，那么针对这种高档衣物如果还是延用之前的洗涤程序，势必会造成衣物洗涤效果欠佳甚至材质损坏；那么针对这种不能进行水洗的高档衣物如何进行洗涤呢？因此如何实现洗衣机自动识别衣物材质并进行判断分类；从而选择相应的清洗程序是今后洗衣机发展的方向。
content_en: With the continuous improvement of people's living standards and people's pursuit of quality of life and good life, the washing function of the drum washing machine has attracted more and more attention. Then the corresponding various washing programs are gradually applied, and the targeted intelligent washing program is more and more favored by consumers. For example, quick washing and ultra-fast washing means washing with a shorter washing time (within about 30 minutes). A small amount of clothing (1-2kg) was worn on the same day to meet people's accelerating life rhythm and quality of life; wool washing refers to the washing of the wool program worn by people on their own; the blanket washing refers to daily life. The large-sized clothes are washed; the children's clothes are used to sort and wash children's clothes at home, thereby speeding up the washing time and improving the washing effect. So how can we carry forward the traditional washing advantages of the drum washing machine, and avoid the dilemma of the poor classification of washing results? At present, the program classification of various types of drum washing machines only pays attention to how to classify carefully. How to wash clothes faster and wash more cleanly. Nowadays, various high-end clothes are emerging in an endless stream. The washing process will inevitably result in poor laundry and even material damage. How do you wash the high-grade clothes that cannot be washed? Therefore, how to realize the automatic recognition of the material of the washing machine and judge the classification; thus selecting the corresponding cleaning program is the direction of the development of the washing machine in the future.

content_cn: 为解决上述问题，本发明提供一种干冰洗衣机，所述洗衣机不再利用水和洗涤剂等助剂对衣物进行洗涤，而是利用干冰对衣物进行洗涤。干冰清洗是以压缩气体作为动力和载体，以干冰颗粒为被加速的粒子，加速后被喷射到被清洗物体表面，利用高速运动的固体干冰颗粒的动量变化、升华、熔化等能量转换，使被清洗物体表面的污垢、油污、残留杂质等迅速冷冻，从而凝结、脆化、被剥离，且可同时随气流清除，清洗过程包括：低温冷冻剥离，-78.5℃的干冰颗粒作用在被清洗的物体表面时，首先冷冻脆化污物，污物在被清洗的表面上破裂，由粘弹态变成固态，且脆性增大，粘性减小，使之在表面上的吸附力骤减，同时表面积增大，部分污物可以自动剥离；吹扫剥离，在压缩气体作为动力的环境下，干冰颗粒状态变化体积膨胀，这样在冲击点造成“微型爆炸”，将污垢层吹扫剥离，具体的，干冰状态变化时对脆化了的污物产生剪切力，引起机械断裂，由于污物与被清洗物表面低温收缩比差很大，在接触面处产生应力集中现象，污物在剪切力作用下剥离；冲击剥离，高速的干冰颗粒碰撞到增大了的污物表面时，将上述动能传递给污物，克服已经减小了的粘附力，因此而产生的剪切力使污物随气流卷走，达到了脱除污物的目的。前述干冰清洗的主要原理相应的可以粗略地理解为，通过压缩气体的流动，干冰颗粒被加速到接近音速的速度撞击被清洗的表面污垢，表面污垢突然降温导致表面脆化，同时造成这些温度极低的含有干冰颗粒的压缩气体进入出现裂缝的污染物内；当表面的污垢遭到撞击时，干冰颗粒迅速升华为气体，这里气体所产生的能量大约是原能量的700倍，从而这些碎裂的污染物从物体的表面被剥离移走。
content_en: In order to solve the above problems, the present invention provides a dry ice washing machine, which no longer uses water and detergents and other auxiliary agents to wash clothes, but uses dry ice to wash clothes. Dry ice cleaning uses compressed gas as power and carrier, and uses dry ice particles as accelerated particles. After acceleration, they are sprayed onto the surface of the object to be cleaned. The energy conversion such as momentum change, sublimation, and melting of solid dry ice particles moving at high speed is used to make the object to be cleaned. The dirt, oil, and residual impurities on the surface of the cleaned object are quickly frozen, so as to condense, embrittle, and peel off, and can be removed with the airflow at the same time. The cleaning process includes: low-temperature freezing and peeling, and -78.5 ℃ dry ice particles act on the object to be cleaned. When it is on the surface, it first freezes and embrittles the dirt, and the dirt breaks on the surface to be cleaned, from viscoelastic state to solid state, and the brittleness increases and the viscosity decreases, so that the adsorption force on the surface decreases sharply, and the surface area is reduced. Increase, part of the dirt can be automatically peeled off; purging and peeling, in the environment of compressed gas as power, the state of dry ice particles changes and expands in volume, which causes a "micro-explosion" at the impact point, and the dirt layer is purged and peeled off. Specifically, When the state of dry ice changes, shear force is generated on the embrittled dirt, causing mechanical fracture. Due to the large difference in low temperature shrinkage ratio between the dirt and the surface of the cleaned object, stress concentration occurs at the contact surface, and the dirt is in the shear force. Under the action of peeling; impact peeling, when the high-speed dry ice particles collide with the increased dirt surface, the above kinetic energy is transferred to the dirt to overcome the reduced adhesion force, and the resulting shear force makes the dirt It is swept away with the airflow to achieve the purpose of removing dirt. The main principle of the aforementioned dry ice cleaning can be roughly understood as follows: through the flow of compressed gas, the dry ice particles are accelerated to a speed close to the speed of sound to hit the cleaned surface dirt, and the surface dirt suddenly cools down, causing the surface to become embrittled, and at the same time cause these extreme temperatures. Low compressed gas containing dry ice particles enters the contaminants where the cracks appear; when the surface dirt is hit, the dry ice particles rapidly sublime into gas, where the energy generated by the gas is about 700 times the original energy, so that these fragments The contaminants are removed from the surface of the object.

content_cn: 本实用新型提供一种分区干衣机，该分区干衣机包括干衣机主体和分区支架，通过将分区支架设置在烘干腔内，使得多个分隔板将烘干腔分为多个烘干室，以能够将不同颜色、不同材质或不同负载的衣物分别放置在不同的烘干室内，避免在烘干过程中，衣物串色；以及使得在较小负载的衣物或易烘干材质的衣物在烘干完成后能够先取出，避免烘干过度导致损坏和浪费能源，提高烘干效率，节省能源。并在烘干过程中，每个烘干室的热气流能够流通，避免不同的烘干室出现较大的温度差影响烘干效率，即整个烘干腔内的热气流循环流通，使得烘干腔内的温度分布均匀；同时，设置有通风孔的分隔板对烘干腔内热气流起到了扰流作用，使得热气流的流速更快，对烘干腔的覆盖范围更全面，避免出现气流死角等，提高了整体的烘干效率。且当无需分区烘干时，能够将分区支架从烘干腔内拆下，提高用户的烘干体验。
content_en: The utility model provides a partitioned clothes dryer. The partitioned clothes dryer comprises a clothes dryer main body and a partitioned bracket. By arranging the partitioned bracket in a drying cavity, a plurality of partition plates divide the drying cavity into a plurality of partitions. Drying room, so that clothes of different colors, different materials or different loads can be placed in different drying chambers, to avoid the color of the clothes during the drying process; After drying, the clothes can be taken out first, avoiding damage and waste of energy caused by excessive drying, improving drying efficiency and saving energy. And during the drying process, the hot air flow in each drying chamber can circulate to avoid the large temperature difference in different drying chambers affecting the drying efficiency, that is, the hot air circulation in the entire drying chamber makes the drying The temperature distribution in the cavity is uniform; at the same time, the partition plate with ventilation holes plays a turbulent role in the hot air flow in the drying cavity, which makes the hot air flow faster and covers the drying cavity more comprehensively, avoiding the occurrence of air flow. Dead corners, etc., improve the overall drying efficiency. And when there is no need for partition drying, the partition bracket can be removed from the drying cavity to improve the drying experience of the user.
