content_cn: 现有技术中，为了提高对衣物的洗涤效果，可以采用雾化喷淋的清洗方式，例如申请号为200520134107.1的专利文献中公开了一种洗衣机的雾化喷淋装置，其包括进水盖、流道芯和喷嘴盖，进水盖与喷嘴盖相互盖合，流道芯位于进水盖和喷嘴盖之间，通过流道芯可以将从进水盖上的进水口进入的水以切线方向压入喷嘴盖上的喷嘴，然后从喷嘴喷出，达到雾化喷淋的效果，这种雾化喷淋是使水形成细微的水珠来对衣物进行清洗，细微的水珠仍是大颗粒的液滴，其比较适用于漂洗和脱水阶段将衣物上残留的洗涤剂冲洗掉，然而在洗衣的初始阶段(即洗涤之前或者洗涤刚开始)，如果直接注水或者直接喷淋都会使衣物表面上的污渍在洗涤液未完全溶解的状态下直接进入到衣物的衬里，从而在后续的洗涤过程中需要更多的时间、水量、洗涤液和机械作用才能够将衣物清洗干净，导致洗涤效果不佳。在这种情形下，可以采用雾化发生器来对衣物进行浸湿，即雾化发生器产生的水雾(其颗粒尺寸远小于喷淋的水珠尺寸)先润湿衣物，使得衣物表面上的污渍先被去除掉，避免衣物表面的污渍进入到衣物的衬里，从而在后续的洗涤过程中能够通过较少的时间、水量、洗涤液和机械作用就能够将衣物清洗干净，提高对衣物的洗涤效果。以现有技术中滚筒洗衣机上的雾化装置为例，雾化装置可以采用一体式结构，采用一体式结构是将雾化发生器固定在壳体内，然后再将壳体安装在窗垫上，这种结构不仅不便于雾化发生器的拆装，而且增加了生产制造成本，尤其在雾化装置损坏时需要将雾化发生器连带壳体一起进行更换，因此，现有的雾化装置多采用分体式结构，以便对雾化发生器进行拆装和更换，然而，采用分体式结构一般是将雾化发生器夹置在两个模块之间，然后将两个模块都固定于窗垫上，但是，洗衣机在运行时会发生振动，从而易导致两个模块发生位置偏移甚至完全分离，这样会影响雾化装置的密封性，从而易导致外筒中的水直接浸染雾化发生器，甚至发生短路现象，造成安全事故。
content_en: In the prior art, in order to improve the washing effect on clothes, an atomizing spray cleaning method may be adopted. For example, patent application No. 200520134107.1 discloses a spray atomizing device for a washing machine, which includes a water inlet cover, The runner core and the nozzle cover, the water inlet cover and the nozzle cover are mutually closed, the runner core is located between the water inlet cover and the nozzle cover, and the water entering from the water inlet on the water inlet cover can be cut in a tangential direction through the runner core. Press into the nozzle on the nozzle cover, and then spray from the nozzle to achieve the effect of atomizing spray. This atomizing spray is to make the water form fine water droplets to wash the clothes. The fine water droplets are still large particles. Liquid droplets, which are more suitable for rinsing and dehydrating the remaining detergent on the laundry. However, in the initial stage of washing (that is, before washing or just after washing), if direct water injection or direct spraying will make the surface of the laundry In the state where the washing liquid is not completely dissolved, the stains directly enter the lining of the clothes, so it needs more time, water, washing liquid and mechanical action to wash the clothes in the subsequent washing process. The objects are cleaned, resulting in poor washing results. In this case, the mist generator can be used to soak the clothes, that is, the water mist generated by the mist generator (the particle size of which is much smaller than the size of the sprayed water droplets) wets the clothes first, so that the surface of the clothes The stains are removed first to prevent the stains on the surface of the clothes from entering the lining of the clothes, so that in the subsequent washing process, the clothes can be cleaned with less time, water, washing liquid and mechanical action, improving the clothes's Washing effect. Taking the atomization device on the drum washing machine in the prior art as an example, the atomization device may adopt an integrated structure. The integrated structure is to fix the atomization generator in the casing, and then install the casing on the window pad. This structure is not only inconvenient for disassembly and assembly of the atomization generator, but also increases the production cost. Especially when the atomization device is damaged, the atomization generator needs to be replaced together with the casing. Therefore, the existing atomization devices are often used. Split structure to disassemble and replace the atomizer. However, the split structure is generally used to sandwich the atomizer between two modules and then fix both modules on the window mat. The washing machine will vibrate during operation, which will easily cause the two modules to shift or even completely separate, which will affect the sealing of the atomization device, which will easily cause the water in the outer cylinder to directly impregnate the atomization generator, or even cause a short circuit. Phenomenon, causing safety accidents.

content_cn: 然而上述油管保护器及其井口压裂装置仅适用于连续油管的安装布置，连续油管能够从井筒中直接穿过井口、阀门以及保护器延伸至井外进行连续作业，然而对于常规油井中所用的多段连接式常规油管，由于井口需要对常规油管进行固定，因此井口设置的四通阀通常为顶端设有连接结构如固定套环或悬挂器，以使多段拼接的油管能够连接固定，因此常规油管无法伸出井口进行布置，上述油管保护器无法使用，若在井口四通阀上使用压裂装置，则会使压裂液直接进入油管中，无法实现环空压裂，影响油管的正常抽油作业。
content_en: However, the above-mentioned tubing protector and its wellhead fracturing device are only suitable for the installation and arrangement of continuous tubing. The continuous tubing can extend from the wellbore directly through the wellhead, valve and protector to the outside of the well for continuous operation. However, for the multi-section connected conventional tubing used in conventional oil wells, since the wellhead needs to fix the conventional tubing, the four-way valve installed at the wellhead usually has a connecting structure such as a fixed collar or a hanger at the top to enable the multi-section spliced tubing to be connected and fixed. Therefore, the conventional tubing cannot extend out of the wellhead for arrangement, and the above-mentioned tubing protector cannot be used. If a fracturing device is used on the wellhead four-way valve, the fracturing fluid will directly enter the tubing, and the annulus fracturing cannot be achieved, which affects the normal oil pumping operation of the tubing.

content_cn: 在一个实施例中，所述节流器还包括设置在所述筒状主体上方的双向卡定弹片，在所述双向卡定弹片上构造有径向向外延伸的引导凸齿和与所述引导凸齿间隔开地位于所述引导凸齿之上的承载凸齿，所述双向卡定弹片在所述引导凸齿嵌入到外层工作筒的相应的引导凹槽内时径向向外地撑开，使所述承载凸齿嵌入到所述外层工作筒的相应的承载凹槽内，所述承载凸齿能在纵向向上和纵向向下的方向上与所述承载凹槽卡定，所述双向卡定弹片还构造为在打捞工具向下推动所述内套筒至所述胶筒解封之后与所述外层工作筒分离开。根据本发明的另一方面，提出了一种与上述节流器相匹配的外层工作筒，在所述外层工作筒的内表面上构造有相应的引导凹槽和承载凹槽，在外层油管的不同深度处设置不同的外层工作筒，不同的外层工作筒具有不同的引导凹槽和承载凹槽，所述节流器在下入到所述引导凸齿和所述承载凸齿分别与引导凹槽和承载凹槽相对应的深度时进行坐挂，所述外层油管为全通径油管，所述引导凹槽和所述承载凹槽构造为耐冲蚀合金件。
content_en: In one embodiment, the restrictor further includes a bidirectional locking elastic piece arranged above the cylindrical body, and a guide protruding tooth extending radially outward is configured on the bidirectional locking elastic piece and the The guide protruding teeth are spaced apart on the bearing protruding teeth above the guide protruding teeth, and the two-way locking elastic pieces are supported radially outward when the guide protruding teeth are embedded in the corresponding guide grooves of the outer working cylinder So that the carrying protruding teeth are embedded in the corresponding carrying grooves of the outer working cylinder, and the carrying protruding teeth can be locked with the carrying grooves in the longitudinal upward and longitudinal downward directions, so The two-way locking elastic piece is also configured to be separated from the outer working cylinder after the fishing tool pushes down the inner sleeve until the rubber cylinder is unsealed.According to another aspect of the present invention, an outer working cylinder matched with the above-mentioned restrictor is provided. The inner surface of the outer working cylinder is configured with corresponding guide grooves and bearing grooves, and Different outer working cylinders are arranged at different depths of the tubing, and different outer working cylinders have different guiding grooves and load-bearing grooves, and the throttle is lowered into the guide convex teeth and the bearing convex teeth respectively The setting is performed at a depth corresponding to the guide groove and the load-bearing groove, the outer oil pipe is a full-diameter oil pipe, and the guide groove and the load-bearing groove are constructed as erosion-resistant alloy parts.

content_cn: 为此，根据本实用新型，提出了一种调流控水装置，包括：设置在井筒中的调流控水基管；若干设置在井筒中的水平段的调流控水单元，所述调流控水单元包括：间隔开设置在所述调流控水基管上的第一密封外筒和第二密封外筒；设置在所述调流控水基管上且处于所述第一密封外筒和第二密封外筒之间的封隔器；以及设置在所述调流控水基管内且处于所述第二密封外筒下游的调流控水筛管；用于打压坐封所述封隔器的辅助工具，所述辅助工具包括：同心设置在所述调流控水基管中的打压作业管柱；以及间隔开设置在所述打压作业管柱尾端的第一内密封件和第二内密封件；其中，所述第一内密封件和第二内密封件能够分别与所述调流控水单元中的所述第一密封外筒和第二密封外筒形成密封配合，从而在对应的所述调流控水单元中形成用于容纳流体以坐封对应的所述封隔器的密封空间。
content_en: To this end, according to the present invention, a flow control water control device is proposed, comprising: a flow regulating water control pipe disposed in the wellbore; and a plurality of flow regulating water control units disposed in the horizontal section of the wellbore, the adjusting The flow control water unit comprises: a first sealed outer cylinder and a second sealed outer cylinder disposed on the flow regulating water base pipe; disposed on the flow regulating water base pipe and in the first seal a packer between the outer cylinder and the second sealed outer cylinder; and a flow regulating water screen disposed in the flow regulating water base pipe and downstream of the second sealed outer cylinder; The auxiliary tool of the packer, comprising: a pressing working pipe column concentrically disposed in the flow regulating water base pipe; and a first inner sealing member disposed at a rear end of the pressing working pipe column And a second inner seal; wherein the first inner seal and the second inner seal are respectively capable of forming a sealing fit with the first sealed outer cylinder and the second sealed outer cylinder in the flow regulating water control unit Thereby forming a fluid for accommodating the fluid in the corresponding flow control water control unit Sealing the sealed space corresponding packer.

content_cn: 随着超深井的增多，大尺寸套管、非标套管的使用逐渐增多，对防喷器型号和规格要求日益提高。例如，一些常见井口安装的FZ35-70防喷器组合，这种FZ35-70防喷器组合的内通径为Ф346.1mm，其套管头内腔直径为Ф420mm，下入Ф365.1mm套管，井口机构的通径呈“上小下大”的状态。受防喷器内通径限制，堵头最大只能下入直径Ф346.1mm的堵头，其外径小于套管头内径，无法形成密封，不满足试压要求。对于这种情况，现场一般采取分段试压的方式，将整套防喷器组合吊起，下入试压堵头后再安装防喷器，对套管头以上部件进行试压，试压完毕再拆开井口机构，取出堵头。这方法不仅操作复杂，而且对防喷器与套管头的连接处无法试压，井筒的完整性无法保证，尤其是对于井控风险较高的高压油气井，无法满足试压要求。
content_en: With the increase in ultra-deep wells, the use of large-size casing and non-standard casing is gradually increasing, and the requirements for BOP models and specifications are increasing day by day. For example, some common wellhead-installed FZ35-70 blowout preventer combinations have an inner diameter of Ф346.1mm, and the inner diameter of the casing head is Ф420mm, and the casing is run into Ф365.1mm. , the diameter of the wellhead mechanism is "small at the top and large at the bottom". Due to the limitation of the inner diameter of the blowout preventer, the plug can only be inserted with a maximum diameter of Ф346.1mm. Its outer diameter is smaller than the inner diameter of the casing head, so it cannot form a seal and does not meet the pressure test requirements. For this situation, the on-site pressure test method is generally adopted in sections. The entire set of blowout preventer assembly is lifted, the pressure test plug is lowered, and then the blowout preventer is installed. The pressure test is performed on the components above the casing head. The pressure test is completed. Then disassemble the wellhead mechanism and take out the plug. This method is not only complicated to operate, but also cannot test the pressure at the connection between the blowout preventer and the casing head, and the integrity of the wellbore cannot be guaranteed. Especially for high-pressure oil and gas wells with high well control risks, it cannot meet the pressure test requirements.

content_cn: 调剖球在井筒中的沉降、径向平移以及吸附于炮眼等动作是一系列复杂的过程，受到井筒、调堵球、流体等参数的影响，目前投球调剖技术在投球选择性封堵高渗层、吸附稳定性等方面缺少相应的深入研究和配套工艺作为支持，致使投球进入井筒后失去了人为对投球的控制和干涉的理论支撑，导致投球施工成功率低、有效期短等问题。通过可视化投球调堵模拟装置实现地面上可视化观察调堵球在井筒运移、吸附、脱附现象。模拟不同井况、不同渗透性储层、不同球水密度差、高中低渗相对位置、喇叭口不同位置等条件下调堵球的运移、吸附、脱附过程，可实现地面观察以及压力、流量实时监控来判断投球封堵效果，为实施投球调剖工艺提供必要的理论及实验基础依据。
content_en: The actions of the profile control ball in the wellbore, such as settlement, radial translation, and adsorption in the blasthole are a series of complex processes, which are affected by parameters such as the wellbore, plugging balls, and fluid. The lack of corresponding in-depth research and supporting technology in terms of seepage layer, adsorption stability, etc., resulted in the loss of artificial control and theoretical support of the ball pitch after it entered the wellbore, resulting in low pitch construction success rate and short validity period. Through the visual ball-throwing and plugging-adjustment simulation device, the movement, adsorption and desorption of plugging-adjusting balls in the wellbore can be visually observed on the ground. Simulate different well conditions, different permeability reservoirs, different ball water density differences, relative positions of high, medium and low permeability, and different positions of the bell mouth to adjust the migration, adsorption, and desorption processes of plugging balls, which can realize ground observation and pressure and flow rate. Real-time monitoring is used to judge the effect of pitching and blocking, which provides the necessary theoretical and experimental basis for the implementation of pitching profile control technology.

content_cn: 为了达成上述另一目的，本发明采用了如下技术方案，同心双层连续油管拖动喷射泵水平井负压排砂方法，其步骤为，地面准备泵车、罐车和连续油管作业车，油井套管内通过连续油管作业车下入由小径连续油管和大径连续油管组成的同心双层连续油管，同心双层连续油管在地面上方位置安装有防喷器，同心双层连续油管下依次接扶正器、喷射泵和导向扶正器；在地面通过泵车将罐车里液体高压注入小径连续油管的进口，进入喷射泵内，继而高速喷出冲刷附近油层的砂砾，同时因在喷射泵喷出高速高压流体在喷射泵喷嘴附近形成负压区域，将周围混有砂砾的液体吸入，进入同心双层连续油管的环空，到达地面通过环空排出器出口排出，经过滤砂网后进入罐车循环使用，经过至少一次的冲刷清洗喷射泵喷嘴附近油层段，实现该油层段排砂解堵。
content_en: In order to achieve the above other object, the present invention adopts the following technical scheme: a concentric double-layer continuous oil pipe drag jet pump horizontal well negative pressure sand discharging method, the steps are: preparing a pump truck, a tank truck and a coiled tubing operation vehicle, and a well casing A concentric double-layer coiled tubing consisting of a small-diameter coiled tubing and a large-diameter coiled tubing is inserted into the tube through a coiled tubing operation vehicle. Concentric double-layer coiled tubing is installed with a blowout preventer at a position above the ground, and a concentric double-layer coiled tubing is sequentially connected to the centralizer. The jet pump and the guiding centralizer; the high pressure of the liquid in the tank is injected into the inlet of the small-diameter coiled tubing through the pump truck on the ground, enters the jet pump, and then the high-speed jet blasts the gravel of the nearby oil layer, and at the same time, the high-speed high-pressure fluid is ejected by the jet pump. A negative pressure region is formed near the nozzle of the jet pump, and the liquid mixed with the gravel is sucked into the annulus of the concentric double-layer coiled tubing, and reaches the ground and is discharged through the outlet of the annulus ejector. After filtering the sand net, it enters the tanker for recycling. At least one time flushing and cleaning the oil layer section near the nozzle of the jet pump to realize sand discharge and plugging of the oil layer section.

content_cn: 本发明实施例的目的是提供一种用于建筑物的抗爆升级改造方法及系统，用于实现对建筑物进行升级改造，以提高建筑物抗爆能力，降低安全风险。为了实现上述目的，本发明实施例提供一种用于建筑物的抗爆升级改造方法，所述方法包括：获取所述建筑物的目标抗爆设防值；检测所述建筑物的强度，其中所述强度包括混凝土结构以及砂浆的抗压强度、钢筋抗拉强度、和砖墙的抗剪强度；将与所述目标抗爆设防值对应的爆炸冲击波作用于所述建筑物的模拟建筑物；根据所述建筑物的所述强度计算所述模拟建筑物在经历所述爆炸冲击波作用之后结构构件的延性比或支座转角；以及在所述结构的延性比大于延性比阈值或支座转角大于支座转角阈值的情况下，将所述结构确定为所述建筑物的薄弱点，从而针对所述薄弱点进行抗爆升级改造。
content_en: The purpose of the embodiments of the present invention is to provide a method and system for anti-explosion upgrading and transformation of buildings, which are used to realize the upgrading and transformation of buildings, so as to improve the anti-explosion capability of buildings and reduce safety risks.In order to achieve the above object, an embodiment of the present invention provides an anti-explosion upgrade and renovation method for a building, the method includes: acquiring a target anti-explosion fortification value of the building; detecting the strength of the building, wherein all The strength includes the compressive strength of concrete structures and mortar, the tensile strength of steel bars, and the shear strength of brick walls; the explosion shock wave corresponding to the target explosion-proof fortification value acts on the simulated building of the building; according to the strength of the building is calculated the ductility ratio of the structural member or the bearing rotation angle of the simulated building after experiencing the blast shock wave; and the ductility ratio of the structure is greater than the ductility ratio threshold or the bearing rotation angle is greater than the bearing rotation angle In the case of the threshold of the seat rotation angle, the structure is determined as the weak point of the building, so that the anti-explosion upgrade is carried out for the weak point.

content_cn: 具体来说，专利号为CN 200820061767.5的专利公开了一种新型的可变径膨胀工具，该发明的可变径膨胀工具是由锥体、爪盘和连杆组成。锥体由3个上膨胀块和3个下膨胀块组成，膨胀块在周向上呈间隔120度中心对称分布，且周向错开呈间隔120度中心对称分布；6个膨胀块各有一个爪子，爪子与膨胀块是连在一体的；上下有两个爪盘，爪盘的中心孔连接连杆，爪盘凹槽连接膨胀块上的爪子；连杆下部嵌入下爪盘，上部穿入上爪盘中心孔，协调两个爪盘之间的动作。该工具采用液压和机械两种动力，但不能实现连续变径。
content_en: Specifically, disclose a kind of novel reducing bloat tool but the patent No. is the patent of CN 200820061767.5, but the reducing bloat tool of this invention is made up of cone, pawl dish and connecting rod.Cone goes up expanding block by 3 and 3 following expanding blocks are formed, and 120 degree centers are symmetrically distributed expanding block upwards being in week at interval, and circumferentially staggers and be 120 degree centers symmetrical distribution at interval; 6 expanding blocks respectively have a claw, and claw and expanding block are connected in one; Two pawl dishes are arranged up and down, and the centre bore of pawl dish connects connecting rod, and pawl dish groove connects the claw on the expanding block; The connecting rod bottom embeds the lower claw dish, and top penetrates the dewclaw center hole, coordinates the action between two pawl dishes.This instrument adopts two kinds of power of hydraulic pressure and machinery, but can not realize continuous reducing.

content_cn: 本实用新型结构由6m3沉砂池、液气砂分离工作筒总成（内有绕自身轴线旋转的转子）、进口观察阀门、挡砂隔板、溢液管、抽插式挡板、排液循环阀门、灌液阀门、清砂口等组成。6m3沉砂池成水平状态固定于作业施工现场12方循环池（作业现场必须配备的铁池子，用来盛修井液体。）上部，并焊接在一起，液气砂分离工作筒总成安装在6方沉砂池上部位置，溢液管焊接在挡砂板一侧的排液循环阀门处，抽插式挡板安装在挡砂隔板靠近池子底部，清砂口安装在沉砂池侧面，并由螺栓固定的挡板密封。将套管出口返出的液体通过液气砂分离工作筒总成进口管线引入，利用液体的动能，带动内部转子快速旋转，借用密度不同离心力不同的原理，将液气砂快速分离；未分离的粉细砂在通过挡砂隔板时，被遮挡沉淀，控制砂子再次进入井筒内；溢液管可以将沉砂池内的液面保持在一定高度，以保证随液体带出来的砂子等颗粒物质沉淀；进口观察阀门用来观察返出液内含砂量；抽插式挡板可以把沉砂池内的液体释放到挡砂隔板外侧，通过排液阀门进入12方循环池内；清砂口用来人力操作清砂平推装入运沙车内；灌液阀门利用沉砂灌与井口大四通的高度差来实现控制灌液，以保持井内液面高度，保证压力平衡。该装置于现有应用装置具有液气砂分离速度快、原理简单、使用操作方便、清砂彻底、操作强度有效降低，提高施工质量的特点。同时因为装置中有液气砂分离工作筒总成装置，因此可以用来洗井、混排、脱气等，适应性强。

content_cn: 本实用新型的目的是这样实现的：泵上油管、抽油泵连接后下入套管内，油层与套管相通，抽油泵处于动液面之下，抽油泵之下连接加长尾管，加长尾管之下安装抽油泵吸入口，抽油泵吸入口处于油层之下。本实用新型的有益效果是：含水井液从油层流到套管内后向下流到抽油泵吸入口才被抽油泵抽出，含水井液向下流动时，会产生油水分离，油层至动液面这段套管内充满了原油，使这段套管不会被腐蚀，从而达到防止套管腐蚀的目的，因此，本实用新型可以延长套管的使用寿命，提高油田开发效益，具有显著的经济效益。
content_en: The purpose of this utility model is achieved in that oil pipe on pump, oil well pump are lowered in sleeve pipe after connecting, oil reservoir communicates with sleeve pipe, and oil well pump is under producing fluid level, connects under oil well pump to lengthen tail pipe, lengthen the oil well pump intake is installed under tail pipe, the oil well pump intake is under oil reservoir.The beneficial effects of the utility model are: contain well liquid and flow to from oil reservoir and flow to oil well pump under backward in sleeve pipe and suck eloquence and extracted out by oil well pump, when containing well liquid and flowing downward, can produce water-oil separating, oil reservoir has been full of crude oil to this section of producing fluid level sleeve pipe, this section sleeve pipe can be corroded, thereby reaches the purpose that prevents casing corrosion, therefore, the utility model can extend the application life of sleeve pipe, improves the oil field development benefit, has significant economic benefit.

content_cn: 相对于现有技术，本实用新型取得了以下有益效果：将组合式打捞接头的打捞头母螺纹与未落井钻杆最下端的钻杆公螺纹旋接，落井钻杆上端的母螺纹开裂胀扣后，若钻杆母螺纹还比较完整，可以充分利用原有的钻杆母螺纹，直接将打捞头的打捞头公螺纹拧入落井钻杆的钻杆母螺纹中使两者结合；若原有的钻杆母螺纹损坏比较严重，则利用最下端的锥形螺纹在落井钻杆的内壁进行攻丝造扣，直接将打捞接头的锥形螺纹拧在落井钻杆的内壁上使两者结合，打捞接头与落井钻杆结合后就能被提上地面；在打捞过程中打捞接头的中心的通孔可以保证泥浆循环的连续，一旦钻杆被卡住后可以为后续作业创造有利条件；打捞头公螺纹和锥形螺纹共同作用可以承受较大的拉力，防止钻杆在提升过程中二次落井。
content_en: With respect to prior art, the utility model has been obtained following beneficial effect: fishing head box thread and the well drilling rod drilling rod male thread bottom that do not fall of Combined fishing joint are spun, fall after the swollen button of box thread cracking of well drilling rod upper end, if the drilling rod box thread is also more complete, can take full advantage of original drilling rod box thread, directly the fishing head male thread of fishing head is screwed in the drilling rod box thread of well drilling rod and make both combinations; If original drilling rod box thread damage comparison is serious, utilize tapered thread bottom to carry out the tapping thread making at the inwall of the well drilling rod that falls, directly the tapered thread of fishing joint is screwed on the inwall of well drilling rod and makes both combinations, fishing joint is combined with the well drilling rod that falls and just can be put on ground afterwards; The through hole at the center of fishing joint can guarantee the continuous of mud circulation in the salvaging process, in case pipe becoming stuck can create favorable conditions for subsequent job after living; Fishing head male thread and tapered thread acting in conjunction can be born larger pulling force, prevent drilling rod secondary falling well in lifting process.

content_cn: 本申请提供一种页岩气水平井单段测试机构及水平井单段测试方法，其利用控制器和安装有电缆的连续油管来控制电控液压膨胀组件对目标井段进行层位封隔，并且依靠测试组件进行单段测试的工艺及方法，通过单段的卡封进行精确的产出情况测试及单段温压测试，排除不同层段间相互干扰，使得测试数据更加真实准确，有效地解决水平井单段测试难题。同时，利用安装有电缆的连续油管对测试组件进行输送，实现了地面控制多次解封与卡封，并能够在地面实时监测卡封情况及测试数据情况。此外，电控开关阀的设计实现了地面控制测试层段的开闭，能够进行单段温压及流量、持率等测试，测试数据能够更加真实的反应单段的情况，通过对单段的精确测试，准确了解每一层段的产出及温压情况，为压裂工艺优化及开发方案调整提供了有力的依据。
content_en: The application provides a shale gas horizontal well single-segment testing mechanism and a horizontal well single-segment testing method, which uses a controller and a coiled tubing installed with a cable to control an electronically controlled hydraulic expansion component to block the target well segment. And rely on the test module for the single-stage test process and method, through the single-segment seal for accurate output test and single-stage temperature and pressure test to eliminate mutual interference between different layers, making the test data more true and accurate and effective Solve the problem of single-segment testing of horizontal wells. At the same time, the test assembly is transported by using the coiled tubing installed with cables to achieve ground control multiple unsealing and blocking, and it is possible to monitor the blocking and test data on the ground in real time. In addition, the design of the electronically controlled on-off valve realizes the opening and closing of the ground control test section, which can perform single-stage temperature and pressure, flow, and holding rate tests. The test data can more accurately reflect the situation of the single section. Accurate testing and accurate understanding of the output and temperature and pressure of each interval provide a powerful basis for fracturing process optimization and development program adjustment.

content_cn: 低渗透、小断块油田在开发、生产过程中，油井结蜡问题日益严重。常规抽油管柱热洗清蜡洗井液从油套环空之间循环至油层部位，经抽油泵的固定凡尔，再从抽油管柱返到地面流程内，达到清除砂、蜡、盐以及其他赃物的目的，在油层压力较低的情况下，部分洗井液进入油层或全部进入油层，洗井液返不出来，或返出较少，灌压油层严重，造成对油层的污染。热洗后油井要全面恢复到热洗前的产液水平一般快的要4～5天，慢的约1～2周才能全面恢复到热洗前的水平。甚至有的井热洗后不出油，最后导致作业，才能恢复正常生产。热洗清蜡后，油井恢复产状时间长，影响原油产量，甚至有的井（重点井）用油洗井，损失部分已采出产量，同时还浪费能源。现有热洗清蜡防油层污染工具均为皮碗式：密封可靠性差，都未能从根本上解决问题，一直未能得到推广应用。
content_en: In the development and production process of low permeability and small fault block oilfields, the problem of waxing in oil wells is becoming more and more serious. The conventional pumping column hot-washing wax cleaning well is circulated from the oil jacket annulus to the oil layer, and is fixed by the pumping pump to the ground process to remove the sand, wax, salt and For the purpose of other stolen goods, in the case of low oil layer pressure, part of the washing fluid enters the oil layer or all enters the oil layer, the washing fluid can not be returned, or the returning oil is less, and the oil filling layer is serious, causing pollution to the oil layer. After hot washing, the oil well should be fully restored to the level of the liquid before the hot wash is generally 4 to 5 days, slow to about 1 to 2 weeks to fully recover to the level before the hot wash. Even some wells do not produce oil after hot washing, and finally lead to operations, in order to resume normal production. After hot washing and wax removal, the oil well resumes its production for a long time, affecting the crude oil production. Even some wells (key wells) use oil to wash the wells, and some of the lost production has been produced, and energy is also wasted. The existing hot-washing wax-proof oil-proof layer pollution tools are all of the cup type: the sealing reliability is poor, and they have not solved the problem fundamentally, and have not been popularized and applied.

content_cn: 结合图1所示，本公开实施例提供一种空调器，包括：冷媒循环主回路、温度补偿支路、室内风机8。冷媒循环主回路，包括通过管路依次连接的压缩机1、室外换热器2、三通阀3、节流装置4、分液装置5、第一室内换热器6。温度补偿支路，包括第二室内换热器7，第二室内换热器7的进口与三通阀3连接，出口与分液装置5连接。室内风机8，第一室内换热器6和第二室内换热器7都设置在室内风机8的一侧。其中，三通阀3可受控使第二室内换热器7、节流装置4分别与室外换热器2连通，以使室外换热器2中的冷媒在节流前先进入第二室内换热器7再流入第一室内换热器6以加热室内空气，或者，使节流装置4与室外换热器2连通以实现正常的制冷或制热功能。
content_en: As shown in FIG. 1 , an embodiment of the present disclosure provides an air conditioner, which includes: a main refrigerant circulation circuit, a temperature compensation branch circuit, and an indoor fan 8 . The main refrigerant circulation loop includes a compressor 1, an outdoor heat exchanger 2, a three-way valve 3, a throttling device 4, a liquid separation device 5, and a first indoor heat exchanger 6 that are connected in sequence through pipelines. The temperature compensation branch includes a second indoor heat exchanger 7 , the inlet of the second indoor heat exchanger 7 is connected to the three-way valve 3 , and the outlet is connected to the liquid separation device 5 . The indoor fan 8, the first indoor heat exchanger 6 and the second indoor heat exchanger 7 are all arranged on one side of the indoor fan 8. Among them, the three-way valve 3 can be controlled to connect the second indoor heat exchanger 7 and the throttling device 4 with the outdoor heat exchanger 2 respectively, so that the refrigerant in the outdoor heat exchanger 2 first enters the second room before throttling. The heat exchanger 7 then flows into the first indoor heat exchanger 6 to heat indoor air, or the throttling device 4 is connected to the outdoor heat exchanger 2 to achieve normal cooling or heating functions.

content_cn: 上述技术方案的有益效果在于：本实用新型的管壳式换热器中，由于管板的堆焊层上设有围绕管孔布置的环形凹槽，因此使得环形凹槽和管孔之间形成有用于与换热管焊接的环形凸部，且由于环形凹槽的槽底壁为弧形壁，或者槽底壁与环形凹槽的环形内侧壁和环形外侧壁之间分别通过圆角过渡，这样不仅能够通过环形凹槽降低焊接拘束度，降低结构刚性，而且通过弧形壁或者圆角也能够降低槽底壁与环形内侧壁和环形外侧壁之间的应力集中，以此当换热管与环形凸部焊接时，能够降低焊接残余应力，进而能够提高换热管和管板之间连接的可靠性，降低换热管和管板连接处应力腐蚀开裂的风险，提高管壳式换热器运行的可靠性，降低检验维护费用。
content_en: The beneficial effect of the above-mentioned technical solution is that: in the tube sheet for shell-and-tube heat exchanger of the present invention, since the surfacing layer is provided with an annular groove arranged around the tube hole, a useful gap is formed between the annular groove and the tube hole. The annular protrusion welded with the heat exchange tube, and because the groove bottom wall of the annular groove is an arc-shaped wall, or the groove bottom wall and the annular inner side wall and the annular outer side wall of the annular groove are respectively through a rounded transition, so Not only can the welding restraint be reduced through the annular groove, but also the structural rigidity can be reduced, and the stress concentration between the groove bottom wall and the annular inner wall and the annular outer wall can also be reduced through the arc-shaped wall or rounded corner, so that it can be used as the heat exchange tube and When the annular protrusion is welded, welding residual stress can be reduced, thereby improving the reliability of the connection between the heat exchange tube and the tube sheet, and reducing the risk of stress corrosion cracking at the connection between the heat exchange tube and the tube sheet.

content_cn: 本实用新型实施例的制冷设备，设有制冰室和制冰风道，通过将制冰风道设置在箱胆内，并在制冰风道中设置制冰蒸发器，通过将进风管和回风管埋设在箱胆和箱壳之间，利用进风管和回风管连通制冰室和制冰风道，同时在进风管和回风管上配置用于与箱壳抵触的支柱，通过箱壳挤压支柱的方式使进风管与回风管压紧箱胆，在简化安装过程的同时使得该制冷设备能够正常进行制冰，保证进风管和回风管在箱胆固定的稳固性。进一步的，风道进、回风管通过卡扣的方式与箱胆实现定位固定，减少螺钉的使用，节约工时，降低成本。更进一步的，同时在箱胆与进风管和回风管相应的位置采用起筋的方式进行密封，保证了进风管和回风管的密封，同时避免发泡液进入进风管或回风管。再进一步的，在盖板上增加起压紧密封作用的支柱，通过挤压支柱的方式使进风管和回风管盖板压紧箱胆，防止漏泡，保证进风管和回风管在箱胆上固定的稳固性。
content_en: The refrigeration equipment of the embodiment of the present invention is provided with an ice-making chamber and an ice-making air duct. The return air pipe is buried between the tank and the case shell, and the air inlet pipe and the return air pipe are used to connect the ice making chamber and the ice making air duct. , the air inlet pipe and the return air pipe are pressed against the tank by the way of extruding the pillars of the box shell, which simplifies the installation process and enables the refrigeration equipment to make ice normally, and ensures that the air inlet pipe and the return air pipe are fixed in the tank. of stability.Further, the air inlet and return air pipes of the air duct are positioned and fixed with the tank by means of snaps, which reduces the use of screws, saves man-hours and reduces costs.Further, at the same time, the corresponding positions of the tank and the air inlet pipe and the return air pipe are sealed by means of ribs, which ensures the sealing of the air inlet pipe and the return air pipe, and prevents the foaming liquid from entering the air inlet pipe or return air pipe. duct.Further, a support is added to the cover plate for pressing and sealing. By squeezing the support, the cover plate of the air inlet pipe and the return air pipe is pressed against the tank to prevent leakage of bubbles and ensure the air inlet pipe and the return air pipe. The stability of the fixation on the tank.

content_cn: 如图4、图6、图7所示，抽真空接头组件13包括第一接头13a和第二接头13b，第一接头13a可移动地连接在抽真空壳体11上，第一接头13a能够朝向保鲜盒20移动或者远离保鲜盒20移动；第二接头13b可移动地穿设在第一接头13a中，第二接头13b通过移动可与密封部件22插接配合，第二接头13b通过移动可脱离密封部件22，第二接头13b上开设有抽真空管路13c；第二接头13b与密封部件22插接配合时，抽真空管路13c通过密封部件22与保鲜盒20内部连通。如图6所示的竖直方向上，抽真空接头组件13的部件可沿竖直方向移动，在需要抽真空前，抽真空接头组件13中的部件进行移动后与密封部件相互限位配合。第一接头13a和第二接头13b分先后顺序移动，第一接头先朝向保鲜盒移动预定距离后达到限位，第二接头再朝向密封部件移动并与其插接配合，然后开始进行抽真空。第一接头和第二接头由抽真空装置的内部机构驱动，驱动过程和传动机构均是现有技术常用的结构，此处不再赘述。
content_en: As shown in Fig. 4, Fig. 6 and Fig. 7, the vacuum joint assembly 13 includes a first joint 13a and a second joint 13b, the first joint 13a is movably connected to the vacuum housing 11, and the first joint 13a can face The fresh-keeping box 20 moves or moves away from the fresh-keeping box 20; the second joint 13b is movably inserted in the first joint 13a, and the second joint 13b can be plugged with the sealing member 22 by moving, and the second joint 13b can be disengaged by moving The sealing part 22 is provided with a vacuuming pipeline 13c on the second joint 13b;In the vertical direction as shown in FIG. 6 , the parts of the vacuum joint assembly 13 can move in the vertical direction. Before vacuuming is required, the parts in the vacuum joint assembly 13 move and cooperate with the sealing parts. The first joint 13a and the second joint 13b move sequentially. The first joint moves toward the fresh-keeping box for a predetermined distance and reaches the limit, and the second joint moves toward the sealing part and fits with it, and then starts vacuuming. The first joint and the second joint are driven by the internal mechanism of the vacuum pumping device. The driving process and the transmission mechanism are common structures in the prior art, and will not be repeated here.

content_cn: 本实用新型旨在至少解决现有技术中存在的技术问题之一。为此，本实用新型提出一种用于空调器的换向装置，所述换向装置有利于降低空调器的噪音。本实用新型还提出一种空调器，包括上述实施例的换向装置。根据本实用新型第一方面实施例的用于空调器的换向装置，包括：壳体；和换向阀，所述换向阀的至少一部分设在所述壳体内，所述换向阀的外周壁和所述壳体的内壁之间填充有阻尼件。根据本实用新型实施例的用于空调器的换向装置，通过在换向阀的外周壁和壳体的内壁之间填充阻尼件，有效地减弱了换向装置的振动，进而可以有效地降低因振动产生的噪音和辐射噪音。根据本实用新型的一些实施例，所述阻尼件为阻尼颗粒。由此，当换向装置振动时，换向装置的振动能量传给阻尼颗粒时，可以引起阻尼颗粒之间摩擦和互相错动。由于阻尼颗粒的内损耗、内摩擦大，进一步地增大了转化为热能的振动能量，从而进一步地减弱了换向装置的振动。而且橡胶颗粒成本低，可以降低生产成本。
content_en: The present invention aims to solve at least one of the technical problems existing in the prior art. To this end, the present utility model proposes a reversing device for an air conditioner, which is advantageous for reducing the noise of the air conditioner.The utility model also provides an air conditioner, comprising the reversing device of the above embodiment.A reversing device for an air conditioner according to a first aspect of the present invention includes: a housing; and a reversing valve, at least a part of the reversing valve is disposed in the housing, and the reversing valve A damping member is filled between the outer peripheral wall and the inner wall of the housing.According to the reversing device for an air conditioner according to an embodiment of the present invention, by filling a damping member between the outer peripheral wall of the reversing valve and the inner wall of the housing, vibration of the reversing device is effectively weakened, and thus can be effectively reduced. Noise and radiation noise due to vibration.According to some embodiments of the present invention, the damping member is a damping particle. Thus, when the reversing device vibrates, the vibration energy of the reversing device is transmitted to the damping particles, which can cause friction between the damping particles and mutual misalignment. Due to the internal loss and internal friction of the damping particles, the vibration energy converted into heat energy is further increased, thereby further reducing the vibration of the reversing device. Moreover, the low cost of rubber particles can reduce production costs.

content_cn: 常用于离心压缩机油路侧和冷媒侧的密封方式为单一式的迷宫密封或螺旋式密封。由于受轴的外形结构影响，迷宫密封多半为平滑式密封，密封性能受密封轴向长度影响很大，结构受长度限制，往往得不到好的密封效果，因此常规离心机往往从蜗壳引一路高压气体进入迷宫密封之间进行密封，这样，相当一部分的高压冷媒气体经电机进入蒸发器中，无形当中造成冷量的浪费。螺旋密封受转子转速影响，密封性能随转速的增大而增大，但功耗也随之增大，由于离心机供油压差基本不变，如果在低转速下运行时，螺旋密封很有可能达不到密封要求而造成油漏入电机腔中。因此，有必要寻找一种在高低转速之间都能获取较好密封效果的结构，以提高离心压缩机的电机腔与电机尾端回油腔之间的密封性能。
content_en: The sealing means that is usually used in centrifugal compressor oil circuit side and medium side is labyrinth seal or the screw seal of single formula.Owing to affected by the form structure of axle, labyrinth seal is the smooth type sealing mostly, sealability is subjected to seal shaft very large to effect length, structure is subjected to length restriction, the sealing effect that often can not get, therefore conventional centrifuge often draws one road pressurized gas from spiral case and enters between the labyrinth seal and seal, like this, the high pressure refrigerant gas of quite a few enters in the vaporizer through motor, causes the waste of cold in the middle of invisible.Spiral seal is affected by rotor speed, sealability increases with the increase of rotating speed, but also thereupon increase of power consumption, because centrifuge fuel feeding pressure reduction is substantially constant, if when moving under the slow-speed of revolution, spiral seal does not probably reach seal request and causes oil leakage to enter in the motor cavity.Therefore, be necessary to seek a kind of structure that between high and low rotating speed, can both obtain better sealing effect, with the motor cavity of raising centrifugal compressor and the sealability between the motor tail end oil back chamber.

content_cn: 本发明提出的一种具有分体式泵头结构的往复泵，包括：动力部、机箱、进液管、出液管及工作组件；所述工作组件包括：缸体、泵头、测温探头、第一单向阀、第二单向阀、柱塞及填料函；所述缸体设置在机箱上，所述缸体上设有往复空间；所述泵头竖直布置，所述泵头与缸体远离机箱的一端连接，所述泵头内设有介质通道，所述介质通道与往复空间连通；所述泵头内设有保温预热通道，所述保温预热通道布置于介质通道的外侧，所述保温预热通道沿竖直方向布置；所述测温探头间隔布置于介质通道内；所述第一单向阀、第二单向阀分别安装在介质通道的上、下两端；所述柱塞可移动的布置于往复空间内，所述柱塞的第一端穿过机箱与动力部传动连接，所述柱塞的第二端能够进入介质通道内；所述填料函位于往复空间内，并设置在柱塞和所述缸体之间；所述介质通道的底端与进液管连通，所述介质通道的顶端与出液管连通。
content_en: The present invention proposes a reciprocating pump with a split pump head structure, comprising: a power unit, a chassis, a liquid inlet pipe, a liquid outlet pipe and a working assembly; the working assembly comprises: a cylinder body, a pump head, a temperature measuring probe, a first one-way valve, a second one-way valve, a plunger and a stuffing box; the cylinder body is arranged on the chassis, and a reciprocating space is provided on the cylinder body; the pump head is arranged vertically, and the pump head is connected to one end of the cylinder body away from the chassis, and a medium channel is provided in the pump head, and the medium channel is connected to the reciprocating space; a heat preservation preheating channel is provided in the pump head, and the heat preservation preheating channel is arranged at On the outside of the medium channel, the insulation preheating channel is arranged in the vertical direction; the temperature measuring probes are arranged at intervals in the medium channel; the first one-way valve and the second one-way valve are respectively installed at the upper and lower ends of the medium channel; the plunger is movably arranged in the reciprocating space, the first end of the plunger passes through the chassis and is transmission-connected to the power unit, and the second end of the plunger can enter the medium channel; the stuffing box is located in the reciprocating space and is arranged between the plunger and the cylinder body; the bottom end of the medium channel is connected to the liquid inlet pipe, and the top end of the medium channel is connected to the liquid outlet pipe.

content_cn: 为了实现上述目的，根据本实用新型的一个方面，提供了一种空调器室内机，包括：壳体，具有进风口、第一出风口以及第二出风口；第一贯流风叶，横置于壳体内的上部；第二贯流风叶，横置于壳体内的下部；以及热交换器，位于进风口处；空调器室内机还包括导向机构，导向机构位于第一贯流风叶与第二贯流风叶之间并沿第一贯流风叶的中心与第二贯流风叶的中心的连线可移动地设置，导向机构将壳体内部分成位于上方的第一工作腔和位于下方的第二工作腔，热交换器对应于第一工作腔的换热面积为S1，对应于第二工作腔的换热面积为S2，且S1/S2的关系为：制热模式下，0.5≤S1/S2＜1.0；制冷模式下，1.5≥S1/S2≥1.0。
content_en: To achieve these goals, according to an aspect of the present utility model, provide a kind of air conditioner room unit, having comprised: housing has air inlet, the first air outlet and the second air outlet; The first through-flow fan blade is horizontally placed on the top in housing; The second through-flow fan blade is horizontally placed on the bottom in housing; And heat exchanger, be positioned at the air inlet place; Air conditioner room unit also comprises guiding mechanism, guiding mechanism arranges between the first through-flow fan blade and the second through-flow fan blade and along the line at the center of the center of the first through-flow fan blade and the second through-flow fan blade movably, guiding mechanism is divided into enclosure interior the first working chamber that is positioned at the top and is positioned at the second working chamber of below, heat exchanger is S1 corresponding to the heat exchange area of the first working chamber, heat exchange area corresponding to the second working chamber is S2, and the pass of S1/S2 is: under heating mode, and 0.5≤S1/S2＜1.0; Under refrigeration mode, 1.5 〉=S1/S2 〉=1.0.

content_cn: 目前的分体式空调系统采用贯流风叶进行通风换气，但是为了保证分体式空调系统具有较大的通风换气的风量，贯流风叶的直径尺寸通常较大，这就导致了风机结构的结构尺寸偏大，进而导致分体式空调系统的厚度较厚。因此，本实用新型的风机系统100通过第一产风装置120和第二产风装置130代替直径较大的贯流风叶，同时第一产风装置120和第二产风装置130均包括至少两个轴流风叶，通过第一产风装置120和第二产风装置130进行通风换气。为了保证风机系统100的产风量，本实用新型的风机系统100通过第一产风装置120和第二产风装置130(至少四个轴流风叶)产风，在保证风机系统100产风量的同时，可以适当的减小轴流风叶的直径尺寸，进而减小风机系统100的结构尺寸，最后能够减小空调系统的厚度。轴流风叶的直径尺寸减小，单个轴流风叶的产风量也相应的减少，可以通过增加轴流风叶的个数增加风机系统100的产风量，能够有效的控制风机结构的外观尺寸，进而保证空调系统的外观尺寸，使空调系统的厚度大大变薄。第一产风装置120和第二产风装置130中，轴流风叶的数量可以根据风机系统100的通风换气性能以及结构尺寸的需求来设计，轴流风叶的数量可以为两个、三个等等。
content_en: Current SPLIT AIR-CONDITIONING SYSTEM adopts through-flow fan blade to carry out ventilation, but in order to ensure that SPLIT AIR-CONDITIONING SYSTEM has the air quantity of larger ventilation, the diameter dimension of through-flow fan blade is usually larger, the physical dimension which results in blower fan structure is bigger than normal, and then causes the thickness of SPLIT AIR-CONDITIONING SYSTEM thicker.Therefore, the through-flow fan blade that blower fan system 100 of the present utility model replaces diameter larger by the first product wind apparatus 120 and the second product wind apparatus 130, first product wind apparatus 120 and the second product wind apparatus 130 include at least two axial-flow leafs simultaneously, carry out ventilation by the first product wind apparatus 120 and the second product wind apparatus 130.In order to ensure the product air quantity of blower fan system 100, blower fan system 100 of the present utility model produces wind apparatus 120 by first and the second product wind apparatus 130 (at least four axial-flow leafs) produces wind, while guarantee blower fan system 100 produces air quantity, the diameter dimension of reduction axial-flow leaf that can be suitable, and then reduce the physical dimension of blower fan system 100, finally can reduce the thickness of air-conditioning system.The diameter dimension of axial-flow leaf reduces, the product air quantity of single axial-flow leaf also reduces accordingly, the product air quantity of blower fan system 100 can be increased by the number increasing axial-flow leaf, effectively can control the apparent size of blower fan structure, and then ensure the apparent size of air-conditioning system, make the thickness of air-conditioning system greatly thinning.First produces wind apparatus 120 and second produces in wind apparatus 130, and the quantity of axial-flow leaf can design according to the demand of the ventilation performance of blower fan system 100 and physical dimension, and the quantity of axial-flow leaf can be two, three etc.

content_cn: 填料式油分离器被广泛应用于大型及中型蒸汽压缩制冷循环系统。常见的填料式油分离器仅具有分油的功能，采用带孔的不锈钢板将填料固定于油分离器壳体内腔，流经填料的气体中携带的润滑油被填料过滤，而实现油气分离，仅通过填料实现分离，分离效率较低。还有通过外置冷却水套来冷却填料以及制冷剂，但实践中发现，加冷却水套对提高分油效率并不明显，分析原因为冷却水套管仅与填料室外层填料实现换热，内层的填料以及流经内层填料的制冷剂距离冷却水套管位置较远，冷却水与整个填料室换热不均匀，从而换热效果差。
content_en: Packed oil separators are widely used in large and medium-sized vapor compression refrigeration cycle systems. The common packing type oil separator only has the function of separating oil. The packing is fixed to the inner cavity of the oil separator shell by a stainless steel plate with holes. The lubricating oil carried in the gas flowing through the packing is filtered by the packing to realize oil and gas separation. The separation is achieved only by packing, and the separation efficiency is low.There is also an external cooling water jacket to cool the filler and refrigerant, but in practice, it is found that adding a cooling water jacket is not obvious to improve the oil separation efficiency. The reason is that the cooling water jacket only exchanges heat with the outer layer of the filler. The inner packing and the refrigerant flowing through the inner packing are far away from the cooling water jacket, and the heat exchange between the cooling water and the entire packing chamber is uneven, resulting in poor heat exchange effect.

content_cn: 单贯流双出风口空调柜机，左右出风口开设在前装饰板部件两侧，2个出风口的双层导风板反向运动，即左导风板绕着导风板的转轴顺时针旋转，则右导风板逆时针旋转，或者左导风板绕着导风板的转轴逆时针旋转，则右导风板顺时针旋转。空调出风一个重要的指标为出风口的送风距离，其表现为风口朝向中间靠的程度来衡量是否有利于送风聚中，即如果风口明显朝左右两边，那么聚中的效果将比较差，经过送风距离实验测试可知，在常温密闭无风环境中测试导风板靠在前装饰板上的状态时的最远送风距离，导风板角度为40°时聚风效果明显，当导风板角度为25°时平行导风板的聚风效果很差，中间区域风速已低于0.3m/s，测速的风速仪无法转动，影响了空调的送风距离。
content_en: Single cross-flow double-outlet air-conditioning cabinet unit, the left and right air outlets are set on both sides of the front decorative panel, and the double-layer air deflectors of the two air outlets move in opposite directions, that is, the left air deflector rotates clockwise around the rotation axis of the air deflector Rotate, the right wind deflector rotates counterclockwise, or the left wind deflector rotates counterclockwise around the rotating shaft of the wind deflector, then the right wind deflector rotates clockwise.An important indicator of the air outlet of the air conditioner is the air supply distance of the air outlet, which is expressed as the degree to which the air outlet faces the middle to measure whether it is conducive to the concentration of the air supply, that is, if the air outlet is obviously facing the left and right sides, the effect of the concentration will be relatively poor , through the air supply distance experiment test, it can be seen that the farthest air supply distance is tested when the air deflector is leaning against the front decorative panel in a closed and windless environment at room temperature. When the angle of the air deflector is 40°, the wind gathering effect is obvious. When the angle of the air deflector is 25°, the wind gathering effect of the parallel air deflector is very poor. The wind speed in the middle area is lower than 0.3m/s, and the anemometer for speed measurement cannot rotate, which affects the air supply distance of the air conditioner.

content_cn: 与现有技术相比，本申请的优点和积极效果是：本申请提出的冷柜温显仪的下盖和冷柜温显仪中，在下盖的上边沿具有一弹性密封圈体，且该弹性密封圈体自下盖的上边沿向下盖外侧的方向，其厚度是由厚变薄的，当将该下盖组装到冷柜内胆与冷柜外壳之间的腔体内后，弹性密封圈体能够贴合在冷柜内胆上开设的冲孔周边起到密封的作用，当向冷柜内胆和冷柜外壳之间的腔体内填充发泡料时，弹性密封圈体从发泡方向上阻隔了发泡的冲击力，防止发泡溢料的情况发生，相比现有技术，该下盖组装完成后，无需涂抹热熔胶，无需贴PE胶带，降低成本也节省了人力和组装时间。进一步的，采用后盖连接件的周边开设卡扣孔、后盖设置包边、以及在包边内侧设置卡扣件的方式，当把后盖的卡扣件卡入后盖连接件的卡扣孔后，后盖与后盖连接件固定，使得后盖和后盖连接件形成一个能够通感温探头和连接线的管路，该管路的连接处受到后盖上的包边的保护，且卡扣孔和卡扣件都位于包边的内侧也受到了包边的保护，保证了发泡过程中不会发生发泡溢料的情况，省去了在后盖包裹PE胶带的工艺，进一步降低了成本和节省了人力和组装时间。
content_en: Compared with the prior art, the advantages and positive effects of this application are: in the lower cover of the freezer temperature indicator and the freezer temperature indicator proposed in this application, there is an elastic sealing ring body on the upper edge of the lower cover, and the elastic sealing ring body is from the bottom The upper edge of the cover is in the direction of the outer side of the lower cover, and its thickness is changed from thick to thin. When the lower cover is assembled into the cavity between the freezer liner and the freezer shell, the elastic sealing ring body can fit in the freezer The perimeter of the punching hole opened on the tank plays a role of sealing. When the cavity between the inner tank of the freezer and the outer shell of the freezer is filled with foam, the elastic sealing ring body blocks the impact of the foam from the foaming direction and prevents In the case of foaming flashing, compared with the prior art, after the lower cover is assembled, there is no need to apply hot melt glue and no PE tape, which reduces costs and saves manpower and assembly time.Further, the method of opening buckle holes on the periphery of the back cover connector, setting the rim of the back cover, and setting the buckle inside the rim, when the buckle of the back cover is snapped into the buckle of the back cover connector After the hole, the back cover and the back cover connecting piece are fixed, so that the back cover and the back cover connecting piece form a pipeline that can communicate with the temperature probe and the connecting line. The connection of the pipeline is protected by the edge of the back cover. Moreover, the buckle hole and the buckle are located on the inner side of the edging and are protected by the edging, which ensures that no foaming overflow occurs during the foaming process, and eliminates the need for wrapping PE tape on the back cover. Further reduce costs and save manpower and assembly time.

content_cn: 根据本实用新型实施例的箱胆组件，箱胆设有用于装设隔板的第一安装槽，当隔板插接于第一安装槽时，调节部能插接于第一锁止部，从而实现隔板与箱胆的锁止。驱动部在调节部的相对侧，驱动部可对调节部进行限位，可通过驱动部止动调节部，调节部不会冲击到箱胆。其中，第二锁止部可以理解为锁扣结构，本申请通过把锁扣分为两部分，即第二锁止部包括调节部和驱动部，调节部与驱动部分隔在箱胆的相对侧，驱动部可对调节部进行限位，可通过驱动部止动调节部，在隔板装配过程中调节部不会冲击箱胆，可减小装配过程中隔板对箱胆的影响。当用户需要拆卸隔板时，只需调节驱动部使调节部移出第一锁止部即可解除隔板与箱胆的锁止，隔板能够沿着第一安装槽移动，从而实现隔板的拆卸，用户省力，用户的体验好。同时，第一锁止部和第二锁止部的结构简单，隔板的安装方便，对隔板和箱胆的制造精度要求低，工艺简单，减少生产成本。
content_en: According to the box assembly of the embodiment of the present invention, the box is provided with a first installation slot for installing a partition. When the partition is inserted into the first installation slot, the adjusting part can be inserted into the first locking part. This achieves the locking of the partition and the box. The driving part is on the opposite side of the adjusting part, and the driving part can limit the adjusting part, and the adjusting part can be stopped by the driving part, so that the adjusting part will not impact the box. Among them, the second locking part can be understood as a locking structure. In this application, the locking part is divided into two parts. That is, the second locking part includes an adjusting part and a driving part. The adjusting part and the driving part are separated on the opposite side of the box. , the driving part can limit the position of the adjusting part, and the adjusting part can be stopped by the driving part. The adjusting part will not impact the box during the assembly process of the partition, which can reduce the impact of the partition on the box during the assembly process. When the user needs to disassemble the partition, he only needs to adjust the driving part so that the adjustment part moves out of the first locking part to unlock the partition and the box, and the partition can move along the first installation groove, thereby realizing the installation of the partition. Disassembly saves the user effort and provides a good user experience. At the same time, the structure of the first locking part and the second locking part is simple, the partition is easy to install, the manufacturing precision of the partition and the box is low, the process is simple, and the production cost is reduced.

content_cn: 空闲数据剔除：用户在手动操作开始或者结束阶段，存在短时间的静止状态，同时，用户在连续动作过程中会存在间歇停顿，这些在静止状态的下的数据称为空闲数据。空闲数据不包含任何运行信息，在手动操作的识别过程中是无效的，并且会影响到手动操作识别的准确度，因此这部分数据需要被过滤剔除。本实施例中通过设置滤波器来过滤掉空闲数据，滤波器的阀值通过统计加速度传感器在静止状态下加速度数据的均值和方差来设定，通过设置静止状态下加速度的范围区间，如果采集的加速度数据落在阀值范围之外，则认为该数据为正常数据，否则，则认为是空闲数据，需要从三轴的加速度数据序列中剔除。异常数据剔除：由于智能手表在运动过程中存在抖动以及传感器供电电压不稳定等都会产生异常数据，例如在静止状态时，加速度值突然变大，或者在运动状态时，相邻数据的变化突然变大，这种异常数据对于手动操作的识别和精度有很大影响，本实施例中依然采用基于统计的方法来剔除这些异常数据，在加速度数据采集的过程中对历史数据进行统计分析，得到均值，然后根据一定的波动范围，得到相应的正常数据区间。如果采集数据中某一项落在此数据区间内，则认为该数据为正常数据，否则，则认为是异常数据，从生成的数据序列中剔除。
content_en: Idle data culling: The user has a short-term quiescent state at the beginning or end of the manual operation. At the same time, the user has intermittent pauses during continuous operation. These data under the quiescent state are called idle data. The idle data does not contain any running information, which is invalid during the manual operation identification process, and affects the accuracy of the manual operation identification, so this part of the data needs to be filtered out. In this embodiment, the idle data is filtered by setting a filter, and the threshold of the filter is set by the mean and variance of the acceleration data of the acceleration sensor in the stationary state, and the range of the acceleration in the static state is set, if the collected If the acceleration data falls outside the threshold range, the data is considered normal data. Otherwise, it is considered as idle data and needs to be removed from the three-axis acceleration data sequence.Abnormal data culling: abnormal data is generated due to jitter in the smart watch during motion and unstable sensor supply voltage. For example, when the acceleration value suddenly increases in the stationary state, or changes in the adjacent data suddenly change during the motion state. Large, this abnormal data has a great influence on the identification and accuracy of manual operation. In this embodiment, statistical methods are still used to eliminate these abnormal data, and historical data is statistically analyzed in the process of acceleration data acquisition to obtain an average value. Then, according to a certain range of fluctuations, the corresponding normal data interval is obtained. If an item in the collected data falls within this data range, the data is considered normal data; otherwise, it is considered abnormal data and is excluded from the generated data sequence.

content_cn: 当前通信网络已融入了人们生活的各个方面。当用户出现网络通信故障时，由于涉及到终端、服务提供商、通信网络等多个层面，故障诊断难度较高。通常，用户倾向于向网络运营商求助或者投诉。当前，面对大量的用户网络故障投诉，一位资深的网络工程师每天能处理的投诉量约20单。有大量的投诉问题无法得到快速有效的解决，极大地影响了用户的体验。自动化的诊断工具是解决上述问题的一个重要方法，用于实现自动化的故障诊断主要有基于机器学习的黑箱故障诊断方法，该方法通过收集历史故障的数据记录，结合网络工程师的人工诊断结果，用监督学习的方法，得到一个故障诊断模型，通过该故障诊断模型对新出现的网络故障进行诊断。基于机器学习的黑箱故障诊断方案对样本故障工单有两个要求：样本故障工单的数量需要较多，样本故障工单的诊断结果准确度需要较高。
content_en: The current communication network has been integrated into all aspects of people's lives. When a user has a network communication failure, it is difficult to diagnose the failure due to multiple levels such as terminals, service providers, and communication networks. Generally, users tend to ask for help or complain to network operators. Currently, facing a large number of user complaints about network failures, a senior network engineer can handle about 20 complaints per day. There are a large number of complaints that cannot be resolved quickly and effectively, which greatly affects the user experience. Automated diagnosis tools are an important method to solve the above problems. The black box fault diagnosis method based on machine learning is mainly used to realize automatic fault diagnosis. This method collects historical fault data records and combines the results of manual diagnosis by network engineers. The method of supervised learning obtains a fault diagnosis model, and diagnoses new network faults through the fault diagnosis model. The black box fault diagnosis scheme based on machine learning has two requirements for sample fault tickets: the number of sample fault tickets needs to be large, and the accuracy of the diagnosis results of sample fault tickets needs to be higher.

content_cn: 具体地，所更改后的文件系统可包括第一元数据集合以及第二元数据集合两套文件元数据，其中，所述第一元数据集合由系统中的各文件的第一文件元数据组成，所述第一文件元数据与系统中的文件的内容无关；所述第二元数据集合由系统中的各文件的第二文件元数据组成，所述第二文件元数据与系统中的文件的内容相关，从而在接收到来自用户的文件系统访问请求，且根据所述访问请求，确定所述用户为系统管理员等具备系统专业管理权限且不具备文件内容访问权限的用户时，可将文件系统中的与文件内容无关的第一元数据集合呈现给所述用户，从而避免了现有技术中存在的文件信息在系统管理人员等非文件所有者面前毫无安全性的问题，提高了文件系统中的文件信息的安全性。
content_en: Specifically, the changed file system may include a first metadata set and a second metadata set of two sets of file metadata, wherein the first metadata set is composed of first file metadata of each file in the system. The first file metadata is independent of the content of the file in the system; the second metadata set is composed of second file metadata of each file in the system, the second file metadata and files in the system Relevant content, so that when a file system access request from a user is received, and according to the access request, it is determined that the user is a system administrator or the like who has system professional management rights and does not have access to file content. The first metadata set in the file system that is not related to the file content is presented to the user, thereby avoiding the problem that the file information existing in the prior art has no security in front of non-file owners such as system administrators, and the problem is improved. The security of file information in the file system.

content_cn: 基本上，光拾取致动器在跟踪方向和焦点方向的两个方向上执行驱动，即两轴驱动。最近，增加物镜的数值孔径(NA)，以便执行高密度的光存储装置，并且减小了激光光源的波长。同样地，减小了光拾取致动器的倾斜方向边缘。为了补偿该缺陷，除了现存的两轴驱动，即聚焦方向和跟踪方向两个方向的驱动之外，需要三轴驱动光拾取致动器，能够在倾斜方向驱动，特别是在光盘的径向上驱动。该三轴驱动光拾取致动器被称为是倾斜驱动光拾取致动器，它除了在聚焦方向和跟踪方向上驱动之外，还能够在倾斜方向上被驱动。
content_en: Basically, the optical pickup actuator performs driving in two directions of the tracking direction and the focus direction, that is, two-axis driving. Recently, the numerical aperture (NA) of the objective lens has been increased to perform a high-density optical storage device and to reduce the wavelength of the laser light source. Also, the oblique direction edge of the optical pickup actuator is reduced. In order to compensate for this defect, in addition to the existing two-axis drive, that is, the drive in both the focus direction and the tracking direction, a three-axis drive optical pickup actuator is required, which can be driven in an oblique direction, particularly in the radial direction of the optical disk. . The three-axis drive optical pickup actuator is referred to as a tilt drive optical pickup actuator which can be driven in an oblique direction in addition to driving in a focus direction and a tracking direction.

content_cn: 根据本发明构思的一方面，提供了一种存储设备，所述存储设备包括：存储器件，所述存储器件包括多个存储块；存储器控制器，所述存储器控制器被配置为控制所述存储器件，以及通过基于第一信息和第二信息执行强化学习来执行垃圾收集，所述第一信息指示所述存储器件在写入数据之前的状态，所述第二信息指示所述存储器件在写入数据之后的状态；主机接口，所述主机接口用于在主机与所述存储器控制器之间进行接口连接；以及闪存接口，所述闪存接口用于在所述存储器控制器与所述存储器件之间进行接口连接。
content_en: According to an aspect of the inventive concept, there is provided a storage device including: a storage device including a plurality of storage blocks; a memory controller configured to control the memory And perform garbage collection by performing reinforcement learning based on first information and second information, the first information indicating the state of the storage device before data is written, and the second information indicating that the storage device is writing The state after entering the data; the host interface, the host interface is used for interface connection between the host and the memory controller; and the flash memory interface, the flash memory interface is used for the memory controller and the storage device Interface connection between.

content_cn: 现在将参照图1对启动器130和响应器140的操作进行描述。首先，当使用USB(或IrDA、IEEE 1394或RS232C)将启动器130连接到响应器140时，启动器130向响应器140请求装置信息(操作S101)。响应器140将装置信息发送给启动器130(操作S102)。当启动器130请求执行OpenSession()时(操作S103)，响应器140为新会话分配各种资源，并为存储在存储器中的所有对象确定ObjectHandle(操作S103-1)。如上所述，可由响应器140提供的所有类型的文件和文件夹(例如，照片、音乐和运动图像)被识别为对象。用于ROOT(根)目录的ObjectHandle必须为0，而其余的ObjectHandle取决于执行。当启动器130请求执行GetObjectHandle()(操作S104)时，响应器140提供如上所述生成的所有对象的ObjectHandle[1]至ObjectHandle[n](操作S105)。启动器130请求启动器130自身所需的对象信息(ObjectInfo)(操作S106)。响应器140提供请求的对象信息(操作S107)。启动器130检查接收的对象信息，并请求与对象信息相应的对象(操作S108)。响应器140将对象发送到启动器130。在完成各种必要的操作之后，启动器130通过调用CloseSession()关闭会话(操作S110)。
content_en: The operations of the initiator 130 and the responder 140 will now be described with reference to FIG. 1. First, when the initiator 130 is connected to the responder 140 using USB (or IrDA, IEEE1394, or RS232C), the initiator 130 requests device information from the responder 140 (operation S101). The responder 140 sends the device information to the initiator 130 (operation S102). When the initiator 130 requests execution of OpenSession () (operation S103), the responder 140 allocates various resources for the new session and determines the ObjectHandle for all objects stored in the memory (operation S103-1). As described above, all types of files and folders (for example, photos, music, and moving images) that can be provided by the responder 140 are recognized as objects. The ObjectHandle for the ROOT (root) directory must be 0, and the rest of the ObjectHandle depends on the execution. When the initiator 130 requests execution of GetObjectHandle () (operation S104), the responder 140 provides ObjectHandle [1] to ObjectHandle [n] of all objects generated as described above (operation S105). The initiator 130 requests object information (ObjectInfo) required by the initiator 130 itself (operation S106). The responder 140 provides the requested object information (operation S107). The initiator 130 checks the received object information and requests an object corresponding to the object information (operation S108). The responder 140 sends the object to the initiator 130. After completing various necessary operations, the initiator 130 closes the session by calling CloseSession () (operation S110).

content_cn: 鉴于现有技术中存在上述技术问题，本发明的目的之一，就是将智能家居系统中的多种家电进行组合联动形成各种影像环境模式，并配合虚拟现实技术，通过移动端对智能家居系统中的影像模式进行切换，使房间的环境进行改变，给人多样的感官体验。不仅可在在一种场景模式下实现多种环境模式，可供选择的家居环境更多；而且可以随时调节环境模式下智能家居设备的目标状态，使其更加贴合用户的使用需求。本发明的目的之二，是提供上述基于移动端切换房间环境模式的装置。
content_en: In view of the above technical problems in the prior art, one of the objects of the present invention is to combine various home appliances in a smart home system to form various image environment modes, and cooperate with virtual reality technology to move through the mobile terminal to the smart home system. The image mode in the switch is switched to change the environment of the room, giving a variety of sensory experiences. Not only can a variety of environment modes be implemented in one scene mode, but the home environment can be more selected; and the target state of the smart home device in the environment mode can be adjusted at any time to make it more suitable for the user's use.Another object of the present invention is to provide an apparatus for switching a room environment mode based on a mobile terminal as described above.

content_cn: 本实用新型要解决的技术问题是：克服现有技术的不足，提供一种增大切刀的运动行程，准确控制样条缺口大小，使上部样条的缺口与下部样条的缺口一致，提高了实验数据的准确性的提高精度的缺口制样机。本实用新型解决其技术问题所采用的技术方案是：该提高精度的缺口制样机，包括固定板、冲切机构和滑动平台，固定板上侧设有水平的导轨，滑动平台滑动设置在导轨上，冲切机构固定在固定板上，滑动平台上侧固定有夹具，夹具在冲切机构一侧设有用于固定工件的夹持凹槽，所述滑动平台上开设有一个平台凹槽，平台凹槽位于夹持凹槽的下方。优选的，所述平台凹槽竖向贯穿滑动平台，固定板在平台凹槽下方开设有固定板凹槽。优选的，所述固定板凹槽竖向贯穿固定板。进一步的，所述固定板上设有一个螺旋测微器，螺旋测微器抵接在滑动平台相对冲切机构的另一侧。
content_en: The technical problem to be solved by the utility model is: to overcome the deficiencies of the prior art, to provide an increase in the movement stroke of the cutter, to accurately control the size of the spline gap, and to make the gap of the upper spline coincide with the gap of the lower spline, thereby improving the The accuracy of the experimental data is improved by the accuracy of the notch sampler.The technical solution adopted by the utility model to solve the technical problem thereof is: the gap-precision sample preparation machine with improved precision includes a fixing plate, a punching mechanism and a sliding platform, and a horizontal guide rail is arranged on the fixed plate side, and the sliding platform is slidably disposed on the guide rail. The punching mechanism is fixed on the fixing plate, and the upper side of the sliding platform is fixed with a clamp. The clamp is provided with a clamping groove for fixing the workpiece on one side of the punching mechanism, and a sliding groove is formed on the sliding platform, and the platform is concave. The groove is located below the clamping groove.Preferably, the platform groove vertically penetrates the sliding platform, and the fixing plate is provided with a fixing plate groove below the platform groove.Preferably, the fixing plate groove vertically penetrates the fixing plate.Further, the fixing plate is provided with a spiral micrometer, and the spiral micrometer abuts on the other side of the sliding platform relative to the punching mechanism.

content_cn: 在一特定实施例中，数据在第一易失性存储器设备104与非易失性存储器设备108之间按地址次序来复制。如本文所使用的，“按地址次序”复制数据意味着从易失性存储器设备复制的每一数据元素被写回易失性存储器设备中的、在禁用易失性存储器设备之前从中复制的同一位置。例如，整个第一易失性存储器设备104的数据映像(例如，快照)(例如，512MB数据映像)可被复制到非易失性存储器设备108，而不管整个DDR第一易失性存储器设备104是否正存储活跃数据(例如，系统100处的硬件组件和/或软件应用正使用的数据)。生成并复制整个第一易失性存储器设备104的数据映像可比压缩数据或只定位并复制活跃数据到非易失性存储器设备108更快。此外，因为非易失性存储器设备108的大小可显著大于第一易失性存储器设备104的大小，所以复制整个第一易失性存储器设备104的快照的存储成本可相对较小且是用户可接受的。另外，因为数据按地址次序被转移到第一易失性存储器设备104且从第一易失性存储器设备104转移，所以在睡眠模式之前使用的存储器映射(例如，虚拟地址到物理地址映射)可在退出睡眠模式之后保持有效。此外，与部分阵列自刷新(PASR)系统不同，第一易失性存储器设备104充满50％以上时的数据损失可被避免。
content_en: In a particular embodiment, data is replicated in an address order between the first volatile memory device 104 and the non-volatile memory device 108. As used herein, "copying by address" means that each data element copied from a volatile memory device is written back to the same copy of the volatile memory device from which it was copied prior to disabling the volatile memory device. position. For example, a data image (eg, a snapshot) of the entire first volatile memory device 104 (eg, a 512 MB data map) can be copied to the non-volatile memory device 108 regardless of the entire DDR first volatile memory device 104. Whether active data is being stored (eg, hardware components at system 100 and/or data being used by the software application). Generating and copying the data image of the entire first volatile memory device 104 can be faster than compressing the data or merely locating and copying the active data to the non-volatile memory device 108. Moreover, because the size of the non-volatile memory device 108 can be significantly larger than the size of the first volatile memory device 104, the cost of copying the snapshot of the entire first volatile memory device 104 can be relatively small and can be user- Accepted. Additionally, because data is transferred to and from the first volatile memory device 104 in address order, the memory map (eg, virtual address to physical address mapping) used prior to sleep mode may Stays active after exiting sleep mode. Moreover, unlike partial array self-refresh (PASR) systems, data loss when the first volatile memory device 104 is more than 50% full can be avoided.

content_cn: 一个方面提供了一种用于由用户装备进行无线通信的方法。该方法包括从网络实体接收调度信息。在一些情况下，该调度信息根据跳频方案来调度多个上行链路数据信道重复在多个时隙中的发送，该跳频方案配置该多个上行链路数据信道重复中的重复的发送之间的跳频。附加地，在一些情况下，该多个时隙包括至少第一全双工(FD)时隙，该第一全双工(FD)时隙包括较大带宽部分(BWP)的上行链路子带和下行链路子带。附加地，在一些情况下，该调度信息指示用于该多个上行链路数据信道重复的至少一个起始资源块(RB)和用于该多个上行链路数据信道重复的从RB偏移集合中选择的至少一个RB偏移。附加地，该方法还包括基于该调度信息来采取与根据该跳频方案在该多个时隙中发送该多个上行链路数据信道重复相关的一个或多个动作。
content_en: One aspect provides a method for wireless communication by a user equipment. The method includes receiving scheduling information from a network entity. In some cases, the scheduling information schedules the transmission of multiple uplink data channel repetitions in multiple time slots according to a frequency hopping scheme, and the frequency hopping scheme configures the frequency hopping between the transmissions of the repetitions in the multiple uplink data channel repetitions. Additionally, in some cases, the multiple time slots include at least a first full-duplex (FD) time slot, and the first full-duplex (FD) time slot includes an uplink subband and a downlink subband of a larger bandwidth part (BWP). Additionally, in some cases, the scheduling information indicates at least one starting resource block (RB) for the multiple uplink data channel repetitions and at least one RB offset selected from a RB offset set for the multiple uplink data channel repetitions. Additionally, the method also includes taking one or more actions related to sending the multiple uplink data channel repetitions in the multiple time slots according to the frequency hopping scheme based on the scheduling information.

content_cn: 通常，无线多址通信系统能够同时支持多个移动设备的通信。每个移动设备可以经由前向链路和反向链路的传输与一个或多个基站通信。前向链路(或下行链路)指的是从基站到移动设备的通信链路，反向链路(或上行链路)指的是从移动设备到基站的通信链路。此外，移动设备和基站之间的通信可以通过单输入单输出(SISO)系统、多输入单输出(MISO)系统、多输入多输出(MIMO)系统等来建立。MIMO系统通常采用多付(NT)发射天线和多付(NR)接收天线来发射数据。由NT付发射天线和NR付接收天线形成的MIMO信道可以分解成NS个独立信道，这些信道称作空间信道。NS个独立信道中的每一个都对应于一个维度。另外，如果能够利用多付发射天线和接收天线形成的另外的维度，则MIMO系统可以由此改善性能(例如，提高频谱效率、更高的吞吐量和/或更高的可靠性)。
content_en: Generally, a wireless multiple-access communication system is capable of supporting communication of multiple mobile devices simultaneously. Each mobile device can communicate with one or more base stations via transmissions on the forward and reverse links. The forward link (or downlink) refers to the communication link from the base station to the mobile device, and the reverse link (or uplink) refers to the communication link from the mobile device to the base station. In addition, communication between a mobile device and a base station may be established through a single-input single-output (SISO) system, a multiple-input single-output (MISO) system, a multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system, and the like.MIMO systems usually use multiple antennas (NT) and multiple antennas (NR) to transmit data. The MIMO channel formed by the NT transmitting antenna and the NR receiving antenna can be decomposed into NS independent channels. These channels are called spatial channels. Each of the NS independent channels corresponds to a dimension. In addition, if additional dimensions formed by multiple transmit and receive antennas can be utilized, the MIMO system can thereby improve performance (eg, increase spectral efficiency, higher throughput, and / or higher reliability).

content_cn: 参考图1，DAB帧100包括同步信道(SCH)102、快速信息信道(FIC)104、以及主服务信道(MSC)106。SCH 102包括在DAB帧100的解码中用于同步的信息。FIC 104包括各种类型的控制信息、要求高速传送的紧急数据、和服务信息。与MSC 106不同，由于FIC 104的信号不经过时间交织器，FIC104具有有可能高速传送的优势，但是具有传送的数据量限制为32字节的不足。MSC 106包括用于多个音频服务、视频服务和数据服务的数据。如图1所示，单个DAB帧100包括多个服务信道108，每个服务信道108包括多个子信道110。各个子信道110通过独立地进行编码和交织过程被复用到MSC106中。

content_cn: 镜像在数据通信领域是一项非常基本的功能，它把设备从某个端口接收或发送的数据帧完全相同的复制一份，然后从设定的目标端口发送出去(原数据按正常流程转发)。设备镜像的数据可以是整个端口接收或发送的数据，也可以按照某种规则定义的流数据。数据镜像的主要功能就是监视进出网络的数据包，供安装了监控软件的管理服务器抓取数据，如网吧需要提供此功能把数据发往公安部门审查。而企业出于信息安全、保护公司机密的需要，也迫切需要网络中有一个端口能提供这种实时监控功能。在企业中用镜像功能，可以很好地对企业内部的网络数据进行监控管理，在网络出现故障的时候，还可以做到很好地故障定位。
content_en: Mirroring is a very basic function in the field of data communication. It copies the same data frame received or sent by a device from a certain port, and then sends it out from the set target port (the original data is forwarded according to the normal process) . The data mirrored by the device can be the data received or sent by the entire port, or the flow data defined according to a certain rule. The main function of data mirroring is to monitor data packets entering and leaving the network for the management server installed with monitoring software to capture data. For example, an Internet cafe needs to provide this function to send data to the public security department for review. For the sake of information security and the protection of company secrets, enterprises also urgently need a port in the network to provide this real-time monitoring function. Using the mirroring function in an enterprise can monitor and manage the internal network data of the enterprise, and can also locate the fault well when the network fails.

content_cn: 另一种DIF削波技术是匹配滤波削波技术，中国专利申请号03800497.3的发明专利使用的技术就属于DIF匹配滤波削波技术，该技术是针对多载波信号削波情况。若仅仅使用缩放器来调整匹配滤波器增益，以使得在满足期望的误差矢量幅度、峰值码域误差和邻道功率泄漏比等发射性能条件下获得预期的峰均比。但是，当各载波的发射功率不相同时，该削波技术使用相同的缩放系数来调整各个载波的匹配滤波器系数，多载波合路信号经过硬削波后的峰值抵消信号均通过此匹配滤波器系数，这将会使发射功率电平低的载波误差幅度矢量和峰值码域误差发射性能严重恶化。因此，在满足系统误差矢量幅度、峰值码域误差和邻道功率泄漏比指标要求下，其削波后信号的峰均比不能取得令人满意的结果。
content_en: Another type of DIF clipping technology is the matched filtering clipping technology. The technology used in the invention patent of China Patent Application No. 03800497.3 belongs to the DIF matching filtering clipping technology, which is aimed at multi-carrier signal clipping. If only the scaler is used to adjust the matched filter gain, the expected peak-to-average ratio can be obtained under the transmission performance conditions such as the desired error vector amplitude, peak code domain error, and adjacent channel power leakage ratio. However, when the transmit power of each carrier is not the same, this clipping technology uses the same scaling factor to adjust the matched filter coefficients of each carrier. The peak cancellation signal of the multi-carrier combined signal after hard clipping is passed through this matching filter. This will cause the carrier error amplitude vector and peak code domain error of low transmit power levels to severely degrade the transmission performance. Therefore, under the requirements of system error vector amplitude, peak code domain error, and adjacent channel power leakage ratio, the peak-to-average ratio of the clipped signal cannot achieve satisfactory results.

content_en: According to another aspect of the present disclosure, a feedforward equalizer is provided. The feedforward equalizer includes a first delay circuit and a second delay circuit. The first delay circuit and the second delay circuit are configured to receive the first input signal and the second input signal and to delay the first input signal and the second input signal respectively using a plurality of latch circuits. The first decoding circuit and the second decoding circuit are configured to generate a plurality of decoded signals by decoding the output signals of the first delay circuit and the second delay circuit respectively. The first multiplexer is configured to receive a plurality of decoded signals from the first decoding circuit and the second decoding circuit. The second multiplexer is configured to receive a first reference output as an output of the first latch circuit of the first delay circuit and a second reference output as an output of the second latch circuit of the second delay circuit. The summing driver is configured to receive and sum the outputs of the first multiplexer and the second multiplexer. The decoding circuit includes a plurality of decoders, and the decoders respectively correspond to outputs of a plurality of latch circuits other than the first reference output and the second reference output for performing the decoding operation.

content_cn: 参见图1，提出本发明的智能时钟维护的方法一实施例，其包括：步骤S101、接收网络管理平台发送的智能时钟启动指令；步骤S102、根据提取的各光方向时钟的SSM字节信息，计算各光方向时钟的SSM等级；步骤S103、对各光方向时钟的SSM等级进行比较，锁定SSM等级为最优的第一时钟；步骤S104、将锁定第一时钟信息上报给网络管理平台，以供建立智能时钟拓扑图关系表。光网络系统由多个网络设备组成，每个网络设备包括有一个或多光信号接口，不同方向的光信号携带的SSM信息不同，计算各个光方向的SSM等级之前，从不同光方向的光信号中提取出各自的SSM信息。在计算SSM等级时，在ITU-T标准算法上，将经过节点的数量、光链路的代价和SRLG等级，这些光链路特性加入到计算SSM等级的计算公式中。因为不同光方向其这些光链路特性不同，且不同光方向的时钟SSM信息不同，计算得出的每个光方向的SSM等级都是唯一的。
content_en: Referring to FIG. 1, an embodiment of a method for maintaining intelligent clock according to the present invention includes:Step S101: Receive an intelligent clock start command sent by the network management platform.Step S102: Calculate an SSM level of each optical direction clock according to the extracted SSM byte information of each optical direction clock.Step S103: Compare SSM levels of the optical direction clocks, and lock the first clock with the SSM level being optimal;Step S104: Report the locked first clock information to the network management platform, so as to establish an intelligent clock topology map relationship table.The optical network system is composed of multiple network devices. Each network device includes one or more optical signal interfaces. The SSM information carried by optical signals in different directions is different. Before calculating the SSM level in each optical direction, optical signals from different optical directions are calculated. Extract the respective SSM information. In calculating the SSM level, on the ITU-T standard algorithm, the number of nodes passing through, the cost of the optical link, and the SRLG level are added to the calculation formula for calculating the SSM level. Because the optical link characteristics of different optical directions are different, and the clock SSM information of different optical directions is different, the calculated SSM level of each optical direction is unique.

content_cn: 首先进行下料、内层图形制作和内层蚀刻。具体是：先裁切铜箔基板成适合加工生产的尺寸大小；再以适当的温度及压力将干膜光阻贴附其上；将贴好干膜光阻的基板进行曝光；干膜光阻在底片透光区域受紫外线照射后会产生聚合反应；该区域的干膜光阻在稍后的显影蚀铜步骤中将被保留下来当作蚀刻阻剂，而将底片上的线路影像移转到板面；最后再将干膜光阻洗除，对于六层(含)以上的内层线路板需要冲出层间线路对位的铆合基准孔。其次完成后的内层线路板须以玻璃纤维树脂胶片与外层线路铜箔黏合，也就是进行黑化/棕化和层压；具体是：在压合前内层线路板需先经黑(氧)化处理使铜面钝化增加绝缘性，并使内层线路板的铜面粗化以便能和胶片产生良好的黏合性能；叠合时先将六层线路(含)以上的内层线路板成对的铆合，再以适当的温度及压力使胶片硬化黏合，压合后的电路板钻出靶孔做为内外层线路对位的基准孔。
content_en: First, the blanking, the inner layer patterning, and the inner layer etching are performed. Specifically, the copper foil substrate is first cut into a size suitable for processing; then the dry film photoresist is attached thereto at an appropriate temperature and pressure; the substrate coated with the dry film photoresist is exposed; the dry film photoresist The polymerization reaction occurs after the ultraviolet light is irradiated on the transparent region of the film; the dry film photoresist in this region will be retained as an etch resist in the later development copper etching step, and the line image on the film is transferred to the film. The surface of the board is finally cleaned by the dry film photoresist. For the inner layer circuit board of six or more layers, the riveting reference hole for the alignment of the interlayer lines is required.After the completion, the inner circuit board shall be bonded with the outer layer copper foil by glass fiber resin film, that is, blackening/browning and laminating; specifically: the inner layer circuit board needs to pass black before pressing ( Oxygenation treatment increases the insulation of the copper surface passivation, and roughens the copper surface of the inner circuit board to produce good adhesion to the film; when stacking, the inner layer line of six layers or more is included. The plates are riveted in pairs, and the film is hardened and bonded at an appropriate temperature and pressure. content_cn: 无线通信系统被广泛部署以提供各种类型的通信内容，诸如语音、视频、分组数据、消息接发、广播等等。这些系统可以能够通过共享可用系统资源(例如，时间、频率和功率)来支持与多个用户的通信。此类多址系统的示例包括第四代(4G)系统(诸如长期演进(LTE)系统、高级LTE(LTE-A)系统或LTE-A Pro系统)和第五代(5G)系统(其可以被称为新空口(NR)系统)。这些系统可以采用诸如码分多址(CDMA)、时分多址(TDMA)、频分多址(FDMA)、正交FDMA(OFDMA)或离散傅里叶变换扩展正交频分复用(DFT-S-OFDM)之类的技术。无线多址通信系统可包括一个或多个基站或一个或多个网络接入节点，每个基站或网络接入节点同时支持用于多个通信设备的通信，这些通信设备可以另外被称为用户装备(UE)。
content_en: Wireless communication systems are widely deployed to provide various types of communication content, such as voice, video, packet data, messaging, broadcasting, and the like. These systems may be able to support communication with multiple users by sharing available system resources (e.g., time, frequency, and power). Examples of such multiple access systems include fourth generation (4G) systems (such as long term evolution (LTE) systems, advanced LTE (LTE-A) systems, or LTE-A Pro systems) and fifth generation (5G) systems (which may be referred to as new air interface (NR) systems). These systems may employ techniques such as code division multiple access (CDMA), time division multiple access (TDMA), frequency division multiple access (FDMA), orthogonal FDMA (OFDMA), or discrete Fourier transform spread orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (DFT-S-OFDM). A wireless multiple access communication system may include one or more base stations or one or more network access nodes, each base station or network access node simultaneously supporting communication for multiple communication devices, which may be further referred to as user equipment (UE).
