content_cn: 一种血压测量方法，其特征在于，应用于电子设备，所述电子设备包括气囊和气泵；所述方法包括：所述电子设备控制所述气泵以第一充气速率向所述气囊充气；所述电子设备在控制所述气泵以所述第一充气速率向所述气囊充气的过程中，检测压力信号，并根据所述压力信号判断脉搏波信号是否出现；所述电子设备在确定所述脉搏波信号出现时，控制所述气泵以第二充气速率向所述气囊充气，所述第二充气速率小于所述第一充气速率；所述电子设备根据以所述第二充气速率向所述气囊充气后检测到的压力信号，实时获取所述脉搏波信号和静压力信号；所述电子设备根据所述脉搏波信号中的至少一个特征点和与所述特征点对应的所述静压力信号确定用户的血压值。根据权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于，所述判断脉搏波信号是否出现，包括：所述电子设备在控制所述气泵以所述第一充气速率向所述气囊充气的过程中，检测所述气囊的压力值，并判断当前时刻所述气囊的压力值是否大于压力阈值；其中，当当前时刻所述气囊的压力值大于所述压力阈值时，确定所述脉搏波信号出现，当当前时刻所述气囊的压力值小于所述压力阈值时，确定所述脉搏波信号未出现。
content_en: A blood pressure measurement method, characterized in that it is applied to an electronic device, the electronic device includes an air bag and an air pump; the method includes:The electronic device controls the air pump to inflate the airbag at a first inflation rate;In the process of controlling the air pump to inflate the airbag at the first inflation rate, the electronic device detects a pressure signal, and determines whether a pulse wave signal appears according to the pressure signal;When determining that the pulse wave signal appears, the electronic device controls the air pump to inflate the airbag at a second inflation rate, the second inflation rate being less than the first inflation rate;The electronic device obtains the pulse wave signal and the static pressure signal in real time according to the pressure signal detected after the airbag is inflated at the second inflation rate;The electronic device determines the blood pressure value of the user according to at least one characteristic point in the pulse wave signal and the static pressure signal corresponding to the characteristic point. The method according to claim 1, wherein the determining whether a pulse wave signal appears comprises: In the process of controlling the air pump to inflate the airbag at the first inflation rate, the electronic device detects the pressure value of the airbag, and determines whether the pressure value of the airbag at the current moment is greater than a pressure threshold; Wherein, when the pressure value of the airbag at the current moment is greater than the pressure threshold, it is determined that the pulse wave signal appears, and when the pressure value of the airbag at the current moment is less than the pressure threshold, it is determined that the pulse wave signal does not appear.

content_en: A method for determining the spatial position of the end of a robotic arm of a robot, which is characterized in that it comprises: Determine the first spatial position of the end of the robot arm of the robot through the motor encoder of each axis of the robot arm of the robot; Determining the second spatial position of the end of the robotic arm of the robot through the acceleration sensor at the end of the robotic arm of the robot; Determine the spatial position difference between the first spatial position and the second spatial position as the spatial position error of the robot arm end of the robot; and determine whether the absolute value of the spatial position error exceeds a set error range; If the absolute value of the spatial position error exceeds the set error range, the first spatial position is calibrated according to the absolute value of the spatial position error. content_cn: 一种净饮机的控制方法，其特征在于，所述方法包括：检测净饮机的水箱的质量值；获取所述水箱的历史质量值；根据所述水箱的质量值与所述历史质量值判断所述净饮机是否满足预设换水条件；若所述净饮机满足预设换水条件，则生成换水提示信息，以提示用户进行换水。根据权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于，所述根据所述水箱的质量值与所述历史质量值判断所述净饮机是否满足预设换水条件，具体包括：比较当前检测时刻检测到的质量值与前一检测时刻检测到的质量值是否相同；若当前检测时刻检测到的质量值与前一检测时刻检测到的质量值相同，则对预设的持续时间参数进行计时累加，得到第一持续时间；判断所述第一持续时间是否大于第一预设时间；若所述第一持续时间大于所述第一预设时间，则判定所述净饮机满足预设换水条件。
content_en: A method for controlling a drinking water purifier, wherein the method includes: Check the quality value of the water tank of the drinking water dispenser; Obtaining a historical quality value of the water tank; Judging whether the water purifier meets a preset water change condition according to the quality value of the water tank and the historical quality value; If the water purifier meets a preset water change condition, a water change prompt message is generated to prompt the user to perform water change. The method according to claim 1, wherein said judging whether the water purifier meets a preset water change condition according to the quality value of the water tank and the historical quality value specifically comprises: Comparing whether the quality value detected at the current detection time is the same as the quality value detected at the previous detection time; If the quality value detected at the current detection time is the same as the quality value detected at the previous detection time, time-accumulating the preset duration parameter to obtain the first duration; Determining whether the first duration is greater than a first preset time; If the first duration is greater than the first preset time, it is determined that the drinking water purifier meets a preset water change condition.

content_cn: 一种环戊烯直接水合制备环戊醇的方法,其特征在于,包括以下步骤：将环戊烯、水、混合溶剂组成的物料连续通过装填催化剂的固定床进行水合反应，反应温度为100～160℃，反应压力为1.0～3.0MPa，体积空速为0.5～2hr-1，其中：混合溶剂由重量比为(0.5～1.5)：1的邻硝基苯酚和醇组成，所述醇为正丁醇，混合溶剂和环戊烯的重量比为(0.5～1.5)：1，水和环戊烯的摩尔比为(3.0～10.0)：1，所述催化剂为表面锚定磺酸基的强酸性阳离子交换树脂；反应结束后，反应物冷却分层为油相和水相，油相物料常压下精馏，38～55℃的馏分冷凝得到未反应的环戊烯，105～120℃的馏分冷凝得到溶剂，135～165℃的馏分冷凝收集得到精制环戊醇。根据权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于：所述混合溶剂中邻硝基苯酚和醇的重量比为(0.8～1.0)：1。根据权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于：所述反应温度为120～130℃，反应压力为1.5～2.0MPa，体积空速为0.8～1.2hr-1。
content_en: A method for directly preparing cyclopentanol by hydration of cyclopentene, comprising the steps of: continuously cyclizing a material consisting of cyclopentene, water and a mixed solvent through a fixed bed packed with a catalyst, and the reaction temperature is 100 ～ 160 ° C, the reaction pressure is 1.0 ~ 3.0MPa, the volume space velocity is 0.5 ~ 2hr-1, wherein: the mixed solvent is composed of o-nitrophenol and alcohol in a weight ratio of (0.5 ~ 1.5): 1, the alcohol is positive Butanol, the weight ratio of the mixed solvent to cyclopentene is (0.5 to 1.5): 1, the molar ratio of water to cyclopentene is (3.0 to 10.0): 1, the catalyst is strong for surface anchoring sulfonic acid groups. Acid cation exchange resin; after the reaction is finished, the reactants are cooled and layered into an oil phase and an aqueous phase, the oil phase material is rectified under normal pressure, and the fraction of 38-55 ° C is condensed to obtain unreacted cyclopentene, 105-120 ° C. The fraction was condensed to obtain a solvent, and the fraction of 135 to 165 ° C was condensed and collected to obtain purified cyclopentanol. The method according to claim 1, wherein the weight ratio of o-nitrophenol to alcohol in the mixed solvent is (0.8 to 1.0):1. The method according to claim 1, wherein the reaction temperature is 120 to 130 ° C, the reaction pressure is 1.5 to 2.0 MPa, and the volume space velocity is 0.8 to 1.2 hr-1.

content_cn: 按照权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于，所述第一加氢处理反应区和第二加氢处理反应区内装填的加氢处理催化剂是负载在无定型氧化铝和/或硅铝载体上的VIB族非贵金属和/或VIII族非贵金属的催化剂，其中VIB族非贵金属为Mo和/或W，VIII族非贵金属为Ni和/或Co。按照权利要求8所述的方法，其特征在于，所述第一加氢处理反应区级配装填两种加氢处理催化剂，按照反应物流的流向依次装填加氢处理催化剂I和加氢处理催化剂II，其装填体积比例为6∶4～8∶2；第二加氢处理反应区仅装填加氢处理催化剂I，其中加氢处理催化剂I的活性金属为Co和Mo，加氢处理催化剂II的活性金属为Ni和W，或着为Ni和Mo，或者为Ni、Mo和W。按照权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于，柴油馏分原料油为直馏柴油；或者直馏柴油掺练部分二次加工柴油，以直馏柴油为基准，二次加工柴油掺练的比例为1％～50％。
content_en: according to the described method of claim 1; It is characterized in that; The hydrotreating catalyst of filling is the non-noble metal catalyzer of group vib base metal and/or VIII family that loads on unformed aluminum oxide and/or the silica-alumina supports in the said first hydrotreatment reaction zone and the second hydrotreatment reaction zone; Wherein the group vib base metal is Mo and/or W, and VIII family base metal is Ni and/or Co. according to the described method of claim 8; It is characterized in that; Two kinds of hydrotreating catalysts of the said first hydrotreatment reaction zone grading loading load hydrotreating catalyst I and hydrotreating catalyst II successively according to the flow direction of reactant flow, and its admission space ratio is 6: 4～8: 2; The second hydrotreatment reaction zone only loads hydrotreating catalyst I, and wherein the reactive metal of hydrotreating catalyst I is Co and Mo, and the reactive metal of hydrotreating catalyst II is Ni and W, or be Ni and Mo, perhaps be Ni, Mo and W. according to the described method of claim 1, it is characterized in that diesel oil distillate raw oil is straight-run diesel oil; Perhaps straight-run diesel oil is mixed experienced part secondary processing diesel oil, is benchmark with straight-run diesel oil, and it is 1%～50% that secondary processing diesel oil is mixed experienced ratio.

content_cn: 根据权利要求1-7中任意一项所述的方法，其中，所述燃料选自天然气、硫磺、液化烃、硫化氢和重油有机物中的至少一种；优选地，所述含硫废弃物选自废硫酸、含硫废液和含硫废气中的至少一种；优选地，在所述含二氧化硫气体中，二氧化硫的含量为3-12mol％；NOx的含量≤100mg/m3，氧气的含量为0.5-5mol％。一种含硫废弃物制硫酸的方法，其特征在于，该方法包括：(1)燃烧含硫废弃物，得到含二氧化硫气体；(2)将所述含二氧化硫气体进行氧化，得到含三氧化硫气体；(3)将所述含三氧化硫气体进行吸收，得到硫酸；其中，在步骤(1)中，所述燃烧采用权利要求1-8中任意一项所述的方法进行。根据权利要求9所述的方法，其中，在进行步骤(2)之前，将所述含二氧化硫气体先依次进行热量回收、冷却净化和干燥处理，然后再进行所述步骤(2)。
content_en: The method according to any one of claims 1-7, wherein the fuel is selected from at least one of natural gas, sulfur, liquefied hydrocarbons, hydrogen sulfide and heavy oil organics; Preferably, the sulfur-containing waste is selected from at least one of waste sulfuric acid, sulfur-containing waste liquid and sulfur-containing waste gas; Preferably, in the sulfur dioxide-containing gas, the content of sulfur dioxide is 3-12 mol%; the content of NOx is less than or equal to 100 mg/m3, and the content of oxygen is 0.5-5 mol%. A method for producing sulfuric acid from sulfur-containing waste, characterized in that the method comprises: (1)Burn sulfur-containing waste to obtain sulfur dioxide-containing gas; (2)The sulfur dioxide-containing gas is oxidized to obtain a sulfur trioxide-containing gas; (3)The sulfur trioxide-containing gas is absorbed to obtain sulfuric acid; Wherein, in step (1), the combustion is performed by the method described in any one of claims 1-8. The method according to claim 9, wherein, before performing step (2), the sulfur dioxide-containing gas is sequentially subjected to heat recovery, cooling purification and drying treatment, and then the step (2) is performed.

content_cn: 一种小晶粒ZSM-5沸石的制备方法，将所需量的硅源和铝源配制成固体重量含量为20-50％的浆液经喷雾干燥成型得到粒径为10～200μm的硅铝小球，经300～600℃焙烧后，与所需量的碱，模板剂以及水混合混匀得到重量组成为10.0SiO2∶0～0.85Al2O3∶0～2.5Na2O∶0～45.0模板剂∶50～300H2O的混合物I，向混合物I中加入重量0.5～20％的晶化导向剂后，混合物I在100～200℃晶化10～360小时得到晶粒尺寸为200～1000nm的小晶粒ZSM-5沸石，其中所用模板剂为二乙胺、三乙胺、正丙胺、正丁胺、己二胺、四丙基氢氧化铵或四丙基溴化铵中的一种；晶化导向剂是按照100SiO2∶0.17～6.80Al2O3∶0～20.0Na2O∶60～450模板剂∶450～3000H2O的重量组成将所需量的硅源、铝源、碱源、模板剂以及水混合均匀后在温度60～120℃下晶化10～360小时后制得，所用模板剂为四丙基氢氧化铵或四丙基溴化铵。根据权利要求1所述的小晶粒ZSM-5沸石的制备方法，其特征在于喷雾成型所用的硅源为硅溶胶、水玻璃或白炭黑中的一种，铝源为氧化铝、硝酸铝、氯化铝、硫酸铝或铝酸钠中的一种。根据权利要求1所述的一种小晶粒ZSM-5沸石的制备方法，其特征在于小晶粒ZSM-5沸石的晶化温度为120～180℃，晶化时间为24～240小时。
content_en: A preparation method of small-grain ZSM-5 zeolite, the required amount of silicon source and aluminum source is formulated into a slurry with a solid content of 20-50% by spray drying to form a silicon aluminum small particle with a particle size of 10 to 200 μm The ball is calcined at 300 ～ 600 ℃, mixed with the required amount of alkali, template and water to obtain a weight composition of 10.0SiO2: 0 ～ 0.85Al2O3: 0 ～ 2.5Na2O: 0 ～ 45.0 template agent: 50 ～ 300H2O Mixture I, after adding 0.5 to 20% by weight of the crystallization director to the mixture I, the mixture I is crystallized at 100 to 200 ° C for 10 to 360 hours to obtain small-grain ZSM-5 zeolite with a grain size of 200 to 1000 nm , Wherein the template agent used is one of diethylamine, triethylamine, n-propylamine, n-butylamine, hexamethylenediamine, tetrapropylammonium hydroxide or tetrapropylammonium bromide; the crystallization guide agent is in accordance with 100SiO2 ： 0.17 ～ 6.80Al2O3: 0 ～ 20.0Na2O: 60 ～ 450 template agent: Weight composition of 450 ～ 3000H2O The required amount of silicon source, aluminum source, alkali source, template agent and water are mixed evenly at a temperature of 60 ～ 120 ℃ It is prepared after 10 to 360 hours of crystallization, and the template used is tetrapropylammonium hydroxide or tetrapropylammonium bromide. The preparation method of small-grain ZSM-5 zeolite according to claim 1, characterized in that the silicon source used for spray molding is one of silica sol, water glass or white carbon black, and the aluminum source is aluminum oxide and aluminum nitrate , Aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate or sodium aluminate. The preparation method of small-grain ZSM-5 zeolite according to claim 1, characterized in that the crystallization temperature of the small-grain ZSM-5 zeolite is 120-180 ° C, and the crystallization time is 24-240 hours.

content_cn: 一种丁二酸单甲酯的制备方法，包括如下内容：丁二酸酐与甲醇进入静态混合器进行单酯化反应，反应流出物进入超重力反应器，同时向超重力反应器通入水蒸汽；反应后液相物料经冷却分离得到丁二酸单甲酯。按照权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于：丁二酸酐和甲醇的摩尔比为1:1～4。按照权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于：丁二酸酐和甲醇的摩尔比为1:1.5～2.5。按照权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于：丁二酸酐与甲醇单酯化反应温度70～160℃，反应停留时间为0.5～5h。按照权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于：丁二酸酐与甲醇单酯化反应温度90～120℃，反应停留时间为 1～2h。
content_en: A preparation method of monomethyl succinate, comprising the following contents: succinic anhydride and methanol enter a static mixer for monoesterification reaction, the reaction effluent enters the supergravity reactor, and simultaneously introduces water vapor into the supergravity reactor; After the reaction, the liquid phase material is separated by cooling to obtain monomethyl succinate. The method of claim 1 wherein the molar ratio of succinic anhydride to methanol is from 1:1 to 4. The method of claim 1 wherein the molar ratio of succinic anhydride to methanol is from 1:1.5 to 2.5. The method according to claim 1, characterized in that the temperature of the monoesterification reaction of succinic anhydride with methanol is 70-160 ° C, and the reaction residence time is 0.5-5 h. The method according to claim 1, characterized in that the temperature of the monoesterification reaction of succinic anhydride with methanol is from 90 to 120 ° C, and the reaction residence time is from 1 to 2 hours.

content_cn: 一种抗钙抗高温钻井液降滤失剂，包含以重量份计的以下组分：水 100份；乙烯基磺酸单体22～38份，优选30～35份；丙烯酰胺20～35份，优选22～27份；马来酰胺酸类单体2～10份，优选3～7份；阳离子乙烯基单体1～5份，优选1～3份。根据权利要求1所述的一种抗钙抗高温钻井液降滤失剂，其特征在于：所述乙烯基磺酸单体选自2-丙烯酰胺基-2-甲基丙磺酸、2-丙烯酰氧基-2-甲基丙磺酸中的至少一种。根据权利要求1所述的一种抗钙抗高温钻井液降滤失剂，其特征在于：所述马来酰胺酸类单体选自N-葡萄糖盐酸盐基马来酰胺酸、N-异丙酸酸基马来酰胺、N-乙酸基马来酰胺酸、N-乙磺酸基马来酰胺酸、N-苯磺酸基马来酰胺酸中的至少一种。
content_en: An anti-calcium anti-high temperature drilling fluid fluid loss additive comprising the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of water; 22 to 38 parts, preferably 30 to 35 parts, of the vinyl sulfonic acid monomer; 20 to 35 parts, preferably 22 to 27 parts, of acrylamide; 2 to 10 parts, preferably 3 to 7 parts, of the maleamic acid monomer; The cationic vinyl monomer is used in an amount of from 1 to 5 parts, preferably from 1 to 3 parts. The anti-calcium anti-high temperature drilling fluid fluid loss additive according to claim 1, wherein: The vinyl sulfonic acid monomer is at least one selected from the group consisting of 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid and 2-acryloyloxy-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid. The anti-calcium anti-high temperature drilling fluid fluid loss additive according to claim 1, wherein: The maleamic acid-based monomer is selected from the group consisting of N-glucose hydrochloride-based maleamic acid, N-isopropionic acid maleimide, N-acetoxy maleamic acid, and N-ethanesulfonic acid. At least one of amic acid and N-benzenesulfonic acid maleamic acid.

content_cn: 一种降低汽油硫含量的方法，该方法包括依次将汽油原料进行分馏处理、脱硫处理、加氢处理和混合处理以得到汽油产品，所述分馏处理包括：将所述汽油原料分馏以得到轻馏分、中馏分和重馏分，其中，轻馏分和中馏分的切割点温度T1为60～100℃，中馏分和重馏分的切割点温度T2为100～120℃，且所述T1和所述T2不同时为100℃；所述脱硫处理包括：采用以下方式1或方式2进行脱硫处理，方式1：将所述轻馏分引入碱洗单元以与其中的碱液接触而进行碱洗精制，得到脱硫醇后轻馏分；然后将所述中馏分和所述脱硫醇后轻馏分引入溶剂抽提单元的溶剂抽提塔中与贫溶剂接触以进行抽提蒸馏，得到抽余油和抽出油；方式2：将所述中馏分引入溶剂抽提单元的溶剂抽提塔中与贫溶剂接触以进行抽提蒸馏，得到抽余油和抽出油；然后将所述抽余油与所述轻馏分引入碱洗单元以与其中的碱液接触而进行碱洗精制，得到脱硫醇后馏分；所述加氢处理包括：将所述脱硫处理的方式1或方式2中的抽出油与所述重馏分一起依次引入至包括含有加氢脱硫催化剂I的第一反应区和含有加氢脱硫催化剂II的第二反应区的加氢脱硫单元中进行加氢脱硫反应，并将所述加氢脱硫单元的产物依次进行气液分离和汽提，得到加氢后重馏分；所述混合处理包括：将所述脱硫处理的方式1中得到的抽余油或方式2中得到的脱硫醇后馏分与所述加氢处理中的加氢后重馏分混合以得到所述汽油产品；在所述脱硫处理中，所述抽提蒸馏包括如下步骤：1)将待分离物料从下部通入所述溶剂抽提塔中与所述贫溶剂接触，塔顶得到第一抽余油，以及塔底得到第一富溶剂，所述待分离物料为所述方式1中的所述中馏分和所述脱硫醇后轻馏分或者为所述方式2中的所述中馏分；2)将所述第一富溶剂引入常压段进行蒸馏，得到第二富溶剂；3)将所述第二富溶剂引入减压汽提段进行汽提，得到所述抽出油和能够循环回所述溶剂抽提塔的回收贫溶剂；5)将所述第一抽余油引入水洗塔中与水逆流接触以进行水洗，得到所述抽余油；
content_en: A method for reducing gasoline sulfur content, the method includes sequentially fractionating gasoline raw materials, desulfurization treatment, hydrogenation treatment and mixing treatment to obtain gasoline products, The fractionation treatment includes: fractionating the gasoline raw material to obtain light fractions, middle fractions and heavy fractions, wherein the cut point temperature T1 of the light fractions and middle fractions is 60-100 ° C, and the cut point temperatures of the middle fractions and heavy fractions T2 is 100-120 ° C, and the T1 and T2 are not 100 ° C at the same time; The desulfurization treatment includes: performing desulfurization treatment in the following manner 1 or manner 2, Method 1: The light fraction is introduced into the alkaline washing unit to be contacted with the alkaline liquid to perform alkaline washing and refining to obtain a light distillate after desulfurization; then the middle distillate and the light distillate after desulfurization are introduced into a solvent for extraction The solvent extraction tower of the unit is contacted with the lean solvent to perform extraction distillation to obtain the residual oil and the extracted oil; Method 2: The middle distillate is introduced into a solvent extraction tower of a solvent extraction unit and is contacted with a lean solvent to perform extractive distillation to obtain a raffinate oil and a distillate oil; then the raffinate oil and the light distillate are introduced The alkaline washing unit is subjected to alkaline washing and refining by contacting with the alkaline solution therein to obtain a dethiolized fraction; The hydroprocessing includes: introducing the extracted oil in the method 1 or method 2 of the desulfurization treatment together with the heavy fraction into the first reaction zone including the hydrodesulfurization catalyst I and the hydrodesulfurization catalyst II Performing hydrodesulfurization in the hydrodesulfurization unit of the second reaction zone, and sequentially subjecting the products of the hydrodesulfurization unit to gas-liquid separation and stripping to obtain a heavy fraction after hydrogenation; The mixing treatment includes: mixing the after-purified oil fraction obtained in the method 1 of the desulfurization treatment or the dethiolized post-distillate obtained in the mode 2 with the post-hydrogenated heavy fraction in the hydroprocessing to obtain the gasoline product ; In the desulfurization treatment, the extractive distillation includes the following steps: 1)The material to be separated is passed into the solvent extraction tower from the lower part to contact with the lean solvent, the first oil residue is obtained at the top of the tower, and the first rich solvent is obtained at the bottom of the tower. The material to be separated is the method 1 The middle distillate and the light distillate after desulfurization or the middle distillate in Mode 2; 2)Introducing the first rich solvent into the atmospheric section for distillation to obtain a second rich solvent; 3)Introducing the second rich solvent into a reduced-pressure stripping section for stripping to obtain the extracted oil and the recovered lean solvent that can be recycled back to the solvent stripping tower; 5)Introducing the first residual oil into a water washing tower and contacting the water countercurrently for water washing to obtain the residual oil;

content_cn: 一种氯铂酸的电化学制备方法，其包括以下步骤：A，设置电解池，所述电解池通过设置于其中的第一隔板分成至少两个槽体；所述第一隔板上设有溢流孔；所述槽体通过设置于其中的第二隔板分成底部相通的两个极室；所述两个极室内分别设有电极；B，将铂粉加入所述槽体的底部，并加入盐酸，然后向同一槽体中的两个电极之间施加交流电，对所述铂粉进行连续电解，电解一段时间后，向电解池中补加盐酸，形成连续进盐酸、连续排出铂浓度稳定的含铂盐酸溶液的产品物流；C，对所述产品物流进行蒸馏和结晶处理，得到氯铂酸。根据权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于，所述第一隔板和第二隔板相垂直。根据权利要求1或2所述的方法，其特征在于，相邻两个第一隔板上的溢流孔分别位于所述第二隔板的两侧。
content_en: An electrochemical preparation method of chloroplatinic acid, comprising the following steps: A, an electrolytic cell is provided, the electrolytic cell is divided into at least two tanks by a first partition disposed therein; the first partition is provided with an overflow hole; and the tank is passed through a second disposed therein The partition plate is divided into two pole chambers communicating at the bottom; the two pole chambers are respectively provided with electrodes; B, adding platinum powder to the bottom of the tank, adding hydrochloric acid, and then applying alternating current between the two electrodes in the same tank, performing continuous electrolysis on the platinum powder, and electrolyzing for a period of time, then into the electrolytic cell. Adding hydrochloric acid to form a product stream continuously flowing into hydrochloric acid and continuously discharging platinum-containing hydrochloric acid solution with stable platinum concentration; C, the product stream is subjected to distillation and crystallization treatment to obtain chloroplatinic acid. The method of claim 1 wherein said first separator and said second separator are perpendicular. The method according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the overflow holes on the adjacent two first partitions are respectively located on both sides of the second partition.

content_cn: 一种用于苯酚羟基化制苯二酚的反应器，包括反应器壳体、反应器封盖、搅拌桨、保温夹套、原料进料口、产物出料口、冷却水进口、冷却水出口、蒸汽进口和蒸汽出口，其中保温夹套位于反应器壳体外部，冷却水进口位于保温夹套上部，冷却水出口位于保温夹套下部，蒸汽进口位于保温夹套下部，蒸汽出口位于保温夹套上部，搅拌桨位于反应器内中央部位，原料进料口位于反应器封盖上，产物出料口位于反应器底部，其特征在于在反应器内还按置有由上而下的金属网，将反应器分隔成内外两圈，搅拌桨位于内圈。根据权利要求1所述用于苯酚羟基化制苯二酚的反应器，其特征在于金属网为60～300目的不锈钢金属网。根据权利要求2所述用于苯酚羟基化制苯二酚的反应器，其特征在于金属网为160～180目的不锈钢金属网。根据权利要求1所述用于苯酚羟基化制苯二酚的反应器，其特征在于产物出料口位于内圈内。
content_en: a kind of reactor that is used for the phenol hydroxylation preparing benzenediol, comprise reactor shell, the reactor capping, stirring rake, insulation jacket, material inlet, the product discharge port, entrance of cooling water, cooling water outlet, steam inlet and vapour outlet, wherein insulation jacket is positioned at the reactor enclosure external body, entrance of cooling water is positioned at insulation jacket top, cooling water outlet is positioned at the insulation jacket bottom, steam inlet is positioned at the insulation jacket bottom, vapour outlet is positioned at insulation jacket top, stirring rake is positioned at the reactor central part, material inlet is positioned in the reactor capping, the product discharge port is positioned at reactor bottom, it is characterized in that in reactor also by the wire netting that is equipped with from top to bottom, reactor is separated into inside and outside two circles, and stirring rake is positioned at inner ring. it is characterized in that wire netting is 60～300 purpose Stainless Steel Wire Meshes according to the described reactor that is used for the phenol hydroxylation preparing benzenediol of claim 1. it is characterized in that wire netting is 160～180 purpose Stainless Steel Wire Meshes according to the described reactor that is used for the phenol hydroxylation preparing benzenediol of claim 2. it is characterized in that the product discharge port is positioned at inner ring according to the described reactor that is used for the phenol hydroxylation preparing benzenediol of claim 1.

content_cn: 根据权利要求10所述的方法，其特征在于，所述将基底依次传送至选择的真空线的各级真空过渡室，抽真空使真空度达到各真空过渡室对应的预设真空度时，所述方法还包括：将所述基底传送至选择的真空线的清洗真空室，抽真空使真空度达到所述清洗真空室的真空度，并对所述基底进行等离子清洗。一种滤波器腔体膜层的制备方法，其特征在于，采用权利要求1至8任一项所述的真空镀膜设备制备的滤波器腔体膜层。根据权利要求19所述的方法，其特征在于，制备所述滤波器腔体膜层的靶材包括：Cr靶、Cu靶、Ag靶；沉积膜层时，在所述滤波器腔体上依次沉积Cr层，Cu层，Ag层。根据权利要求19所述的方法，其特征在于，制备所述滤波器腔体膜层的靶材包括：Cr靶、Cu靶、Ag-Ta靶；沉积膜层时，在所述滤波器腔体上依次沉积Cr层，Cu层，Ag-Ta层。
content_en: The method according to claim 10, characterized in that, when the substrates are sequentially transferred to the vacuum transition chambers of each level of the selected vacuum line, a vacuum is applied so that the degree of vacuum reaches a preset vacuum degree corresponding to each vacuum transition chamber. The method also includes: The substrate is transferred to a cleaning vacuum chamber of a selected vacuum line, and the vacuum is evacuated so that the degree of vacuum reaches the vacuum degree of the cleaning vacuum chamber, and the substrate is subjected to plasma cleaning. A method for preparing a filter cavity film layer, which is characterized by using the filter cavity film layer prepared by the vacuum coating device according to any one of claims 1 to 8. The method according to claim 19, wherein the target material for preparing the filter cavity film layer comprises: a Cr target, a Cu target, and an Ag target; when the film layer is deposited, sequentially on the filter cavity Deposition of Cr layer, Cu layer, Ag layer. The method according to claim 19, wherein the target material for preparing the film layer of the filter cavity comprises: a Cr target, a Cu target, and an Ag-Ta target; when the film layer is deposited, the filter cavity is A Cr layer, a Cu layer, and an Ag-Ta layer are sequentially deposited on it.

content_cn: 一种排水盒组件，其特征在于，应用于衣物处理设备，所述衣物处理设备设有上下依次设置的第一桶和第二桶，所述排水盒组件包括：盒体(1)，所述盒体(1)上设置有用于与衣物处理设备的第一桶连通的第一进水口(11)、用于与衣物处理设备的第二桶连通的第二进水口(12)以及用于将所述盒体(1)内的水排出的总出水口(13)；所述第一进水口(11)位置高于所述第二进水口(12)位置，所述第二进水口(12)位置高于所述总出水口(13)位置；所述盒体(1)中形成有相互连通的第一排水腔和第二排水腔，所述第一排水腔与第二排水腔的连通位置高于所述总出水口(13)所处高度；所述第一排水腔用于容纳从所述第一进水口(11)进入的水，所述第二排水腔用于容纳从所述第二进水口(12)进入的水；所述总出水口(13)与所述第一排水腔连通，所述第二排水腔中的水通过进入所述第一排水腔从所述总出水口(13)排出。如权利要求1所述的排水盒组件，其特征在于，所述排水盒组件还设有与所述盒体(1)配合的上盖(14)以及位于所述盒体(1)内的挡板(7)，所述挡板(7)上设有连通所述第一排水腔和第二排水腔的通孔或所述挡板(7)与所述上盖(14)之间间隔有间隙使所述第一排水腔和第二排水腔连通。如权利要求1或2所述的排水盒组件，其特征在于，所述排水盒组件还包括液位监测装置(2)；所述液位监测装置(2)包括第一探针和第二探针，所述第一探针位于所述第一排水腔中，所述第二探针位于所述第二排水腔中；当所述第二探针检测到所述第二排水腔中有水，且第一探针检测到所述第一排水腔中有水时，所述第一探针和第二探针向外输出有水信号。
content_en: A drainage box assembly, characterized in that it is applied to a clothes processing device, wherein the clothes processing device is provided with a first barrel and a second barrel arranged in sequence up and down, and the drainage box assembly comprises: A box body (1), the box body (1) being provided with a first water inlet (11) for communicating with a first barrel of a clothes processing device, a second water inlet (12) for communicating with a second barrel of the clothes processing device, and a total water outlet (13) for discharging water in the box body (1); the first water inlet (11) is located higher than the second water inlet (12), and the second water inlet (12) is located higher than the total water outlet (13); A first drainage cavity and a second drainage cavity which are connected to each other are formed in the box body (1), and the communication position between the first drainage cavity and the second drainage cavity is higher than the height of the total water outlet (13); The first drainage cavity is used to accommodate water entering from the first water inlet (11), and the second drainage cavity is used to accommodate water entering from the second water inlet (12); The main water outlet (13) is in communication with the first drainage cavity, and water in the second drainage cavity enters the first drainage cavity and is discharged from the main water outlet (13). The drainage box assembly according to claim 1, characterized in that: The drainage box assembly is also provided with an upper cover (14) matched with the box body (1) and a baffle (7) located inside the box body (1); the baffle (7) is provided with a through hole connecting the first drainage cavity and the second drainage cavity, or a gap is provided between the baffle (7) and the upper cover (14) so that the first drainage cavity and the second drainage cavity are connected. The drainage box assembly according to claim 1 or 2, characterized in that the drainage box assembly further comprises a liquid level monitoring device (2); The liquid level monitoring device (2) comprises a first probe and a second probe, wherein the first probe is located in the first drainage cavity and the second probe is located in the second drainage cavity; when the second probe detects that there is water in the second drainage cavity and the first probe detects that there is water in the first drainage cavity, the first probe and the second probe output water signals to the outside.

content_cn: 一种衣物处理设备的称重方法，所述衣物处理设备包括衣物处理桶和连接在所述衣物处理桶上的阻尼器，其特征在于，所述方法包括：获得阻尼器在衣物处理桶投放负载后的第一形变量；使衣物处理桶加速升速到预设转速，利用电流测量方法检测筒内衣物重量，得到衣物测量重量；检测阻尼器的第二形变量，确定阻尼器的形变量的变化率；根据所述阻尼器的形变量及其对应的形变量变化率确定修正系数，对所述衣物测量重量进行修正，得到筒内衣物的实际重量。如权利要求1所述的方法，其特征在于，所述根据所述阻尼器的形变量及其对应的形变量变化率对所述衣物测量重量进行修正，包括：将所述形变量与形变量设定值进行比较，以及将所述形变量变化率与形变率设定值进行比较；在所述形变量大于所述形变量设定值，且所述形变量变化率大于所述形变率设定值的情况下，根据所述形变量和所述形变量变化率确定修正系数，对所述衣物测量重量进行修正。如权利要求2所述的方法，其特征在于，所述方法还包括：在所述形变量小于或等于所述形变量设定值，且所述形变量变化率小于或等于所述形变率设定值的情况下，或，在所述形变量大于所述形变量设定值，且所述形变量变化率小于或等于所述形变率设定值的情况下，确定修正系数为1，将所述衣物测量重量作为筒内衣物的实际重量；或，在所述形变量小于或等于所述形变量设定值，且所述形变量变化率大于所述形变率设定值的情况下，进行故障提醒并中止称重程序。
content_en: A weighing method for laundry treatment equipment, the laundry treatment equipment includes a laundry treatment barrel and a damper connected to the laundry treatment barrel, characterized in that the method includes: Obtain the first deformation amount of the damper after the load is placed in the laundry barrel; Accelerate the clothes processing barrel to a preset speed, use the current measurement method to detect the weight of the clothes in the barrel, and obtain the measured weight of the clothes; detect the second deformation amount of the damper and determine the change rate of the deformation amount of the damper; A correction coefficient is determined based on the deformation amount of the damper and its corresponding deformation amount change rate, and the measured weight of the clothing is corrected to obtain the actual weight of the clothing in the tube. The method of claim 1, wherein correcting the measured weight of the clothing according to the deformation amount of the damper and its corresponding deformation amount change rate includes: Compare the deformation amount with the deformation amount set value, and compare the deformation amount change rate with the deformation rate set value; In the case where the deformation amount is greater than the deformation amount set value and the deformation amount change rate is greater than the deformation rate set value, a correction coefficient is determined based on the deformation amount and the deformation amount change rate. The laundry measurement weight is corrected. The method of claim 2, further comprising: When the deformation amount is less than or equal to the deformation amount set value, and the deformation amount change rate is less than or equal to the deformation rate set value, or when the deformation amount is greater than the deformation amount set value, fixed value, and the deformation amount change rate is less than or equal to the deformation rate set value, determine the correction coefficient to be 1, and use the measured weight of the clothing as the actual weight of the clothing in the tube; Or, when the deformation amount is less than or equal to the deformation amount set value, and the deformation amount change rate is greater than the deformation rate set value, a fault reminder is issued and the weighing process is stopped.

content_cn: 根据权利要求6所述的一种烘干设备的控制方法，其特征在于：所述烘干风道包括将桶体内的风导入烘干风道的进风口，控制获取烘干风道进风口处的进风量Q2，控制所述预设出风量Q0与所述进风量Q2成正相关关系。根据权利要求7所述的一种烘干设备的控制方法，其特征在于：预设最小出风量Qmin,且Qmin＜Q0，将获取的出风量Q1与最小出风量Qmin进行比较，若Q＜Qmin，则控制烘干设备发出提示信息，用于提醒用户疏通烘干风道；和/或，计算获取的进风量Q2与出风量Q1的差值△Q＇，预设差值△Q0＇，将获取的差值△Q＇与预设差值△Q0＇进行比较，若△Q＇＞△Q0＇，则控制烘干设备发出提示信息，用于提醒用户疏通烘干风道。根据权利要求1-3任一所述的一种烘干设备的控制方法，其特征在于：所述烘干设备包括用于向烘干风道内进风的风机，控制减小烘干风道的送风量Q包括：控制减小风机的转速。一种烘干设备，其特征在于：采用上述权利要求1-9任一所述的控制方法控制。

The air inlet volume Q2 at the air outlet controls the preset air outlet volume Q0 to have a positive correlation with the air inlet volume Q2. content_cn: 一种衣物处理装置的腔体，其特征在于：所述腔体(1)内设有多个可以独立工作、处理不同衣物的腔室，所述多个腔室相互嵌设在一起。如权利要求1所述的衣物处理装置的腔体，其特征在于：所述腔体(1)包括壳体，所述多个腔室设置在所述壳体内，所述多个腔室至少两个腔室之间和/或所述多个腔室中的至少一个与所述壳体内壁之间形成可拆卸的凸凹配合嵌设关系。如权利要求1所述的衣物处理装置的腔体，其特征在于：所述衣物处理装置包括壳体，所述多个腔室形成在所述壳体内，且所述壳体在所述多个腔室之间设有隔板(2)将所述多个腔室分隔成所述多个独立工作的腔室；且每相邻两个腔室之间的隔板(2)还在相邻两个腔室的嵌设区形成一可用于相邻两个腔室的功能区。
content_en: A cavity of a clothes processing device is characterized in that: the cavity (1) is provided with a plurality of chambers that can work independently and process different clothes, and the plurality of chambers are embedded in each other. The cavity of the laundry treatment device according to claim 1, characterized in that: the cavity (1) comprises a shell, the plurality of chambers are arranged in the shell, and the plurality of chambers are at least two A detachable convex-concave fitting embedded relationship is formed between the two chambers and/or between at least one of the plurality of chambers and the inner wall of the housing. The cavity of the laundry treatment device according to claim 1, wherein the laundry treatment device comprises a housing, the plurality of chambers are formed in the housing, and the housing is in the plurality of A partition (2) is provided between the chambers to divide the multiple chambers into the multiple independently working chambers; and the partition (2) between every two adjacent chambers is still adjacent The embedded area of the two chambers forms a functional area that can be used for two adjacent chambers.

content_cn: 一种基于电机功率的脱水漂洗方法，其特征在于，所述基于电机功率的脱水漂洗方法在主洗完成后进行，所述基于电机功率的脱水漂洗方法包括：获取脱水漂洗指令，并进入脱水漂洗程序，所述脱水漂洗程序包括：控制排水组件(40)启动；控制喷淋组件(30)向洗涤装置的外筒洗涤腔(21)喷水，并控制电机带动筒体(20)转动，以对所述筒体(20)内的衣物进行脱水；获取所述电机的功率；根据所述电机的功率选定与预设功率区间相匹配的子脱水漂洗程序；在不同的所述子脱水漂洗程序中，所述喷淋组件(30)的运行时长、所述排水组件(40)的运行时长、所述电机的转速中的至少一者不同。根据权利要求1所述的基于电机功率的脱水漂洗方法，其特征在于，在不同的所述子脱水漂洗程序中，所述预设功率区间的端点值越大，对应的所述电机的转速越小；和/或所述预设功率区间的端点值越大，对应的所述子脱水漂洗程序的运行时长越长。
content_en: A dehydration rinsing method based on motor power, characterized in that, the dehydration rinsing method based on motor power is performed after main washing is completed, and the dehydration rinsing method based on motor power comprises: acquiring a dehydration rinsing instruction, and entering dehydration rinsing program, the dehydration and rinsing program includes: control the drain assembly (40) to start; Controlling the spray assembly (30) to spray water into the outer tub washing chamber (21) of the washing device, and controlling the motor to drive the tub (20) to rotate, so as to dehydrate the clothes in the tub (20); Get the power of the motor; Selecting a sub-dehydration and rinsing program matching the preset power interval according to the power of the motor; In different sub-dehydration and rinsing procedures, at least one of the operation time of the spray assembly (30), the operation time of the drainage assembly (40), and the rotation speed of the motor is different. The dehydration and rinsing method based on motor power according to claim 1, wherein in different sub-dehydration and rinsing procedures, The larger the endpoint value of the preset power interval, the smaller the corresponding rotational speed of the motor; and/or The larger the endpoint value of the preset power interval, the longer the corresponding running duration of the sub-dehydration and rinsing program.

content_cn: 根据权利要求1所述的干衣机蒸发器的清洗方法，其特征在于：向蒸发器喷雾的喷雾量决定于使干衣机滚筒内的空气温度降低1-2℃。根据权利要求1所述的干衣机蒸发器的清洗方法，其特征在于：在干衣机内部还设置第二喷雾装置以向干衣机滚筒内的衣物喷雾。一种干衣机蒸发器清洗装置，其特征在于：包括至少一个第一喷雾装置及安装在蒸发器下方的积水盒，所述第一喷雾装置向所述蒸发器喷雾，所述第一喷雾装置通过水管与自来水源连接。根据权利要求6所述的一种干衣机蒸发器清洗装置，其特征在于：在所述第一喷雾装置与自来水源之间的水管上串接有进水阀，所述进水阀与控制器连接，所述控制器中具有用于判定烘干后形成的湿热空气是否达到饱和状态的判断模块。
content_en: A method of cleaning a dryer of an dryer according to claim 1, wherein the amount of spray to the evaporator is determined by lowering the temperature of the air in the dryer drum by 1-2 °C. A method of cleaning a dryer of an dryer according to claim 1, wherein a second spraying means is further disposed inside the dryer to spray the laundry in the dryer drum. A dryer cleaning device for a clothes dryer, comprising: at least one first spraying device and a water collecting box installed under the evaporator, the first spraying device spraying the evaporator, the first spray The device is connected to the tap water source through a water pipe. A dryer cleaning device for a clothes dryer according to claim 6, wherein a water inlet valve is connected in series to the water pipe between the first spray device and the tap water source, and the water inlet valve and the control valve are connected. The controller is connected to the controller, and the controller has a determination module for determining whether the hot and humid air formed after drying reaches a saturated state.

content_cn: 根据权利要求7所述的风道结构，其特征在于，下竖直部包括上子竖直部和下子竖直部，上子竖直部的内部和中竖直部的内部形成转换腔，下子竖直部的底壁上设左右分布的两个第二抵接部，两个第二抵接部将下子竖直部分隔为右段腔、中段腔和左段腔，两个第二抵接部的第一部分分别向中段腔内弯折形成圆弧状的第二部分，换向板与第二部分顶部外侧的圆弧面相抵。根据权利要求8所述的风道结构，其特征在于，两个第一抵接部相对风道竖直方向的中心对称设置，两个第二抵接部相对风道竖直方向的中心对称设置，第二抵接部的第二部分设于第一抵接部的正下方。一种具有烘干功能的衣物处理装置，包括衣物处理腔，衣物处理腔内部具有挂设衣物的空间，其特征在于，还包括权利要求1-9任一项所述的风道结构，风道具有分别与衣物处理腔顶、底部连通的上风口和下风口，换向板用于切换第一风道与上风口或下风口连通，以及第二风道与下风口或上风口连通。
content_en: The air duct structure according to claim 7 is characterized in that the lower vertical portion includes an upper sub-vertical portion and a lower sub-vertical portion, the interior of the upper sub-vertical portion and the interior of the middle vertical portion form a conversion cavity, and two second abutting portions distributed on the left and right are provided on the bottom wall of the lower sub-vertical portion, and the two second abutting portions separate the lower sub-vertical portion into a right section cavity, a middle section cavity and a left section cavity, and the first portions of the two second abutting portions are respectively bent into the middle section cavity to form an arc-shaped second portion, and the reversing plate abuts against the arc surface on the outer side of the top of the second portion. The air duct structure according to claim 8 is characterized in that the two first abutting portions are symmetrically arranged relative to the center of the air duct in the vertical direction, the two second abutting portions are symmetrically arranged relative to the center of the air duct in the vertical direction, and the second part of the second abutting portion is arranged directly below the first abutting portion. A clothing processing device with a drying function, comprising a clothing processing chamber, the interior of the clothing processing chamber having a space for hanging clothing, characterized in that it also comprises the air duct structure according to any one of claims 1 to 9, the air duct having an upper air outlet and a lower air outlet respectively connected to the top and bottom of the clothing processing chamber, and a reversing plate for switching the first air duct to be connected to the upper air outlet or the lower air outlet, and the second air duct to be connected to the lower air outlet or the upper air outlet.

content_cn: 一种洗衣机脱水控制方法，其特征在于，洗衣机在脱水开始前获取桶内第一水位高度和衣物堆积高度对应的第二水位高度，在脱水不平衡时根据第一水位和第二水位进水进行平衡修正。根据权利要求1所述的洗衣机脱水控制方法，其特征在于，所述第二水位高度不低于衣物在桶内的堆积高度。根据权利要求1所述的洗衣机脱水控制方法，其特征在于，洗衣机在放入衣物运行脱水后，首先检测洗涤桶内的水位并记录为第一水位，之后排水至空桶水位。根据权利要求1～3任意一项所述的洗衣机脱水控制方法，其特征在于，洗衣机在脱水过程检测到洗涤桶不平衡时，选择第一水位和第二水位中较高的水位作为进水水位进行平衡修正。
content_en: A washing machine dehydration control method, characterized in that the washing machine obtains the first water level in the tub and the second water level corresponding to the laundry accumulation height before the dehydration starts, and performs water intake according to the first water level and the second water level when the dehydration is unbalanced Balance correction. The method for controlling dehydration of a washing machine according to claim 1, wherein the height of the second water level is not lower than the stacking height of the laundry in the tub. The method for controlling the dehydration of a washing machine according to claim 1, wherein the washing machine first detects the water level in the washing tub and records it as the first water level after the laundry is put into the dehydration operation, and then drains to the empty tub water level. The washing machine dehydration control method according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein when the washing machine detects that the washing tub is unbalanced during the dehydration process, the higher water level of the first water level and the second water level is selected as the water inlet water level Perform balance corrections.

content_cn: 一种衣物处理设备的控制方法，其特征在于，所述衣物处理设备包括洗涤设备和烘干设备，在所述洗涤设备和所述烘干设备处于联动的情况下，所述控制方法包括：获取所述洗涤设备的洗涤程序和待处理衣物的衣物信息；根据所述洗涤程序匹配所述烘干设备相对应的烘干程序；根据所述烘干程序，获取相对应的烘干参数；根据所述衣物信息和所述烘干参数，确定目标烘干时间T；控制所述烘干设备按照所述目标烘干时间T烘干。根据权利要求1所述的衣物处理设备的控制方法，其特征在于，“根据所述烘干程序，获取相对应的烘干参数”的步骤具体包括：根据所述烘干程序，获取初始烘干时间T0和目标含水率W0。根据权利要求2所述的衣物处理设备的控制方法，其特征在于，“根据所述衣物信息和所述烘干参数，确定目标烘干时间T”的步骤具体包括：根据所述衣物信息和所述目标含水率W0，计算补偿烘干时间T1；根据所述初始烘干时间T0和所述补偿烘干时间T1，确定目标烘干时间T。
content_en: A control method for a clothes processing device, characterized in that the clothes processing device comprises a washing device and a drying device, and when the washing device and the drying device are in linkage, the control method comprises: Acquiring a washing program of the washing device and clothing information of the clothing to be processed; Matching a drying program corresponding to the drying device according to the washing program; According to the drying program, obtaining corresponding drying parameters; Determining a target drying time T according to the clothing information and the drying parameters; The drying device is controlled to dry according to the target drying time T. content_cn: 1.一种文字输入方法，用于包括处理芯片、触摸屏、以及加速度传感器的穿戴设备中，所述加速度传感器、所述处理芯片均与所述处理芯片连接，其特征在于，在输入法启动时，在触摸屏的周侧进行手动操作，在所述处理芯片侧，包括以下步骤：a1、接收所述加速度传感器在所述手动操作时采集到的三轴的加速度数据序列，并传至步骤a2；其中，所述三轴分别沿垂直于所述触摸屏的z轴、以及互相垂直且均平行于所述触摸屏的x轴和y轴；a2、根据采集到的三轴加速度数据序列得到手动操作特征值，并传至步骤a3；a3、根据该手动操作特征值得到与之相映射的控制信号，并传至步骤a4；其中，所述处理芯片中预存有每种手动操作特征值映射的控制信号；a4、执行所述控制信号，并将执行该控制信号所对应的结果显示于触摸屏中。2.根据权利要求1所述的文字输入方法，其特征在于，在步骤a1和a2之间，还包括步骤：a0、对采集到的三轴加速度数据序列进行预处理，以去除冗余数据，并将去掉冗余数据的三轴加速度数据序列传至步骤a2。

content_cn: 11.一种控制烹饪模式的装置，包括：识别模块，用于识别待烹饪的食物的种类，并获取操作对象定制的所述食物的至少一种口感数据；第一确定模块，用于基于所述食物的种类，确定对应的深度确定性策略梯度模型；第一调整模块，用于使用确定的深度确定性策略梯度模型处理所述食物的至少一种口感数据，获取调整数据，其中，所述调整数据用于调整烹饪参数；第二确定模块，用于基于调整数据确定调整后的烹饪模式。12.根据权利要求11所述的装置，其特征在于，所述装置还包括：制定模块，用于在使用确定的深度确定性策略梯度模型处理所述食物的至少一种口感数据，获取调整数据之前，针对不同种类的食物训练得到不同的深度确定性策略梯度模型，并针对不同的深度确定性策略梯度模型制定相应的烹饪模式。13.根据权利要求11或12所述的装置，其特征在于，所述装置还包括：判断模块，用于在识别待烹饪的食物的种类之后，判断是否接收到进入调整烹饪模式的指令；执行模块，用于如果接收到所述指令，进入获取操作对象定制的所述食物的至少一种口感数据的步骤；如果没有接收到所述指令，控制烹饪器具按照预先设定的烹饪模式进行工作。

【背景技术】 红外感应器已经广泛应用于自动水龙头、 自动冲水小便斗、 抽水马桶冲洗设备、 喷射热水的马桶坐圈、 手干燥器和装有热风风扇的抽水马桶等卫生设备中。 传统的红外感应器大部分采用主动式红外感应方式， 即红外发射器发射一定波长 的红外线， 经人体反射后， 通过红外接收器接收后， 判断该反射信号强度， 来实现自 动感应判断。 然而， 一些对红外线反射率低的物质 （如黑色衣服、 头发等）， 就很难实 现自动感应判断。 红外发射器的红外光经过该些物质反射后， 只有极少数的红外光线 被红外接收器接收。 由于反射信号的强度不够， 而导致感应器无法判断是否有目标物 存在， 因而导致感应失灵。 为了解决上述传统红外感应洁具感应失灵的问题， 将距离检测感应装置 （PSD ) 引入卫浴自动化领域内。 如图 9所示， PSD传感器是一种对入射光位置敏感的光电器 件。 即当入射光照在器件感光面的不同位置时， PSD将输出不同的电信号。 PSD传感 器是利用三角测量原理， 能够精确测量距离的特点来实现的自动感应判断。 如图 9所 示， 光源发出的光经透镜 L1聚焦后投向待测体的表面。 反射光由透镜 L2聚焦到一维 PSD上， 形成一个光点。 若透镜 L1与 L2间的中心距离为 b， 透镜 L2到 PSD表面之 间的距离 （即透镜 L2的焦距） 为 f， 聚焦在 PSD表面的光点距离透镜 L2中心的距离 为 x， 则根据相似三角形 PAB和 BCD的性质， 可得出待测距离 DIS为： DIS = bf/x。 因此， 只要测出 PSD的光点位置坐标 X的值， 即可测出待测体的距离。 当检测到待测体的距离位于预先设定的范围内时， 距离检测感应装置控制卫生洁 具的进行出水、 冲水等工作状态。 由于距离检测感应装置判断目标物与距离检测感应 装置的距离来实现自动感应的目的， 而不是判断发射信号的强度， 从而可有效解决传 统红外感应所存在"因反射信号的强度不够而导致感应失灵"的缺陷。 然而， 利用该距离检测感应装置需要各部件具有较高的定位精度， 因此如何保证 感应装置的定位精度需要解决。
【发明内容】 本发明的目的在于提供一种具有较高定位精度的距离检测感应装置。 本发明的目的是通过如下技术方案实现的： 一种距离检测感应装置， 包括： 壳体、 聚焦用的透镜、 电路板、 红外线发射装置、 感应发射光线的接收装置以及起屏蔽作用 的遮蔽罩。 其中壳体包括主体部以及位于主体部顶面上的两圆形开孔。 透镜包括设置 于壳体开孔位置处的发射透镜和接收透镜。 电路板安装于壳体主体部内， 设有若干电 子元器件， 对信号进行处理。 发射装置为发光二极管， 安装在电路板上， 发射红外光 线到发射透镜。 接收装置为距离检测感应模块， 安装在电路板上， 感应从接收透镜聚 焦下来的反射光线。 所述发射透镜与接收透镜之间还设有一连接部， 该连接部包括至 少一弯折部。 进一步地， 所述连接部为两次弯折而成， 呈 Z形。 进一步地， 所述透镜的下方为圆柱形结构。 进一步地， 所述透镜与壳体之间采用注塑成型的方式安装在一起。 进一步地， 还包括一安装于发射透镜与发射装置之间或接收透镜与接收装置之间 的密封件。 进一歩地， 还包括一通过螺钉固定在壳体上的排线整理装置。 进一步地， 还包括显示工作状态或异常情况的指示灯， 该指示灯安装在电路板上 并位于发射装置附近。 进一歩地， 遮蔽罩， 安装于发射装置与接收装置的周围， 防止电磁干扰。 进一步地， 遮蔽罩分为相互焊接的第一、 第二遮蔽罩， 其中第一遮蔽罩通过螺钉 与壳体固定并与电路板接触而实现接地， 而第二遮蔽罩通过卡扣结构与壳体固定的， 所述发射和接收装置被安装于遮蔽罩与电路板之间。 进一步地， 壳体为导电材料制成。 与现有技术相比， 本发明距离检测感应装置具有较高的定位精度， 提高整机感应 性能。

5安装在电子元器件之间，能充分利用壳体 1内部以及电路板 3上、 下两侧面的空间。 综上所述， 这样设置可以降低整个距离检测感应装置 100的高度、 减小体积。 另外， 发射装置 4和接收装置 5安装后位于电路板 3 (也可起到屏蔽效果） 与遮 蔽罩 6之间， 可以有效屏蔽外部的干扰。 本发明距离检测感应装置 100的发射装置 4和接收装置 5通过定位支架 7、8固定， 确保发射装置 4和接收装置 5的位置精度。该定位支架 7、 8通过与壳体 1配合固定而 可保证发射装置 4和接收装置 5与壳体 1的相对位置。 将发射装置 4和接收装置 5安 装至定位支架 7、 8相应的收容部后再进行焊接固定，而可保证其位置精度不受安装的 影响， 从而可以有效防止将发射装置 4和接收装置 5焊接在电路板 3上， 因为安装工 艺等问题而导致安装精度不够，距离检测感应装置 100效果不理想， 甚至失效的缺点。 另外， 本发明距离检测感应装置 100生产成本较低， 利于普及应用。 虽然上面已经揭示了本发明的具体实施方式， 但是它们不是本发明范围的局限， 熟知本技术领域的人员对以上所述具体实施的修改和变化也包含在本发明的范围之 内。

1.  A distance detection induction device comprises a housing, a condensing lens, a circuit board, an infrared light emitting means for emitting the infrared light, a light receiving means for receiving and sensing the infrared light which is emitted by the infrared light emitting means and reflected by target, and a shielding cover, wherein said housing comprises a main body and two round openings on the top of said main body; said condensing lens comprises an emitting lens and a receiving lens respectively located at said two round openings; said circuit board bearing multi-electronic components is used for processing signal and is mounted inside said main body; said infrared light emitting means is an infrared light-emitting diode mounted on said circuit board, and emits the infrared light to said emitting lens; said light receiving means is a distance detecting sensing module mounted on said circuit board to sense the reflected light focused by said receiving lens, characterized in that a connection part having at least a bending part is set between said emitting lens and said receiving lens.
2.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that said connection part is bent twice, as "z" shape.
3.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that the lower parts of said condensing lens are made into the cylindrical structure.
4.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that said condensing lens and said housing are installed together by injection molding.
5.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that said distance detection induction device also includes a sealing component mounted between said emitting lens and said infrared light emitting means or between said receiving lens and said light receiving means.
6.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that said distance detection induction device also includes a circuit wire disposing means fixed in said housing by screws.
7.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that said distance detection induction device also includes an indicator mounted on said circuit board and near said infrared light emitting means for demonstrating the normal or the non-normal status of the distance detection induction device.
8.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that said shielding cover is mounted around said infrared light emitting means and said light receiving means, keeping said infrared light emitting means and said light receiving means from the electromagnetic interference.
9.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 8, characterized in that said shielding cover comprises the first shielding cover and the second shielding cover welded with said first shielding cover, wherein said first shielding cover is fixed in said housing by screws and is touched with said circuit board for grounding, while said second shielding cover is fixed to said housing by the clip structure, said infrared light emitting means and said light receiving means are mounted between said shielding cover and said circuit board.
10.  The distance detection induction device according to claim 1, characterized in that said housing is made of conducting material.Field of the Invention
[0001]The present invention relates to an infrared induction device, particularly to a distance detection induction device applied in the automatic operation for sanitation and bathroom, such as automatic sensing faucet, automatic flush urinal etc.
Background of the Invention
[0002]The infrared sensor has been widely used in the sanitary equipments, such as automatic sensing faucet, automatic flush urinal, flush facilities of the toilet, toilet seat having the hot water sprayer, hand dryer, toilet having the fan providing hot blast, etc.
[0003]Most of traditional infrared sensors adopt the active sensing method, i.e. the infrared emitter emits the infrared light with certain wavelength, and then the infrared receiver receives the infrared light after the reflection of the human body, further the infrared sensor judges the intensity oil the reflected signals to realize the automatic sensing and judging. However, the infrared sensor could not complete the automatic sensing and judging if the target has low reflectivity to infrared light (for example, the black clothing, hair, etc.). There is only few infrared light could be received by the infrared receiver after the infrared light from the infrared emitter was reflected by such matter. The intensity of the reflected signals is not strong enough, so that the above infrared sensor fails to judge whether there is a target existing in the sensing area.
[0004]To solve the above-mentioned problem of induction malfunction in the traditional infrared sensing sanitary ware, the Position Sensitive Detector (PSD) is introduced to the automatic operation for sanitation and bathroom. Shown as Fig. 9, the PSD sensor is a kind of photoelectric apparatus which is sensitive to the position of the incident light. When the incident light irradiates on the different position of the photosensitive surface of the PSD, the PSD will send out the different electrical signal. Using the triangulation principle, the PSD can accurately survey the distance to realize the auto-induction judgment. Shown as Fig. 9, the light from the light source irradiates on the surface of the detected target after focused by the lens L1. The reflected light is focused onto the one-dimensional PSD by the lens L2 and forms a luminous spot. If the distance between the center of the lens L1 and the center of the lens L2 is "b", the distance from the lens L2 to the surface of the PSD is "f", the distance between the luminous spot focused on the surface of the PSD and the center of the lens L2 is "x", the detected distance DIS can be expressed as: DIS=bf/x according to the principle of the similar triangles PAB and BCD. Therefore, so long as the value of the distance between the luminous spot focused on the surface of the PSD and the center of the lens L2 "x" is surveyed, the detected distance DIS can be determined.
[0005]When the distances of the detected target body fall into the pre-determined range, the distance detection induction device will control the sanitary fittings to work. Because the distance detection induction device achieves the purpose of the auto-induction by the way of judging the distance between the target and the distance detection induction device, not by the way of judging the intensity of the emitting signal, the problem of the induction malfunction caused by weak reflected signal in the traditional infrared sensing devices is solved.
[0006]However, it is necessary that the components of the distance detection induction device have higher positioning precision, therefore, so how to ensure the positioning precision of the Device need to be solved.
Summary of the Invention
[0007]The object of the present invention is to provide a distance detection induction device having higher positioning precision.
[0008]The purpose of the present invention is realized by the following technical solutions: a distance detection induction device comprises a housing, a condensing lens, a circuit board, an infrared light emitting means, a light receiving means for receiving and sensing the light which is emitted by the infrared light emitting means and reflected by target, and a shielding cover. The housing comprises a main body and two round opening on the top of the main body. The condensing lens comprises an emitting lens and a receiving lens located at the opening of the housing. The circuit board bearing multiple electronic components for processing signal is mounted inside the main body of the housing. The infrared light emitting means is light-emitting diode fixed on said circuit board, and emits the infrared light to the emitting lens. The light receiving meals is distance detecting sensing module fixed on said circuit board to sense the reflected light focused by the receiving lens. A connection part having at least a bending part is set between the emitting lens and the receiving lens.
[0009]Further, said connection part is bent twice as "z" shape.
[0010]Further, said lower parts of the condensing tens are made into the cylindrical structure.
[0011]Further, said condensing lens and said housing are combined together by injection molding.
[0012]Further, said distance detection induction device also comprises a sealing component mounted between the emitting lens and the infrared light emitting means or between the receiving lens and the light receiving means.
[0013]Further, the distance detection induction device also comprises a circuit wire disposing means fixed in the housing by screws.
[0014]Further, the distance detection induction device also comprises an indicator mounted on the circuit board and near the infrared light emitting means for demonstrating the normal or non-normal status of the distance detection induction device.
[0015]Further, said shielding cover is mounted around the infrared light emitting means and the light receiving means, keeping the infrared light emitting means and the light receiving means from the electromagnetic interference.
[0016]Further, said shielding cover comprises the first shielding cover and the second shielding cover, which are welded together, wherein the first shielding cover is fixed in the housing by screws and is touched with the circuit board for grounding, the second shielding cover is fixed to the housing by the clip structure, the infrared light emitting means and the light receiving means are mounted between the shielding cover and the circuit board.
[0017]Further, the housing is made of conducting material.
[0018]Compared with prior art, the components of the distance detection induction device of the present invention has higher positioning precision and can enhance induction performance of the overall device.
Brief Description of the Drawings
[0019] Fig. 1a is the three-dimensional view of the distance detection induction device of the present invention. Fig. 1b is the three-dimensional view of the distance detection induction device of the present invention from other angle. Fig. 2 is the exploded schematic drawing of the distance detection induction device of the present invention. Fig. 3 is the exploded schematic drawing of the distance detection induction device of the present invention from other angle. Fig. 4a is a part of the three-dimensional assembly chart of the distance detection induction device of the present invention. Fig. 4b is the schematic drawing of Fig. 4a from other angle. Fig. 4c is the exploded schematic drawing of the structure shown on Fig. 4b. Fig. 5 is the view of the housing of the distance detection induction device of the present invention. Fig. 6 is the view of the emitting positioning bracket of the distance detection induction device of the present invention. Fig. 7a is the exploded schematic drawing of the light receiving means and its positioning bracket of the distance detection induction device of the present invention. Fig. 7b is the view of Fig. 7a from other angle. Fig. 8 is the sectional drawing along A-A in Fig. 1a. Fig. 9 is the principle figure of the distance detection induction device of the prior art. 
Detailed Description of the Invention
[0020]The embodiments of the present invention will be clearly described referring the attached drawings, wherein the same figures are marked for the same structure parts or same function. It is understood that the attached drawings is just for the description of the embodiments of the present invention, not a limitation to the present invention. Besides, the attached drawings are not drawn as the pro rata.
[0021]Shown as Fig. 1 to Fig. 7, the distance detection induction device 100 of the present invention are mainly mounted on all kinds of the automatic sanitary equipments such as an urinal or toilet having automatic sensing device, a tap having automatic sensing device and so on.
[0022]The distance detection induction device 100 of the present invention mainly comprises a housing 1, a condensing lens 2 for focusing, a circuit board 3 bearing multiple electronic components, a infrared light emitting means 4 for emitting the infrared light, a light receiving means 5 for receiving and sensing the reflected infrared light and a shielding cover 6 having the function of electromagnetic shielding.
[0023]In the above device, the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 are mounted on the same side of the circuit board 3. Shown as the embodiments of the present invention, the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 are mounted onto the circuit board 3 by leg welding. The condensing lens 2 is fixed in the housing 1 and lens 2 comprises the emitting lens 21 which focuses and emits the infrared light and the receiving lens 22 which focuses the reflected infrared light onto the light receiving means 5.
[0024]For the distance detection induction device 100, the precise position between the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 should be precisely set. The precise position among the infrared light emitting means 4, the light receiving means 5 and the condensing lens 2 should be precisely set too. Therefore, the distance detection induction device 100 of the present invention comprises an emitting positioning bracket 7 which fixes the infrared light emitting means 4, a receiving positioning bracket 8 which fixes the light receiving means 5. The emitting positioning bracket 7 and the receiving positioning bracket 8 hold the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5, and are coordinately positioned to the housing 1 to ensure the positioning precision of the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5.
[0025]Moreover, the shielding cover 6 is mounted on the periphery of the circuit board 3, and on the side that the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 are mounted to prevent the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 from the electromagnetic interference (EMI) of surroundings.
[0026]The housing 1 comprises a longitudinal long main body 10, the first round opening 11 and the second round opening 12 on the top of the main body 10. The condensing lens 2, the circuit board 3 bearing multiple electronic components, the infrared light emitting means 4, the light receiving means 5 and the shielding cover 6 are all set within the main body 10 of the housing 1. Correspondingly, the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22 of the condensing lens 2 are respectively mounted in the first round opening 11 and the second round opening 12. The housing 1 is made of the insulating material such as ordinary plastic. Indeed, in another embodiment of the present invention, the housing 1 is made of the conducting material such as metal, conducting plastics to prevent from the electromagnetic interference effectively.
[0027]In the superior embodiments of the present invention, the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22 of the condensing lens 2 are installed into the first round opening 11 and the second round opening 12 of the housing 1 by injection molding. Particularly, the installation of the condensing lens 2 and the housing 1 is made by injection molding twice. First, the condensing lens 2 is molded. Then, the molded condensing lens 2 is put into the mold of the housing 1 and is molded together with the housing 1. By injection molding, the problem of seal between the condensing lens 2 and the housing 1 is solved, and it also can ensure the relative positioning precision of the center of the condensing lens 2 and the housing 1. The lower parts of the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22 are all made into the cylindrical structure to ensure the positioning precision during injection molding with the housing 1. Specially, the emitting lens 21 is connected with the receiving lens 22 by the connection part 23. In past design process, the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22 are arranged alone. However, the relative position precision between the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22, and the relative position precision between the condensing lens 2 and both of the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 should be precisely set. It is not easy to control the position precision if the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22 are established alone, and it is too hard to reach the requirements of precision. Thus, the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22 are connected as a whole by a connection part 23 to ensure the position precision. Further, the connection part 23 has at least a bending part to prevent the emitted infrared light emitted by lens 21 from conducting into the receiving lens 22 along the connection part 23 directly. It avoids unnecessary reflection and refraction effect of internal light, and ensures the detecting precision of the distance detection induction device. As shown on Fig. 2 and Fig. 3, the connection part 23 is bended by several times as the "z" shape. Considered from the overall evaluation of cost and effect, in this structure it needs reflecting for two times for the emitted infrared light to conduct into the receiving lens 22 from the emitting lens 21. The optical path turns more complex, which can more effectively prevent the emitted infrared light emitted by lens 21 from conducting into the receiving lens 22 directly. Surely, the bending part can be increased or reduced according to the practical application situation. In another embodiment of the present invention, the condensing lens 2 and the housing I also can be mounted by assembly.
[0028]Multiple electronic components are integrated into the circuit board 3. The first hole 31 and the second hole 32 are placed just opposite to the emitting lens 21 and the receiving lens 22. The first hole 31 allows the emitting positioning bracket 7 passing through. The circuit board 3 processes the signal and transmits the processed data to the master-control unit. Thus, the sanitary fitting is controlled further (not shown in the figure) .
[0029]The infrared light emitting means 4 is infrared light-emitting diodes (IR LED) fixed on the circuit board 3, and located on the under side of the circuit board 3 (As shown as Fig. 2 and Fig. 3, The side of the circuit board 3 that faces the condensing lens 2 is the upside, and the opposite side is the under side of the circuit board 3). An indicator 41. is mounted on the under side of the circuit board 3 near the infrared light emitting means 4, and is used for demonstrating the normal or the non-normal working status of the distance detection induction device 100 such as the insufficiency of the battery capacity.
[0030]The light receiving means 5 is a distance detecting sensing module (PSD Sensing Module) fixed on the circuit board 3, and located on the under side of the circuit board 3.
[0031]The shielding cover 6 is fixed on the base of the housing 1 by the screws 101 and 102 to shield the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5. It includes the first shielding cover 61 and the second shielding cover 62. The first shielding cover 61 is fixed with the housing 1 and is touched with the ground line of the circuit board 3 by the screws 101 and 102 for grounding. The second shielding cover 62 is fixed with the housing 1 by the clip structure and is touched with the first shielding cover 61 by welding for grounding. It is better to set like the above-mentioned means, than to install a whole shielding cover, which will be not easy to be installed.
[0032]The emitting positioning bracket 7 is fixed with the housing 1. It includes a big round hole 71 at the top of the emitting positioning bracket 7 and coordinated with the emitting lens 21, and includes the holder 72 in the bottom of the emitting positioning bracket 7 to hold the infrared light emitting means 4. The diameter of the big round hole 71 is an approximate match to the emitting area of the emitting lens 21. The support stick 73 are set on two sides of the emitting positioning bracket 7 to press against the circuit board 3 closely, so that the circuit board 3 could provide enough bracket force to the emitting positioning bracket 7 correspondingly to avoid many problems, such as the emitting positioning bracket 7 dropping out from the housing 1 during the installation process. Specially, the emitting positioning bracket 7 also includes square protruding parts 74 at the two sides of the emitting positioning bracket 7. The square protruding parts 74 match with the positioning grooves 13 which are on the internal top of the housing 1, so that the emitting positioning bracket 7 and the housing 1 can be positioned. Surely, the square protruding parts 74 also can be set at other positions of the emitting positioning bracket 7 and can be other shapes such as a cylinder protruding stand. The holder 72 of the emitting positioning bracket 7 goes through the first hole 31 in the circuit board 3 from the upside of the circuit board 3, and takes in and positions the infrared light emitting means 4 on the under side of the circuit board 3. The weld legs of the infrared light emitting means 4 are bent after outstretching through the slots (not marked) on the two sides of the holder 72, and are welded on the circuit board 3. The emitting positioning bracket 7 is made of the insulating material. Of course, it also can be made of the conducting material. When the emitting positioning bracket 7 is made of the conducting material, it works as a shield to prevent from the electromagnetic interference.
[0033]Shown as Fig. 6, the emitting positioning bracket 7 also includes a small round hole 75 and an indicating hole 76. The small round hole 75 is near the holder 72 holding the infrared light emitting means 4, and the indicating hole 76 is to show the light emitted by indicator 41. Shown as Fig. 8, the small round hole 75 and the big round hole 71 form the cone-shaped channel of the infrared emission light, so the light is projected from the chip of the infrared light emitting means 4, passing through the small round hole 75 and the big round hole 71, and is projected out after focused by the emitting lens 21. Thus, the light is not projected to other regions of the housing 1 to avoid affecting the efficiency and introducing the light interference. No reflection and refraction of the interior light is projected to the light receiving means 5, and affects the detection effect. The chip of the infrared light emitting means 4 is so big that the emitting light has a big halo, which is a very disadvantageous factor to the light receiving means that needs precise signals and influences the detection result. In this embodiment of the present invention, the infrared light emitted out from the chip of the infrared light emitting means held in the holder 72 only passes through the small round hole 75 to project out. The light passes through the big round hole 71 and is focused by the emitting lens projecting out. The cross-section of the small round hole 75 is smaller than the light emitting area of the infrared light emitting means 4, and the unnecessary light is blocked. It effectively reduces the affection of the halo to the detection signal, and enhances the detection precision. In this case, the emitting positioning bracket 7 is working as the guide means of the emitted light.
[0034]Shown as Fig. 7a and Fig. 7b, the receiving positioning bracket 8 comprises the transom 81 fixed onto the housing 1 and the holder 82 connected together with the transom 81. The holder 82 holds the light receiving means 5. The holder 82 has the holding space 821 holding the light receiving means 5. A rectangular aperture 820 is set on the top of the holder 82 aligning with the second hole 32 on the circuit board 3 to let the received light active at the receiving surface of the light receiving means 5. The holder 82 is formed by extending the middle part of the transom 81 horizontally, so the weld legs of the light receiving means 5 can extend out from the slots on the two sides of the holder 82 to conveniently make the welding. For effective positioning, the two free ends of the transom 81 are fitted with the positioning groove 14 on the two sidewalls of the main body 10 of the housing 1.
[0035]The distance detection induction device 100 of the present invention also includes a circuit wire disposing means 9. The circuit wire disposing means 9 can tidy up the wires (not shown in the figure) on the circuit board 3 effectively and fix them in the housing 1 by the screw 103.
[0036]The distance detection induction device 100 of the present invention also includes a sealing component 104 which mounted between the condensing lens 2 and the circuit board 3 for sealing. On one hand, the sealing component 104 can prevent the epoxy used for sealing from entering the light receiving means 5; for example, prevent the epoxy from entering the light receiving means 5 through the second hole 32. On the other hand, the sealing component 104 can prevent the interference light from entering the housing 1 or the light receiving means 5. In the present embodiment, the sealing component 104 is made of silicone rubber; of course, it also can be made of other sealing material. If permissible, similar seal structure can be used between the emitting lens 21 and the infrared light emitting means 4.
[0037]Shown as Fig. 8, the first hole 31 and the second hole 32 are set on the circuit board 3. The infrared light emitting means 4 projects the infrared emitting light to the emitting lens 21 through the first hole 31. The emitting lens 21 focuses the infrared emitting light to the target area. When human body or moving target goes into the target area, the infrared light is reflected. The receiving lens 22 receives and focuses the reflected infrared light onto the light receiving means 5 through the second hole 32. According to PSD triangulation principle, the light receiving means 5 surveys the distance of the target, then controls the sanitary fittings finally. Set like this, the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 can be fixed on the under side of the circuit board 3 (The side of the circuit board 3 that faces the condensing lens 2 is the upside, and the opposite side is the under side of the circuit board 3). Because the focal distance of the condensing lens 2 is set with a determinate value, the thickness of the circuit board 3 can be part of the focal distance. Meanwhile, because other electronic components are set on the circuit board 3, it can make highly efficient use of the inner space of the housing 1 and the space on either of upside or underside of the circuit board 3 to install the infrared light emitting means 4 and 5 among these electronic components. Such arrangement reduces the height and the volume of the whole distance detection induction device 100.
[0038]Moreover, as the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 are installed between the circuit board 3 and the shielding cover 6, which can block the exterior disturbance, and the external interference could be shielded effectively.
[0039]The infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 of the distance detection induction device 100 of the present invention are fixed by the positioning brackets 7 and 8 to ensure the positioning precision of the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5. The relative position of the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 to the housing 1 can be ensured by fixing the positioning bracket 7 and 8 to the housing 1 coordinately. Since welding process starts after the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 are fixed into the corresponding holders of the positioning bracket 7 and 8, so that the position precisions of the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 are not influenced by the installment. Therefore, it solves the problem that the position precisions is influenced by installation, which exist in prior art. Thus, it effectively solves the problems that the distance detection induction device 100 does not work well or even doses not work caused by the bad installation precision when the infrared light emitting means 4 and the light receiving means 5 are installed to the circuit board 3.
[0040]Moreover, the production cost of the distance detection induction device 100 of the present invention is low, in favor of the popularization and application.
[0041]Although the present invention has been described and illustrated in detail, it is clearly understood that the same is by way of illustration and example only and is not to be taken by way of limitation, the spirit and scope of the present invention.

本发明涉及一种液压凸轮轴及其液压控制系统， 尤其是汽车发动机的液压电磁凸 轮轴。 背景技术
目前， 国际上针对两段气门升程的技术已比较成熟， 通常达到这一目的的技术有 很多， 可以选择两段式的液压挺杆或者摇臂， 其中比较有代表性的是舍弗勒、 伊顿、 德尔福等公司， 也可以选择两种驱动凸轮， 例如： 本田 i一 vtec等。
对于这些零部件的控制方式除了依靠单独 ECU 之外， 普遍采用液压系统， 与电 磁控制相比较而言， 液压系统设计难度较小， 但执行时间较长， 对于对瞬时程度要求 不高的发动机来说， 液压控制系统仍然是首选。 发明内容
本发明所要解决的技术问题在于， 针对现有技术的不足提供一种液压凸轮轴及其 液压控制系统， 其结构简单并可以实现快速响应。
本发明所要解决的另一个技术问题在于， 针对现有技术的不足提供一种液压凸轮 轴及其液压控制系统， 可以改变气门升程， 提高发动机性能。
本发明所要解决的技术问题， 是通过如下技术方案实现的：
一种液压凸轮轴， 包括凸轮轴前端和凸轮轴本体， 一液压控制总成设置在凸轮轴 前端与凸轮轴本体之间， 其使液压凸轮轴沿轴方向移动。
所述液压控制总成可以使液压凸轮轴沿轴方向移动 10mm。
还包括驱动凸轮和信号轮， 驱动凸轮由两种凸轮构成， 其可根据凸轮轴的轴向位 置进行选择。
所述液压控制总成包括油孔， 导向槽和油腔， 油孔与外部油道相连并通向油腔， 油腔内的油压决定凸轮轴轴向位置， 导向槽连接凸轮轴并限制凸轮轴的轴向运动。
还包括 ECU和电磁阀， 其共同控制油腔内的油压。
一种液压电磁凸轮轴， 包括凸轮轴前端， 凸轮轴本体， 电磁阀和电控单元 ECU, 一液压控制总成设置在凸轮轴前端与凸轮轴本体之间，其使液压凸轮轴沿轴方向移动， 该液压控制总成包括油孔， 导向槽和油腔， 油孔与外部油道相连并通向油腔， 油腔内 的油压决定凸轮轴轴向位置， 导向槽连接凸轮轴并限制凸轮轴的轴向运动， 所述 ECU 和电磁阀共同控制油腔内的油压。
所述液压凸轮轴的液压控制系统， 包括电磁阀和电控单元 ECU, 所述电磁阀和电 控单元 ECU共同控制液压控制总成中的液压。
液压凸轮轴所在发动机的各缸均设有独立的液压控制系统。
第一缸、 第二缸、 第三缸、 第四缸分别设有第一缸液压控制， 第二缸液压控制， 第三缸液压控制和第四缸液压控制。
还包括传感器， 其感应并传递信号至电控单元 ECU, 电控单元 ECU将组切换信 号传送至电磁阀， 电磁阀根据信号分别控制连接凸轮轴上第一至第四缸液压控制中油 路的油压。
所述传感器为凸轮相位传感器， 其感应信号轮的信号。
相邻两缸的液压控制部分状态是相反的， 即第一缸液压控制、 第三缸液压控制为 开启时， 第二缸液压控制、 第四缸液压控制缸为关闭， 切换为各缸依次在基圆位置切 换。
换句话说， 本发明主要有如下特点：
( 1 ) 该机构中的凸轮轴前端与凸轮轴本体之间存在液压控制部分， 可以使凸轮 轴沿轴方向移动 10mm;
( 2 ) 该凸轮轴的驱动凸轮由两种凸轮构成， 可根据凸轮轴的轴向位置来选择驱 动凸轮；
( 3 ) 凸轮轴轴向位置由油腔中的油压来决定， 该油压由独立的 ECU和电磁阀操 纵；
( 4) 快速响应过程， 最常时间为 300 曲轴转角， 可避免产生失火、 回火等不正 常燃烧；
( 5 ) 各缸独立的液压控制系统， 可以使发动机在切换时选择最合适的切换时间， 提高了发动机切换时的稳定性。
本发明在控制执行方面， 依靠液压控制依次完成各缸凸轮切换， 最大限度地优化 控制系统， 为发动机瞬时响应提供可行性方案。 同时可根据发动机工况的需要， 仅单 独改变个别气缸的升程。 此技术可适用于停缸发动机。
与目前现有技术相比， 本发明的有益效果体现在： 结构简单、 实用； 气门升程为 两段式； 可提高发动机性能、 燃油经济性， 同时降低排放； 具体优势为： 实现气门升 程可变， 发动机性能显著提高； 排放、 油耗明显低于同排量的发动机； 结构简单、 紧 凑， 设计合理， 发动机整体体积无明显改变； 各缸单独控制， 控制方式灵活多变； 增 强了发动机在低速时的扭矩输出。 附图说明
图 1为本发明液压控制部分局部剖视图；
图 2为本发明液压控制关闭状态剖视图；
图 3为本发明液压控制开启状态剖视图；
图 4为本发明系统示意图。
主要元件的附图标记说明：
1 凸轮轴前端， 2—液压控制总成， 3—驱动凸轮， 4 凸轮轴本体， 5—信号轮， 6 油孔， 7—导向槽， 8 油腔， 9一第一缸液压控制， 10—第二缸液压控制， 11一第 三缸液压控制， 12—第四缸液压控制， 13—电磁阀， 14 ECU, 15—凸轮轴相位传感 器。 具体实施方式
下面结合附图和具体实施例， 对本发明的技术方案进行详细地描述， 以下所述的 实施例为本发明多种实施方式中的优选实施例。
图 1为本发明液压控制部分局部剖视图；图 2为本发明液压控制关闭状态剖视图； 图 3为本发明液压控制开启状态剖视图； 图 4为本发明系统示意图。 如图 4所示并结 合图 1-图 3， 本发明所提供的液压控制系统主要由液压电磁凸轮轴、 电磁阀 13、 凸轮 轴相位传感器 15和 ECU14等组成。
当发动机运行在中高负荷工况时， ECU14根据凸轮相位传感器 15分别将 4组切 换信号传输到电磁阀 13， 电磁阀 13根据此信号分别改变连接凸轮轴上 4个液压控制 部分油路的油压， 相邻两缸的液压控制部分状态是相反的， 即第一缸液压控制 9、 第 三缸液压控制 11为开启时， 第二缸液压控制 10、 第四缸液压控制 12则为关闭， 切换 为各缸依次在基圆位置切换， 整个切换步骤如下：
第一缸液压控制 9减压， 同时第二缸液压控制 10增压， 完成第一缸凸轮切换； 第二缸液压控制 10减压， 完成第二缸凸轮切换； 第三缸液压控制 11减压， 同时第四缸液压控制 12增压， 完成第三缸凸轮切换； 第四缸液压控制 12减压， 完成第四缸凸轮切换。
当切换到低升程时， 整个过程与以上动作相反。
在进行驱动凸轮状态切换的过程中， 外部油道的油从油孔 6进出油腔 8中， 同时 凸轮轴的轴向运动由导向槽 7的限制、 连接。
结合上面的工作原理图对本发明的技术方案作进一步的说明：
如图 1-图 3所示， 本发明还提供一种液压电磁凸轮轴， 包括： 凸轮轴前端 1， 凸 轮轴本体 4， 电磁阀 13和电控单元 ECU14, —液压控制总成 2设置在凸轮轴前端 1 与凸轮轴本体 4之间， 其使液压凸轮轴沿轴方向移动， 该液压控制总成 2包括油孔 6， 导向槽 7和油腔 8， 油孔 6与外部油道相连并通向油腔 8， 油腔 8内的油压决定凸轮轴 轴向位置， 导向槽 7连接凸轮轴并限制凸轮轴的轴向运动， 所述 ECU14和电磁阀 13 共同控制油腔 8内的油压。
所述液压凸轮轴的液压控制系统， 包括凸轮相位传感器 15， 电磁阀 13和电控单 元 ECU14, 所述电磁阀 13和电控单元 ECU14共同控制液压控制总成 2中的液压， 液 压凸轮轴所在发动机的各缸均设有独立的液压控制系统， 即： 第一缸、 第二缸、 第三 缸、 第四缸分别设有第一缸液压控制 9， 第二缸液压控制 10， 第三缸液压控制 11， 第 四缸液压控制 12， 凸轮轴相位传感器 15感应并传递信号至电控单元 ECU14, 电控单 元 ECU14将 4组切换信号传送至电磁阀 13， 电磁阀 13根据信号分别控制连接凸轮轴 上第一缸液压控制 9至第四缸液压控制至 12中油路的油压。相邻两缸的液压控制部分 状态是相反的， 即： 第一缸液压控制 9、 第三缸液压控制 11为开启时， 第二缸液压控 制 10、 第四缸液压控制 12缸为关闭， 切换为各缸依次在基圆位置切换。
